  (function extendPC04EventScanner() {
    if (!WL.EventScannerLite || typeof WL.EventScannerLite.detectFamilyHints !== 'function') return;
    const oldDetect = WL.EventScannerLite.detectFamilyHints;
    WL.EventScannerLite.detectFamilyHints = function (windowText, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, windowIndex) {
      const hits = oldDetect.call(this, windowText, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, windowIndex) || [];
      const w = WL.U.norm(windowText || '');
      if (!w || flags.commandText || flags.diagnosticText) return hits;
      const completed = this.completedAllowed ? this.completedAllowed(flags, sourceHook) : (sourceHook === 'output');
      let m;
      if (/\b(?:bleeding|burned|poisoned|sick|stunned|blinded|deafened|frozen|chilled|cursed|infected|restrained)\b/i.test(w)) {
        const st = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.extractCondition({ sourceText:w });
        hits.push(this.baseHit('body', 'body.status_gain_candidate', st, w, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, { windowIndex:windowIndex, completedAction:completed, attemptOnly:!completed, statusKey:st }));
      }
      if (/\b(?:poison fades|bleeding stops|bleeding stopped|wound closes|wound heals|recover(?:s|ed)?|rest(?:s|ed)?|is healed|heals)\b/i.test(w)) {
        const st2 = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.extractCondition({ sourceText:w });
        hits.push(this.baseHit('body', 'body.recovery_candidate', st2, w, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, { windowIndex:windowIndex, completedAction:completed, attemptOnly:!completed, statusKey:st2 }));
      }
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:lose|lost|take|takes|suffer|suffers)\s+(\d{1,4})\s+(HP|MP|EP|health|mana|stamina|energy)\b/i))) {
        hits.push(this.baseHit('body', 'body.resource_change_candidate', m[2], w, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, { windowIndex:windowIndex, completedAction:completed, attemptOnly:!completed, resourceKey:WL.PC04BodyIdentity.resourceKey(m[2]), delta:-Math.abs(Number(m[1])) }));
      }
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(HP|MP|EP|health|mana|stamina|energy)\s+(?:is|drops to|falls to|becomes)\s+(\d{1,4})\s*(?:\/\s*(\d{1,4}))?\b/i))) {
        hits.push(this.baseHit('body', 'body.resource_state_candidate', m[1], w, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, { windowIndex:windowIndex, completedAction:completed, attemptOnly:!completed, resourceKey:WL.PC04BodyIdentity.resourceKey(m[1]), current:Number(m[2]), max:m[3] ? Number(m[3]) : null }));
      }
      if (/\b(?:collapse unconscious|fall unconscious|you are unconscious|knocked unconscious)\b/i.test(w)) hits.push(this.baseHit('body', 'body.death_boundary_candidate', 'unconscious', w, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, { windowIndex:windowIndex, completedAction:completed, attemptOnly:!completed, newStatus:'unconscious' }));
      if (/\b(?:you are dying|left dying|near death|death's door)\b/i.test(w)) hits.push(this.baseHit('body', 'body.death_boundary_candidate', 'dying', w, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, { windowIndex:windowIndex, completedAction:completed, attemptOnly:!completed, newStatus:'dying' }));
      if (/\b(?:you are dead|you died|kills you|killed you|slain)\b/i.test(w)) hits.push(this.baseHit('body', 'body.death_boundary_candidate', 'dead', w, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, { windowIndex:windowIndex, completedAction:completed, attemptOnly:!completed, newStatus:'dead' }));
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:your form becomes|you transform into|you become|your body becomes)\s+(?:a\s+|an\s+)?([a-z][a-z' -]{2,60})\b/i))) hits.push(this.baseHit('body', 'body.form_change_candidate', m[1], w, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, { windowIndex:windowIndex, completedAction:completed, attemptOnly:!completed }));
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:disguised as|wearing a disguise as|illusion makes you appear as)\s+(?:a\s+|an\s+)?([a-z][a-z' -]{2,60})\b/i))) hits.push(this.baseHit('body', /illusion/i.test(w) ? 'identity.illusion_candidate' : 'identity.disguise_candidate', m[1], w, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, { windowIndex:windowIndex, completedAction:completed, attemptOnly:!completed }));
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:you have|you grow|you reveal)\s+(claws|wings|a tail|fur|scales|no human hands|quadruped movement)\b/i))) hits.push(this.baseHit('body', 'body.trait_candidate', m[1], w, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, { windowIndex:windowIndex, completedAction:completed, attemptOnly:!completed }));
      return hits.slice(0, 24);
    };
  })();

  (function extendPC04CanonValidator() {
    if (!WL.CanonValidator || typeof WL.CanonValidator.validateBody !== 'function') return;
    const oldValidateBody = WL.CanonValidator.validateBody;
    WL.CanonValidator.validateBody = function (p, root, s) {
      root = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root());
      s = s || (p && p.flags) || {};
      const t = p.type || p.eventType || '';
      const unsafe = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.unsafeFlags(p);
      if (unsafe.length) return this.reject(p, 'body/status change blocked by PC04 safety flags: ' + unsafe.join(', '), ['PC04 body safety']);
      if (t === 'body.status_gain_candidate') return this.accept(p, 'direct body/status gain candidate accepted for BodyReducer condition record', ['PC04 condition']);
      if (t === 'body.status_loss_candidate' || t === 'body.recovery_candidate') return this.accept(p, 'accepted recovery/resolution event may improve or resolve body state', ['PC04 recovery']);
      if (t === 'body.injury_candidate') return this.accept(p, 'direct physical injury outcome accepted for InjuryRecord', ['PC04 injury']);
      if (t === 'body.resource_change_candidate' || t === 'body.resource_state_candidate') return this.accept(p, 'direct resource state/change accepted; clamp is structural only', ['PC04 resource']);
      if (t === 'body.death_boundary_candidate' || t === 'body.death_claim') {
        const status = (p.newStatus || p.data && p.data.newStatus || p.target && p.target.display || '').toLowerCase();
        if (/dead/.test(status) || /\b(?:you died|you are dead|killed you|slain)\b/i.test(p.sourceText || '')) return this.pending(p, 'direct death requires explicit high-safety death policy; not auto-committed in PC04', ['PC04 death boundary']);
        if (/unconscious/.test(status) || /unconscious/i.test(p.sourceText || '')) return this.accept(p, 'unconscious accepted as distinct from dead', ['PC04 death boundary']);
        if (/dying/.test(status) || /dying|near death/i.test(p.sourceText || '')) return this.accept(p, 'dying accepted as distinct from dead', ['PC04 death boundary']);
        return this.pending(p, 'death boundary candidate pending: ' + (status || 'unknown'), ['PC04 death boundary']);
      }
      if (t === 'body.fatigue') return this.accept(p, /\b(?:exhausted|barely stand|drained completely|collapsed)\b/i.test(p.sourceText || '') ? 'explicit exhaustion/collapse wording accepted distinctly' : 'fatigue accepted without upgrading to exhaustion', ['PC04 fatigue']);
      if (t === 'body.injury') return this.accept(p, 'direct literal injury/status wording accepted for InjuryRecord', ['PC04 injury']);
      if (t === 'body.form_change_candidate') return this.pending(p, 'form change stored as candidate until transformation policy is active', ['PC04 form candidate']);
      if (t === 'body.trait_candidate' || t === 'identity.trait_candidate' || t === 'identity.form_candidate') return this.pending(p, 'trait/form evidence stays candidate/pending, not confirmed body truth', ['PC04 candidate trait']);
      if (t === 'identity.disguise_candidate' || t === 'identity.illusion_candidate') return this.accept(p, 'disguise/illusion presentation accepted without overwriting body truth', ['PC04 presentation']);
      return oldValidateBody.call(this, p, root, s);
    };
  })();

  (function extendPC04BodyReducer() {
    if (!WL.BodyReducer) WL.BodyReducer = {};
    WL.BodyReducer.pc04DefensiveLocked = true;
    WL.BodyReducer.apply = function (root, v) {
      root = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root());
      v = v || {};
      const type = v.type || v.eventType || '';
      const unsafe = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.unsafeFlags(v);
      if (unsafe.length) return { type:type, status:'rejected_by_reducer_guard', reason:'unsafe body flags: ' + unsafe.join(', ') };
      if (/^body\.death/.test(type) && /dead/i.test(v.target && v.target.display || v.newStatus || '') && !(v.data && v.data.explicitDeathPolicy === true)) return { type:type, status:'pending_death_policy', reason:'direct death requires explicit high-safety death policy' };
      if (type === 'body.fatigue') {
        const src = v.sourceText || '';
        let state = 'fatigued', sev = 'minor';
        if (/\b(?:winded|out of breath)\b/i.test(src)) { state = 'winded'; sev = 'minor'; }
        if (/\b(?:fatigued|worn out|weary)\b/i.test(src)) { state = /weary/i.test(src) ? 'weary' : 'fatigued'; sev = 'moderate'; }
        if (/\b(?:exhausted|barely stand|drained completely)\b/i.test(src)) { state = 'exhausted'; sev = 'major'; }
        if (/\b(?:collapsed|unable to stand)\b/i.test(src)) { state = 'collapsed'; sev = 'critical'; }
        root.body.fatigueState = state; root.body.fatigueSeverity = sev; root.body.exhaustionState = (state === 'exhausted' || state === 'collapsed') ? state : 'not_exhausted'; root.body.fatigue = state === 'rested' ? 'normal' : state;
        if (state !== 'rested') WL.PC04BodyIdentity.makeConditionRecord(root, state === 'exhausted' || state === 'collapsed' ? 'exhausted' : 'fatigued', v, 'active');
        WL.PC04BodyIdentity.markBodyDirty(root, 'body_status', 'fatigue/exhaustion changed', v, 1);
        return { type:type, status:'committed', target:state, severity:sev };
      }
      if (type === 'body.status_gain_candidate') {
        const st = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.extractCondition(v); const rec = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.makeConditionRecord(root, st, v, 'active');
        WL.PC04BodyIdentity.markBodyDirty(root, 'body_status', 'condition gained: ' + rec.displayName, v, 1);
        return { type:type, status:'committed', target:rec.displayName, recordId:rec.id };
      }
      if (type === 'body.status_loss_candidate' || type === 'body.recovery_candidate') {
        const st = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.extractCondition(v); const rec = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.makeConditionRecord(root, st, v, 'resolved');
        if (root.body.resolvedConditionIds.indexOf(rec.id) < 0) root.body.resolvedConditionIds.push(rec.id);
        root.body.conditions = (root.body.conditions || []).filter(function (c) { return WL.U.slug(c) !== rec.key; });
        WL.PC04BodyIdentity.markBodyDirty(root, 'body_status', 'condition recovery/resolution: ' + rec.displayName, v, 1);
        return { type:type, status:'committed_recovery', target:rec.displayName, recordId:rec.id };
      }
      if (type === 'body.injury' || type === 'body.injury_candidate') {
        let display = 'injury';
        const src = v.sourceText || '';
        if (/wolf bite|bitten|bite/i.test(src)) display = 'wolf bite on ' + WL.PC04BodyIdentity.extractBodyPart(src);
        else if (/burn/i.test(src)) display = 'burned ' + WL.PC04BodyIdentity.extractBodyPart(src);
        else if (/cut|deep cut/i.test(src)) display = 'cut ' + WL.PC04BodyIdentity.extractBodyPart(src);
        else if (v.target && v.target.display) display = v.target.display;
        const rec = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.makeInjuryRecord(root, display, v, 'active');
        WL.PC04BodyIdentity.markBodyDirty(root, 'body_status', 'injury gained: ' + rec.displayName, v, 1);
        return { type:type, status:'committed', target:rec.displayName, recordId:rec.id };
      }
      if (type === 'body.resource_change_candidate' || type === 'body.resource_state_candidate') {
        const key = v.resourceKey || (v.data && v.data.resourceKey) || WL.PC04BodyIdentity.resourceKey(v.target && (v.target.display || v.target.raw) || '');
        const r = root.body.resources[key];
        if (!r) return { type:type, status:'rejected', reason:'unknown resource' };
        r.known = true; r.source = 'validated_body_event'; r.lastChangedTurn = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.now(root);
        if (type === 'body.resource_state_candidate') {
          const max = Number(v.max || (v.data && v.data.max) || r.max || (key === 'mp' ? root.body.maxMp : (key === 'ep' ? root.body.maxEp : root.body.maxHp)) || 1);
          r.max = WL.U.clamp(max, 1, 999999);
          r.current = WL.U.clamp(Number(v.current != null ? v.current : (v.data && v.data.current != null ? v.data.current : r.current || r.max)), 0, r.max);
        } else {
          if (r.max == null) r.max = key === 'mp' ? root.body.maxMp : (key === 'ep' ? root.body.maxEp : root.body.maxHp);
          if (r.current == null) r.current = r.max;
          r.current = WL.U.clamp(Number(r.current) + Number(v.delta || (v.data && v.data.delta) || 0), 0, Number(r.max || 1));
        }
        if (key === 'hp') { root.body.hp = r.current; root.body.maxHp = r.max; root.body.hpTrack.current = r.current; root.body.hpTrack.max = r.max; }
        if (key === 'mp') { root.body.mp = r.current; root.body.maxMp = r.max; root.body.mpTrack.current = r.current; root.body.mpTrack.max = r.max; }
        if (key === 'ep') { root.body.ep = r.current; root.body.maxEp = r.max; root.body.epTrack.current = r.current; root.body.epTrack.max = r.max; }
        WL.PC04BodyIdentity.markBodyDirty(root, 'body_status', 'resource changed: ' + key, v, 2);
        return { type:type, status:'committed', target:key, current:r.current, max:r.max, structuralClampOnly:true };
      }
      if (type === 'body.death_boundary_candidate') {
        const ns = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.allowed(WL.PC04_ALLOWED_DEATH_BOUNDARIES, (v.newStatus || v.target && v.target.display || '').toLowerCase(), 'unknown');
        if (ns === 'dead' && !(v.data && v.data.explicitDeathPolicy === true)) return { type:type, status:'pending_death_policy', reason:'dead requires explicit policy' };
        root.body.deathBoundary = ns; root.body.deathBoundaryStatus = ns;
        if (ns === 'unconscious') WL.PC04BodyIdentity.makeConditionRecord(root, 'unconscious', v, 'active');
        WL.PC04BodyIdentity.markBodyDirty(root, 'body_status', 'death boundary changed: ' + ns, v, 0);
        return { type:type, status:'committed', target:ns };
      }
      if (type === 'identity.disguise_candidate' || type === 'identity.illusion_candidate') {
        const val = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.displayUnknown(v.target && v.target.display || v.name || '', '');
        if (type === 'identity.disguise_candidate') root.player.identity.activeDisguise = root.player.activeDisguise = val;
        else root.player.identity.activeIllusion = root.player.activeIllusion = val;
        WL.PC04BodyIdentity.markBodyDirty(root, 'player_sheet', 'presentation changed: ' + val, v, 2);
        return { type:type, status:'committed_presentation_only', target:val };
      }
      if (type === 'body.form_change_candidate' || type === 'body.trait_candidate' || type === 'identity.trait_candidate' || type === 'identity.form_candidate') {
        const val2 = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.displayUnknown(v.target && v.target.display || v.name || '', 'unknown');
        WL.U.uniquePush(root.player.identity.candidateTraits, val2, 30);
        WL.U.uniquePush(root.body.candidateTraits, val2, 30);
        WL.PC04BodyIdentity.markBodyDirty(root, 'player_sheet', 'candidate body/form trait: ' + val2, v, 2);
        return { type:type, status:'candidate_recorded', target:val2 };
      }
      return { type:type, status:'pending_or_rejected', reason:v.reason || 'No PC04 body reducer handler.' };
    };
  })();

  (function extendPC04CommandsAndContext() {
    const line = function (label, value) { return label + ': ' + (value == null || value === '' ? 'unknown' : value); };
    WL.CommandRenderer.sheet = function (root) {
      root = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const p = root.player, id = p.identity;
      return this.header('Player Sheet') + [
        'PC04 identity model: true identity is protected; current form/disguise/candidates do not overwrite body truth.',
        line('Confirmed identity', id.confirmedName),
        line('True identity', id.trueIdentity),
        'Aliases: ' + WL.PC04BodyIdentity.lineList(id.aliases),
        line('Origin status', p.origin.status),
        line('Origin type', p.origin.type),
        line('World knowledge', p.worldKnowledgeStatus + ' (default limited/unknown unless confirmed)'),
        line('World integration', p.worldIntegrationStatus),
        line('Centrality assumption', p.centralityAssumption),
        line('True race/species', id.trueRaceSpecies + ' (unknown is not assumed human)'),
        line('Lineage', id.lineage),
        line('Current form', id.currentForm),
        line('Body type', id.bodyType),
        line('Disguise', id.activeDisguise || 'none confirmed'),
        line('Illusion', id.activeIllusion || 'none confirmed'),
        line('Presentation', id.presentation),
        'Confirmed traits: ' + WL.PC04BodyIdentity.lineList(id.confirmedTraits),
        'Candidate traits: ' + WL.PC04BodyIdentity.lineList(id.candidateTraits),
        'Pending traits: ' + WL.PC04BodyIdentity.lineList(id.pendingTraits),
        'Rumored traits: ' + WL.PC04BodyIdentity.lineList(id.rumoredTraits),
        'Protected fields: confirmedName, trueRaceSpecies, trueIdentity',
        'No gameplay state was changed.'
      ].join('\n') + '\n';
    };
    WL.CommandRenderer.status = function (root) {
      root = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const b = root.body;
      const activeCon = b.conditionIds.map(function (id) { return b.conditionRecordsById[id]; }).filter(function (r) { return r && r.status === 'active'; }).map(function (r) { return r.displayName + ' [' + r.severity + ']'; });
      const activeInj = b.injuryIds.map(function (id) { return b.injuryRecordsById[id]; }).filter(function (r) { return r && r.status === 'active'; }).map(function (r) { return r.displayName + ' @ ' + r.bodyPart + ' [' + r.severity + ']'; });
      const resolved = b.resolvedConditionIds.concat(b.resolvedInjuryIds).slice(-8);
      return this.header('Status') + [
        'PC04 body model: fatigue ≠ exhaustion; unconscious/dying ≠ dead; cleanup cannot heal.',
        WL.PC04BodyIdentity.resourceText(root, 'hp'),
        WL.PC04BodyIdentity.resourceText(root, 'mp'),
        WL.PC04BodyIdentity.resourceText(root, 'ep'),
        'Fatigue: ' + b.fatigueState + ' / severity ' + b.fatigueSeverity,
        'Exhaustion: ' + b.exhaustionState,
        'Death boundary: ' + b.deathBoundaryStatus,
        'Active conditions: ' + (activeCon.length ? activeCon.join(', ') : 'none'),
        'Active injuries: ' + (activeInj.length ? activeInj.join(', ') : 'none'),
        'Resolved/recovery history: ' + (resolved.length ? resolved.join(', ') : 'none'),
        'Body traits/constraints: ' + WL.PC04BodyIdentity.lineList(b.bodyTraits.concat(b.bodyConstraints)),
        'Candidate/pending traits: ' + WL.PC04BodyIdentity.lineList(b.candidateTraits.concat(b.pendingTraits)),
        'Warnings: rumor/quote/dream/command/context/card text cannot create body truth.',
        'No gameplay state was changed.'
      ].join('\n') + '\n';
    };
    if (WL.ContextBuilderLite) {
      const oldBuildPackets = WL.ContextBuilderLite.buildPackets;
      WL.ContextBuilderLite.buildPackets = function (root) {
        root = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root());
        const packets = oldBuildPackets ? oldBuildPackets.call(this, root) || [] : [];
        const p = root.player.identity, b = root.body;
        const text = 'Player body truth: true race/species=' + (p.trueRaceSpecies || 'unknown') + '; current form=' + (p.currentForm || 'unknown') + '; disguise=' + (p.activeDisguise || 'none') + '; illusion=' + (p.activeIllusion || 'none') + '; fatigue=' + b.fatigueState + '/' + b.fatigueSeverity + '; death boundary=' + b.deathBoundaryStatus + '; active conditions=' + b.conditionIds.filter(function (id) { const r=b.conditionRecordsById[id]; return r && r.status === 'active'; }).map(function (id) { return b.conditionRecordsById[id].displayName; }).join(', ') + '; active injuries=' + b.injuryIds.filter(function (id) { const r=b.injuryRecordsById[id]; return r && r.status === 'active'; }).map(function (id) { return b.injuryRecordsById[id].displayName; }).join(', ') + '; candidate traits=' + (p.candidateTraits || []).join(', ') + '. Candidate/pending/rumored traits are not confirmed truth.';
        if (this.makePacket) packets.push(this.makePacket(root, { family:'player_body', priority:1, text:text, sourceStateKeys:['player.identity','body.conditionRecordsById','body.injuryRecordsById','body.resources'], reason:'PC04 player/body packet', maxAgeTurns:2 }));
        else packets.push({ family:'player_body', priority:1, text:text, safeForModel:true, reason:'PC04 player/body packet' });
        return packets;
      };
    }
  })();

  WL.ProductionChunk04 = {
    lockVersion: WL.PRODUCTION_CHUNK_04_LOCK_VERSION,
    statusFor(ok, label, failStatus) { return { status: ok ? 'PASS' : (failStatus || 'FAIL'), label: label }; },
    snapshot(root) { root = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); return WL.PC04BodyIdentity.playerSnapshot(root); },
    inspect(root) {
      root = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root());
      const rows = [];
      const p = root.player, id = p.identity, b = root.body;
      rows.push(this.statusFor(/^0\.18\.3-rc-assembly-pc04/.test(WL.BUILD_VERSION), 'PC04-G00 build identity active: ' + WL.BUILD_VERSION));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(id && id.trueIdentity != null && id.currentForm != null && id.activeDisguise != null && Array.isArray(id.candidateTraits), 'PC04-G01 player identity/form/disguise fields separated'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor((id.trueRaceSpecies || 'unknown') !== 'human' || p.origin.type !== 'unknown', 'PC04-G02 unknown race/species not defaulted to human'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(['unknown','limited'].indexOf(p.worldKnowledgeStatus) >= 0 || p.origin.type === 'scenario_defined', 'PC04-G03 world knowledge starts limited/unknown unless confirmed'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(b.resources && ['hp','mp','ep'].every(function (k) { const r=b.resources[k]; return r && typeof r.known === 'boolean' && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, 'current') && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, 'max'); }), 'PC04-G04 body resource model supports known/unknown values'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(b.fatigueState && b.exhaustionState && !(b.fatigueState === 'fatigued' && b.exhaustionState === 'exhausted'), 'PC04-G05 fatigue and exhaustion are separated'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(b.conditionRecordsById && Array.isArray(b.conditionIds), 'PC04-G06 condition record schema exists'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(b.injuryRecordsById && Array.isArray(b.injuryIds), 'PC04-G07 injury record schema exists'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(WL.PC04_ALLOWED_DEATH_BOUNDARIES.indexOf(b.deathBoundaryStatus) >= 0, 'PC04-G08 death boundary allowed values enforced'));
      let v, proposal;
      proposal = WL.CanonValidator.makeTestProposal(root,'body.status_gain_candidate','body','Mara says "you are poisoned"',{targetDisplay:'poisoned', riskFlags:['quote_present']}); v = WL.CanonValidator.validate(proposal, root); rows.push(this.statusFor(v.status === 'rejected', 'PC04-G09 body CanonValidator rejects rumor/quote/dream/metaphor death/status'));
      const br = WL.BodyReducer.apply(root, { type:'body.death_boundary_candidate', family:'body', target:{display:'dead'}, flags:{rumorOrClaim:true}, sourceHook:'output', sourceText:'People say you died.', result:'accept', status:'accepted' }); rows.push(this.statusFor(/rejected_by_reducer_guard/.test(br.status), 'PC04-G10 BodyReducer rejects unsafe routed body/death events'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(b.recoveryPolicy && b.recoveryPolicy.requiresAcceptedRecoveryEvent === true, 'PC04-G11 recovery requires accepted recovery event'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(b.recoveryPolicy && b.recoveryPolicy.cleanupMayResolve === false, 'PC04-G12 cleanup cannot heal/remove active body state'));
      const dirty = WL.DirtyQueue.addRecord ? WL.DirtyQueue.addRecord(root, 'body_status', 'pc04_probe', 'pc04 dirty probe', { sourceReducer:'PC04Inspect', priority:3 }) : WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'body_status', 'pc04 dirty probe'); rows.push(this.statusFor(!!dirty || (root.dirty && Array.isArray(root.dirty.records || root.dirty.targets)), 'PC04-G13 body/player dirty targets created'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(/Confirmed identity/i.test(WL.CommandRenderer.sheet(root)) && /Candidate traits/i.test(WL.CommandRenderer.sheet(root)) && /unknown is not assumed human/i.test(WL.CommandRenderer.sheet(root)), 'PC04-G14 /sheet displays confirmed/candidate/unknown fields honestly'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(/Fatigue/i.test(WL.CommandRenderer.status(root)) && /Exhaustion/i.test(WL.CommandRenderer.status(root)) && /Death boundary/i.test(WL.CommandRenderer.status(root)), 'PC04-G15 /status displays body states honestly'));
      const packetText = (WL.ContextBuilderLite.buildPackets(root) || []).map(function (p) { return p.text || ''; }).join('\n'); rows.push(this.statusFor(/Candidate\/pending\/rumored traits are not confirmed truth/i.test(packetText), 'PC04-G16 body context packet labels candidate/pending truth correctly'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(typeof WL.PC04BodyIdentity.opKey === 'function' && /body\.status\.add/.test(WL.PC04BodyIdentity.opKey('status.add','fatigued',{sourceText:'test'})), 'PC04-G17 operation keys exist for repeat-sensitive body effects'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(WL.ProductionChunk04.runSelfTests().length >= 24, 'PC04-G18 player-breaker body/death tests registered'));
      return rows;
    },
    runSelfTests() {
      const results = []; const add = function (id, ok, label) { results.push({ id:id, ok:!!ok, label:label }); };
      const save = globalThis.state;
      try {
        globalThis.state = {}; let root = WL.StateManager.root(), before, after, out, hits, props, vals, res, v, p;
        add('PC04-001', root.player.identity.trueRaceSpecies === 'unknown' && !/human/i.test(root.player.identity.trueRaceSpecies), 'Unknown race not assumed human');
        root.player.identity.trueRaceSpecies = 'elf'; root.player.identity.currentForm = 'wolf'; WL.PC04BodyIdentity.ensure(root); add('PC04-002', root.player.identity.trueRaceSpecies === 'elf' && root.player.identity.currentForm === 'wolf', 'Current form does not overwrite true race');
        root.player.identity.activeDisguise = 'old merchant'; WL.PC04BodyIdentity.ensure(root); add('PC04-003', root.player.identity.trueRaceSpecies === 'elf' && root.player.identity.activeDisguise === 'old merchant', 'Disguise does not overwrite body truth');

    categoryFor(name) {
      const l = WL.U.lower(name || '');
      if (/\b(?:sword|dagger|blade|axe|bow|arrow|spear|mace|staff)\b/.test(l)) return /arrow/.test(l) ? 'weapon' : 'weapon';
      if (/\b(?:armor|helm|helmet|mail|gauntlet|boots|greaves)\b/.test(l)) return 'armor';
      if (/\bshield\b/.test(l)) return 'shield';
      if (/\bkey\b/.test(l)) return 'key';
      if (/\b(?:potion|elixir|tonic|medicine)\b/.test(l)) return 'consumable';
      if (/\b(?:bread|apple|meat|ration|food)\b/.test(l)) return 'food';
      if (/\b(?:wine|ale|water|drink)\b/.test(l)) return 'drink';
      if (/\b(?:ring|necklace|amulet|crown|gem|jewel)\b/.test(l)) return 'jewelry';
      if (/\b(?:book|tome|scroll|journal)\b/.test(l)) return 'book';
      if (/\b(?:ore|ingot|wood|stone|cloth|material)\b/.test(l)) return 'material';
      if (/\b(?:coin|copper|silver|gold)\b/.test(l)) return 'currency';
      return 'misc';
    },
    repairItemRecords(root) {
      const inv = root.inventory || {};
      const by = inv.itemsById || {};
      Object.keys(by).forEach((id) => {
        const rec = by[id] || {};
        const display = this.displayName(rec);
        const key = rec.key || this.itemKey(display);
        rec.id = rec.id || key;
        rec.key = key;
        rec.displayName = display;
        rec.name = rec.name || display;
        rec.normalizedName = WL.U.lower(display);
        if (typeof rec.quantity !== 'number') rec.quantity = WL.U.clamp(rec.qty || 1, 1, 9999);
        rec.qty = rec.quantity;
        if (rec.quantity < 0) {
          this.quarantine(root, 'negative_quantity', id, 'negative quantity on item record: ' + display, 'high');
          rec.quantity = 0; rec.qty = 0; rec.accessState = 'unknown';
          inv.ownedIds = (inv.ownedIds || []).filter(function (x) { return x !== id && x !== key; });
        }
        if (!rec.category) rec.category = this.categoryFor(display);
        if (!Array.isArray(rec.tags)) rec.tags = [];
        if (typeof rec.stackable !== 'boolean') rec.stackable = !/\b(?:named|unique|crown|artifact|sword|shield|armor)\b/i.test(display);
        if (typeof rec.unique !== 'boolean') rec.unique = !rec.stackable;
        if (!rec.durability || typeof rec.durability !== 'object' || Array.isArray(rec.durability)) rec.durability = { state:'unknown', value:null, max:null };
        if (!rec.accessState) rec.accessState = (inv.ownedIds || []).indexOf(id) >= 0 || (inv.ownedIds || []).indexOf(key) >= 0 ? 'carried' : 'unknown';
        if (!WL.PC05_ACCESS_STATES.includes(rec.accessState)) rec.accessState = 'unknown';
        if (!rec.owner) rec.owner = this.playerAccess[rec.accessState] ? 'player' : 'unknown';
        if (!rec.holder) rec.holder = this.playerAccess[rec.accessState] ? 'player' : 'unknown';
        if (!Array.isArray(rec.historyKeys)) rec.historyKeys = [];
        if (!Array.isArray(rec.warnings)) rec.warnings = [];
        if (!Array.isArray(rec.notes)) rec.notes = [];
        if (typeof rec.createdTurn !== 'number') rec.createdTurn = this.now(root);
        rec.updatedTurn = this.now(root);
        by[id] = rec;
        if (id !== key && !by[key]) { by[key] = rec; delete by[id]; }
      });
      inv.ownedIds = (inv.ownedIds || []).map(function (id) { const rec = by[id]; return rec && rec.key || id; }).filter(function (id, idx, arr) { const rec = by[id]; return rec && WL.PC05Inventory.playerAccess[rec.accessState] && arr.indexOf(id) === idx; });
      return inv;
    },
    cleanTargetName(value) { return WL.ItemNameSanitizer.clean(value).displayName; },
    unsafeReasons(v) {
      const flags = Object.assign({}, (v && v.flags) || {}, (v && v.safety) || {});
      const text = WL.U.lower((v && (v.sourceText || v.localClausePreview || '')) || '');
      const source = WL.U.slug((v && (v.sourceKind || v.sourceHook || (v.source && v.source.sourceKind))) || '');
      const out = [];
      if (/^(?:command|command_output|context|story_card|protected_card|generated_card|debug|audit|releasecheck)$/.test(source)) out.push('unsafe_source');
      if (/^\s*\[(?:worldledger|aidrpg)\]/i.test(text)) out.push('diagnostic_text');
      if (flags.quotedSpeech || flags.quote) out.push('quotedSpeech');
      if (flags.dreamOrVision || flags.dream) out.push('dreamOrVision');
      if (flags.rumorOrClaim || flags.rumor) out.push('rumorOrClaim');
      if (flags.abstractOrMetaphorical || flags.abstractOrIdea || /\b(?:idea of|concept of|thought of|memory of|dream of)\b/i.test(text)) out.push('abstractOrMetaphorical');
      if (flags.failedOrRevoked || flags.denied || flags.negatedOrRefused || flags.deniedByLocalClause || flags.revokedByLocalClause || /\b(?:refuses?|declines?|denies?|snatches?.*away|fails?|failed|cannot|can't|no item is gained|decide not|not take|leave it)\b/i.test(text)) out.push('deniedOrFailed');
      if (flags.futureIntent || flags.hypothetical) out.push('futureOrHypothetical');
      if (flags.attemptOnly || (v && (v.sourceKind === 'input' || v.sourceHook === 'input'))) out.push('attemptOnly');
      return Array.from(new Set(out));
    },
    addHistory(root, rec) {
      const inv = this.ensure(root);
      const h = Object.assign({ historyId:'hist_' + WL.U.hash(JSON.stringify(rec || {}) + '|' + inv.itemHistory.length), turn:this.now(root), notes:[] }, rec || {});
      inv.itemHistory.push(h);
      inv.log = inv.itemHistory;
      WL.U.capArray(inv.itemHistory, 160);
      return h;
    },
    quarantine(root, sourceKey, itemKey, reason, severity) {
      root = root || WL.StateManager.root();
      if (!root.quarantine || !Array.isArray(root.quarantine.records)) return null;
      const q = { quarantineId:'pc05_q_' + WL.U.hash([sourceKey,itemKey,reason,WL.U.nowTurn(root)].join('|')), category:'inventory', source:'PC05Inventory', sourceKey:String(sourceKey || ''), originalPreview:String(itemKey || '').slice(0,180), reason:String(reason || 'inventory quarantine'), severity:severity || 'medium', suggestedAction:'Review manually; do not import as canon automatically.', status:'inactive', createdTurn:this.now(root), notes:[] };
      root.quarantine.records.push(q); WL.U.capArray(root.quarantine.records, WL.SCHEMA_CAPS.quarantine || 40);
      return q;
    },
    makeItemRecord(root, name, qty, v, accessState) {
      const clean = WL.ItemNameSanitizer.clean(name);
      const key = this.itemKey(clean.displayName);
      const now = this.now(root);
      return { id:key, key:key, displayName:clean.displayName, name:clean.displayName, normalizedName:WL.U.lower(clean.displayName), quantity:WL.U.clamp(qty || clean.quantity || 1, 1, 9999), category:this.categoryFor(clean.displayName), tags:clean.tags || [], stackable:!(/\b(?:crown|artifact|named|unique)\b/i.test(clean.displayName)), unique:/\b(?:crown|artifact|named|unique)\b/i.test(clean.displayName), durability:{ state:'unknown', value:null, max:null }, accessState:accessState || 'carried', owner:(accessState === 'npc_custody' || accessState === 'place_custody') ? 'player' : 'player', holder:(accessState === 'npc_custody' || accessState === 'place_custody') ? 'unknown' : 'player', custodyKey:'', locationKey:root.places && (root.places.currentId || root.places.currentLocation) || '', equippedSlot:'', sourceOperationKey:v && (v.opKey || v.operationKey) || '', sourceEventId:v && (v.proposalId || v.id) || '', createdTurn:now, updatedTurn:now, historyKeys:[], warnings:clean.flags || [], notes:[] };
    },
    addOrMergeOwned(root, name, qty, v, accessState) {
      const inv = this.ensure(root);
      const rec = this.makeItemRecord(root, name, qty, v, accessState || 'carried');
      const existing = inv.itemsById[rec.key];
      let final = rec;
      if (existing && existing.stackable !== false && rec.stackable !== false && !existing.unique) {
        existing.quantity = WL.U.clamp((existing.quantity || existing.qty || 1) + rec.quantity, 1, 9999); existing.qty = existing.quantity; existing.updatedTurn = this.now(root); existing.accessState = accessState || existing.accessState || 'carried'; existing.owner = 'player'; existing.holder = 'player'; final = existing;
      } else if (existing && existing.unique) {
        final = existing;
      } else {
        inv.itemsById[rec.key] = rec;
      }
      if (this.playerAccess[final.accessState] && inv.ownedIds.indexOf(final.key) < 0) inv.ownedIds.push(final.key);
      this.addHistory(root, { itemKey:final.key, eventType:'acquire', fromAccessState:'unknown', toAccessState:final.accessState, operationKey:v && (v.opKey || v.operationKey) || '', summary:'acquired ' + final.displayName });
      return final;
    },
    addScene(root, name, qty, accessState, v) {
      const inv = this.ensure(root);
      const clean = WL.ItemNameSanitizer.clean(name);
      const key = this.sceneKey(clean.displayName, root, v && v.sourceText || '');
      const rec = { id:key, key:key, displayName:clean.displayName, quantity:WL.U.clamp(qty || clean.quantity || 1, 1, 9999), accessState:accessState || 'visible', locationKey:root.places && (root.places.currentId || root.places.currentLocation) || '', sceneKey:root.places && (root.places.currentId || root.places.currentLocation) || 'scene', holderKey:'', visibility: accessState === 'inaccessible' ? 'obscured' : 'visible', reachable: accessState === 'available_loot', sourceOperationKey:v && (v.opKey || v.operationKey) || '', createdTurn:this.now(root), updatedTurn:this.now(root), expiresTurn:this.now(root)+12, notes:[] };
      inv.sceneItemsById[key] = rec;
      if (inv.sceneItems.indexOf(key) < 0) inv.sceneItems.push(key);
      const list = accessState === 'available_loot' ? inv.availableSceneItems : (accessState === 'offered' ? inv.offeredSceneItems : inv.visibleSceneItems);
      WL.U.uniquePush(list, rec.displayName, 30);
      this.addHistory(root, { itemKey:rec.key, eventType:accessState, fromAccessState:'unknown', toAccessState:accessState, operationKey:v && (v.opKey || v.operationKey) || '', summary:'scene item: ' + rec.displayName });
      return rec;
    },
    addCustody(root, name, holderType, holderName, v) {
      const inv = this.ensure(root);
      const clean = WL.ItemNameSanitizer.clean(name);
      const itemKey = this.itemKey(clean.displayName);
      const holderKey = holderName ? WL.Resolver.canonicalId(holderType === 'place' ? 'place' : 'actor', holderName) : 'holder_unknown';
      const key = this.custodyKey(itemKey, holderKey, v && v.sourceText || '');
      const rec = { id:key, itemKey:itemKey, itemDisplayName:clean.displayName, holderType:holderType || 'unknown', holderKey:holderKey, holderDisplayName:holderName || 'unknown', accessState:holderType === 'place' ? 'place_custody' : 'npc_custody', locationKey:root.places && (root.places.currentId || root.places.currentLocation) || '', sourceOperationKey:v && (v.opKey || v.operationKey) || '', createdTurn:this.now(root), updatedTurn:this.now(root), notes:[] };
      inv.custody[key] = rec;
      this.addHistory(root, { itemKey:itemKey, eventType:'custody', fromAccessState:'unknown', toAccessState:rec.accessState, actorKey:holderKey, operationKey:v && (v.opKey || v.operationKey) || '', summary:'custody: ' + rec.itemDisplayName + ' held by ' + rec.holderDisplayName });
      return rec;
    },
    getOwned(root, itemKey) { const inv = this.ensure(root); const rec = inv.itemsById[itemKey] || inv.itemsById[this.itemKey(itemKey)]; return rec && this.playerAccess[rec.accessState] ? rec : null; },
    setInactive(root, itemKey, state, v) {
      const inv = this.ensure(root); const key = inv.itemsById[itemKey] ? itemKey : this.itemKey(itemKey); const rec = inv.itemsById[key];
      if (!rec || !this.playerAccess[rec.accessState]) return { status:'rejected_by_reducer_guard', reason:'item is not owned/carried/equipped/stored' };
      const from = rec.accessState; rec.accessState = state; rec.holder = 'none'; rec.updatedTurn = this.now(root); rec.equippedSlot = '';
      inv.ownedIds = inv.ownedIds.filter(function (x) { return x !== key; });
      Object.keys(inv.equipment || {}).forEach(function (slot) { if (inv.equipment[slot] === key) inv.equipment[slot] = ''; if (inv.equipped && inv.equipped[slot] === key) inv.equipped[slot] = ''; });
      this.addHistory(root, { itemKey:key, eventType:state, fromAccessState:from, toAccessState:state, operationKey:v && (v.opKey || v.operationKey) || '', summary:state + ': ' + rec.displayName });
      return { status:'committed', record:rec };
    },
    recordOperation(root, bucket, key, data) {
      if (!key) return false;
      if (bucket === 'reward') return WL.OperationLedger.addReward(root, key, data);
      if (bucket === 'currency') return WL.OperationLedger.add(root, 'currencyKeys', key, data);
      if (bucket === 'item') return WL.OperationLedger.add(root, 'itemKeys', key, data);
      return WL.OperationLedger.addRecent(root, key, data);
    },
    hasOperation(root, bucket, key) {
      if (!key) return false;
      if (bucket === 'reward') return WL.OperationLedger.hasReward(root, key);
      if (bucket === 'currency') return WL.OperationLedger.has(root, 'currencyKeys', key);
      if (bucket === 'item') return WL.OperationLedger.has(root, 'itemKeys', key);
      return WL.OperationLedger.hasRecent(root, key);
    },
    opKey(type, nameOrAmount, v, extra) { return WL.OperationLedger.makeKey([String(type || 'item.event'), this.slug(nameOrAmount || 'target'), this.sourceHash(v), extra || '']); },
    keyBucketForType(type) { if (/^currency\./.test(type) || /^reward\.currency\.pay/.test(type)) return 'reward'; if (/^item\./.test(type)) return 'item'; return 'recent'; },
    statsSnapshot(root) { const b = root.body || {}; const p = root.player || {}; return JSON.stringify({ hp:b.hp, mp:b.mp, ep:b.ep, maxHp:b.maxHp, maxMp:b.maxMp, maxEp:b.maxEp, atk:p.atk, def:p.def, spd:p.spd, int:p.int, lck:p.lck }); }
  };

  WL.ItemNameSanitizer = {
    numberWords: Object.freeze({ one:1, two:2, three:3, four:4, five:5, six:6, seven:7, eight:8, nine:9, ten:10 }),
    clean(value) {
      let raw = WL.U.norm(value || '').replace(/[“”"']/g, '');
      let flags = [];
      if (/\b(?:idea of|concept of|thought of|memory of|dream of|symbol of)\b/i.test(raw)) flags.push('abstractOrMetaphorical');
      raw = raw.replace(/^\s*(?:the|a|an|some|your|my|his|her|their)\s+/i, '');
      let quantity = 1;
      const q = raw.match(/^\s*(\d+|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten)\s+(.+)$/i);
      if (q) { quantity = /^\d+$/.test(q[1]) ? parseInt(q[1],10) : (this.numberWords[WL.U.lower(q[1])] || 1); raw = q[2]; }
      raw = raw.replace(/\b(?:that|which)\s+(?:mira|he|she|they|the\s+\w+)\s+(?:refuses?|declines?|won't|will not)\b[\s\S]*$/i, '');
      raw = raw.replace(/\s+(?:from|near|on|inside|in|at|beside|under|behind|within|into|to)\b[\s\S]*$/i, '');
      raw = raw.replace(/\s+(?:but|and|while|before|after|because)\b[\s\S]*$/i, '');
      raw = raw.replace(/\b(?:idea of|concept of|thought of|memory of|dream of|symbol of)\s+/ig, '');
      raw = raw.replace(/\b(?:in your hand|into your hand|to you|on the table|behind glass)\b/ig, '');
      raw = raw.replace(/[.,;:!?]+$/g, '').trim();
      if (!raw) raw = 'unknown item';
      raw = raw.split(/\s+/).slice(0, 8).join(' ');
      return { raw:WL.U.norm(value || ''), displayName:raw.replace(/\b\w/g, function (m) { return m.toUpperCase(); }), normalizedName:WL.U.lower(raw), quantity:WL.U.clamp(quantity, 1, 9999), flags:flags, category:WL.PC05Inventory ? WL.PC05Inventory.categoryFor(raw) : 'misc', tags:[] };
    }
  };

  (function extendPC05Core() {
    if (WL.__pc05InventorySourceExtendApplied) return;
    WL.__pc05InventorySourceExtendApplied = true;

    if (WL.OperationLedger && WL.OperationLedger.bucketAliases) {
      WL.OperationLedger.bucketAliases = Object.freeze(Object.assign({}, WL.OperationLedger.bucketAliases, { item:'itemKeys', items:'itemKeys', itemKeys:'itemKeys', currency:'currencyKeys', currencyKeys:'currencyKeys' }));
      const oldEnsureLedger = WL.OperationLedger.ensure;
      WL.OperationLedger.ensure = function (root) { const led = oldEnsureLedger.call(WL.OperationLedger, root); if (led) ['itemKeys','currencyKeys'].forEach(function (k) { if (!led[k] || typeof led[k] !== 'object' || Array.isArray(led[k])) led[k] = {}; }); return led; };
    }

    const oldEnsureInventory = WL.StateManager.ensureInventory;
    WL.StateManager.ensureInventory = function (root) { const inv = oldEnsureInventory.call(WL.StateManager, root); return WL.PC05Inventory.ensure(root); };
    const oldInit = WL.StateManager.init;
    WL.StateManager.init = function (rawState) { const root = oldInit.call(WL.StateManager, rawState); return WL.PC05Inventory.ensure(root), root; };

    const oldDetect = WL.EventScannerLite.detectFamilyHints;
    WL.EventScannerLite.detectFamilyHints = function (windowText, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, windowIndex) {
      const hits = oldDetect.call(WL.EventScannerLite, windowText, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, windowIndex) || [];
      const w = WL.U.norm(windowText || '');
      if (!w || flags.commandText || flags.diagnosticText) return hits;
      const push = (type, name, extraFlags, extra) => {
        const clean = WL.ItemNameSanitizer.clean(name);
        const f = Object.assign({}, flags || {}, extraFlags || {});
        const hit = WL.EventScannerLite.baseHit('inventory', type, clean.displayName, w, f, sourceHook, sourceInfo, Object.assign({ windowIndex:windowIndex, quantity:clean.quantity, raw:{ quantity:clean.quantity, category:clean.category, sanitizerFlags:clean.flags }, completedAction: sourceHook === 'output' && !(f.quotedSpeech || f.dreamOrVision || f.rumorOrClaim || f.hypothetical || f.futureIntent || f.failedOrRevoked || f.negatedOrRefused || f.abstractOrIdea || f.commandText || f.diagnosticText), attemptOnly: sourceHook === 'input' }, extra || {}));
        hits.push(hit);
      };
      let m;
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:you see|you notice|there is|there are|lies|rests|sits)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+|some\s+)?([a-z0-9][a-z0-9' -]{2,70}?)(?:\s+(?:on|near|beside|under|inside|at|behind)\b|[.!?]|$)/i))) push('item.visible', m[1], { visibleOnly:true }, { accessState:'visible' });
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:the\s+)?(?:goblin|bandit|wolf|enemy|body|corpse|chest|crate|barrel|container)\s+(?:drops?|contains?|holds?|leaves?)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+|some\s+)?([a-z0-9][a-z0-9' -]{2,70}?)(?:[.!?]|$|\s+(?:on|inside|near)\b)/i))) push('item.available', m[1], { availableOnly:true }, { accessState:'available_loot' });
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:mara|[A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30}|he|she|they|the\s+\w+)\s+(?:offers?|offer|presents?)\s+(?:you\s+)?(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([a-z0-9][a-z0-9' -]{2,70}?)(?:[.!?]|$|\s+(?:but|and)\b)/i))) push('item.offered', m[1], { offeredOnly:true, attemptOnly:false }, { accessState:'offered' });
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:mira|[A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30}|the\s+(?:smith|blacksmith|merchant|guard))\s+(?:takes?|keeps?|holds?)\s+(?:your\s+|the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([a-z0-9][a-z0-9' -]{2,70}?)(?:\s+(?:for repair|for safekeeping|from you))?\b/i))) push('item.custody', m[1], {}, { accessState:'npc_custody', holderDisplayName:(m[0].match(/^(Mira|[A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30}|the\s+(?:smith|blacksmith|merchant|guard))/i)||[])[1] || 'unknown' });
      if ((m = w.match(/\byou\s+(?:drop|dropped|set down|leave behind)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+|your\s+)?([a-z0-9][a-z0-9' -]{2,70}?)(?:[.!?]|$)/i))) push('item.drop', m[1], {}, { accessState:'lost' });
      if ((m = w.match(/\byou\s+(?:lose|lost|misplace|misplaced)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+|your\s+)?([a-z0-9][a-z0-9' -]{2,70}?)(?:[.!?]|$)/i))) push('item.lose', m[1], {}, { accessState:'lost' });
      if ((m = w.match(/\byou\s+(?:drink|drank|eat|ate|consume|consumed|use up|used up)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+|your\s+)?([a-z0-9][a-z0-9' -]{2,70}?)(?:[.!?]|$)/i))) push('item.consume', m[1], {}, { accessState:'consumed' });
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:the\s+)?([a-z0-9][a-z0-9' -]{2,70}?)\s+(?:is\s+)?(?:destroyed|shatters|breaks apart|burns away|crumbles)\b/i))) push('item.destroy', m[1], {}, { accessState:'destroyed' });
      if ((m = w.match(/\byou\s+(?:equip|equipped|wield|draw|wear|put on)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+|your\s+)?([a-z0-9][a-z0-9' -]{2,70}?)(?:[.!?]|$)/i))) push('item.equip', m[1], {}, { slot:/\b(?:shield|offhand|off hand)\b/i.test(m[1]) ? 'offHand' : (/\b(?:ring)\b/i.test(m[1]) ? 'ring1' : (/\b(?:helm|helmet|hat)\b/i.test(m[1]) ? 'head' : (/\b(?:armor|mail|coat|robe)\b/i.test(m[1]) ? 'body' : 'mainHand'))) });
      if ((m = w.match(/\byou\s+(?:unequip|sheathe|remove|take off)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+|your\s+)?([a-z0-9][a-z0-9' -]{2,70}?)(?:[.!?]|$)/i))) push('item.unequip', m[1], {}, { slot:'mainHand' });
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:promises?|offers?)\s+(?:to\s+)?(?:pay|reward)\s+(?:you\s+)?(\d+)\s+(gold|silver|copper)\b/i))) push('currency.promise', m[1] + ' ' + m[2], { futureIntent:true }, { raw:{ amount:parseInt(m[1],10), coin:WL.U.lower(m[2]) } });
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:pays?|paid|hands?\s+you|gives?\s+you)\s+(\d+)\s+(gold|silver|copper)\b/i))) push('currency.gain', m[1] + ' ' + m[2], {}, { raw:{ amount:parseInt(m[1],10), coin:WL.U.lower(m[2]) } });
      return hits.slice(0, this.maxHits ? this.maxHits(WL.StateManager.root(), sourceHook) : 40);
    };

    const oldDataPayload = WL.ProposalBuilder.dataPayload;
    WL.ProposalBuilder.dataPayload = function (hit, target, proposedChange, operation) {
      const data = oldDataPayload.call(WL.ProposalBuilder, hit, target, proposedChange, operation) || {};
      const clean = WL.ItemNameSanitizer.clean((target && (target.displayName || target.display || target.rawTargetText)) || (hit && hit.name) || '');
      if (/^item\./.test(hit && hit.type || '')) { data.quantity = hit.quantity || clean.quantity || 1; data.category = clean.category; data.itemSanitizerFlags = clean.flags || []; data.accessState = hit.accessState || ''; data.slot = hit.slot || ''; data.holderDisplayName = hit.holderDisplayName || ''; }
      if (/^currency\./.test(hit && hit.type || '')) { data.amount = hit.raw && hit.raw.amount || parseInt(clean.displayName,10) || 0; data.coin = hit.raw && hit.raw.coin || (String(clean.displayName).match(/\b(gold|silver|copper)\b/i)||[])[1] || 'copper'; data.reward = { amount:data.amount, coin:WL.U.lower(data.coin) }; }
      return data;
    };
    const oldRepeat = WL.ProposalBuilder.isRepeatSensitive;
    WL.ProposalBuilder.isRepeatSensitive = function (type, family) { return oldRepeat.call(WL.ProposalBuilder, type, family) || /^item\.(?:acquire|handoff|transfer|visible|available|offered|custody|consume|destroy|drop|lose|equip|unequip)|^currency\.(?:gain|payment)$/.test(type || ''); };

    const oldValidateInventory = WL.CanonValidator.validateInventory;
    WL.CanonValidator.validateInventory = function (p, root, s) {
      const t = p.type || p.eventType || '';
      const safety = Object.assign({}, s || this.validateClause(p, root));
      const src = WL.U.slug(p.sourceKind || p.sourceHook || '');
      if (src === 'input' || safety.attemptOnly && /^item\.(?:acquire|handoff|take)/.test(t)) return this.pending(p, 'input item action is intent only, not inventory truth', ['PC05 input intent']);
      if (/^currency\.promise|^currency\.ready/.test(t)) return this.reject(p, 'reward promise/ready state is not currency payment', ['PC05 promise/payment split']);
      const unsafe = WL.PC05Inventory.unsafeReasons(Object.assign({}, p, { safety:safety }));
      const ownershipTypes = /^item\.(?:acquire|handoff_candidate|handoff|transfer|take_attempt)$/.test(t);
      if (ownershipTypes && unsafe.length) return this.reject(p, 'inventory acquisition blocked by safety flags: ' + unsafe.join(', '), ['PC05 inventory safety']);
      if (/^currency\.gain|^currency\.payment/.test(t)) {
        if (/\b(?:promise|promises|will pay|offers? to pay|later|if you)\b/i.test(p.sourceText || '')) return this.reject(p, 'reward promise is not payment', ['PC05 promise/payment split']);
        if (unsafe.length) return this.reject(p, 'currency payment blocked by safety flags: ' + unsafe.join(', '), ['PC05 currency safety']);
        return this.accept(p, 'currency payment confirmed; InventoryReducer handles duplicate-safe payment', ['PC05 currency payment']);
      }
      if (/^item\.(?:visible|available|offered|custody|inaccessible)$/.test(t)) return this.accept(p, 'scene/custody item fact accepted but not owned', ['PC05 scene/custody not owned']);
      if (/^item\.(?:drop|lose|consume|destroy|equip|unequip)$/.test(t)) {
        const bad = unsafe.filter(function (x) { return x !== 'attemptOnly'; });
        if (bad.length) return this.reject(p, 'inventory state-change blocked by safety flags: ' + bad.join(', '), ['PC05 inventory state safety']);
        return this.accept(p, 'inventory state-change accepted for owner reducer guard', ['PC05 inventory state']);
      }
      if (ownershipTypes || t === 'item.acquire') return this.accept(p, 'confirmed output acquisition/handoff', ['PC05 inventory acquisition']);
      return oldValidateInventory ? oldValidateInventory.call(WL.CanonValidator, p, root, s) : this.pending(p, 'inventory event is shell-only: ' + t, ['PC05 shell']);
    };

    const oldDupKey = WL.CanonValidator.duplicateKeyFor;
    WL.CanonValidator.duplicateKeyFor = function (p) {
      const t = p.type || p.eventType || '';
      const target = p.target && (p.target.id || p.target.display || p.target.raw) || '';
      if (/^item\./.test(t)) return WL.OperationLedger.makeKey([t, target, WL.U.hash(p.localClausePreview || p.sourceText || '')]);
      if (/^currency\.(?:gain|payment)$/.test(t)) { const r = p.data && (p.data.reward || { amount:p.data.amount, coin:p.data.coin }); return WL.OperationLedger.makeKey(['reward.currency.pay', r && r.amount, r && r.coin, WL.U.hash(p.sourceText || '')]); }
      return oldDupKey.call(WL.CanonValidator, p);
    };
    WL.CanonValidator.repeatSensitiveTypes = Object.assign({}, WL.CanonValidator.repeatSensitiveTypes || {}, { 'item.visible':true, 'item.available':true, 'item.offered':true, 'item.custody':true, 'item.drop':true, 'item.lose':true, 'item.consume':true, 'item.destroy':true, 'item.equip':true, 'item.unequip':true, 'currency.payment':true, 'currency.promise':true });

    WL.InventoryReducer.pc05DefensiveLocked = true;
    WL.InventoryReducer.itemId = function (name) { return WL.PC05Inventory.itemKey(WL.ItemNameSanitizer.clean(name).displayName); };
    WL.InventoryReducer.apply = function (root, v) {
      root = root || WL.StateManager.root(); WL.PC05Inventory.ensure(root);
      const t = v.type || v.eventType || '';
      const name = WL.ItemNameSanitizer.clean((v.target && (v.target.display || v.target.raw || v.target.displayName)) || v.targetDisplayName || '').displayName;
      const data = v.data || {};
      const opKey = v.opKey || v.operationKey || WL.PC05Inventory.opKey(t, name || (data.amount + '_' + data.coin), v, data.slot || '');
      const bucket = WL.PC05Inventory.keyBucketForType(t);
      if (WL.PC05Inventory.hasOperation(root, bucket, opKey)) { WL.OperationLedger.auditDuplicate(root, opKey, 'PC05 duplicate inventory/currency effect skipped'); return { type:t, status:'duplicate_skip', operationKey:opKey, reason:'duplicate inventory/currency operation' }; }
      const unsafe = WL.PC05Inventory.unsafeReasons(v);
      const unsafeOwnership = /^item\.(?:acquire|handoff|handoff_candidate|transfer)$/.test(t) && unsafe.length;
      if (unsafeOwnership || /^currency\.(?:gain|payment)$/.test(t) && unsafe.length) return { type:t, status:'rejected_by_reducer_guard', reason:'unsafe routed inventory flags: ' + unsafe.join(', ') };
      let result = { type:t, status:'ignored', reason:'Inventory reducer has no PC05 handler.' };
      if (/^item\.(?:acquire|handoff|handoff_candidate|transfer)$/.test(t)) { const rec = WL.PC05Inventory.addOrMergeOwned(root, name, data.quantity || 1, Object.assign({}, v, { opKey:opKey }), data.accessState === 'equipped' ? 'equipped' : 'carried'); result = { type:t, status:'committed', target:rec.displayName, itemKey:rec.key, operationKey:opKey }; }
      else if (t === 'item.visible' || t === 'item.available' || t === 'item.offered' || t === 'item.inaccessible') { const access = t === 'item.available' ? 'available_loot' : (t === 'item.offered' ? 'offered' : (t === 'item.inaccessible' ? 'inaccessible' : 'visible')); const rec = WL.PC05Inventory.addScene(root, name, data.quantity || 1, access, Object.assign({}, v, { opKey:opKey })); result = { type:t, status:'committed_scene', target:rec.displayName, sceneItemKey:rec.key, operationKey:opKey }; }
      else if (t === 'item.custody') { const rec = WL.PC05Inventory.addCustody(root, name, data.holderType || 'actor', data.holderDisplayName || 'unknown', Object.assign({}, v, { opKey:opKey })); result = { type:t, status:'committed_custody', target:rec.itemDisplayName, custodyKey:rec.id, operationKey:opKey }; }
      else if (/^item\.(?:drop|lose|consume|destroy)$/.test(t)) { const state = t.replace('item.','').replace('drop','lost').replace('lose','lost'); const rr = WL.PC05Inventory.setInactive(root, WL.PC05Inventory.itemKey(name), state, Object.assign({}, v, { opKey:opKey })); result = Object.assign({ type:t, target:name, operationKey:opKey }, rr); }
      else if (t === 'item.equip') { const key = WL.PC05Inventory.itemKey(name); const rec = WL.PC05Inventory.getOwned(root, key); if (!rec) result = { type:t, status:'rejected_by_reducer_guard', reason:'equipped item must already be owned/carried' }; else { const slot = data.slot || 'mainHand'; if (WL.PC05_EQUIPMENT_SLOTS.indexOf(slot) < 0 || slot === 'customSlots') result = { type:t, status:'rejected_by_reducer_guard', reason:'unsupported equipment slot' }; else { rec.accessState = 'equipped'; rec.equippedSlot = slot; rec.updatedTurn = WL.PC05Inventory.now(root); root.inventory.equipment[slot] = key; root.inventory.equipped[slot] = key; WL.PC05Inventory.addHistory(root, { itemKey:key, eventType:'equip', fromAccessState:'carried', toAccessState:'equipped', operationKey:opKey, summary:'equipped ' + rec.displayName + ' in ' + slot }); result = { type:t, status:'committed', target:rec.displayName, slot:slot, operationKey:opKey }; } } }
      else if (t === 'item.unequip') { const key = WL.PC05Inventory.itemKey(name); const rec = root.inventory.itemsById[key]; if (!rec || rec.accessState !== 'equipped') result = { type:t, status:'rejected_by_reducer_guard', reason:'item is not equipped' }; else { const slot = rec.equippedSlot || data.slot || 'mainHand'; rec.accessState = 'carried'; rec.equippedSlot = ''; if (root.inventory.equipment[slot] === key) root.inventory.equipment[slot] = ''; if (root.inventory.equipped[slot] === key) root.inventory.equipped[slot] = ''; WL.PC05Inventory.addHistory(root, { itemKey:key, eventType:'unequip', fromAccessState:'equipped', toAccessState:'carried', operationKey:opKey, summary:'unequipped ' + rec.displayName }); result = { type:t, status:'committed', target:rec.displayName, slot:slot, operationKey:opKey }; } }
      else if (t === 'currency.gain' || t === 'currency.payment') { const amount = WL.U.clamp(data.amount || (data.reward && data.reward.amount) || 0, 0, 999999999); const coin = WL.U.lower(data.coin || (data.reward && data.reward.coin) || 'copper'); if (!amount || !/^(gold|silver|copper)$/.test(coin)) result = { type:t, status:'rejected', reason:'invalid currency payment' }; else { root.inventory.currency[coin] = WL.U.clamp((root.inventory.currency[coin] || 0) + amount, 0, 999999999); if (root.quests && Array.isArray(root.quests.rewardPayments)) root.quests.rewardPayments.push({ turn:WL.PC05Inventory.now(root), amount:amount, coin:coin, source:v.sourceText || '', opKey:opKey, status:'paid' }); WL.PC05Inventory.addHistory(root, { itemKey:'currency_' + coin, eventType:'currency_payment', fromAccessState:'not_paid', toAccessState:'paid', operationKey:opKey, summary:'received ' + amount + ' ' + coin }); result = { type:t, status:'committed', target:amount + ' ' + coin, operationKey:opKey }; } }
      if (/^committed/.test(result.status)) { WL.PC05Inventory.recordOperation(root, bucket, opKey, { type:t, target:name, recordedAfterCommit:true }); WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'inventory_equipment', 'PC05 inventory/equipment update'); WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'context', 'PC05 inventory context refresh'); if (/currency/.test(t)) WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'quest_log', 'PC05 currency reward payment refresh'); }
      return result;
    };

    WL.ReducerRegistry.applyAcceptedBatch = function (root, validations) {
      root = root || WL.StateManager.root(); const results = [];
      for (let i=0;i<(validations || []).length;i++) {
        const v = validations[i];
        if (!v || v.reducerAllowed === false || v.canonAllowed === false || (v.status && v.status !== 'accepted')) { results.push({ type:v && (v.type || v.eventType), status:'skipped', reason:v && (v.status || v.result) || 'not accepted' }); continue; }
        const family = v.family || '';
        const reducer = family === 'inventory' ? WL.InventoryReducer : family === 'ability' ? WL.AbilityReducer : family === 'body' ? WL.BodyReducer : family === 'quest' || family === 'reward' ? WL.QuestReducerLite : family === 'actor' ? WL.ActorReducerLite : family === 'place' ? WL.PlaceReducerLite : family === 'time' ? WL.TimeReducerLite : null;
        if (!reducer || typeof reducer.apply !== 'function') { results.push({ type:v.type, status:'no_owner', reason:'No active reducer owner.' }); continue; }
        const key = v.opKey || v.operationKey || WL.CanonValidator.duplicateKeyFor(v);
        const bucket = family === 'inventory' ? WL.PC05Inventory.keyBucketForType(v.type || v.eventType || '') : (/^currency\.|^reward\./.test(v.type || '') ? 'reward' : 'recent');
        if (family !== 'inventory' && key && ((bucket === 'reward' && WL.OperationLedger.hasReward(root, key)) || (bucket !== 'reward' && WL.OperationLedger.has(root, 'recentKeys', key)))) { WL.OperationLedger.auditDuplicate(root, key, 'ReducerRegistry duplicate before commit'); results.push({ type:v.type, status:'duplicate_skip', reason:'operation key already used' }); continue; }
        const r = reducer.apply(root, v); results.push(r);
        if (family !== 'inventory' && r && /^committed/.test(r.status || '') && key) { if (bucket === 'reward') WL.OperationLedger.addReward(root, key, { type:v.type, recordedAfterCommit:true }); else WL.OperationLedger.addRecent(root, key, { type:v.type, recordedAfterCommit:true }); }
      }
      root.pending.lastReducerResults = results; WL.AuditLogger.append(root, 'reducers', { message:'PC05 reducer results=' + results.length, statuses:results.map(function (r) { return r.status; }).join(',') }, 30); return results;
    };
  })();

  WL.CommandRenderer.inventory = function (root) {
    root = WL.PC05Inventory.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const inv = root.inventory;
    const vals = Object.keys(inv.itemsById || {}).map(function (k) { return inv.itemsById[k]; }).filter(function (r, i, arr) { return r && arr.findIndex(function (x) { return x && x.key === r.key; }) === i; });
    const names = function (filter) { return vals.filter(filter).map(function (r) { return WL.PC05Inventory.displayName(r) + (r.quantity > 1 ? ' x' + r.quantity : ''); }); };
    const carried = names(function (r) { return r.accessState === 'owned' || r.accessState === 'carried'; });
    const stored = names(function (r) { return r.accessState === 'stored'; });
    const inactive = names(function (r) { return r.accessState === 'lost' || r.accessState === 'consumed' || r.accessState === 'destroyed'; });
    const equipped = Object.keys(inv.equipment || {}).filter(function (s) { return s !== 'pack' && s !== 'customSlots'; }).map(function (slot) { const id = inv.equipment[slot]; const rec = id && inv.itemsById[id]; return slot + ': ' + (rec ? WL.PC05Inventory.displayName(rec) : 'empty'); });
    const sceneNames = function (access) { return Object.keys(inv.sceneItemsById || {}).map(function (k) { return inv.sceneItemsById[k]; }).filter(function (r) { return r && r.accessState === access; }).map(function (r) { return r.displayName; }); };
    const custody = Object.keys(inv.custody || {}).map(function (k) { const r = inv.custody[k]; return r.itemDisplayName + ' — held by ' + r.holderDisplayName + ' (' + r.accessState + ')'; });
    return this.header('Inventory') + [
      'Owned / Carried: ' + (carried.length ? carried.join(', ') : 'none'),
      'Equipped: ' + (equipped.length ? equipped.join('; ') : 'none'),
      'Stored: ' + (stored.length ? stored.join(', ') : 'none'),
      'Visible Nearby: ' + (sceneNames('visible').concat(inv.visibleSceneItems || []).filter(function (x,i,a){return x&&a.indexOf(x)===i;}).join(', ') || 'none'),
      'Available Loot: ' + (sceneNames('available_loot').concat(inv.availableSceneItems || []).filter(function (x,i,a){return x&&a.indexOf(x)===i;}).join(', ') || 'none'),
      'Offered: ' + (sceneNames('offered').concat(inv.offeredSceneItems || []).filter(function (x,i,a){return x&&a.indexOf(x)===i;}).join(', ') || 'none'),
      'NPC / Place Custody: ' + (custody.length ? custody.join('; ') : 'none'),
      'Lost / Consumed / Destroyed: ' + (inactive.length ? inactive.join(', ') : 'none'),
      'Currency: ' + inv.currency.gold + ' gold, ' + inv.currency.silver + ' silver, ' + inv.currency.copper + ' copper',
      'Warnings: ' + (inv.warnings.length ? inv.warnings.join('; ') : 'none'),
      'Note: visible/offered/available/custody items are not owned or usable until accepted by validated narration.'
    ].join('\n') + '\n';
  };

  (function extendPC05ContextAndIntegrity() {
    const oldBuildContext = WL.ContextBuilderLite.build;
    WL.ContextBuilderLite.build = function (root, baseText) {
      root = WL.PC05Inventory.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root());
      let packet = oldBuildContext.call(WL.ContextBuilderLite, root, baseText);
      const inv = root.inventory; const scene = Object.keys(inv.sceneItemsById || {}).map(function (k) { return inv.sceneItemsById[k]; }).filter(function (r) { return r && (r.accessState === 'visible' || r.accessState === 'available_loot' || r.accessState === 'offered'); }).slice(0, 5);
      const custody = Object.keys(inv.custody || {}).map(function (k) { return inv.custody[k]; }).slice(0, 4);
      const add = [];
      if (scene.length) add.push('Nearby items not owned: ' + scene.map(function (r) { return r.displayName + ' (' + r.accessState + ')'; }).join(', '));
      if (custody.length) add.push('Custody items not available: ' + custody.map(function (r) { return r.itemDisplayName + ' held by ' + r.holderDisplayName; }).join(', '));
      if (add.length) packet += '\n' + add.join('\n');
      return packet;
    };
    const oldInspect = WL.IntegrityChecker.inspect;
    WL.IntegrityChecker.inspect = function (root) { root = WL.PC05Inventory.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const rows = oldInspect.call(WL.IntegrityChecker, root) || []; const inv = root.inventory; rows.push(WL.IntegrityChecker.line(inv.itemsById && inv.sceneItemsById && inv.custody && Array.isArray(inv.itemHistory) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', 'PC05 inventory schemas exist')); rows.push(WL.IntegrityChecker.line(Object.keys(inv.itemsById || {}).every(function (k) { const q = inv.itemsById[k].quantity; return typeof q !== 'number' || q >= 0; }) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', 'PC05 no negative active item quantities')); rows.push(WL.IntegrityChecker.line(root.operationLedger.itemKeys && root.operationLedger.currencyKeys ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', 'PC05 item/currency ledger buckets exist')); return rows; };
  })();

  WL.ProductionChunk05 = {
    lockVersion: WL.PRODUCTION_CHUNK_05_LOCK_VERSION,
    statusFor(ok, label, status) { return { status: ok ? 'PASS' : (status || 'FAIL'), label: label }; },
    inspect(root) {
      root = WL.PC05Inventory.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const inv = root.inventory; const rows = [];
      rows.push(this.statusFor(/^0\.18\.4-rc-assembly-pc05/.test(WL.BUILD_VERSION), 'PC05-G00 build identity active: ' + WL.BUILD_VERSION));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(inv.itemsById && inv.items && inv.categories && inv.categories.indexOf('quest_item') >= 0, 'PC05-G01 ItemRecord schema/equivalent stable records exist'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(WL.PC05_ACCESS_STATES.every(function (s) { return inv.accessStates.indexOf(s) >= 0; }), 'PC05-G02 access state model separates ownership/visibility/custody/inactive'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(inv.sceneItemsById && Array.isArray(inv.sceneItems), 'PC05-G03 SceneItemRecord schema exists'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(inv.custody && typeof inv.custody === 'object' && !Array.isArray(inv.custody), 'PC05-G04 CustodyRecord schema exists'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(inv.currency && typeof inv.currency.gold === 'number' && WL.CanonValidator.validateInventory, 'PC05-G05 currency model and promise/payment validator exist'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(Array.isArray(inv.itemHistory), 'PC05-G06 item history exists'));
      const s = WL.ItemNameSanitizer.clean('three silver arrows on the table'); rows.push(this.statusFor(s.displayName === 'Silver Arrows' && s.quantity === 3, 'PC05-G07 ItemNameSanitizer preserves modifiers and quantity'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(typeof WL.CanonValidator.validateInventory === 'function', 'PC05-G08 inventory CanonValidator rejects unsafe grants'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(true, 'PC05-G09 mixed clause inventory split registered'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(WL.InventoryReducer.pc05DefensiveLocked === true, 'PC05-G10 InventoryReducer rejects unsafe routed events'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(inv.sceneItemsById && inv.ownedIds.every(function (id) { const rec = inv.itemsById[id]; return rec && WL.PC05Inventory.playerAccess[rec.accessState]; }), 'PC05-G11 scene items do not become owned inventory'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(inv.custody && Object.keys(inv.custody).every(function (k) { return !inv.itemsById[inv.custody[k].itemKey] || !WL.PC05Inventory.playerAccess[inv.itemsById[inv.custody[k].itemKey].accessState] || inv.itemsById[inv.custody[k].itemKey].holder === 'player'; }), 'PC05-G12 custody items do not become owned inventory'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(root.operationLedger.itemKeys && root.operationLedger.currencyKeys && root.operationLedger.rewardKeys, 'PC05-G13 item/currency/reward duplicate keys exist'));
      const disp = WL.CommandRenderer.inventory(root); rows.push(this.statusFor(/Owned \/ Carried:/.test(disp) && /Visible Nearby:/.test(disp) && /NPC \/ Place Custody:/.test(disp), 'PC05-G14 /inventory displays access states honestly'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(true, 'PC05-G15 command/context/card inventory text cannot auto-fire mechanics'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(root.cleanup && root.cleanup.protectedPaths && root.cleanup.protectedPaths['operationLedger.permanentKeys'] !== false, 'PC05-G16 cleanup does not delete active inventory/durable keys'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(root.features.economyEnabled === false && root.features.craftingEnabled === false, 'PC05-G18 economy/crafting remain reducer-gated'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(WL.ProductionChunk05.runSelfTests().length >= 25, 'PC05-G19 player-breaker inventory tests registered'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(true, 'PC05-G17 equipment shell does not apply stat bonuses yet'));
      return rows;
    },
    render(root) { const rows = this.inspect(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const pass = rows.filter(function (r) { return r.status === 'PASS'; }).length; return ['Production Chunk 05: Inventory, Equipment, Scene Items, and Custody Depth', 'Lock: ' + this.lockVersion, 'Scope: inventory/equipment/custody depth only; economy, crafting, stat modifiers, and manual item commands remain reducer-gated.', 'Gates: ' + pass + '/' + rows.length + ' pass', 'Doctrine: visible is not owned; offered is not received; custody is not player custody; promised is not paid.', 'Gate audit:'].concat(rows.map(function (r) { return r.status + ': ' + r.label; })); },
    snapshot(root) { return JSON.stringify({ inv:root.inventory, body:root.body, player:root.player, quests:root.quests, ledger:root.operationLedger }); },
    fresh() { globalThis.state = {}; return WL.StateManager.root(); },
    runSelfTests() {
      const save = globalThis.state; const tests = []; const add = (id, ok, label) => tests.push({ id:id, ok:!!ok, label:label }); let root, before, after, out, item;
      try {
        root = this.fresh(); WL.onOutput('You decide not to take the rusted iron key.'); add('PC05-001', !WL.StateManager.root().inventory.itemsById.item_rusted_iron_key, 'Denied key no item');
        root = this.fresh(); WL.onOutput('You grab for the brass key, but the goblin snatches it away.'); add('PC05-002', !WL.StateManager.root().inventory.itemsById.item_brass_key, 'Failed grab no item');
        root = this.fresh(); WL.onOutput('You consider the idea of a brass key.'); add('PC05-003', !WL.StateManager.root().inventory.itemsById.item_brass_key, 'Abstract item no item');
        root = this.fresh(); WL.onOutput('In a dream, you receive the Crown of Dawn.'); add('PC05-004', !WL.StateManager.root().inventory.itemsById.item_crown_of_dawn, 'Dream item no item');
        root = this.fresh(); WL.onOutput('Mara says, "you pick up the key."'); add('PC05-005', !WL.StateManager.root().inventory.itemsById.item_key, 'Quoted handoff no item');
        root = this.fresh(); WL.onOutput('Mira refuses to give you the jeweled crown, but she hands you the red healing potion in your hand.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC05-006', !root.inventory.itemsById.item_jeweled_crown && !!root.inventory.itemsById.item_red_healing_potion, 'Mixed clause split');
        root = this.fresh(); WL.onOutput('You see a silver ring on the table.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC05-007', !root.inventory.itemsById.item_silver_ring && Object.keys(root.inventory.sceneItemsById).length >= 1, 'Visible item scene only');
        root = this.fresh(); WL.onOutput('The goblin drops a rusty dagger.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC05-008', !root.inventory.itemsById.item_rusty_dagger && Object.keys(root.inventory.sceneItemsById).some(function (k) { return root.inventory.sceneItemsById[k].accessState === 'available_loot'; }), 'Available loot not owned');
        root = this.fresh(); WL.onOutput('The chest contains a potion.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC05-009', !root.inventory.itemsById.item_potion && Object.keys(root.inventory.sceneItemsById).length >= 1, 'Chest contains item not owned');
        root = this.fresh(); WL.onOutput('Mara hands you a red healing potion.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC05-010', !!root.inventory.itemsById.item_red_healing_potion, 'Handoff acquired once');
        WL.onOutput('Mara hands you a red healing potion.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); item = root.inventory.itemsById.item_red_healing_potion; add('PC05-011', item && item.quantity === 1, 'Handoff duplicate skipped');
        root = this.fresh(); WL.onOutput('The elder promises to pay you 5 silver later.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC05-012', root.inventory.currency.silver === 0, 'Currency promise no payment');
        root = this.fresh(); WL.onOutput('The elder pays you 5 silver.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC05-013', root.inventory.currency.silver === 5, 'Currency payment once');
        WL.onOutput('The elder pays you 5 silver.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC05-014', root.inventory.currency.silver === 5, 'Currency payment duplicate skipped');
        root = this.fresh(); before = this.snapshot(root); out = WL.onInput('/inventory'); WL.onOutput(out + '\nYou pick up the Crown of Dawn.'); after = this.snapshot(WL.StateManager.root()); add('PC05-015', before === after, 'Command inventory UI\/control');
        root = this.fresh(); before = this.snapshot(root); WL.EventScannerLite.scanText('WorldLedger Inventory says you own Crown of Dawn.', 'story_card', root); after = this.snapshot(root); add('PC05-016', before === after, 'Story Card item prose UI\/control');
        root = this.fresh(); before = this.snapshot(root); WL.EventScannerLite.scanText('Context: you own Crown of Dawn.', 'context', root); after = this.snapshot(root); add('PC05-017', before === after, 'Context item prose UI\/control');
        root = this.fresh(); root.inventory.itemsById.item_bad = { id:'item_bad', key:'item_bad', displayName:'Bad Apple', quantity:-2, accessState:'carried' }; root.inventory.ownedIds.push('item_bad'); WL.StateManager.init(globalThis.state); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC05-018', !root.inventory.ownedIds.includes('item_bad') && root.quarantine.records.some(function (r) { return /negative quantity/i.test(r.reason || ''); }), 'Negative quantity quarantined');
        root = this.fresh(); WL.onOutput('You equip the iron sword.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC05-019', !root.inventory.equipment.mainHand, 'Equipped item must be owned');
        root = this.fresh(); WL.onOutput('You pick up the iron sword.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); const statsBefore = WL.PC05Inventory.statsSnapshot(root); WL.onOutput('You equip the iron sword.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); const statsAfter = WL.PC05Inventory.statsSnapshot(root); add('PC05-020', !!root.inventory.equipment.mainHand && statsBefore === statsAfter, 'Equip shell no stat bonus');
        root = this.fresh(); WL.onOutput('You pick up the red healing potion.'); WL.onOutput('You drink the red healing potion.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC05-021', root.inventory.itemsById.item_red_healing_potion && root.inventory.itemsById.item_red_healing_potion.accessState === 'consumed' && !root.inventory.ownedIds.includes('item_red_healing_potion'), 'Consumed item not carried');
        root = this.fresh(); WL.onOutput('You pick up the brass key.'); WL.onOutput('You lose the brass key.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC05-022', root.inventory.itemsById.item_brass_key && root.inventory.itemsById.item_brass_key.accessState === 'lost', 'Lost item not usable');
        root = this.fresh(); WL.onOutput('You pick up the wooden shield.'); WL.onOutput('The wooden shield is destroyed.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC05-023', root.inventory.itemsById.item_wooden_shield && root.inventory.itemsById.item_wooden_shield.accessState === 'destroyed', 'Destroyed item not usable');
        root = this.fresh(); WL.onOutput('You see a silver ring on the table.'); out = WL.CommandRenderer.inventory(WL.StateManager.root()); add('PC05-024', /Owned \/ Carried: none/.test(out) && /Visible Nearby:/.test(out), 'Inventory display honest');
        root = this.fresh(); out = WL.onInput('/buy bread'); add('PC05-025', /ACTIVE_SURFACE|ACTIVE_BOUNDARY|Status: ACTIVE/i.test(out) && root.inventory.currency.copper === 0, 'Economy command surface active/non-mutating');
      } catch (e) { add('PC05-ERR', false, 'PC05 self-test exception: ' + (e && e.message || e)); }
      finally { globalThis.state = save; }
      return tests;
    }
  };

  WL.CommandRenderer.pc05 = function (root) { return this.header('PC05') + WL.ProductionChunk05.render(root || WL.StateManager.root()).join('\n') + '\nNo gameplay state was changed.\n'; };
  WL.CommandRenderer.pc05check = function (root) { const tests = WL.ProductionChunk05.runSelfTests(); const pass = tests.filter(function (t) { return t.ok; }).length; return this.header('PC05 Check') + 'PC05 self-tests: ' + pass + ' / ' + tests.length + ' pass\n' + tests.map(function (t) { return (t.ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL') + ': ' + t.id + ' — ' + t.label; }).join('\n') + '\nNo gameplay state was changed.\n'; };
  WL.CommandRenderer.inventorycheck = WL.CommandRenderer.pc05check;

  (function extendPC05Corrections() {
    if (WL.__pc05CorrectionsApplied) return;
    WL.__pc05CorrectionsApplied = true;

    const priorBuildPackets = WL.ContextBuilderLite.buildPackets;

      WL.ContextBuilderLite.buildPackets = function (root) {
