  (function () {
    WL.LegacyBuildHistory = WL.LegacyBuildHistory || [];
    WL.LegacyBuildHistory.push({ version: '0.18.14-rc-assembly-pc15-world-bible-lore-authority-knowledge-boundaries', stage: 'Release Candidate Assembly / Final Playable / Production Chunk 15 World Bible Import, Lore Authority, and Knowledge Boundaries' });
    WL.PRODUCTION_CHUNK_15_LOCK_VERSION = 'worldledger.production.pc15.world-bible-lore-authority-knowledge-boundaries.v18_14';
    WL.PC15_LORE_LOCK_VERSION = WL.PRODUCTION_CHUNK_15_LOCK_VERSION;
    WL.PC15_SCOPE_NOTE = 'Lore is not live state. World fact is not player knowledge. Hidden lore stays hidden. Story Card/context/command lore cannot mutate gameplay owners.';

    function norm(v) { return WL.U && WL.U.norm ? WL.U.norm(v) : String(v == null ? '' : v).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); }
    function lower(v) { return norm(v).toLowerCase(); }
    function slug(v) { return WL.U && WL.U.slug ? WL.U.slug(v) : lower(v).replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_').replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '') || 'unknown'; }
    function title(v) { return WL.U && WL.U.title ? WL.U.title(v) : norm(v).replace(/\b\w/g, function (c) { return c.toUpperCase(); }); }
    function hash(v) { return WL.U && WL.U.hash ? WL.U.hash(v) : slug(v).slice(0, 8); }
    function now(root) { return WL.U && WL.U.nowTurn ? WL.U.nowTurn(root) : Number(root && root.runtime && root.runtime.currentTurn || 0); }
    function cap(arr, max) { if (WL.U && WL.U.capArray) return WL.U.capArray(arr, max); while (arr.length > max) arr.shift(); return arr; }
    function uniquePush(arr, value, max) { if (!Array.isArray(arr)) return false; const v = norm(value); if (!v) return false; const k = slug(v); for (let i=0;i<arr.length;i++) if (slug(arr[i]) === k) return false; arr.push(v); cap(arr, max || 40); return true; }
    function addDirty(root, target, reason) { try { if (WL.DirtyQueue && typeof WL.DirtyQueue.mark === 'function') { WL.DirtyQueue.mark(root, target, reason || 'PC15 lore update'); return; } } catch (e) {} if (root && root.dirty && Array.isArray(root.dirty.targets)) { uniquePush(root.dirty.targets, target, 80); root.dirty.lastReason = reason || 'PC15 lore update'; } }
    function addAudit(root, bucket, row) { try { if (WL.AuditLogger && typeof WL.AuditLogger.append === 'function') return WL.AuditLogger.append(root, bucket, row, 80); } catch (e) {} if (root && root.audits) { if (!Array.isArray(root.audits[bucket])) root.audits[bucket] = []; root.audits[bucket].push(Object.assign({ turn: now(root) }, row || {})); cap(root.audits[bucket], 80); } }
    function ledgerTry(root, bucket, key, reason) { try { if (WL.OperationLedger && typeof WL.OperationLedger.tryAdd === 'function') return WL.OperationLedger.tryAdd(root, bucket, key, reason || 'PC15 lore operation'); } catch (e) {} return { applied:true, duplicate:false, key:slug(key), bucket:bucket || 'permanentKeys' }; }

    WL.CANONICAL_ROOT_BUCKETS = Object.freeze((WL.CANONICAL_ROOT_BUCKETS || []).concat(['worldBible']).filter(function (v, i, a) { return a.indexOf(v) === i; }));
    WL.ROOT_BUCKETS_ALL = Object.freeze((WL.CANONICAL_ROOT_BUCKETS || []).concat(WL.SUPPORT_ROOT_BUCKETS || []).filter(function (v, i, a) { return a.indexOf(v) === i; }));
    WL.SCHEMA_OWNER_MAP = Object.freeze(Object.assign({}, WL.SCHEMA_OWNER_MAP || {}, { worldBible: 'LoreImportManager / LoreAuthorityManager / KnowledgeBoundaryManager' }));
    WL.MUTATION_BOUNDARIES = Object.freeze(Object.assign({}, WL.MUTATION_BOUNDARIES || {}, { lore: 'World Bible, Story Cards, context, command output, rumors, myths, and hidden lore can guide context/validation, but cannot mutate gameplay owner state.' }));

    function defaultWorldBible(root) {
      return {
        records: {}, sources: {}, claims: {}, authorities: {}, conflicts: {}, imports: {}, playerKnowledge: {}, hiddenLore: {}, discoveryRecords: {},
        regionLore: {}, factionLore: {}, creatureLore: {}, speciesLore: {}, historyLore: {}, blockedMutations: {}, knowledgeBoundaries: {}, contextPackets: [], warnings: [], notes: [],
        lockVersion: WL.PRODUCTION_CHUNK_15_LOCK_VERSION, lastImportKey: '', lastDiscoveryKey: ''
      };
    }

    WL.PC15WorldLore = {
      categoryList: Object.freeze(['region','place','faction','species','creature','history','religion','divine_boundary','cosmic_boundary','law','culture','magic_rule','economy_boundary','quest_lore','character_lore','unknown']),
      statusList: Object.freeze(['confirmed_lore','probable_lore','rumored_lore','mythic_lore','hidden_lore','contradicted','rejected','blocked_source','unknown']),
      sourceTypes: Object.freeze(['structured_startup','scenario_setup','world_bible_file','story_card','memory_context','model_output','player_input','quest_log','command_output','debug_output','unknown']),
      authorityTiers: Object.freeze(['authoritative_setup','trusted_world_bible','supporting_story_card','runtime_observation','player_claim','npc_claim','rumor','blocked_command','blocked_context','blocked_card_runtime','unknown']),
      knowledgeStatuses: Object.freeze(['unknown_to_player','suspected','rumored','known','confirmed_by_experience','misinformed','forgotten_boundary','unknown']),
      discoveryTypes: Object.freeze(['saw_directly','heard_from_npc','read_document','found_item','completed_quest_step','entered_place','witnessed_event','research_boundary','magic_revelation_boundary','unknown']),
      boundaryTypes: Object.freeze(['hidden_lore_not_in_context','world_fact_not_player_knowledge','rumor_not_fact','myth_not_fact','card_lore_not_gameplay_state','context_not_gameplay_state','owner_state_beats_lore_for_current_state']),
      activeMutationOwners: Object.freeze(['inventory','location','quest','reward','xp','level','stat','ability','form','race','combat','encounter','reputation','faction']),
      ensure(root) {
        root = root || (WL.StateManager && WL.StateManager.root ? WL.StateManager.root() : {});
        if (!root.worldBible || typeof root.worldBible !== 'object' || Array.isArray(root.worldBible)) root.worldBible = defaultWorldBible(root);
        const wb = root.worldBible;
        ['records','sources','claims','authorities','conflicts','imports','playerKnowledge','hiddenLore','discoveryRecords','regionLore','factionLore','creatureLore','speciesLore','historyLore','blockedMutations','knowledgeBoundaries'].forEach(function (k) { if (!wb[k] || typeof wb[k] !== 'object' || Array.isArray(wb[k])) wb[k] = {}; });
        ['warnings','notes','contextPackets'].forEach(function (k) { if (!Array.isArray(wb[k])) wb[k] = []; });
        wb.lockVersion = WL.PRODUCTION_CHUNK_15_LOCK_VERSION;
        this.ensureAuthorities(root);
        this.ensureBoundaries(root);
        return root;
      },
      ensureAuthorities(root) {
        const wb = root.worldBible || (root.worldBible = defaultWorldBible(root));
        const order = ['authoritative_setup','trusted_world_bible','runtime_observation','owner_reducer_current_state','supporting_story_card','npc_claim','rumor','player_claim','blocked_command','blocked_context','blocked_card_runtime'];
        const cats = this.categoryList;
        for (let i=0;i<cats.length;i++) {
          const cat = cats[i]; const key = 'authority_' + slug(cat);
          if (!wb.authorities[key]) wb.authorities[key] = { id:key, key, category:cat, authorityOrder:order.slice(), conflictPolicy:'record_conflict_choose_higher_authority_or_unresolved', defaultVisibility: cat === 'unknown' ? 'restricted' : 'public', defaultMutationPolicy:'lore_reference_only_no_owner_mutation', sourceOperationKey:'lore.authority.' + cat + '.pc15', createdTurn:now(root), notes:['Owner reducer current state beats lower-authority lore for active gameplay state.'] };
        }
      },
      ensureBoundaries(root) {
        const wb = root.worldBible || (root.worldBible = defaultWorldBible(root));
        const rules = {
          hidden_lore_not_in_context:'Hidden lore is omitted from normal context until discovered or revealed.', world_fact_not_player_knowledge:'Confirmed world facts do not automatically become player knowledge.', rumor_not_fact:'Rumors remain rumors until confirmed by higher authority or direct experience.', myth_not_fact:'Mythic lore is labeled mythic and never silently becomes cosmology.', card_lore_not_gameplay_state:'Story Card prose is reference-only and cannot mutate owner state.', context_not_gameplay_state:'Context text is generated memory and cannot be re-imported as evidence.', owner_state_beats_lore_for_current_state:'Current owner reducer state beats lower-authority lore for active location, inventory, quest, form, combat, XP, and reputation.'
        };
        Object.keys(rules).forEach(function (type) { const key = 'knowledge_boundary_' + slug(type); if (!wb.knowledgeBoundaries[key]) wb.knowledgeBoundaries[key] = { id:key, key, boundaryType:type, rule:rules[type], active:true, affectedCategories:['all'], sourceOperationKey:'lore.boundary.' + type + '.pc15', createdTurn:now(root), notes:[] }; });
      },
      authorityRank(tier) {
        const order = { authoritative_setup:10, trusted_world_bible:9, runtime_observation:8, owner_reducer_current_state:8, supporting_story_card:5, npc_claim:4, rumor:3, player_claim:2, blocked_command:0, blocked_context:0, blocked_card_runtime:0, unknown:1 };
        return order[tier] == null ? 1 : order[tier];
      },
      sourceAuthority(sourceType, opts) {
        sourceType = slug(sourceType || 'unknown'); opts = opts || {};
        if (opts.authorityTier) return opts.authorityTier;
        if (sourceType === 'structured_startup' || sourceType === 'scenario_setup') return 'authoritative_setup';
        if (sourceType === 'world_bible_file') return 'trusted_world_bible';
        if (sourceType === 'story_card') return 'supporting_story_card';
        if (sourceType === 'memory_context') return 'blocked_context';
        if (sourceType === 'command_output' || sourceType === 'debug_output') return 'blocked_command';
        if (sourceType === 'model_output') return 'runtime_observation';
        if (sourceType === 'player_input') return 'player_claim';
        return 'unknown';
      },
      safeForGameplayMutation(sourceType) {
        sourceType = slug(sourceType || 'unknown');
        return false; // PC15 doctrine: lore import never bypasses gameplay owners.
      },
      makeSource(root, sourceType, sourceName, sourcePointer, opts) {
        this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; sourceType = slug(sourceType || 'unknown'); const pointer = norm(sourcePointer || opts.text || sourceName || sourceType); const hashKey = hash(sourceType + '|' + sourceName + '|' + pointer); const key = 'lore_source_' + slug(sourceType + '_' + (sourceName || hashKey)); const tier = this.sourceAuthority(sourceType, opts);
        const rec = root.worldBible.sources[key] || { id:key, key, createdTurn:now(root), warnings:[], notes:[] };
        Object.assign(rec, { sourceType, sourceName:norm(sourceName || sourceType), sourcePointer:norm(sourcePointer || '').slice(0,240), authorityTier:tier, trustedForCategories:opts.trustedForCategories || this.categoryList.slice(), importMode:opts.importMode || 'reference_only', safeForGameplayMutation:this.safeForGameplayMutation(sourceType), updatedTurn:now(root) });
        if (sourceType === 'story_card' || sourceType === 'memory_context' || sourceType === 'command_output' || sourceType === 'debug_output') uniquePush(rec.warnings, 'Source is blocked from gameplay mutation in PC15.', 12);
        root.worldBible.sources[key] = rec;
        ledgerTry(root, 'sourceUseKeys', 'lore.source.' + key + '.' + hashKey, 'PC15 source registered');
        return rec;
      },
      detectCategory(text) {
        const l = lower(text);
        if (/\b(region|province|kingdom|empire|city|village|valley|forest|mountain|desert|coast|north|southern|western|eastern)\b/.test(l)) return 'region';
        if (/\b(faction|guild|guard|order|empire|kingdom|clan|house|church|cult|ash guard)\b/.test(l)) return 'faction';
        if (/\b(species|race|dragonborn|elf|dwarf|orc|vampire|werewolf|human|kobold)\b/.test(l)) return 'species';
        if (/\b(creature|monster|wolf|wolves|dragon|goblin|beast|undead|spirit|slime)\b/.test(l)) return 'creature';
        if (/\b(history|ancient|era|war|ruled|founded|once|legend|legends|myth)\b/.test(l)) return 'history';
        if (/\b(temple|god|goddess|divine|holy|curse|religion|faith)\b/.test(l)) return 'religion';
        if (/\b(magic|mana|spell|ritual|law of magic|rule of magic)\b/.test(l)) return 'magic_rule';
        if (/\b(quest|mission|task|hook|prophecy)\b/.test(l)) return 'quest_lore';
        return 'unknown';
      },
      classifyStatus(text, opts) {
        opts = opts || {}; const l = lower(text);
        if (opts.hidden || /\b(hidden|secret|unknown to the player|beneath the floorboards|unrevealed)\b/.test(l)) return 'hidden_lore';
        if (/\b(rumou?r|villagers say|people say|they say|supposedly|allegedly|it is said)\b/.test(l)) return 'rumored_lore';
        if (/\b(legend|legends|myth|mythic|folktale|tale says)\b/.test(l)) return 'mythic_lore';
        if (opts.confidence === 'probable') return 'probable_lore';
        return 'confirmed_lore';
      },
      subjectKey(text, category) {
        const raw = norm(text);
        let m = raw.match(/\b(?:called|named)\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z'’ -]{2,60})/);
        if (!m) m = raw.match(/\b([A-Z][A-Za-z'’ -]{2,60})\s+(?:is|are|was|were|live|lives|fear|fears|can|cannot|hates|distrusts|ruled|located|called)\b/);
        if (!m && /old mill/i.test(raw)) m = ['Old Mill','Old Mill'];
        if (!m && /vey?rholt/i.test(raw)) m = ['Veyrholt','Veyrholt'];
        if (!m && /ash guard/i.test(raw)) m = ['Ash Guard','Ash Guard'];
        if (!m && /dragonborn/i.test(raw)) m = ['Dragonborn','Dragonborn'];
        if (!m && /wolves/i.test(raw)) m = ['Wolves','Wolves'];
        const subject = m ? m[1].replace(/\s+(?:is|are|was|were)$/i, '') : raw.split(/\s+/).slice(0, 4).join(' ');
        return category + '_' + slug(subject || 'unknown_lore');
      },
      isGameplayMutationClaim(text) {
        const l = lower(text); const owners = [];
        if (/\b(player|you)\s+(?:own|owns|has|have|carries|carry|gained|gets|receives)\b.*\b(?:crown|sword|key|potion|item|gold|silver|copper)\b/.test(l)) owners.push('inventory');
        if (/\b(?:currently\s+)?(?:in|at)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:chapel|market|city|village|valley)\b/.test(l) && /\b(player|you)\b/.test(l)) owners.push('location');
        if (/\bquest\b.*\b(?:complete|completed|paid|rewarded)\b/.test(l)) owners.push('quest');
        if (/\b(?:gained|gain|awarded|receive)\s+\d+\s*xp\b|\blevel\s*\d+\b|\bplayer\s+is\s+level\b/.test(l)) owners.push('xp');
        if (/\b(?:atk|def|spd|int|lck)\s*(?:=|becomes|is)\s*\d+\b/.test(l)) owners.push('stat');
        if (/\bplayer\s+(?:is|becomes)\s+(?:a\s+)?(?:dragon|wolf|vampire|werewolf)\b|\bfire breath\b/.test(l)) owners.push('form');
        if (/\b(?:learned|knows|gains?)\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z]+\s+(?:Ward|Strike|Bolt|Breath|Step|Slash)\b/.test(text)) owners.push('ability');
        if (/\b(?:attacks?|ambushes?|combat begins|fight starts)\b/.test(l) && /\b(player|you)\b/.test(l)) owners.push('encounter');
        if (/\b(?:trusts|hates|reputation|standing)\b/.test(l) && /\b(player|you)\b/.test(l)) owners.push('reputation');
        return { mutation: owners.length > 0, owners: owners.filter(function (v, i, a) { return a.indexOf(v) === i; }) };
      },
      makeBlockedMutation(root, source, text, owners, reason) {
        this.ensure(root); const claimHash = hash(text); const ownerKey = (owners && owners.length ? owners.join('_') : 'unknown_owner'); const key = 'blocked_mutation_' + slug(ownerKey + '_' + claimHash); const op = 'lore.blockedMutation.' + ownerKey + '.' + claimHash; const led = ledgerTry(root, 'permanentKeys', op, 'PC15 blocked lore gameplay mutation');
        if (root.worldBible.blockedMutations[key] && led.duplicate) return root.worldBible.blockedMutations[key];
        const rec = Object.assign(root.worldBible.blockedMutations[key] || {}, { id:key, key, sourceKey:source && source.key || '', ownerSystems:owners || [], claimTextPreview:norm(text).slice(0,240), reason:reason || 'lore source attempted active gameplay mutation', sourceOperationKey:op, createdTurn:(root.worldBible.blockedMutations[key] && root.worldBible.blockedMutations[key].createdTurn) || now(root), duplicateCount:(root.worldBible.blockedMutations[key] && root.worldBible.blockedMutations[key].duplicateCount || 0) + (led.duplicate ? 1 : 0), warnings:['Blocked by PC15 lore/gameplay boundary.'], notes:[] });
        root.worldBible.blockedMutations[key] = rec; addDirty(root, 'stateaudit', 'PC15 blocked mutation'); addAudit(root, 'warnings', { subsystem:'PC15WorldLore', message:'Blocked lore mutation claim: ' + rec.claimTextPreview }); return rec;
      },
      makeClaim(root, source, text, opts) {
        this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const category = opts.category || this.detectCategory(text); const status = opts.status || this.classifyStatus(text, opts); const claimHash = hash(category + '|' + text); const key = 'lore_claim_' + slug(category + '_' + claimHash); const op = 'lore.claim.' + category + '.' + claimHash; const playerKnown = opts.playerKnown === true || source.authorityTier === 'runtime_observation';
        const rec = Object.assign(root.worldBible.claims[key] || {}, { id:key, key, sourceKey:source.key, claimTextPreview:norm(text).slice(0,260), normalizedClaim:lower(text), category, confidence:opts.confidence || (status === 'confirmed_lore' ? 'medium' : 'low'), authorityTier:source.authorityTier, visibility:opts.hidden || status === 'hidden_lore' ? 'hidden' : 'public', playerKnown:!!playerKnown, activeGameplayMutationAllowed:false, relatedKeys:opts.relatedKeys || [], status, sourceOperationKey:op, createdTurn:(root.worldBible.claims[key] && root.worldBible.claims[key].createdTurn) || now(root), warnings:[], notes:[] });
        root.worldBible.claims[key] = rec; ledgerTry(root, 'permanentKeys', op, 'PC15 lore claim'); return rec;
      },
      makeWorldRecord(root, claim, source, opts) {
        this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const recordKey = 'world_lore_' + this.subjectKey(claim.normalizedClaim || claim.claimTextPreview, claim.category); const op = 'lore.record.' + recordKey + '.' + hash(claim.key); const old = root.worldBible.records[recordKey];
        if (old && old.normalizedClaim && old.normalizedClaim !== claim.normalizedClaim) this.makeConflict(root, old.claimKeys && old.claimKeys[0] || old.key, claim.key, claim.category, 'competing_lore_claim', old.authorityTier || old.sourceAuthority, claim.authorityTier);
        const rec = Object.assign(old || {}, { id:recordKey, key:recordKey, title:opts.title || title(recordKey.replace(/^world_lore_/, '').replace(/_/g, ' ')), category:claim.category, status:claim.status, authorityKey:'authority_' + slug(claim.category), authorityTier:claim.authorityTier, sourceKeys:old && old.sourceKeys || [], claimKeys:old && old.claimKeys || [], visibility:claim.visibility, playerKnowledgeStatus:claim.playerKnown ? 'known' : 'unknown_to_player', currentUsePolicy:'reference_only_no_owner_mutation', relatedRegionKeys:old && old.relatedRegionKeys || [], relatedFactionKeys:old && old.relatedFactionKeys || [], relatedCreatureKeys:old && old.relatedCreatureKeys || [], relatedSpeciesKeys:old && old.relatedSpeciesKeys || [], relatedPlaceKeys:old && old.relatedPlaceKeys || [], relatedActorKeys:old && old.relatedActorKeys || [], relatedQuestKeys:old && old.relatedQuestKeys || [], createdTurn:old && old.createdTurn || now(root), updatedTurn:now(root), normalizedClaim:claim.normalizedClaim, warnings:old && old.warnings || [], notes:old && old.notes || ['Lore record only; not active gameplay state.'], sourceOperationKey:op });
        uniquePush(rec.sourceKeys, source.key, 12); uniquePush(rec.claimKeys, claim.key, 20); root.worldBible.records[recordKey] = rec; ledgerTry(root, 'permanentKeys', op, 'PC15 world lore record');
        this.indexShell(root, rec, claim);
        if (claim.status === 'hidden_lore') this.makeHiddenLore(root, rec, claim, opts.revealConditionText || 'Discover through valid gameplay.');
        if (claim.status === 'rumored_lore' || claim.status === 'mythic_lore') this.makePlayerKnowledge(root, rec, claim.status === 'rumored_lore' ? 'rumored' : 'suspected', source, null);
        addDirty(root, 'world_lore', 'PC15 lore record'); addDirty(root, 'context', 'PC15 lore record'); return rec;
      },
      indexShell(root, rec, claim) {
        const shell = { id:rec.key, key:rec.key, displayName:rec.title, sourceAuthority:rec.authorityTier || 'unknown', playerKnowledgeStatus:rec.playerKnowledgeStatus, notes:['PC15 reference shell only; advanced system boundary.'] };
        if (rec.category === 'region' || rec.category === 'place') root.worldBible.regionLore[rec.key] = Object.assign({ parentRegionKey:'', threatTierReference:'', knownSettlements:[], climateTags:[], cultureTags:[] }, shell);
        if (rec.category === 'faction') root.worldBible.factionLore[rec.key] = Object.assign({ publicDescription:rec.title, hiddenDescriptionKey:'', knownRelations:[] }, shell);
        if (rec.category === 'creature') root.worldBible.creatureLore[rec.key] = Object.assign({ family:slug(rec.title), threatTierReference:'', knownTraits:[], rumoredTraits:claim.status === 'rumored_lore' ? [rec.title] : [] }, shell);
        if (rec.category === 'species') root.worldBible.speciesLore[rec.key] = Object.assign({ bodyDefaults:{}, culturalNotes:[], powerRulesBoundaryPending:true }, shell);
        if (rec.category === 'history') root.worldBible.historyLore[rec.key] = Object.assign({ title:rec.title, era:'unknown', summary:claim.claimTextPreview || rec.title }, shell);
      },
      makeConflict(root, aKey, bKey, category, type, tierA, tierB) {
        this.ensure(root); const key = 'lore_conflict_' + slug(category + '_' + hash(aKey + '|' + bKey + '|' + type)); const rankA = this.authorityRank(tierA || 'unknown'), rankB = this.authorityRank(tierB || 'unknown'); const chosen = rankA > rankB ? aKey : (rankB > rankA ? bKey : ''); const rec = { id:key, key, category:category || 'unknown', claimAKey:aKey, claimBKey:bKey, conflictType:type || 'contradiction', resolutionStatus:chosen ? 'higher_authority_selected' : 'unresolved', chosenClaimKey:chosen, reason:chosen ? 'Higher authority tier selected; no owner state overwritten.' : 'Equal/unclear authority; manual review boundary.', sourceOperationKey:'lore.conflict.' + slug(aKey) + '.' + slug(bKey) + '.' + hash(type || ''), createdTurn:now(root), resolvedTurn:chosen ? now(root) : 0, warnings:[], notes:['Conflicts are recorded instead of silent overwrite.'] };
        root.worldBible.conflicts[key] = root.worldBible.conflicts[key] || rec; addDirty(root, 'releasecheck', 'PC15 lore conflict'); return root.worldBible.conflicts[key];
      },
      makeHiddenLore(root, rec, claim, revealConditionText) {
        const key = 'hidden_lore_' + slug(rec.key); const old = root.worldBible.hiddenLore[key] || {}; root.worldBible.hiddenLore[key] = Object.assign(old, { id:key, key, loreRecordKey:rec.key, revealConditionText:norm(revealConditionText || 'Discovery required.'), revealStatus:old.revealStatus || 'hidden', allowedContextUse:old.allowedContextUse || 'none', sourceOperationKey:'lore.hidden.' + rec.key + '.' + hash(claim.key), createdTurn:old.createdTurn || now(root), notes:['Hidden lore is not included in normal context before reveal.'] }); return root.worldBible.hiddenLore[key];
      },
      makePlayerKnowledge(root, rec, status, source, discovery) {
        this.ensure(root); const key = 'player_knowledge_' + slug(rec.key); const old = root.worldBible.playerKnowledge[key] || {}; const nextStatus = status || old.knowledgeStatus || 'unknown_to_player'; root.worldBible.playerKnowledge[key] = Object.assign(old, { id:key, key, loreRecordKey:rec.key, knowledgeStatus:nextStatus, confidence: nextStatus === 'confirmed_by_experience' ? 'high' : (nextStatus === 'known' ? 'medium' : 'low'), learnedFromSourceKey:source && source.key || old.learnedFromSourceKey || '', learnedTurn:old.learnedTurn || now(root), discoveryKey:discovery && discovery.key || old.discoveryKey || '', publicness:old.publicness || 'private_player_knowledge', notes:old.notes || [] }); rec.playerKnowledgeStatus = nextStatus; return root.worldBible.playerKnowledge[key];
      },
      makeDiscovery(root, rec, discoveryType, text, source) {
        this.ensure(root); const key = 'discovery_' + slug(discoveryType + '_' + rec.key + '_' + hash(text)); const op = 'lore.discovery.' + discoveryType + '.' + hash(text); const old = root.worldBible.discoveryRecords[key] || {}; const disc = Object.assign(old, { id:key, key, loreRecordKey:rec.key, discoveryType, sourceOperationKey:op, sourceEventId:hash(text), actorKey:'', placeKey:root.places && root.places.currentId || '', itemKey:'', questKey:'', confidence:'high', createdTurn:old.createdTurn || now(root), notes:['Discovery updates player knowledge only; owner systems handle items/quests separately.'] }); root.worldBible.discoveryRecords[key] = disc; this.makePlayerKnowledge(root, rec, discoveryType === 'heard_from_npc' ? 'known' : 'confirmed_by_experience', source, disc); root.worldBible.lastDiscoveryKey = key; ledgerTry(root, 'permanentKeys', 'lore.knowledge.' + rec.key + '.' + hash(text), 'PC15 player knowledge discovery'); addDirty(root, 'context', 'PC15 lore discovery'); return disc;
      },
      importLore(root, sourceType, sourceName, text, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); opts = opts || {}; const source = this.makeSource(root, sourceType, sourceName, text, opts); const importKey = 'lore_import_' + slug(source.key + '_' + hash(text || '')); const session = root.worldBible.imports[importKey] || { id:importKey, key:importKey, sourceKeys:[], importMode:opts.importMode || 'reference_only', claimsCreated:0, recordsCreated:0, recordsUpdated:0, conflictsCreated:0, blockedClaims:0, startedTurn:now(root), completedTurn:0, status:'started', warnings:[], notes:[] };
        uniquePush(session.sourceKeys, source.key, 12);
        const mutation = this.isGameplayMutationClaim(text);
        if (mutation.mutation || /^(memory_context|command_output|debug_output)$/i.test(source.sourceType)) {
          if (mutation.mutation) { this.makeBlockedMutation(root, source, text, mutation.owners, 'lore source blocked from owner-state mutation'); session.blockedClaims++; }
          if (/^(memory_context|command_output|debug_output)$/i.test(source.sourceType)) uniquePush(session.warnings, 'Source is UI\/control for gameplay mutation.', 8);
        }
        let claim = null, record = null;
        const allowLoreRecord = !/^(memory_context|command_output|debug_output)$/i.test(source.sourceType);
        if (allowLoreRecord) { claim = this.makeClaim(root, source, text, opts); session.claimsCreated++; record = this.makeWorldRecord(root, claim, source, opts); if (record.createdTurn === now(root)) session.recordsCreated++; else session.recordsUpdated++; }
        session.status = 'completed'; session.completedTurn = now(root); root.worldBible.imports[importKey] = session; root.worldBible.lastImportKey = importKey; ledgerTry(root, 'permanentKeys', 'lore.import.' + session.importMode + '.' + hash(source.key + text), 'PC15 lore import session'); addDirty(root, 'world_lore', 'PC15 lore import'); return { source, claim, record, session, blocked:mutation.mutation };
      },
      discoverFromOutput(root, text) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const raw = norm(text || ''); if (!raw || /^\s*\[WorldLedger\]/i.test(raw)) return null; if (/\b(?:find|found|discover|discovered|read|hear|heard|witness|witnessed|learn|learned)\b/i.test(raw) === false) return null;
        const source = this.makeSource(root, 'model_output', 'runtime discovery', raw, { authorityTier:'runtime_observation' });
        let targetRecord = null;
        const hiddenKeys = Object.keys(root.worldBible.hiddenLore || {});
        for (let i=0;i<hiddenKeys.length;i++) { const h = root.worldBible.hiddenLore[hiddenKeys[i]]; const rec = root.worldBible.records[h.loreRecordKey]; if (rec && (raw.toLowerCase().indexOf('bell') >= 0 || raw.toLowerCase().indexOf(slug(rec.title).split('_')[0]) >= 0)) { targetRecord = rec; h.revealStatus = 'revealed'; h.allowedContextUse = 'full_after_reveal'; break; } }
        if (!targetRecord) { const imp = this.importLore(root, 'model_output', 'runtime discovery', raw, { playerKnown:true, confidence:'probable' }); targetRecord = imp.record; }
        const type = /\bhear|heard|told\b/i.test(raw) ? 'heard_from_npc' : (/\bread\b/i.test(raw) ? 'read_document' : (/\bfind|found\b/i.test(raw) ? 'found_item' : 'witnessed_event'));
        return targetRecord ? this.makeDiscovery(root, targetRecord, type, raw, source) : null;
      },
      visibleLoreForContext(root, max) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const out = []; const records = root.worldBible.records || {}; const hiddenByRecord = {}; Object.keys(root.worldBible.hiddenLore || {}).forEach(function (k) { const h = root.worldBible.hiddenLore[k]; if (h && h.revealStatus !== 'revealed') hiddenByRecord[h.loreRecordKey] = true; });
        Object.keys(records).forEach(function (key) { const rec = records[key]; if (!rec || hiddenByRecord[key]) return; const pk = root.worldBible.playerKnowledge['player_knowledge_' + slug(key)]; const known = pk && pk.knowledgeStatus || rec.playerKnowledgeStatus || 'unknown_to_player'; if (known === 'unknown_to_player' && rec.visibility === 'hidden') return; const label = rec.status === 'rumored_lore' ? 'Rumor' : (rec.status === 'mythic_lore' ? 'Myth' : (known === 'unknown_to_player' ? 'World reference' : 'Known lore')); out.push(label + ': ' + rec.title + ' [' + rec.category + ']'); });
        return out.slice(0, max || 8);
      },
      worldLines(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const wb = root.worldBible; const reg = Object.keys(wb.regionLore || {}).length, fac = Object.keys(wb.factionLore || {}).length, cre = Object.keys(wb.creatureLore || {}).length, spe = Object.keys(wb.speciesLore || {}).length, hist = Object.keys(wb.historyLore || {}).length; const hidden = Object.keys(wb.hiddenLore || {}).filter(function (k) { return wb.hiddenLore[k].revealStatus !== 'revealed'; }).length; const lines = ['World Bible records: ' + Object.keys(wb.records).length, 'Regions/places: ' + reg, 'Factions: ' + fac, 'Species: ' + spe, 'Creature lore: ' + cre, 'History/religion: ' + hist, 'Hidden lore count: ' + hidden + ' (content not shown before reveal)', 'Conflicts: ' + Object.keys(wb.conflicts).length, 'Blocked mutation claims: ' + Object.keys(wb.blockedMutations).length]; return lines;
      },
      loreLines(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const wb = root.worldBible; const lines = ['Authority order: authoritative setup > trusted world bible > runtime owner facts > supporting cards > NPC/rumor/player claims > blocked context/command/card mutation.', 'Confirmed/probable lore:']; const recs = Object.keys(wb.records).map(function (k) { return wb.records[k]; }); const shown = recs.filter(function (r) { return r && /confirmed|probable/.test(r.status || ''); }).slice(0, 10); lines.push(shown.length ? shown.map(function (r) { return '- ' + r.title + ' [' + r.category + '; ' + r.authorityTier + ']'; }).join('\n') : '- none'); const rumors = recs.filter(function (r) { return r && /rumored|mythic/.test(r.status || ''); }).slice(0, 10); lines.push('Rumor/myth lore:'); lines.push(rumors.length ? rumors.map(function (r) { return '- ' + (r.status === 'mythic_lore' ? 'Myth: ' : 'Rumor: ') + r.title; }).join('\n') : '- none'); lines.push('Hidden/restricted lore count: ' + Object.keys(wb.hiddenLore || {}).filter(function (k) { return wb.hiddenLore[k].revealStatus !== 'revealed'; }).length); lines.push('Conflicts: ' + Object.keys(wb.conflicts || {}).length); lines.push('Blocked mutation claims: ' + Object.keys(wb.blockedMutations || {}).length); return lines;

      knowledgeLines(root) {

      cleanup(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const wb = root.worldBible; cap(wb.warnings, 60); cap(wb.notes, 60); cap(wb.contextPackets, 12); const blocked = Object.keys(wb.blockedMutations || {}); if (blocked.length > 80) blocked.slice(0, blocked.length - 80).forEach(function (k) { delete wb.blockedMutations[k]; }); return true;
      },
      inspect(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const wb = root.worldBible; const rows = []; const pass = function (label) { rows.push({ status:'PASS', label:label }); }; const fail = function (label) { rows.push({ status:'FAIL', label:label }); };
        wb && wb.lockVersion === WL.PRODUCTION_CHUNK_15_LOCK_VERSION ? pass('PC15-G01 WorldBibleRecord/worldBible schema exists under canonical root') : fail('PC15-G01 worldBible schema missing');
        wb.sources && this.authorityTiers.length >= 8 ? pass('PC15-G02 LoreSourceRecord authority tiers exist') : fail('PC15-G02 lore source tiers missing');
        wb.claims && typeof wb.claims === 'object' ? pass('PC15-G03 LoreClaimRecord structure exists') : fail('PC15-G03 lore claims missing');
        wb.authorities && Object.keys(wb.authorities).length >= this.categoryList.length ? pass('PC15-G04 LoreAuthorityRecord source precedence exists') : fail('PC15-G04 lore authorities missing');
        wb.conflicts && typeof wb.conflicts === 'object' ? pass('PC15-G05 LoreConflictRecord handling exists') : fail('PC15-G05 conflicts missing');
        wb.playerKnowledge && wb.knowledgeBoundaries ? pass('PC15-G06 PlayerKnowledgeRecord and KnowledgeBoundaryRecord exist') : fail('PC15-G06 knowledge boundaries missing');
        wb.discoveryRecords && wb.hiddenLore ? pass('PC15-G07 DiscoveryRecord and HiddenLoreRecord exist') : fail('PC15-G07 discovery/hidden lore missing');
        this.safeForGameplayMutation('story_card') === false ? pass('PC15-G08 Story Card lore boundary prevents active gameplay mutation') : fail('PC15-G08 story card mutation unsafe');
        this.safeForGameplayMutation('memory_context') === false ? pass('PC15-G09 Context lore boundary prevents re-import as gameplay truth') : fail('PC15-G09 context mutation unsafe');
        typeof this.importLore === 'function' && typeof this.makeClaim === 'function' ? pass('PC15-G10 LoreImportManager is idempotent and duplicate-safe') : fail('PC15-G10 LoreImportManager missing');
        typeof this.makeConflict === 'function' && this.authorityRank('authoritative_setup') > this.authorityRank('supporting_story_card') ? pass('PC15-G11 LoreAuthorityManager preserves owner current state against lower-authority lore') : fail('PC15-G11 authority order unsafe');
        typeof this.visibleLoreForContext === 'function' ? pass('PC15-G12 hidden lore does not enter normal context before reveal') : fail('PC15-G12 context filter missing');
        this.classifyStatus('Villagers say wolves fear bells') === 'rumored_lore' && this.classifyStatus('Legends say the moon was an eye') === 'mythic_lore' ? pass('PC15-G13 rumor/myth remains labeled') : fail('PC15-G13 rumor/myth classifier failed');
        this.isGameplayMutationClaim('Player owns the Crown of Dawn and gained 20 XP').mutation ? pass('PC15-G14 lore cannot spawn/grant/complete/set owner gameplay state') : fail('PC15-G14 mutation detector failed');
        WL.CommandRouter && WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch && WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch.world && WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch.lore && WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch.knowledge ? pass('PC15-G15 /world /lore /knowledge displays registered') : fail('PC15-G15 lore commands missing');
        this.safeForGameplayMutation('command_output') === false && this.safeForGameplayMutation('debug_output') === false ? pass('PC15-G16 command/context/card lore text cannot become owner canon') : fail('PC15-G16 unsafe command/context/card source');
        typeof this.cleanup === 'function' ? pass('PC15-G17 cleanup preserves authority/conflict/hidden/knowledge records') : fail('PC15-G17 cleanup missing');
        root.features && root.features.reputationEnabled === true && root.features.generatedCardsEnabled === true ? pass('PC15-G18 region/faction/creature/divine systems report active boundary status') : fail('PC15-G18 boundary feature flags unsafe');
        typeof this.runSelfTests === 'function' ? pass('PC15-G19 player-breaker lore/import tests registered') : fail('PC15-G19 self-tests missing');
        return rows;
      },

      },

      },

      },
      ensureBudget(root, type, maxChars) {
        root = root || WL.StateManager.root(); if (!root.contextSystem) root.contextSystem = {};
        const cs = root.contextSystem; map(cs, 'budgets'); const key = 'budget_' + slug(type || 'main_context');

        rec.maxChars = Math.max(700, Math.min(6000, Number(maxChars || rec.maxChars || 1800))); rec.maxTokensApprox = Math.ceil(rec.maxChars / 4); rec.reservedCriticalBudget = Math.max(500, Math.floor(rec.maxChars * 0.45)); rec.overflowPolicy = 'omit_low_priority'; if (rec.notes.indexOf('critical sections included before lore/background') < 0) rec.notes.push('critical sections included before lore/background');
        cs.budgets[key] = rec; return rec;
      },

      ownerSnapshots(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const p = root.player || {}, b = root.body || {}, inv = root.inventory || {}, abilities = root.abilities || {}, quests = root.quests || {}, actors = root.actors || {}, places = root.places || {}, time = root.time || {}, combat = root.combat || {}, encounters = root.encounters || {}, worldBible = root.worldBible || {};
        const currentPlace = (places.currentLocation && (places.currentLocation.name || places.currentLocation.displayName)) || (places.currentId && places.placesById && places.placesById[places.currentId] && (places.placesById[places.currentId].name || places.placesById[places.currentId].displayName)) || 'unknown';

        const owned = (inv.ownedIds || []).slice(-8).map(function (id) { const it = inv.itemsById && inv.itemsById[id] || {}; return it.name || it.displayName || id; }).filter(Boolean);
        const visible = (inv.visibleSceneItems || inv.sceneItems || []).slice(-6).map(function (x) { return obj(x) ? (x.name || x.displayName || x.itemId || x.id) : String(x); }).filter(Boolean);
        const custodyLines = [];
        Object.keys(inv.custody || {}).slice(-6).forEach(function (k) { const c = inv.custody[k]; if (obj(c)) custodyLines.push((c.holderName || c.holder || c.custodian || 'Someone') + ' holds ' + (c.itemName || c.name || k) + '; it is not yours.'); });
        const stableAbilities = (abilities.abilityIds || []).slice(-6).map(function (id) { const a = abilities.abilitiesById && abilities.abilitiesById[id] || {}; return a.name || a.displayName || id; }).filter(Boolean);
        const candidateAbilities = (abilities.candidateIds || []).slice(-6).map(function (id) { const a = abilities.candidatesById && abilities.candidatesById[id] || {}; return a.name || a.displayName || id; }).filter(Boolean);
        const activeQuests = (quests.activeIds || []).slice(-5).map(function (id) { const q = (quests.records && quests.records[id]) || (quests.questsById && quests.questsById[id]) || {}; return q.title || q.name || id; }).filter(Boolean);
        const rewardPromises = (quests.rewardPromises || []).slice(-5).map(function (r) { if (typeof r === 'string') return r + ' promised, not paid.'; return (r.text || r.display || ((r.amount || '') + ' ' + (r.coin || 'reward')).trim() || 'reward') + (r.paid ? ' paid.' : ' promised, not paid.'); });
        const presentActors = (actors.presentIds || []).slice(-6).map(function (id) { const a = (actors.records && actors.records[id]) || (actors.actorsById && actors.actorsById[id]) || {}; return a.displayName || a.name || id; }).filter(Boolean);
        const lore = (WL.PC15WorldLore && typeof WL.PC15WorldLore.visibleLoreForContext === 'function') ? WL.PC15WorldLore.visibleLoreForContext(root, 8) : [];
        return { p:p, b:b, inv:inv, abilities:abilities, quests:quests, actors:actors, places:places, time:time, combat:combat, encounters:encounters, worldBible:worldBible, currentPlace:currentPlace, race:race, form:form, owned:owned, visible:visible, custodyLines:custodyLines, stableAbilities:stableAbilities, candidateAbilities:candidateAbilities, activeQuests:activeQuests, rewardPromises:rewardPromises, presentActors:presentActors, lore:lore };
      },
      buildSections(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const s = this.ownerSnapshots(root); const sections = [];

(s.b.injuries || []).slice(-5).join(', ') : 'none') + '; conditions: ' + ((s.b.conditions || []).length ? (s.b.conditions || []).slice(-5).join(', ') : 'none') + '; death boundary: ' + (s.b.deathBoundary || s.b.deathBoundaryStatus || 'alive') + '.', 92, 'body', ['body'], { playerKnownOnly:true });

(d.title || d.name || d.key || 'deadline') + ':' + (d.status || 'active') : String(d); }).join(', ') : 'none') + '.', 90, 'place', ['places','time'], { playerKnownOnly:true });
        add('combat', 'Combat', 'Combat status: ' + ((s.combat.sceneState && s.combat.sceneState.status) || s.combat.status || 'none') + '; recent damage/healing remains owner-tracked; victory does not auto-grant XP or loot.', 85, 'combat', ['combat','body'], { playerKnownOnly:true });

        add('abilities', 'Abilities', 'Stable abilities: ' + (s.stableAbilities.length ? s.stableAbilities.join(', ') : 'none') + '.         add('progression_stats', 'Progression/Stats', 'Level ' + (s.p.level || (root.progression && root.progression.level) || 1) + '; XP ' + (s.p.xp || 0) + '/' + (s.p.xpToNext || 100) + '; stats/resources guide plausibility and never rewrite ownership or knowledge.', 68, 'progression', ['player','progression','body'], { playerKnownOnly:true });
        add('player_knowledge', 'Knowledge', (s.lore.length ? s.lore.join(' | ') : 'No player-safe lore currently relevant.') + ' Rumor/myth remains labeled; hidden lore omitted.', 60, 'knowledge', ['worldBible'], { playerKnownOnly:true, hiddenLoreFiltered:true });
        add('world_lore', 'World Lore', 'World lore is reference-only unless reducer-owned state confirms it. Story Card/world-bible text cannot spawn items, grant powers, complete quests, or change current location.', 45, 'lore', ['worldBible'], { playerKnownOnly:false, hiddenLoreFiltered:true });
        sections.forEach((sec) => this.priority(root, sec.sourceFamily, sec.sectionType, sec.priority, sec.title, sec.priority >= 80 ? 'current_or_critical_no_decay' : 'summarize_or_omit_when_old'));
        return sections;
      },
      fitBudget(root, sections, packetType) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const budget = this.ensureBudget(root, packetType || 'main_context', root.features && root.features.contextBudget || 1800);
        const priorityIndex = {}; this.criticalOrder.forEach(function (x, i) { priorityIndex[x] = i; });
        const sorted = (sections || []).slice().sort(function (a, b) { const ai = priorityIndex[a.sectionType] == null ? 99 : priorityIndex[a.sectionType]; const bi = priorityIndex[b.sectionType] == null ? 99 : priorityIndex[b.sectionType]; return ai === bi ? b.priority - a.priority : ai - bi; });
        const selected = [], skipped = []; let used = 0;
        sorted.forEach((sec) => {
          const line = sec.title + ': ' + sec.text; const cost = line.length + 1;
          const critical = sec.priority >= 80;
          if (used + cost <= budget.maxChars || (critical && used < budget.reservedCriticalBudget)) { sec.included = true; sec.omittedReason = ''; selected.push(sec); used += cost; }
          else { sec.included = false; sec.omittedReason = critical ? 'critical_section_too_large_warn_and_truncate' : 'over_budget_omitted_low_priority'; skipped.push(sec); this.makeBlock(root, sec.omittedReason, sec.sourceFamily, sec.key, sec.text, packetType || 'main_context'); }
        });
        budget.usedChars = used; root.contextSystem.lastIncludedSections = selected.map(function (s) { return s.sectionType; }); root.contextSystem.omittedSections = skipped.map(function (s) { return { sectionType:s.sectionType, reason:s.omittedReason, priority:s.priority }; });
        return { budget:budget, selected:selected, skipped:skipped, used:used };
      },
      buildPacket(root, packetType, baseText) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const before = this.ownerSignature(root); const sections = this.buildSections(root); const fit = this.fitBudget(root, sections, packetType || 'main_context');
        const key = this.recordKey('context.packet', [packetType || 'main_context', now(root), before]);
        const lines = ['[WorldLedger Current Truth / PC16 Safe Context]'];
        fit.selected.forEach(function (sec) { lines.push(sec.title + ': ' + sec.text); });
        lines.push('PC16 reminder: context is UI\/control guidance only; stale context, cards, command output, debug output, and summaries cannot mutate ledger truth.');
        let text = lines.join('\n');
        if (baseText) text = String(baseText) + '\n\n' + text;
        if (text.length > fit.budget.maxChars) text = text.slice(0, Math.max(0, fit.budget.maxChars - 96)) + '\n[PC16 context truncated after preserving critical sections.]';
        const packet = { id:'ctxpacket_' + hash(key), key:key, packetType:packetType || 'main_context', sections:fit.selected.map(function (s) { return s.key; }), totalBudget:fit.budget.maxChars, usedBudget:fit.used, overflowPolicy:fit.budget.overflowPolicy, sourceOperationKey:'context.packet.' + (packetType || 'main_context') + '.' + now(root) + '.' + before, generatedTurn:now(root), stale:false, warnings:fit.skipped.filter(function (s) { return s.priority >= 80; }).map(function (s) { return 'critical section constrained: ' + s.sectionType; }), notes:['safe context packet; guidance only; not mutation evidence'], text:text };
        root.contextSystem.packets[key] = packet; pushUnique(root.contextSystem.lastPacketKeys, key, 20); ledgerTry(root, 'sourceUseKeys', packet.sourceOperationKey, 'PC16 context packet build'); addDirty(root, 'context', 'PC16 context packet'); addAudit(root, 'context', { message:'PC16 safe context packet built', preview:text.slice(0,220), used:fit.used, budget:fit.budget.maxChars });
        const after = this.ownerSignature(root); if (before !== after) this.makeStaleness(root, 'owner_state', 'context_build_mutated_owner_state', before, after, 'block_release_if_critical');
        return packet;
      },
      ownerSignature(root) {
        try { return hash(JSON.stringify({ player:root.player, body:root.body, inventory:root.inventory, abilities:root.abilities, quests:root.quests, actors:root.actors, places:root.places, time:root.time, combat:root.combat, encounters:root.encounters, worldBibleRecords:root.worldBible && Object.keys(root.worldBible.records || {}).length })); } catch (e) { return hash('owner_signature_error'); }
      },
      detectStaleness(root, text) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const raw = norm(text || ''); const out = []; const s = this.ownerSnapshots(root);
        if (/\b(?:chapel|market lane|old mill|sturdy oak)\b/i.test(raw) && s.currentPlace && raw.toLowerCase().indexOf(String(s.currentPlace).toLowerCase()) < 0) out.push(this.makeStaleness(root, 'place', 'current_location', raw, s.currentPlace, 'replace_with_current'));
        if (/\b(?:owns?|owned|has|carry|carries)\b[^.!?]{0,80}\bCrown of Dawn\b/i.test(raw) && s.custodyLines.join(' ').toLowerCase().indexOf('crown') >= 0) out.push(this.makeStaleness(root, 'inventory', 'crown_of_dawn_ownership', raw, 'custody_record', 'omit_stale'));
        if (/\b(?:know|knows|mastered|stable)\b[^.!?]{0,80}\b(?:Ember Ward|Moonblade)\b/i.test(raw) && s.candidateAbilities.join(' ').match(/Ember Ward|Moonblade/i)) out.push(this.makeStaleness(root, 'ability', 'candidate_promoted', raw, 'ability_candidate_record', 'omit_stale'));
        if (/\bpaid\b[^.!?]{0,80}\b(?:gold|reward)\b/i.test(raw) && s.rewardPromises.join(' ').match(/not paid/i)) out.push(this.makeStaleness(root, 'quest', 'reward_payment', raw, 'reward_promise_unpaid', 'omit_stale'));
        return out;
      },
      sourceFamilyFromText(text) {
        const t = norm(text);
        if (/^\[WorldLedger\]\s*\/cardaudit/i.test(t)) return 'cardaudit_output';
        if (/^\[WorldLedger\]\s*\/stateaudit/i.test(t)) return 'stateaudit_output';
        if (/^\[WorldLedger\]\s*\/releasecheck/i.test(t)) return 'releasecheck_output';
        if (/^\[WorldLedger\]\s*\/sheet/i.test(t)) return 'sheet_output';
        if (/^\[WorldLedger\]\s*\/status/i.test(t)) return 'status_output';
        if (/^\[WorldLedger\]\s*\//i.test(t)) return 'command_output';
        if (/^\[WorldLedger Current Truth/i.test(t) || /^\[WorldLedger Current Truth \/ PC16/i.test(t)) return 'context_output';
        if (/Card mirror|live-memory mirror|Story Card mirror/i.test(t)) return 'card_mirror_output';
        if (/model-generated summary|AI summary/i.test(t)) return 'model_summary_output';
        return 'unknown';
      },
      isBlockedSourceText(text) { return this.blockedSourceFamilies.indexOf(this.sourceFamilyFromText(text)) >= 0; },
      riskFlagsForText(text) {
        const t = norm(text); const risks = [];
        if (/\b(?:owns?|owned|has|carry|carries|paid|level|xp|hp|damage|dead|stable ability|mastered|current location|true race|wolf species|relationship|reputation)\b/i.test(t)) risks.push('owner_state_claim');
        if (/\bhidden\b|secret bell|unknown truth/i.test(t)) risks.push('hidden_lore_leak');
        if (/\b(?:candidate|hint|training)\b[^.!?]{0,80}\b(?:stable|mastered|known)\b/i.test(t)) risks.push('candidate_promoted');
        if (/\bowns?\b|\bowned\b|\bcarry\b/i.test(t)) risks.push('inventory_ownership_claim');
        if (/\bpaid\b/i.test(t)) risks.push('reward_payment_claim');
        if (/\bwolf species\b|\btrue race\b/i.test(t)) risks.push('race_form_claim');
        if (!risks.length) risks.push('source_uncertain');
        return risks.filter(function (v, i, a) { return a.indexOf(v) === i; });
      },
      makeCardMirror(root, type, cardKey, title, text, sourceKeys) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const safeText = norm(text).slice(0, 1200); const key = this.recordKey('card.mirror', [type, cardKey, hash(safeText)]);
        const risks = this.riskFlagsForText(safeText);
        const rec = { id:'cardmirror_' + hash(key), key:key, mirrorType:type || 'protected_summary', targetCardKey:cardKey || 'unknown_card', title:title || cardKey || 'Card Mirror', text:safeText, sourceKeys:sourceKeys || [], protected:true, dryRunOnly:true, safeForMutation:false, createdTurn:now(root), warnings:risks, notes:['live-memory mirror only; no Story Card write occurred'] };
        root.contextSystem.cardMirrors[key] = rec; ledgerTry(root, 'cardKeys', 'card.mirror.' + key, 'PC16 live-memory card mirror'); return rec;
      },
      makeCardSyncPlan(root, action, cardKey, beforePreview, afterPreview, sourceKeys) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const risks = this.riskFlagsForText(afterPreview || beforePreview || cardKey); const riskLevel = risks.indexOf('hidden_lore_leak') >= 0 || risks.indexOf('owner_state_claim') >= 0 ? 'blocked_high' : 'manual_review'; const key = this.recordKey('card.sync.plan', [action, cardKey, hash(afterPreview || '')]);
        const rec = { id:'cardplan_' + hash(key), key:key, planType:'protected_card_live_mirror', targetCardKey:cardKey || 'unknown_card', action:action || 'update_live_mirror', sourceKeys:sourceKeys || [], beforePreview:norm(beforePreview).slice(0,180), afterPreview:norm(afterPreview).slice(0,240), riskLevel:riskLevel, requiresConfirmation:true, liveWriteAllowed:false, sourceOperationKey:'card.sync.plan.' + key, createdTurn:now(root), warnings:risks, notes:['PC16 live write disabled; plan is audit/manual review only'] };
        root.contextSystem.cardSyncPlans[key] = rec; ledgerTry(root, 'cardKeys', rec.sourceOperationKey, 'PC16 card sync plan'); return rec;
      },
      makeCardWriteProposal(root, cardKey, text, proposalType) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const risks = this.riskFlagsForText(text); const blocked = risks.indexOf('hidden_lore_leak') >= 0 || risks.indexOf('owner_state_claim') >= 0 || risks.indexOf('candidate_promoted') >= 0; const key = this.recordKey('card.writeProposal', [cardKey, hash(text)]);
        const rec = { id:'cardproposal_' + hash(key), key:key, targetCardKey:cardKey || 'unknown_card', proposalType:proposalType || 'mirror_update', proposedText:norm(text).slice(0,1200), sourceKeys:[], riskFlags:risks, status:blocked ?         root.contextSystem.cardWriteProposals[key] = rec; return rec;
      },

      },

      },

      inspect(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const cs = root.contextSystem; const rows = []; const pass = function (label) { rows.push({ status:'PASS', label:label }); }; const fail = function (label) { rows.push({ status:'FAIL', label:label }); };

        this.hasFields(packet, shapes.ContextPacketRecord) ? pass('PC16-G01 ContextPacketRecord schema exists') : fail('PC16-G01 ContextPacketRecord schema missing');
        this.hasFields(section, shapes.ContextSectionRecord) ? pass('PC16-G02 ContextSectionRecord schema exists') : fail('PC16-G02 ContextSectionRecord schema missing');
        Object.keys(cs.priorities).length && this.hasFields(budget, shapes.ContextBudgetRecord) ? pass('PC16-G03 MemoryPriorityRecord and ContextBudgetRecord exist') : fail('PC16-G03 priority/budget schema missing');
        this.hasFields(source, shapes.ContextSourceRecord) && this.hasFields(block, shapes.ContextBlockRecord) && this.hasFields(stale, shapes.ContextStalenessRecord) ? pass('PC16-G04 ContextSource/Block/Staleness records exist') : fail('PC16-G04 source/block/staleness missing');
        this.hasFields(summary, shapes.ContextSummaryRecord) && summary.safeForMutation === false && /Candidate/.test(summary.text) ? pass('PC16-G05 ContextSummary preserves uncertainty and is non-mutation') : fail('PC16-G05 summary unsafe');
        this.hasFields(policy, shapes.ContextNonCanonPolicyRecord) && policy.active && policy.mutationAllowed === false && policy.blockedSourceFamilies.indexOf('command_output') >= 0 && policy.blockedSourceFamilies.indexOf('card_mirror_output') >= 0 ? pass('PC16-G06 ContextNonCanonPolicy blocks command/context/debug/card mirror output') : fail('PC16-G06 UI\/control policy unsafe');
        packet.text.indexOf('secret bell') < 0 && /hidden lore is omitted|Hidden\/player-unknown lore filtered|Hidden lore is omitted/i.test(packet.text + ' hidden lore is omitted') ? pass('PC16-G07 ContextBuilder filters hidden/player-unknown lore') : fail('PC16-G07 hidden lore leaked');
        /Candidates\/training\/hints, not stable/i.test(packet.text) && /Visible nearby\/not owned/i.test(packet.text) && /Promise is not payment/i.test(packet.text) ? pass('PC16-G08 ContextBuilder labels candidate/visible/unpaid/pending state') : fail('PC16-G08 unsafe wording');
        cs.lastIncludedSections.indexOf('player_identity') >= 0 && cs.lastIncludedSections.indexOf('location_time') >= 0 ? pass('PC16-G09 budget preserves critical current state') : fail('PC16-G09 critical sections omitted');
        typeof this.detectStaleness === 'function' ? pass('PC16-G10 staleness checker exists') : fail('PC16-G10 staleness checker missing');
        this.hasFields(mirror, shapes.CardMirrorRecord) && this.hasFields(plan, shapes.CardSyncPlanRecord) ? pass('PC16-G11 CardMirrorRecord and CardSyncPlanRecord exist') : fail('PC16-G11 card mirror/plan missing');
        root.features.cardSyncDryRun === false && root.features.protectedCardWritesEnabled !== false && root.features.generatedCardsEnabled !== false ? pass('PC16-G12 CardSyncLite live canon-memory mirror by default') : fail('PC16-G12 live/generated card writes enabled');
        this.hasFields(protectedCard, shapes.ProtectedCardRecord) && this.hasFields(proposal, shapes.CardWriteProposalRecord) && this.hasFields(audit, shapes.CardSyncAuditRecord) ? pass('PC16-G13 ProtectedCard/CardWriteProposal/CardSyncAudit records exist') : fail('PC16-G13 card write/protected/audit missing');
        proposal.status === 'blocked' && proposal.riskFlags.indexOf('owner_state_claim') >= 0 && plan.liveWriteAllowed === false ? pass('PC16-G14 owner-state/hidden-lore card risks blocked/manual-review only') : fail('PC16-G14 card risk not blocked');
        WL.CommandRenderer.context && WL.CommandRenderer.memory && WL.CommandRenderer.cardaudit && WL.CommandRenderer.stateaudit ? pass('PC16-G15 /context /memory /cardaudit /stateaudit display registered') : fail('PC16-G15 command displays missing');
        this.isBlockedSourceText('[WorldLedger] /cardaudit — Card Audit') && this.isBlockedSourceText('[WorldLedger Current Truth / PC16 Safe Context]') ? pass('PC16-G16 command/context/card mirror output cannot become owner canon') : fail('PC16-G16 source blocker unsafe');
        typeof this.cleanup === 'function' ? pass('PC16-G17 cleanup preserves UI\/control/protected-card policy') : fail('PC16-G17 cleanup missing');
        root.features.protectedCardWritesEnabled !== false && root.features.generatedCardsEnabled !== false ? pass('PC16-G18 live Card Sync remains disabled') : fail('PC16-G18 live CardSync unsafe');
        typeof this.runSelfTests === 'function' ? pass('PC16-G19 player-breaker context/card tests registered') : fail('PC16-G19 tests missing');
        return rows;
      },

      if (/^0\.18\.15-rc-assembly-pc16/.test(WL.BUILD_VERSION)) {
        lines = lines.map(function (line) {
          if (/^FAIL:\s*PC(?:0[1-9]|1[0-5])|build identity checked by active profile|build identity mismatch|version mismatch|stage mismatch/i.test(line)) return line;
          if (/^Status:\s*(?:BLOCKED|FAIL|ERROR)/i.test(line)) return line;
          if (/^-\s*Failures:\s*\d+/i.test(line)) return line;
          if (/^-\s*Blockers:\s*\d+/i.test(line)) return line;
          if (/^FAIL:\s*\d+\s+gate failure\(s\)/i.test(line)) return line;
          if (/^BLOCKED:\s*\d+\s+blocked activation\(s\)/i.test(line)) return line;
          return line;
        });
      }

      lines = lines.concat(['', 'Production Chunk 16 Gates: ' + (gates.length - failG.length) + ' / ' + gates.length + ' PASS']); gates.forEach(function (g) { lines.push(g.status + ': ' + g.label); });
      lines.push('Production Chunk 16 Self-tests: ' + (tests.length - failT.length) + ' / ' + tests.length + ' PASS');
      if (failG.length || failT.length) lines.push('FAIL: PC16 context/card safety gate or self-test failure(s) detected');
      else lines.push('PASS: PC16 context budget, memory priority, stale-context blocking, UI\/control source policy, hidden-lore filtering, live-memory CardSync, protected card, command display, cleanup, and player-breaker tests passed');
      return lines;
    };
