        root = this.ensure(root); const key = 'creature_threat_' + slug(speciesKey); const old = root.creatures.threatProfiles[key] || {}; const rec = Object.assign(old, { id:key, key:key, speciesKey:speciesKey, objectiveThreatLabel:label || old.objectiveThreatLabel || 'unknown', relativeDangerLabel:old.relativeDangerLabel || 'depends_on_context', noRubberBand:true, sourceOperationKey:old.sourceOperationKey || 'creature.threat.' + slug(speciesKey), updatedTurn:now(root), notes:old.notes || ['Creature threat does not scale to player level; relative danger is display only.'] });
        root.creatures.threatProfiles[key] = rec; const sp = root.creatures.species[speciesKey]; if (sp) sp.threatProfileKey = key; const b = root.creatures.bestiary['bestiary_' + slug(speciesKey)]; if (b) uniquePush(b.knownThreatLabels, rec.objectiveThreatLabel, 10); return rec;
      },
      makeWeaknessResistance(root, speciesName, kind, trait, status, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const sp = this.makeSpeciesRecord(root, speciesName, { entryStatus: status === 'hidden' ? 'hidden' : 'partial', playerKnowledgeStatus: status === 'hidden' ? 'hidden' : (status || 'rumored') }); const hidden = !!opts.hidden || status === 'hidden'; const key = 'creature_wr_' + slug(sp.key + '_' + kind + '_' + trait); const old = root.creatures.weaknessesResistances[key] || {};
        const rec = Object.assign(old, { id:key, key:key, speciesKey:sp.key, kind:kind || 'weakness', trait:norm(trait || 'unknown'), knowledgeStatus:status || old.knowledgeStatus || 'rumored', confidence:opts.confidence || (status === 'confirmed_by_observation' ? 'high' : 'low'), hidden:hidden, sourceOperationKey:old.sourceOperationKey || 'creature.wr.' + slug(sp.key) + '.' + slug(kind) + '.' + slug(trait), createdTurn:old.createdTurn || now(root), notes:old.notes || ['Weakness/resistance knowledge does not auto-win, auto-null damage, or bypass combat validation.'] });
        root.creatures.weaknessesResistances[key] = rec; uniquePush(sp.weaknessResistanceKeys, key, 20); const b = this.makeBestiaryEntry(root, sp.key, { entryStatus:hidden ? 'hidden' : 'partial', playerKnowledgeStatus:hidden ? 'hidden' : rec.knowledgeStatus }); if (hidden) { uniquePush(b.hiddenFactKeys, key, 20); this.makeHiddenFact(root, sp.displayName, kind + ': ' + trait, 'hidden'); } else if (kind === 'weakness') uniquePush(b.knownWeaknesses, rec.trait + ' (' + rec.knowledgeStatus + ')', 20); else uniquePush(b.knownResistances, rec.trait + ' (' + rec.knowledgeStatus + ')', 20); this.makeKnowledge(root, sp.key, kind, rec.knowledgeStatus, { trait:rec.trait, sourceKey:rec.sourceOperationKey }); dirty(root, 'creatures', 'PC17 weakness/resistance'); return rec;
      },
      makeLootProfile(root, speciesName, itemName, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const sp = this.makeSpeciesRecord(root, speciesName, { entryStatus:'partial' }); const key = 'creature_loot_' + slug(sp.key + '_' + itemName); const rec = root.creatures.lootProfiles[key] || { id:key, key:key, speciesKey:sp.key, lootType:opts.lootType || 'possible_material', itemName:title(itemName || 'unknown material'), knowledgeStatus:opts.knowledgeStatus || 'known', ownedItemCreated:false, sourceOperationKey:'creature.loot.' + slug(sp.key) + '.' + slug(itemName), createdTurn:now(root), notes:['Loot profile is not inventory ownership and does not create an item.'] };
        root.creatures.lootProfiles[key] = rec; const b = this.makeBestiaryEntry(root, sp.key, { playerKnowledgeStatus:'partial' }); uniquePush(b.knownLootNotes, rec.itemName + ' possible; not owned/harvested', 20); const species = root.creatures.species[sp.key]; if (species) species.lootProfileKey = key; dirty(root, 'creatures', 'PC17 loot profile'); return rec;
      },
      makeBodyPart(root, speciesName, partName, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const sp = this.makeSpeciesRecord(root, speciesName, { entryStatus:'partial' }); const key = 'creature_body_part_' + slug(sp.key + '_' + partName); const rec = root.creatures.bodyParts[key] || { id:key, key:key, speciesKey:sp.key, partName:title(partName || 'unknown part'), partType:opts.partType || 'body_part', harvestStatus:opts.harvestStatus || 'not_harvested', ownedItemCreated:false, sourceOperationKey:'creature.bodypart.' + slug(sp.key) + '.' + slug(partName), createdTurn:now(root), notes:['Body part reference is not an owned item. Harvesting remains inventory/crafting validation.'] };
        root.creatures.bodyParts[key] = rec; const species = root.creatures.species[sp.key]; if (species) uniquePush(species.bodyPartKeys, key, 20); return rec;
      },
      makeInstance(root, speciesName, status, text, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const sp = this.makeSpeciesRecord(root, speciesName, { entryStatus:'partial' }); const op = 'creature.instance.' + slug(sp.key) + '.' + (status || 'candidate') + '.' + hash(text || status); const dupe = ledger(root, 'permanentKeys', op, 'PC17 creature instance'); const key = 'creature_instance_' + slug(sp.key + '_' + (status || 'candidate') + '_' + hash(text || status));
        if (dupe.duplicate && root.creatures.instances[key]) return root.creatures.instances[key];
        const rec = { id:key, key:key, speciesKey:sp.key, variantKey:opts.variantKey || '', displayName:opts.displayName || sp.displayName, instanceType:opts.instanceType || (/\b(?:pack|herd|swarm|group|three|two|\d+)\b/i.test(text || '') ? 'group' : 'individual'), count:opts.count || (/(?:three|3)\b/i.test(text || '') ? 3 : 1), status:status || 'candidate', placeKey:opts.placeKey || (root.places && root.places.currentId || ''), sceneKey:opts.sceneKey || '', encounterKey:opts.encounterKey || (root.encounters && root.encounters.activeEncounterKey || ''), combatantKey:opts.combatantKey || '', actorKey:opts.actorKey || '', knownToPlayer:opts.knownToPlayer !== false, sourceOperationKey:op, createdTurn:now(root), updatedTurn:now(root), endedTurn:0, warnings:[], notes:['Creature instance is not automatically combat, XP, or loot.'] };
        root.creatures.instances[key] = rec; this.makeObservation(root, sp.displayName, status === 'present' ? 'presence' : status, text, { status:status || 'candidate' }); dirty(root, 'creatures', 'PC17 creature instance'); return rec;
      },
      makeEncounterBoundary(root, speciesName, boundaryType, text, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const sp = this.makeSpeciesRecord(root, speciesName, { entryStatus:'partial' }); const key = 'creature_boundary_' + slug(sp.key + '_' + boundaryType + '_' + hash(text || boundaryType)); const rec = root.creatures.encounterBoundaries[key] || { id:key, key:key, speciesKey:sp.key, boundaryType:boundaryType || 'reference_only', encounterKey:opts.encounterKey || (root.encounters && root.encounters.activeEncounterKey || ''), combatKey:opts.combatKey || '', spawnedEncounter:false, createdCombat:false, grantedXP:false, createdLoot:false, sourceOperationKey:'creature.boundary.' + slug(sp.key) + '.' + hash(text || boundaryType), createdTurn:now(root), notes:['Ecology boundary records do not spawn fights, create damage, grant XP, or create loot.'] };
        root.creatures.encounterBoundaries[key] = rec; return rec;
      },
      makeObservation(root, speciesName, observationType, text, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const sp = this.makeSpeciesRecord(root, speciesName, { entryStatus:'partial' }); const key = 'creature_observation_' + slug(sp.key + '_' + observationType + '_' + hash(text || observationType)); const rec = root.creatures.observations[key] || { id:key, key:key, speciesKey:sp.key, observationType:observationType || 'unknown', status:opts.status || 'observed', placeKey:opts.placeKey || (root.places && root.places.currentId || ''), sourceOperationKey:'creature.observation.' + slug(sp.key) + '.' + hash(text || observationType), createdTurn:now(root), notes:['Observation updates ecology/bestiary only.'] };
        root.creatures.observations[key] = rec; return rec;
      },
      makeRumor(root, speciesName, rumorType, claimText) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const sp = this.makeSpeciesRecord(root, speciesName, { entryStatus:'rumored', playerKnowledgeStatus:'rumored' }); const key = 'creature_rumor_' + slug(sp.key + '_' + rumorType + '_' + hash(claimText || rumorType)); const rec = root.creatures.rumors[key] || { id:key, key:key, speciesKey:sp.key, rumorType:rumorType || 'unknown', claimText:norm(claimText).slice(0, 220), knowledgeStatus:'rumored', sourceOperationKey:'creature.rumor.' + slug(sp.key) + '.' + hash(claimText || rumorType), createdTurn:now(root), notes:['Rumor is not confirmed fact and cannot spawn an encounter or grant an advantage.'] };
        root.creatures.rumors[key] = rec; this.makeKnowledge(root, sp.key, rumorType || 'myth', 'rumored', { sourceKey:rec.sourceOperationKey }); return rec;
      },
      makeHiddenFact(root, speciesName, factText, revealStatus) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const sp = this.makeSpeciesRecord(root, speciesName, { entryStatus:'hidden', playerKnowledgeStatus:'hidden' }); const key = 'creature_hidden_' + slug(sp.key + '_' + hash(factText)); const rec = root.creatures.hiddenFacts[key] || { id:key, key:key, speciesKey:sp.key, factType:'hidden_bestiary_fact', factText:norm(factText).slice(0, 220), revealStatus:revealStatus || 'hidden', allowedContextUse:'none_until_revealed', sourceOperationKey:'creature.hidden.' + slug(sp.key) + '.' + hash(factText), createdTurn:now(root), notes:['Hidden bestiary fact is filtered from normal context until revealed.'] };
        root.creatures.hiddenFacts[key] = rec; const species = root.creatures.species[sp.key]; if (species) uniquePush(species.hiddenFactKeys, key, 20); const b = this.makeBestiaryEntry(root, sp.key, { entryStatus:'hidden', playerKnowledgeStatus:'hidden' }); uniquePush(b.hiddenFactKeys, key, 20); return rec;
      },
      makeContextRuleRecord(root, key) { return { id:key, key:key, ruleType:'creature_context_source_safety_policy', hiddenFactsAllowed:false, spawnFromContextAllowed:false, mutationAllowed:false, createdTurn:now(root), notes:['Creature context and card mirrors cannot mutate ecology, encounters, combat, inventory, XP, or player powers.'] }; },
      makeBlockedMutation(root, speciesName, claimText, reason) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const sp = speciesName ? this.makeSpeciesRecord(root, speciesName, { entryStatus:'partial' }) : null; const key = 'creature_blocked_' + slug((sp && sp.key || 'unknown') + '_' + hash(claimText || reason)); const rec = root.creatures.blockedMutations[key] || { id:key, key:key, speciesKey:sp && sp.key || '', claimText:norm(claimText).slice(0, 220), reason:reason || 'blocked creature mutation', ownersBlocked:['abilities','player','inventory','progression','combat','encounters'], sourceOperationKey:'creature.blocked.' + hash(claimText || reason), createdTurn:now(root), notes:['Creature/species lore cannot directly mutate player powers or other owner state.'] };
        root.creatures.blockedMutations[key] = rec; uniquePush(root.creatures.warnings, rec.reason, 50); return rec;
      },
      classifyText(text) {
        const raw = norm(text); const l = lower(raw); const species = this.speciesFromText(raw); const nonCanon = this.isNonCanonText(raw); const quoted = /["“”]/.test(raw) || /\b(?:says|said|tells?|claims?)\b[^.!?]{0,80}["“]/i.test(raw); const dream = /\b(?:dream|vision|imagines?|hallucination|illusion|metaphor|as if|symbolic)\b/i.test(l);
        const rumor = /\b(?:rumou?r|people say|they say|it is said|legend says|legends say|supposedly|allegedly|villagers say|bestiary says|lore says|world bible|story card)\b/i.test(l);
        const sign = /\b(?:tracks?|footprints?|spoor|scat|claw marks?|shed scales?|tufts? of fur|howl(?:ing)?|howls?|roar(?:ing)?|screech(?:ing)?|distant cry|bones gnawed|tracks lead)\b/i.test(l);
        const distant = /\b(?:distant|far away|far above|somewhere beyond|beyond the trees|nearby but unseen|in the distance|echoes?)\b/i.test(l);
        const present = /\b(?:steps? from|emerges?|appears?|blocks your path|stands? before|is here|are here|you see|you spot|surrounds?|lunges?|growling before you|pads into|flies overhead)\b/i.test(l) && !distant;
        const attack = /\b(?:attacks?|bites?|claws?|slashes?|charges?|lunges?|strikes?|burns?|breathes fire|mauls?)\b/i.test(l);
        const dead = /\b(?:dead|dies?|defeat(?:ed)?|falls dead|corpse|carcass|slain)\b/i.test(l);
        const loot = /\b(?:pelt|pelts|fang|fangs|claw|claws|scale|scales|hide|horn|horns|venom sac|heart|core|drops?|loot|valuable)\b/i.test(l);
        const harvest = /\b(?:harvest|skin|butcher|take the fang|cut out|carve out|pluck|extract)\b/i.test(l);
        const weakness = /\b(?:weak to|weakness|vulnerable to|fears?|fear|recoils from|burns easily|hates silver|silver bells?|fire|holy water|sunlight)\b/i.test(l);
        const resistance = /\b(?:resists?|resistant to|immune to|arrows bounce|blades bounce|shrugs off|unharmed by)\b/i.test(l);
        const habitat = /\b(?:live near|lives near|haunt|haunts|nest in|nests in|den near|territory|territorial|habitat|roam|roams|found in|dwells? in)\b/i.test(l);
        const playerPowerRisk = /\b(?:you gain|player gains|can now|learn(?:s|ed)?|gain the ability|breath(?:e|es) fire|copy|absorb|devour|become a dragon species|dragonborn can breathe fire)\b/i.test(l) && /\b(?:dragon|dragonborn|wolf|creature|species|power|ability|breath(?:e|es) fire)\b/i.test(l);
        return { raw, lower:l, species, nonCanon, quoted, dream, rumor, sign, distant, present, attack, dead, loot, harvest, weakness, resistance, habitat, playerPowerRisk };
      },
      traitFromText(text, kind) { const l = lower(text); if (/silver bell/.test(l)) return 'silver bells'; if (/silver/.test(l)) return 'silver'; if (/fire|flame|burn/.test(l)) return 'fire'; if (/sunlight|sun/.test(l)) return 'sunlight'; if (/holy water|holy/.test(l)) return 'holy water'; if (/arrow/.test(l)) return 'arrows'; if (/blade|sword/.test(l)) return 'blades'; if (/magic|spell/.test(l)) return 'magic'; return kind === 'resistance' ? 'unknown resistance' : 'unknown weakness'; },
      signTypeFromText(text) { const l = lower(text); if (/track|footprint|spoor/.test(l)) return 'tracks'; if (/howl/.test(l)) return 'howling'; if (/roar/.test(l)) return 'roar'; if (/claw mark/.test(l)) return 'claw_marks'; if (/scale/.test(l)) return 'shed_scales'; if (/scat/.test(l)) return 'scat'; return 'sign'; },
      lootNameFromText(text) { const l = lower(text); if (/pelt/.test(l)) return 'pelt'; if (/fang/.test(l)) return 'fang'; if (/claw/.test(l)) return 'claw'; if (/scale/.test(l)) return 'scale'; if (/hide/.test(l)) return 'hide'; if (/horn/.test(l)) return 'horn'; if (/core/.test(l)) return 'core'; if (/venom/.test(l)) return 'venom sac'; return 'creature part'; },
      observeOutput(root, text, sourceFamily) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const c = this.classifyText(text || ''); if (!c.raw || c.nonCanon || c.dream || c.quoted) { if (c.species.length && (c.nonCanon || c.dream || c.quoted)) audit(root, 'parser', { subsystem:'PC17CreatureEcology', outcome:'blocked_source', reason:'creature claim from UI\/control/dream/quoted text ignored', preview:c.raw.slice(0, 160) }); return []; }
        const made = []; if (!c.species.length) return made;
        for (let i = 0; i < c.species.length; i++) {
          const spName = c.species[i]; const sp = this.makeSpeciesRecord(root, spName, { entryStatus:c.rumor ? 'rumored' : 'partial', playerKnowledgeStatus:c.rumor ? 'rumored' : 'known' }); made.push(sp);
          if (c.playerPowerRisk) made.push(this.makeBlockedMutation(root, spName, c.raw, 'species/creature lore cannot grant player powers automatically'));
          if (c.habitat || c.rumor) { made.push(c.rumor ? this.makeRumor(root, spName, c.habitat ? 'habitat_rumor' : 'creature_rumor', c.raw) : this.makeHabitat(root, spName, c.raw, { presenceLikelihood:'possible' })); }
          if (c.sign) made.push(this.makeSign(root, spName, this.signTypeFromText(c.raw), c.raw, { distanceStatus:c.distant ? 'distant' : 'nearby_unknown', certainty:c.rumor ? 'rumored' : 'possible', knowledgeStatus:c.rumor ? 'rumored' : 'suspected' }));
          if (c.present && !c.rumor) made.push(this.makeInstance(root, spName, c.attack ? 'encounter_active' : 'present', c.raw, { knownToPlayer:true, encounterKey:root.encounters && root.encounters.activeEncounterKey || '' }));
          else if (c.distant && !c.rumor) made.push(this.makeInstance(root, spName, 'distant', c.raw, { knownToPlayer:true }));
          if (c.attack) made.push(this.makeEncounterBoundary(root, spName, 'attack_routes_to_combat_owner', c.raw, { encounterKey:root.encounters && root.encounters.activeEncounterKey || '' }));
          if (c.weakness) made.push(this.makeWeaknessResistance(root, spName, 'weakness', this.traitFromText(c.raw, 'weakness'), c.rumor ? 'rumored' : 'confirmed_by_observation', { confidence:c.rumor ? 'low' : 'high' }));
          if (c.resistance) made.push(this.makeWeaknessResistance(root, spName, 'resistance', this.traitFromText(c.raw, 'resistance'), c.rumor ? 'rumored' : 'confirmed_by_observation', { confidence:c.rumor ? 'low' : 'high' }));
          if (c.loot) { const loot = this.lootNameFromText(c.raw); made.push(this.makeLootProfile(root, spName, loot, { knowledgeStatus:c.rumor ? 'rumored' : 'known' })); if (/fang|claw|scale|horn|core|heart|hide|pelt|venom/.test(lower(loot))) made.push(this.makeBodyPart(root, spName, loot, { harvestStatus:c.harvest ? 'attempted_not_validated' : 'not_harvested' })); }
          if (c.dead) made.push(this.makeEncounterBoundary(root, spName, 'death_does_not_grant_xp_or_loot', c.raw, {}));
        }
        if (made.length) { audit(root, 'reducers', { subsystem:'PC17CreatureEcology', outcome:'observed', reason:'creature ecology/bestiary records updated without bypassing encounter/combat/inventory/progression owners', count:made.length, preview:c.raw.slice(0, 180) }); dirty(root, 'context', 'PC17 creature observation'); }
        return made;
      },
      observeInput(root, text) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const c = this.classifyText(text || ''); if (!c.species.length || /^\s*\//.test(c.raw)) return [];
        const made = [];
        if (c.harvest || c.attack) c.species.forEach(function (sp) { made.push(WL.PC17CreatureEcology.makeEncounterBoundary(root, sp, c.harvest ? 'input_harvest_requires_inventory_validation' : 'input_attack_intent_not_ecology_commit', c.raw, {})); });
        return made;
      },
      importLoreSourceLink(root, sourceType, sourceName, text, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); opts = opts || {}; const c = this.classifyText(text || ''); if (!c.species.length) return [];
        const made = []; if (/^(command_output|debug_output|memory_context|context)$/i.test(sourceType || '')) return made;
        c.species.forEach(function (sp) {
          if (opts.hidden || /\b(?:hidden|secret|unknown to the player)\b/i.test(text || '')) made.push(WL.PC17CreatureEcology.makeHiddenFact(root, sp, text, 'hidden'));
          else if (c.weakness || c.resistance) made.push(WL.PC17CreatureEcology.makeWeaknessResistance(root, sp, c.resistance ? 'resistance' : 'weakness', WL.PC17CreatureEcology.traitFromText(text, c.resistance ? 'resistance' : 'weakness'), c.rumor ? 'rumored' : 'known', { confidence:c.rumor ? 'low' : 'medium' }));
          else if (c.habitat || c.rumor) made.push(c.rumor ? WL.PC17CreatureEcology.makeRumor(root, sp, 'lore_rumor', text) : WL.PC17CreatureEcology.makeHabitat(root, sp, text, { presenceLikelihood:'possible' }));
          else made.push(WL.PC17CreatureEcology.makeSpeciesRecord(root, sp, { entryStatus:c.rumor ? 'rumored' : 'partial', playerKnowledgeStatus:c.rumor ? 'rumored' : 'known', sourceKey:'pc17_lore_sourceLink_' + hash(text || sp) }));
          if (c.playerPowerRisk) made.push(WL.PC17CreatureEcology.makeBlockedMutation(root, sp, text, 'species lore cannot grant player powers'));
        });
        return made;
      },
      visibleBestiary(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const rows = [];
        objKeys(root.creatures.bestiary).sort().forEach(function (k) { const b = root.creatures.bestiary[k]; if (!b || b.entryStatus === 'hidden' || b.playerKnowledgeStatus === 'hidden') return; const weakness = arr(b.knownWeaknesses).join(', ') || 'none known'; const resist = arr(b.knownResistances).join(', ') || 'none known'; const signs = arr(b.knownSigns).join(', ') || 'none known'; rows.push(b.displayName + ' — ' + b.entryStatus + ' / knowledge=' + b.playerKnowledgeStatus + '; signs=' + signs + '; weakness=' + weakness + '; resistance=' + resist + '; loot=' + (arr(b.knownLootNotes).join(', ') || 'not owned/harvested')); });
        return rows;
      },
      creatureLines(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const lines = [];
        lines.push('Policy: creature lore is not an encounter; signs are not presence; presence is not combat; death is not XP/loot.');
        lines.push('Species records: ' + objKeys(root.creatures.species).length + ', instances: ' + objKeys(root.creatures.instances).length + ', signs: ' + objKeys(root.creatures.signs).length + ', bestiary entries: ' + objKeys(root.creatures.bestiary).length);
        const present = objKeys(root.creatures.instances).map(function (k) { return root.creatures.instances[k]; }).filter(function (r) { return /present|encounter_active|nearby|distant|corpse/.test(r.status); }).slice(-6);
        lines.push('Observed creatures: ' + (present.length ? present.map(function (r) { return r.displayName + ' [' + r.status + ']'; }).join(', ') : 'none'));
        const signs = objKeys(root.creatures.signs).map(function (k) { return root.creatures.signs[k]; }).slice(-6);
        lines.push('Recent signs: ' + (signs.length ? signs.map(function (s) { return WL.PC17CreatureEcology.displaySpecies(s.speciesKey) + ' ' + s.signType + ' (' + s.distanceStatus + ')'; }).join(', ') : 'none'));
        const boundaries = objKeys(root.creatures.encounterBoundaries).map(function (k) { return root.creatures.encounterBoundaries[k]; }).slice(-4);
        lines.push('Boundaries: ' + (boundaries.length ? boundaries.map(function (b) { return WL.PC17CreatureEcology.displaySpecies(b.speciesKey) + ' ' + b.boundaryType + ' / XP=' + b.grantedXP + ' loot=' + b.createdLoot; }).join('; ') : 'none'));
        return lines;
      },
      bestiaryLines(root) { const rows = this.visibleBestiary(root); return ['Bestiary visibility: hidden facts omitted; rumored facts labeled; entries do not spawn creatures or grant combat advantage.'].concat(rows.length ? rows : ['No player-known creature entries yet.']); },
      contextLines(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const rows = [];
        const best = this.visibleBestiary(root).slice(0, 5);
        if (best.length) rows.push('Bestiary known/rumored: ' + best.join(' | '));
        const signs = objKeys(root.creatures.signs).map(function (k) { return root.creatures.signs[k]; }).slice(-4);
        if (signs.length) rows.push('Creature signs only, not presence: ' + signs.map(function (s) { return WL.PC17CreatureEcology.displaySpecies(s.speciesKey) + ' ' + s.signType + ' (' + s.distanceStatus + ')'; }).join(', '));
        const inst = objKeys(root.creatures.instances).map(function (k) { return root.creatures.instances[k]; }).filter(function (r) { return /present|encounter_active|distant|nearby/.test(r.status); }).slice(-4);
        if (inst.length) rows.push('Creature instances: ' + inst.map(function (r) { return r.displayName + ' [' + r.status + '; not automatic damage/XP/loot]'; }).join(', '));
        rows.push('Creature rule: ecology informs context/threat only; combat, XP, inventory, powers, and encounters need owner validation.');
        return rows;
      },
      cleanup(root) { root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); ['warnings','notes'].forEach(function (k) { cap(root.creatures[k], 80); }); return root; },
      ownerSignature(root) { root = root || WL.StateManager.root(); return JSON.stringify({ inv:root.inventory, player:root.player, body:root.body, prog:root.progression, abilities:root.abilities }); },
      inspect(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const c = root.creatures; const rows = []; const pass = function (label) { rows.push({ status:'PASS', label:label }); }; const fail = function (label) { rows.push({ status:'FAIL', label:label }); };
        /^0\.18\.16-rc-assembly-pc17/.test(WL.BUILD_VERSION) ? pass('PC17-G01 build identity active') : fail('PC17-G01 build identity mismatch: ' + WL.BUILD_VERSION);
        c.lockVersion === WL.PRODUCTION_CHUNK_17_LOCK_VERSION ? pass('PC17-G02 creature lock present') : fail('PC17-G02 creature lock missing');

      parseCurrency: function (text) { const m = norm(text).match(/(\d{1,6})\s*(copper|silver|gold)\b/i); return m ? { amount:Number(m[1]), coin:m[2].toLowerCase(), display:Number(m[1]) + ' ' + m[2].toLowerCase() } : null; },
      itemId: function (name) { return 'item_' + slug(name); },

      normalizeItemName: function (name) { let v = norm(name).replace(/^(?:the|a|an|your|his|her|their|my)\s+/i, '').replace(/[.!?;,]+$/g, '').trim(); if (/^red potion$/i.test(v)) v = 'red healing potion'; if (/^room$/i.test(v)) v = 'lodging room'; if (!v || /^(?:it|them|one|offer|price|gold|silver|copper|money|debt)$/i.test(v)) return ''; return title(v); },
      currentShopKey: function (root, fallback) {

      },
      shopTypeFromName: function (name) { const l = lower(name); if (/blacksmith|smith|forge/.test(l)) return 'blacksmith'; if (/healer|clinic|temple/.test(l)) return 'healer'; if (/trainer|dojo|academy/.test(l)) return 'trainer'; if (/inn|tavern/.test(l)) return /tavern/.test(l) ? 'tavern' : 'inn'; if (/stable/.test(l)) return 'stable'; if (/alchemist|potion/.test(l)) return 'alchemist'; if (/market|stall/.test(l)) return 'market_stall'; return 'unknown'; },
      inferShopName: function (text) { const l = lower(text); if (/blacksmith|smith|forge/.test(l)) return 'Blacksmith'; if (/healer/.test(l)) return 'Healer'; if (/trainer/.test(l)) return 'Trainer'; if (/inn/.test(l)) return 'Inn'; if (/stable/.test(l)) return 'Stable'; if (/merchant/.test(l)) return 'Merchant'; if (/shop/.test(l)) return 'Shop'; return 'Known Shop'; },
      inferServiceType: function (text) { const l = lower(text); if (/heal|wound|bleeding|close/.test(l)) return 'healing'; if (/repair|mend|fix/.test(l)) return 'repair'; if (/train|lesson|teach/.test(l)) return 'training'; if (/room|inn|lodg|sleep/.test(l)) return 'lodging'; if (/transport|ride|cart|ferry|horse/.test(l)) return 'transport'; if (/information|secret|rumor/.test(l)) return 'information'; return 'unknown'; },
      inferItemFromText: function (text, role) {
        const raw = norm(text); let m;
        if (role === 'purchase' && (m = raw.match(/hands? you (?:the\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,60})(?:\.|,|$)/i))) return this.normalizeItemName(m[1]);
        if (role === 'sale' && (m = raw.match(/sell (?:the\s+|your\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,60})(?:,| for | and |\.|$)/i))) return this.normalizeItemName(m[1]);
        if ((m = raw.match(/(?:costs?|for sale|priced at|price is)\s+(?:at\s+)?\d+\s*(?:gold|silver|copper)\s*(?:for\s+)?(?:the\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,60})/i))) return this.normalizeItemName(m[1]);
        if ((m = raw.match(/(?:the\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,60})\s+(?:costs?|is for sale for|for sale for)\s+\d+\s*(?:gold|silver|copper)/i))) return this.normalizeItemName(m[1]);
        if ((m = raw.match(/for (?:your\s+|the\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,60})(?:\.|,|$)/i))) return this.normalizeItemName(m[1]);
        return '';
      },
      snapshot: function (root) { this.ensure(root); return { currency: clone(root.inventory && root.inventory.currency || {}), ownedIds: arr(root.inventory && root.inventory.ownedIds).slice(), itemsById: clone(root.inventory && root.inventory.itemsById || {}), body: clone(root.body || {}) }; },

      recordQuote: function (root, displayName, amount, coin, quoteType, text, opts) { this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const shop = this.ensureShop(root, opts.shopName || this.inferShopName(text), {}); const itemKey = opts.service ?       addDispute: function (root, type, claimA, claimB, relatedKey, text) { this.ensure(root); const key = this.sourceKey('dispute.' + type + '.' + (relatedKey || ''), text || claimA || claimB); let r = root.economy.disputes[key]; if (!r) r = root.economy.disputes[key] = { id:key, key, disputeType:type || 'unknown', relatedTradeKey:relatedKey || '', claimA:norm(claimA), claimB:norm(claimB), resolvedStatus:'unresolved', sourceOperationKey:key, createdTurn:now(root), notes:[] }; dirty(root,'economy','economic dispute: ' + type); return r; },
      applyCurrency: function (root, coin, amountDelta, transactionKey, type, text, before) { this.ensure(root); if (!root.inventory || !root.inventory.currency) return { applied:false, reason:'inventory currency missing' }; coin = String(coin || '').toLowerCase(); const amount = Math.abs(Number(amountDelta || 0)); if (!amount || !/^(?:gold|silver|copper)$/.test(coin)) return { applied:false, reason:'invalid currency' }; const key = 'currency.' + (amountDelta >= 0 ? 'gain' : 'loss') + '.' + amount + '.' + coin + '.' + slug(transactionKey || hash(text)); const l = led(root, 'permanentKeys', key, { transactionType:type || 'currency_transaction' }); if (!l.applied) return { applied:false, duplicate:true, key, reason:'duplicate currency transaction skipped' };
        let cur = Number(root.inventory.currency[coin] || 0); const beforeCur = before && before.currency ? Number(before.currency[coin] || 0) : null;
        if (amountDelta < 0) {
          // Older currency-gain parsing can misread "you pay X" as income. When a pre-output snapshot exists,
          // treat any same-output increase above the snapshot as legacy noise before applying the true payment loss.
          if (beforeCur != null && cur > beforeCur) cur = beforeCur;
          if (cur < amount) return { applied:false, dispute:this.addDispute(root, 'insufficient_funds', 'Need ' + amount + ' ' + coin, 'Have ' + cur + ' ' + coin, transactionKey, text), reason:'insufficient funds' };
          root.inventory.currency[coin] = Math.max(0, cur - amount);
        } else {
          if (beforeCur != null && cur >= beforeCur + amount) {
            // A legacy inventory/reward reducer already applied the gain from the same story output. Keep PC18 transaction audit without double-paying.
          } else root.inventory.currency[coin] = Math.min(999999999, cur + amount);
        }
        const tr = { id:key, key, transactionType:type || (amountDelta >= 0 ? 'currency_gain' : 'currency_loss'), amount, currencyType:coin, fromHolderKey:amountDelta < 0 ? 'player' : 'counterparty', toHolderKey:amountDelta < 0 ? 'counterparty' : 'player', relatedTradeKey:transactionKey || '', relatedQuestKey:'', relatedDebtKey:'', sourceOperationKey:transactionKey || key, inventoryOperationKey:key, status:'applied', createdTurn:now(root), appliedTurn:now(root), duplicateOf:'', warnings:[], notes:[] };
        root.economy.transactions[key] = tr; dirty(root,'inventory_equipment','currency transaction'); dirty(root,'economy','currency transaction'); return { applied:true, key, transaction:tr };
      },
      addItemOwned: function (root, itemName, transactionKey, text, before) { this.ensure(root); const name = this.normalizeItemName(itemName); if (!name) return { applied:false, reason:'invalid item' }; const id = this.itemId(name); const key = 'item.purchase.receive.' + id + '.' + slug(transactionKey || hash(text)); const l = led(root, 'permanentKeys', key, { transactionType:'item_receive' }); if (!l.applied) return { applied:false, duplicate:true, key }; if (!root.inventory.itemsById) root.inventory.itemsById = {}; if (!Array.isArray(root.inventory.ownedIds)) root.inventory.ownedIds = [];
        const beforeOwned = before && arr(before.ownedIds).indexOf(id) >= 0; const nowOwned = root.inventory.ownedIds.indexOf(id) >= 0;
        if (!nowOwned) { root.inventory.itemsById[id] = root.inventory.itemsById[id] || { id, name, qty:1, holder:'player', owner:'player', availability:'available', custody:'player', createdTurn:now(root) }; root.inventory.itemsById[id].holder='player'; root.inventory.itemsById[id].owner='player'; root.inventory.itemsById[id].availability='available'; root.inventory.ownedIds.push(id); }
        else if (!beforeOwned && nowOwned) { /* legacy parser already performed handoff; do not increment */ }
        else { /* already owned before transaction; purchase still records but does not duplicate unique item */ }
        dirty(root,'inventory_equipment','item received: ' + name); return { applied:true, key, itemId:id, name };
      },
      removeItemOwned: function (root, itemName, transactionKey, text) { this.ensure(root); const name = this.normalizeItemName(itemName); if (!name) return { applied:false, reason:'invalid item' }; const id = this.itemId(name); const key = 'item.sale.transfer.' + id + '.' + slug(transactionKey || hash(text)); const l = led(root, 'permanentKeys', key, { transactionType:'item_transfer' }); if (!l.applied) return { applied:false, duplicate:true, key }; if (!root.inventory.itemsById || !root.inventory.itemsById[id] || arr(root.inventory.ownedIds).indexOf(id) < 0) return { applied:false, dispute:this.addDispute(root, 'item_not_owned', 'Tried to sell/transfer ' + name, 'Item is not in owned inventory', transactionKey, text), reason:'item not owned' };
        root.inventory.ownedIds = root.inventory.ownedIds.filter(function (x) { return x !== id; }); root.inventory.itemsById[id].availability = 'transferred'; root.inventory.itemsById[id].holder = 'counterparty'; root.inventory.itemsById[id].owner = 'counterparty'; root.inventory.itemsById[id].transferredTurn = now(root); dirty(root,'inventory_equipment','item transferred: ' + name); return { applied:true, key, itemId:id, name };
      },
      makeTradeOffer: function (root, type, text, opts) { this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const key = this.sourceKey('offer.' + type, text); let r = root.economy.tradeOffers[key]; if (!r) r = root.economy.tradeOffers[key] = { id:key, key, offerType:type || 'unknown', offeredByHolderKey:opts.by || 'counterparty', offeredToHolderKey:opts.to || 'player', giveItemKeys:opts.giveItems || [], receiveItemKeys:opts.receiveItems || [], giveCurrency:opts.giveCurrency || null, receiveCurrency:opts.receiveCurrency || null, serviceKeys:opts.serviceKeys || [], conditionsText:norm(text).slice(0,240), status:opts.status || 'offered', sourceOperationKey:key, createdTurn:now(root), acceptedTurn:0, rejectedTurn:0, notes:[] }; dirty(root,'economy','trade offer'); return r; },
      recordPurchase: function (root, itemName, amount, coin, text, before, opts) { this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const item = this.normalizeItemName(itemName); const key = this.sourceKey('purchase.player.' + (opts.seller || 'seller') + '.' + item + '.' + amount + '.' + coin, text); let rec = root.economy.purchases[key]; if (!rec) rec = root.economy.purchases[key] = { id:key, key, buyerHolderKey:'player', sellerHolderKey:opts.seller || this.holderKey(this.inferShopName(text)), shopKey:this.currentShopKey(root, this.inferShopName(text)), itemKey:this.itemId(item), itemDisplayName:item, quantity:1, priceAmount:amount, currencyType:coin, priceQuoteKey:opts.priceQuoteKey || '', paymentOperationKey:'', inventoryReceiveOperationKey:'', status:'accepted', sourceOperationKey:key, createdTurn:now(root), appliedTurn:0, warnings:[], notes:[] };
        const pay = this.applyCurrency(root, coin, -amount, key, 'purchase_payment', text, before); if (!pay.applied) { const legacyId = this.itemId(item); if (before && arr(before.ownedIds).indexOf(legacyId) < 0 && root.inventory && arr(root.inventory.ownedIds).indexOf(legacyId) >= 0) { root.inventory.ownedIds = root.inventory.ownedIds.filter(function (x) { return x !== legacyId; }); if (root.inventory.itemsById && root.inventory.itemsById[legacyId]) { root.inventory.itemsById[legacyId].availability = 'blocked_payment_failed'; root.inventory.itemsById[legacyId].holder = 'seller'; root.inventory.itemsById[legacyId].owner = 'seller'; } } rec.status = 'disputed'; rec.warnings.push(pay.reason || 'payment failed'); return rec; }
        const recv = this.addItemOwned(root, item, key, text, before); if (!recv.applied) { rec.status = 'disputed'; rec.warnings.push(recv.reason || 'item receive failed'); return rec; }
        rec.paymentOperationKey = pay.key; rec.inventoryReceiveOperationKey = recv.key; rec.status = 'completed'; rec.appliedTurn = now(root); return rec;
      },
      recordSale: function (root, itemName, amount, coin, text, before, opts) { this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const item = this.normalizeItemName(itemName); const key = this.sourceKey('sale.player.' + (opts.buyer || 'buyer') + '.' + item + '.' + amount + '.' + coin, text); let rec = root.economy.sales[key]; if (!rec) rec = root.economy.sales[key] = { id:key, key, sellerHolderKey:'player', buyerHolderKey:opts.buyer || 'counterparty', itemKey:this.itemId(item), itemDisplayName:item, quantity:1, priceAmount:amount, currencyType:coin, itemTransferOperationKey:'', paymentOperationKey:'', status:'accepted', sourceOperationKey:key, createdTurn:now(root), appliedTurn:0, warnings:[], notes:[] };
        const trans = this.removeItemOwned(root, item, key, text); if (!trans.applied) { rec.status = 'disputed'; rec.warnings.push(trans.reason || 'item transfer failed'); return rec; }
        const pay = this.applyCurrency(root, coin, amount, key, 'sale_payment', text, before); if (!pay.applied) { rec.status = 'disputed'; rec.warnings.push(pay.reason || 'payment failed'); return rec; }
        rec.itemTransferOperationKey = trans.key; rec.paymentOperationKey = pay.key; rec.status = 'completed'; rec.appliedTurn = now(root); return rec;
      },
      recordBarter: function (root, giveItem, receiveItem, text, before, opts) { this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const give = this.normalizeItemName(giveItem), receive = this.normalizeItemName(receiveItem); const key = this.sourceKey('barter.player.counterparty.' + give + '.' + receive, text); let rec = root.economy.barters[key]; if (!rec) rec = root.economy.barters[key] = { id:key, key, partyAHolderKey:'player', partyBHolderKey:opts.partyB || 'counterparty', partyAOffers:[this.itemId(give)], partyBOffers:[this.itemId(receive)], status:'accepted', partyATransferKeys:[], partyBTransferKeys:[], sourceOperationKey:key, createdTurn:now(root), appliedTurn:0, warnings:[], notes:[] };
        const out = this.removeItemOwned(root, give, key, text); if (!out.applied) { rec.status='disputed'; rec.warnings.push(out.reason || 'player item transfer failed'); return rec; }
        const incoming = this.addItemOwned(root, receive, key, text, before); if (!incoming.applied) { rec.status='disputed'; rec.warnings.push(incoming.reason || 'counterparty item receive failed'); return rec; }
        rec.partyATransferKeys.push(out.key); rec.partyBTransferKeys.push(incoming.key); rec.status='completed'; rec.appliedTurn=now(root); dirty(root,'economy','barter completed'); return rec;
      },
      recordService: function (root, serviceType, amount, coin, text, status, before, opts) { this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const provider = opts.provider || this.inferShopName(text); const key = this.sourceKey('service.' + serviceType + '.' + provider + '.player', text); let rec = root.economy.serviceContracts[key]; if (!rec) rec = root.economy.serviceContracts[key] = { id:key, key, serviceType:serviceType || 'unknown', providerActorKey:this.holderKey(provider), customerHolderKey:'player', shopKey:this.currentShopKey(root, provider), description:norm(text).slice(0,240), priceAmount:amount || 0, currencyType:coin || '', status:status || 'offered', paymentOperationKey:'', resultOperationKeys:[], relatedQuestKey:'', createdTurn:now(root), paidTurn:0, completedTurn:0, warnings:[], notes:[] };
        if (amount && coin && (status === 'paid' || status === 'accepted_paid')) { const pay = this.applyCurrency(root, coin, -amount, key, 'service_payment', text, before); if (pay.applied) { rec.paymentOperationKey = pay.key; rec.status = 'paid'; rec.paidTurn = now(root); } else { rec.status = 'disputed'; rec.warnings.push(pay.reason || 'service payment failed'); } }
        else if (status) rec.status = status;
        dirty(root,'economy','service contract'); return rec;
      },
      completeService: function (root, serviceType, text) { this.ensure(root); const candidates = keys(root.economy.serviceContracts).map(function (k) { return root.economy.serviceContracts[k]; }).filter(function (r) { return r.serviceType === serviceType && /^(?:paid|in_progress|accepted|offered)$/.test(r.status || ''); }); const rec = candidates[candidates.length - 1] || this.recordService(root, serviceType, 0, '', text, 'completed_pending_result', null, {}); rec.status = 'completed'; rec.completedTurn = now(root); if (serviceType === 'healing') { if (root.body) { root.body.conditions = arr(root.body.conditions).filter(function (c) { return !/bleeding/i.test(c); }); const removed = arr(root.body.injuries).length; root.body.injuries = arr(root.body.injuries).filter(function (c) { return !/wound|bleeding/i.test(c); }); rec.resultOperationKeys.push('body.healing_service_result.' + hash(text)); rec.notes.push(removed ? 'Body owner-compatible wound/bleeding cleanup applied.' : 'Healing result recorded; no matching wound state needed repair.'); dirty(root,'body','healing service result'); } }
        return rec; },
      recordDebt: function (root, debtor, creditor, amount, coin, reason, status, text) { this.ensure(root); const key = this.sourceKey('debt.' + debtor + '.' + creditor + '.' + amount + '.' + coin, text); let rec = root.economy.debts[key]; if (!rec) rec = root.economy.debts[key] = { id:key, key, debtorHolderKey:debtor || 'player', creditorHolderKey:creditor || 'counterparty', amount, currencyType:coin, reason:reason || '', status:status || 'owed', dueText:'', dueTurn:0, issuedOperationKey:'', repaymentOperationKeys:[], relatedQuestKey:'', createdTurn:now(root), updatedTurn:now(root), settledTurn:0, warnings:[], notes:[] }; rec.status = status || rec.status; rec.updatedTurn = now(root); dirty(root,'economy','debt state'); return rec; },
      recordLoanIssue: function (root, lender, borrower, amount, coin, text, before) { this.ensure(root); const key = this.sourceKey('loan.issue.' + lender + '.' + borrower + '.' + amount + '.' + coin, text); let loan = root.economy.loans[key]; if (!loan) loan = root.economy.loans[key] = { id:key, key, lenderHolderKey:lender || 'counterparty', borrowerHolderKey:borrower || 'player', principalAmount:amount, currencyType:coin, interestPolicyBoundaryPending:true, collateralKeys:[], status:'issued', principalPaymentOperationKey:'', repaymentOperationKeys:[], createdTurn:now(root), issuedTurn:now(root), settledTurn:0, warnings:[], notes:[] }; const pay = this.applyCurrency(root, coin, amount, key, 'loan_principal', text, before); if (pay.applied) loan.principalPaymentOperationKey = pay.key; else { loan.status='disputed'; loan.warnings.push(pay.reason || 'loan issue failed'); } this.recordDebt(root, borrower || 'player', lender || 'counterparty', amount, coin, 'loan principal repayment', 'issued', text); return loan; },
      repayDebt: function (root, creditor, amount, coin, text, before) { this.ensure(root); const debtList = keys(root.economy.debts).map(function (k) { return root.economy.debts[k]; }).filter(function (d) { return d.currencyType === coin && Number(d.amount) === Number(amount) && /owed|issued|partially_repaid|proposed/.test(d.status || ''); }); const debt = debtList[debtList.length - 1] || this.recordDebt(root, 'player', creditor || 'counterparty', amount, coin, 'repayment without prior debt record', 'owed', text); const key = this.sourceKey('debt.repay.player.' + (creditor || 'counterparty') + '.' + amount + '.' + coin, text); const pay = this.applyCurrency(root, coin, -amount, key, 'debt_repayment', text, before); if (pay.applied) { debt.status = 'repaid'; debt.settledTurn = now(root); debt.repaymentOperationKeys.push(pay.key); } else { debt.status = 'disputed'; debt.warnings.push(pay.reason || 'repayment failed'); } dirty(root,'economy','debt repayment'); return debt; },
      recordDeposit: function (root, counterparty, amount, coin, purpose, text, before) { this.ensure(root); const key = this.sourceKey('deposit.player.' + (counterparty || 'counterparty') + '.' + amount + '.' + coin, text); let rec = root.economy.depositsEscrow[key]; if (!rec) rec = root.economy.depositsEscrow[key] = { id:key, key, holderKey:'counterparty', counterpartyKey:counterparty || 'counterparty', itemKeys:[], currencyAmount:amount, currencyType:coin, purpose:purpose || '', status:'proposed', releaseConditionText:'explicit refund/release required', depositOperationKeys:[], releaseOperationKeys:[], createdTurn:now(root), releasedTurn:0, warnings:[], notes:[] }; const pay = this.applyCurrency(root, coin, -amount, key, 'deposit', text, before); if (pay.applied) { rec.status='held'; rec.depositOperationKeys.push(pay.key); } else { rec.status='disputed'; rec.warnings.push(pay.reason || 'deposit payment failed'); } dirty(root,'economy','deposit escrow'); return rec; },
      releaseDeposit: function (root, counterparty, amount, coin, text, before) { this.ensure(root); const found = keys(root.economy.depositsEscrow).map(function (k) { return root.economy.depositsEscrow[k]; }).filter(function (r) { return r.currencyAmount === amount && r.currencyType === coin && /held|proposed/.test(r.status || ''); }); const rec = found[found.length - 1] || this.recordDeposit(root, counterparty || 'counterparty', amount, coin, 'deposit refund without prior record', text, before); const key = this.sourceKey('escrow.release.' + rec.key, text); const pay = this.applyCurrency(root, coin, amount, key, 'refund', text, before); if (pay.applied) { rec.status='released'; rec.releasedTurn=now(root); rec.releaseOperationKeys.push(pay.key); } else { rec.status='disputed'; rec.warnings.push(pay.reason || 'refund failed'); } dirty(root,'economy','deposit refund'); return rec; },
      classifyText: function (text, source) {
        const raw = norm(text); const l = lower(raw); const cur = this.parseCurrency(raw); const flags = { raw, lower:l, source:source || 'output', nonCanon:this.isNonCanonText(raw, source), currency:cur, priceOnly:false, stockOnly:false, intentOnly:false, offerOnly:false, paymentConfirmed:false, handoffConfirmed:false, serviceCompleted:false, promiseOnly:false, debtOnly:false, loanIssued:false, repayment:false, deposit:false, refund:false, purchase:false, sale:false, barter:false, service:false, denied:false, item:'', serviceType:'', shopName:this.inferShopName(raw), warnings:[] };
        if (/\brefuses? to sell|won't sell|will not sell|not for sale\b/i.test(raw)) flags.denied = true;
        if (/\b(?:costs?|price is|priced at|for sale for|fee is|charges?)\b/i.test(raw) && cur) flags.priceOnly = true;
        if (/\b(?:on the shelf|stock|stocks?|available|for sale)\b/i.test(raw) && !/\b(?:you pay|you buy|you purchase|you sell|you give)\b/i.test(raw)) flags.stockOnly = true;
        if (/^\s*I\s+(?:want to|try to|attempt to|ask to)\s+(?:buy|purchase|sell|trade|barter)/i.test(raw)) flags.intentOnly = true;
        if (/\boffers?\b/i.test(raw) && !/\b(?:you pay|you give|you sell|you repay|hands? you)\b/i.test(raw)) flags.offerOnly = true;
        if (/\b(?:you pay|you paid|you hand over|you give)\b/i.test(raw) && cur) flags.paymentConfirmed = true;
        if (/\b(?:hands? you|gives? you|passes? you|receives?|takes?|merchant pays you|pays you|lends? you|returns? your)\b/i.test(raw)) flags.handoffConfirmed = true;
        if (/\b(?:you buy|you purchase|you pay).*\b(?:hands? you|gives? you|passes? you)\b/i.test(raw)) flags.purchase = true;
        if (/\byou sell\b/i.test(raw) || /\boffers?\s+\d+\s*(?:gold|silver|copper)\s+for your\b/i.test(raw)) flags.sale = true;
        if (/\b(?:trade|barter)\b/i.test(raw) || /\byou give .* and (?:she|he|they|\w+) gives? you\b/i.test(raw)) flags.barter = true;
        if (/\b(?:healer|trainer|inn|stable|transport|repair|training|lodging|room|lessons?)\b/i.test(raw) && (cur || /\boffers?\b|\bcloses? the wound|stops? the bleeding/i.test(raw))) { flags.service = true; flags.serviceType = this.inferServiceType(raw); }
        if (/\b(?:closes? the wound|stops? the bleeding|heals? your wound|repairs? the|mends? the|teaches? you|lesson completed|arrives? at)\b/i.test(raw)) { flags.serviceCompleted = true; flags.service = true; if (!flags.serviceType) flags.serviceType = this.inferServiceType(raw); }
        if (/\byou owe\b|\bdebt\b/i.test(raw) && cur) { flags.debtOnly = true; flags.promiseOnly = true; }
        if (/\blends? you\b/i.test(raw) && cur) flags.loanIssued = true;
        if (/\brepay\b/i.test(raw) && cur) flags.repayment = true;
        if (/\bdeposit\b/i.test(raw) && /\b(?:leave|pay|hand over)\b/i.test(raw) && cur) flags.deposit = true;
        if (/\breturns? your\b/i.test(raw) && /\bdeposit\b/i.test(raw) && cur) flags.refund = true;
        if (/\bpromises? to pay|will pay you|reward will be\b/i.test(raw) && cur) flags.promiseOnly = true;
        flags.item = this.inferItemFromText(raw, flags.purchase ? 'purchase' : (flags.sale ? 'sale' : ''));
        return flags;
      },
      observeInput: function (root, text) { root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const c = this.classifyText(text || '', 'input'); if (!c.raw || c.nonCanon) return []; if (c.intentOnly) { const key = this.sourceKey('purchase_intent', c.raw); this.makeTradeOffer(root, /sell/.test(c.lower) ? 'sale_offer' : (/trade|barter/.test(c.lower) ? 'barter_offer' : 'purchase_offer'), c.raw, { status:'offered' }); return [{ key, type:'intent_only' }]; } return []; },
      observeOutput: function (root, text, source, before) { root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const c = this.classifyText(text || '', source || 'output'); if (!c.raw) return []; if (c.nonCanon) { if (/\b(?:gold|silver|copper|shop|buy|sell|price|debt|loan|service|stock)\b/i.test(c.raw)) audit(root,'parser',{ subsystem:'PC18Economy', outcome:'blocked_source', reason:'economy text from UI\/control source ignored', preview:c.raw.slice(0,180) }); return []; }
        const made=[]; const cur=c.currency;
        if (c.denied) { made.push(this.addDispute(root,'seller_refuses','purchase/sale requested','seller refused or item not for sale','',c.raw)); return made; }
        if (c.refund && cur) { made.push(this.releaseDeposit(root, c.shopName, cur.amount, cur.coin, c.raw, before)); return made; }
        if (c.deposit && cur) { made.push(this.recordDeposit(root, c.shopName, cur.amount, cur.coin, 'deposit/escrow', c.raw, before)); return made; }
        if (c.loanIssued && cur) { made.push(this.recordLoanIssue(root, c.shopName, 'player', cur.amount, cur.coin, c.raw, before)); return made; }
        if (c.repayment && cur) { made.push(this.repayDebt(root, c.shopName, cur.amount, cur.coin, c.raw, before)); return made; }
        if (c.debtOnly && cur) { made.push(this.recordDebt(root, 'player', c.shopName, cur.amount, cur.coin, 'owed amount stated', 'owed', c.raw)); return made; }
        if (c.barter && /\boffers? to trade\b/i.test(c.raw)) { const m=c.raw.match(/offers? to trade (?:her|his|their|the)\s+([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,50})\s+for your\s+([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,50})/i); made.push(this.makeTradeOffer(root,'barter_offer',c.raw,{ by:'counterparty', to:'player', giveItems:m?[this.itemId(this.normalizeItemName(m[1]))]:[], receiveItems:m?[this.itemId(this.normalizeItemName(m[2]))]:[], status:'offered' })); return made; }
        if (c.barter && /\byou give\b/i.test(c.raw)) { const m=c.raw.match(/you give\s+\w+\s+(?:the\s+|your\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,50}),?\s+and\s+\w+\s+gives? you\s+(?:the\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,50})/i); if (m) made.push(this.recordBarter(root, m[1], m[2], c.raw, before, {})); return made; }
        if (c.sale && /\boffers?\s+\d+/i.test(c.raw) && cur && !/\byou sell\b/i.test(c.raw)) { const item=this.inferItemFromText(c.raw,'sale'); made.push(this.makeTradeOffer(root,'sale_offer',c.raw,{ by:'counterparty', to:'player', receiveItems:item?[this.itemId(item)]:[], giveCurrency:cur, status:'offered' })); if (item) made.push(this.recordQuote(root,item,cur.amount,cur.coin,'buy_offer',c.raw,{ shopName:c.shopName })); return made; }
        if (c.sale && /\byou sell\b/i.test(c.raw) && cur) { const item=this.inferItemFromText(c.raw,'sale'); if (item) made.push(this.recordSale(root,item,cur.amount,cur.coin,c.raw,before,{})); return made; }
        if (c.purchase && cur) { const item=this.inferItemFromText(c.raw,'purchase'); if (item) made.push(this.recordPurchase(root,item,cur.amount,cur.coin,c.raw,before,{})); return made; }
        if (c.service && c.offerOnly && cur) { made.push(this.recordQuote(root, c.serviceType + ' service', cur.amount, cur.coin, c.serviceType === 'lodging' ? 'inn_fee' : (c.serviceType + '_fee'), c.raw, { service:true, serviceType:c.serviceType, shopName:c.shopName })); made.push(this.recordService(root,c.serviceType,cur.amount,cur.coin,c.raw,'offered',before,{ provider:c.shopName })); return made; }
        if (c.service && c.paymentConfirmed && cur) { made.push(this.recordService(root,c.serviceType || this.inferServiceType(c.raw),cur.amount,cur.coin,c.raw,'paid',before,{ provider:c.shopName })); return made; }
        if (c.serviceCompleted) { made.push(this.completeService(root,c.serviceType || this.inferServiceType(c.raw),c.raw)); return made; }
        if (c.priceOnly && cur) { const item=this.inferItemFromText(c.raw,'price') || (c.service ? (c.serviceType + ' service') : 'Unknown goods'); made.push(this.recordQuote(root,item,cur.amount,cur.coin,c.service ? (c.serviceType + '_fee') : 'ask_price',c.raw,{ service:c.service, serviceType:c.serviceType, shopName:c.shopName })); return made; }
        if (c.stockOnly) { let qty=1; const q=c.raw.match(/\b(\d+|one|two|three|four|five)\b/i); if(q){ const map={one:1,two:2,three:3,four:4,five:5}; qty=Number(q[1])||map[q[1].toLowerCase()]||1; } let m=c.raw.match(/(?:on the shelf are|stock(?:s)?|available are|sells?)\s+(?:\d+|one|two|three|four|five)?\s*(?:the\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,70}?)(?:\s+for sale|\s+for\s+\d|\.|$)/i); const item = m ? this.normalizeItemName(m[1].replace(/s$/i,'')) : ''; if (item) made.push(this.recordStock(root,item,qty,c.raw,{ shopName:c.shopName })); return made; }
        if (c.promiseOnly && cur) { made.push(this.makeTradeOffer(root,'reward_offer',c.raw,{ by:'counterparty', to:'player', giveCurrency:cur, status:'offered' })); return made; }
        return made;
      },
