        root = this.ensure(root); name = title(name); if (!name) return null;
        const key = this.materialKey(name); let rec = root.crafting.materials[key];
        if (!rec) rec = root.crafting.materials[key] = { id:key, key:key, displayName:name, materialFamily:this.materialFamily(name), linkedItemKey:this.itemId(name), quantityKnown:false, quantity:0, qualityLabel:'unknown', state:'available_reference', ownershipStatus:'unknown', accessState:'unknown', sourceOperationKey:sourceOperationKey || '', createdTurn:now(root), updatedTurn:now(root), warnings:[], notes:[] };
        rec.displayName = name; rec.materialFamily = this.materialFamily(name); rec.linkedItemKey = this.itemId(name); rec.updatedTurn = now(root);
        if (status) rec.ownershipStatus = status;
        if (access) rec.accessState = access;
        if (typeof qty === 'number') { rec.quantityKnown = true; rec.quantity = Math.max(0, qty); }
        if (sourceOperationKey) rec.sourceOperationKey = sourceOperationKey;
        if (notes) pushUnique(rec.notes, notes, 8);
        return rec;
      },

      ownedMaterialCount(root, name) {
        root = this.ensure(root); name = title(name); const id = this.itemId(name); const item = root.inventory.itemsById[id];
        if (item && root.inventory.ownedIds.indexOf(id) >= 0) return WL.U.clamp(item.qty == null ? 1 : item.qty, 0, 999999);
        const m = root.crafting.materials[this.materialKey(name)];
        if (m && this.consumableOwnership[m.ownershipStatus]) return WL.U.clamp(m.quantity || 0, 0, 999999);
        return 0;
      },

      addInventoryItem(root, name, qty, sourceKey, reason) {
        root = this.ensure(root); name = title(name); qty = WL.U.clamp(qty || 1, 1, 9999);
        const invKey = makeKey(['inventory.create.crafted', this.itemId(name), sourceKey || hash(name)]);
        const led = WL.OperationLedger.tryAdd(root, 'permanentKeys', invKey, { reason:reason || 'crafted output owner handoff' });
        if (!led.applied) { this.addDispute(root, 'duplicate_result', name, 'Duplicate crafted output skipped.', sourceKey); return { applied:false, duplicate:true, inventoryOperationKey:invKey }; }
        const id = this.itemId(name);
        if (!root.inventory.itemsById[id]) root.inventory.itemsById[id] = { id:id, name:name, qty:qty, holder:'player', owner:'player', availability:'available', category: this.outputFamily(name), createdTurn:now(root), condition:'crafted', source:'pc19_crafting' };
        else root.inventory.itemsById[id].qty = WL.U.clamp((root.inventory.itemsById[id].qty || 0) + qty, 0, 999999);
        if (root.inventory.ownedIds.indexOf(id) < 0) root.inventory.ownedIds.push(id);
        if (WL.DirtyQueue && typeof WL.DirtyQueue.add === 'function') WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'inventory_equipment', 'crafted output: ' + name);
        return { applied:true, duplicate:false, itemId:id, inventoryOperationKey:invKey };
      },

      consumeMaterial(root, name, qty, sourceKey, reason, attemptKey) {
        root = this.ensure(root); name = title(name); qty = WL.U.clamp(qty || 1, 1, 9999);
        const matKey = this.materialKey(name); const invId = this.itemId(name);
        const cKey = makeKey(['craft.consume', attemptKey || 'unknown_attempt', matKey, qty, sourceKey || hash(name)]);
        const led = WL.OperationLedger.tryAdd(root, 'permanentKeys', cKey, { reason:reason || 'craft material consumption' });
        if (!led.applied) return { applied:false, duplicate:true, consumptionKey:cKey, reason:'duplicate material consumption skipped' };
        const owned = this.ownedMaterialCount(root, name);
        if (owned < qty) {
          this.addDispute(root, 'missing_materials_but_success_claimed', name, 'Material was not owned/access-valid for consumption.', sourceKey);
          return { applied:false, duplicate:false, consumptionKey:cKey, reason:'material not owned/access-valid' };
        }
        const item = root.inventory.itemsById[invId];
        if (item && root.inventory.ownedIds.indexOf(invId) >= 0) {
          item.qty = WL.U.clamp((item.qty || 1) - qty, 0, 999999);
          if (item.qty <= 0) {
            item.availability = 'consumed'; item.holder = 'none'; item.owner = 'none';
            root.inventory.ownedIds = root.inventory.ownedIds.filter(function(x){ return x !== invId; });
          }
        }
        const rec = this.makeMaterialRecord(root, name, 'consumed', 'consumed', 0, cKey, 'consumed through duplicate-safe inventory owner handoff');
        if (rec) rec.state = 'consumed';
        const consId = 'consumption_' + hash(cKey);
        root.crafting.consumptions[consId] = { id:consId, key:cKey, materialKey:matKey, linkedItemKey:invId, quantityConsumed:qty, consumptionReason:reason || 'craft_success', sourceAttemptKey:attemptKey || '', sourceOperationKey:sourceKey || '', inventoryOperationKey:makeKey(['inventory.consume.material', matKey, cKey]), applied:true, createdTurn:now(root), warnings:[], notes:[] };
        if (WL.DirtyQueue && typeof WL.DirtyQueue.add === 'function') WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'inventory_equipment', 'material consumed: ' + name);
        return { applied:true, duplicate:false, consumptionKey:cKey, recordId:consId };
      },

      addRecipe(root, name, status, sourceKey, reason) {
        root = this.ensure(root); name = title(name || 'Unknown Recipe'); const key = this.recipeKey(name);
        let rec = root.crafting.recipes[key];
        if (!rec) rec = root.crafting.recipes[key] = { id:key, key:key, displayName:name, outputFamily:this.outputFamily(name), outputDisplayName:name, ingredientRequirements:[], toolRequirements:[], workstationRequirements:[], skillRequirements:[], timeRequirementText:'unknown', difficultyLabel:'unknown', knownStatus:'unknown', authoritySourceKey:'', sourceOperationKey:sourceKey || '', createdTurn:now(root), updatedTurn:now(root), warnings:[], notes:[] };
        rec.updatedTurn = now(root); rec.knownStatus = status || rec.knownStatus || 'unknown'; if (sourceKey) rec.sourceOperationKey = sourceKey; if (reason) pushUnique(rec.notes, reason, 8);
        return rec;
      },

      addRecipeKnowledge(root, name, status, sourceKey, reason) {
        root = this.ensure(root); name = title(name || 'Unknown Recipe'); const recipe = this.addRecipe(root, name, status === 'known' ? 'known' : status, sourceKey, reason); const id = 'recipe_knowledge_' + slug(name);
        let rec = root.crafting.recipeKnowledge[id];
        if (!rec) rec = root.crafting.recipeKnowledge[id] = { id:id, recipeKey:recipe.key, knowledgeStatus:'unknown_to_player', confidence:'low', learnedFromSourceKey:'', discoveryKey:'', learnedTurn:0, notes:[] };
        rec.knowledgeStatus = status || rec.knowledgeStatus; rec.confidence = status === 'known' ? 'high' : (status === 'partial' ? 'medium' : 'low'); rec.learnedFromSourceKey = sourceKey || rec.learnedFromSourceKey; rec.discoveryKey = sourceKey || rec.discoveryKey; if (!rec.learnedTurn) rec.learnedTurn = now(root); if (reason) pushUnique(rec.notes, reason, 8);
        if (WL.DirtyQueue && typeof WL.DirtyQueue.add === 'function') WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'crafting', 'recipe knowledge: ' + name);
        return rec;
      },

      createAttempt(root, outputName, status, sourceText, sourceKind) {
        root = this.ensure(root); outputName = title(outputName || this.extractOutputName(sourceText) || 'Unknown Craft'); const sourceHash = hash(sourceText); const aKey = this.attemptKey(outputName, sourceHash); const opKey = makeKey(['craft.intent', aKey, sourceHash]);
        let rec = root.crafting.attempts[aKey];
        if (!rec) rec = root.crafting.attempts[aKey] = { id:aKey, key:aKey, recipeKey:this.recipeKey(outputName), intendedOutputName:outputName, actorKey:'player', playerIsCrafter:true, materialsProposed:[], toolsProposed:[], workstationKey:'', attemptStatus:status || 'intent_only', sourceOperationKey:opKey, sourceEventId:sourceHash, sourceKind:sourceKind || 'input', createdTurn:now(root), updatedTurn:now(root), warnings:[], notes:[] };
        else { rec.updatedTurn = now(root); rec.attemptStatus = status || rec.attemptStatus; }
        if (WL.OperationLedger) WL.OperationLedger.tryAdd(root, 'sourceUseKeys', opKey, { reason:'crafting attempt recorded' });
        if (WL.DirtyQueue && typeof WL.DirtyQueue.add === 'function') WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'crafting', 'craft attempt: ' + outputName);
        return rec;
      },

      addProgress(root, attempt, status, text, sourceKey) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const id = 'craft_progress_' + hash((attempt && attempt.key || 'unknown') + '|' + status + '|' + (sourceKey || hash(text)));
        const rec = root.crafting.progress[id] = { id:id, attemptKey:attempt && attempt.key || '', recipeKey:attempt && attempt.recipeKey || '', progressStatus:status || 'in_progress', progressText:norm(text).slice(0,240), progressCurrent: status === 'nearly_complete' ? 75 : 25, progressRequired:100, sourceOperationKey:sourceKey || '', createdTurn:now(root), updatedTurn:now(root), notes:[] };
        return rec;
      },

      addResult(root, attempt, resultType, outputName, sourceText, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; outputName = title(outputName || (attempt && attempt.intendedOutputName) || this.extractOutputName(sourceText) || 'Unknown Craft');
        const sourceHash = hash(sourceText); const opKey = makeKey(['craft', resultType || 'result', attempt && attempt.key || 'unknown_attempt', outputName, sourceHash]);
        const led = WL.OperationLedger.tryAdd(root, 'permanentKeys', opKey, { reason:'crafting result recorded' });
        if (!led.applied) { this.addDispute(root, 'duplicate_result', outputName, 'Duplicate crafting result skipped.', opKey); return { duplicate:true, status:'duplicate_skip', key:opKey }; }
        const id = 'craft_result_' + hash(opKey); const rec = root.crafting.results[id] = { id:id, key:opKey, attemptKey:attempt && attempt.key || '', recipeKey:attempt && attempt.recipeKey || this.recipeKey(outputName), resultType:resultType || 'unknown', outputDisplayName:outputName, outputItemKey:this.itemId(outputName), qualityLabel:opts.qualityLabel || 'standard', materialConsumptionKeys:[], outputRecordKey:'', ownerHandoffStatus:'not_needed', sourceOperationKey:opKey, createdTurn:now(root), warnings:[], notes:[] };
        if (attempt) attempt.attemptStatus = /success/.test(resultType) ? 'success' : (/failure|failed/.test(resultType) ? 'failed' : attempt.attemptStatus);
        if (opts.consume && opts.material && opts.material.name) {
          const c = this.consumeMaterial(root, opts.material.name, opts.material.qty || 1, opKey, opts.consumeReason || (resultType === 'success' ? 'craft_success' : 'craft_failure_validated'), attempt && attempt.key);
          if (c.consumptionKey) rec.materialConsumptionKeys.push(c.consumptionKey);
          if (!c.applied && resultType === 'success') rec.warnings.push('material consumption not applied: ' + (c.reason || 'unknown'));
        }
        if (resultType === 'success' || resultType === 'partial_success') {
          const outKey = makeKey(['craft.output', attempt && attempt.key || 'unknown_attempt', this.itemId(outputName), sourceHash]);
          const handoff = this.addInventoryItem(root, outputName, 1, outKey, 'crafted output inventory handoff');
          const outId = 'craft_output_' + hash(outKey);
          root.crafting.outputs[outId] = { id:outId, key:outKey, outputItemKey:this.itemId(outputName), displayName:outputName, outputFamily:this.outputFamily(outputName), qualityLabel:rec.qualityLabel, status:handoff.applied ? 'created_owned' : (handoff.duplicate ? 'rejected' : 'failed'), sourceAttemptKey:attempt && attempt.key || '', sourceOperationKey:opKey, inventoryOperationKey:handoff.inventoryOperationKey || '', createdTurn:now(root), warnings:handoff.duplicate ? ['duplicate output skipped'] : [], notes:[] };
          rec.outputRecordKey = outId;
          rec.ownerHandoffStatus = handoff.applied ? 'inventory_handoff_applied' : 'inventory_handoff_failed';
        }
        if (WL.DirtyQueue && typeof WL.DirtyQueue.add === 'function') { WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'crafting', 'craft result: ' + outputName); WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'context', 'crafting truth changed'); }
        return rec;
      },

      addFailure(root, outputName, sourceText, material, consumeConfirmed) {
        const attempt = this.createAttempt(root, outputName || this.extractOutputName(sourceText) || 'Unknown Craft', 'failed', sourceText, 'output');
        const opts = consumeConfirmed && material ? { consume:true, material:material, consumeReason:'craft_failure_validated' } : {};
        const rec = this.addResult(root, attempt, consumeConfirmed ? 'failure_consumed_some' : 'failure_no_consumption', attempt.intendedOutputName, sourceText, opts);
        const id = 'craft_failure_' + hash((rec.key || '') + '|failure');
        root.crafting.failures[id] = { id:id, key:id, attemptKey:attempt.key, failureType:consumeConfirmed ? 'failure_consumed_some' : 'failure_no_consumption', outputDisplayName:attempt.intendedOutputName, sourceOperationKey:rec.key || '', createdTurn:now(root), warnings:[], notes:[] };
        return rec;
      },

      addRepair(root, status, targetName, sourceText, data) {
        root = this.ensure(root); data = data || {}; targetName = title(targetName || this.extractItemTarget(sourceText) || 'Unknown Item'); const sourceHash = hash(sourceText); const key = makeKey(['repair', status || 'unknown', this.itemId(targetName), sourceHash]);
        const led = WL.OperationLedger.tryAdd(root, 'permanentKeys', key, { reason:'repair record ' + status });
        if (!led.applied && status === 'completed') { this.addDispute(root, 'duplicate_result', targetName, 'Duplicate repair completion skipped.', key); return { status:'duplicate_skip', key:key }; }
        const id = 'repair_' + hash(key); const rec = root.crafting.repairs[id] = { id:id, key:key, targetItemKey:this.itemId(targetName), targetDisplayName:targetName, repairStatus:status || 'unknown', damageStateBefore:data.before || 'unknown', damageStateAfter:data.after || (status === 'completed' ? 'repaired' : 'unknown'), materialConsumptionKeys:[], serviceContractKey:data.serviceContractKey || '', costPaymentKey:data.costPaymentKey || '', sourceOperationKey:key, createdTurn:now(root), completedTurn:status === 'completed' ? now(root) : 0, warnings:[], notes:[] };
        if (status === 'completed') {
          const item = root.inventory.itemsById[this.itemId(targetName)];
          if (item && root.inventory.ownedIds.indexOf(item.id) >= 0) { item.condition = 'repaired'; item.repairedTurn = now(root); rec.notes.push('item condition updated through PC19 inventory owner sourceLink'); }
          else rec.warnings.push('repair completion recorded but target item was not owned; condition update boundary');
        }
        if (WL.DirtyQueue && typeof WL.DirtyQueue.add === 'function') { WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'crafting', 'repair ' + status + ': ' + targetName); WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'inventory_equipment', 'repair boundary: ' + targetName); }
        return rec;
      },

      addUpgrade(root, status, targetName, upgradeName, sourceText) {
        root = this.ensure(root); targetName = title(targetName || this.extractItemTarget(sourceText) || 'Unknown Item'); upgradeName = title(upgradeName || this.extractUpgradeName(sourceText) || 'Upgrade');
        const key = makeKey(['upgrade', status || 'unknown', this.itemId(targetName), slug(upgradeName), hash(sourceText)]);
        const id = 'upgrade_' + hash(key); const rec = root.crafting.upgrades[id] = { id:id, key:key, targetItemKey:this.itemId(targetName), upgradeName:upgradeName, upgradeStatus:status || 'unknown', oldItemStatePreview:'unknown', newItemStatePreview: status === 'completed' ? 'descriptive upgrade completed; stat mechanics boundary' : 'pending', materialConsumptionKeys:[], sourceOperationKey:key, inventoryOperationKey:'', createdTurn:now(root), warnings:['stat/equipment bonuses are boundary-managed unless owner rules validate'], notes:[] };
        if (WL.OperationLedger) WL.OperationLedger.tryAdd(root, 'permanentKeys', key, { reason:'upgrade record ' + status });
        if (WL.DirtyQueue && typeof WL.DirtyQueue.add === 'function') WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'crafting', 'upgrade ' + status + ': ' + targetName);
        return rec;
      },

      extractUpgradeName(text) {
        const l = lower(text);
        if (/reinforc/.test(l)) return 'Reinforcement';
        if (/sharpen/.test(l)) return 'Sharpening';
        if (/improv/.test(l)) return 'Improvement';
        return 'Upgrade';
      },

      addEnchant(root, status, targetName, enchantName, sourceText, mechanicalStatus) {
        root = this.ensure(root); targetName = title(targetName || this.extractItemTarget(sourceText) || 'Unknown Item'); enchantName = title(enchantName || this.extractEnchantName(sourceText) || 'Unknown Enchantment');
        const key = makeKey(['enchant', status || 'unknown', this.itemId(targetName), slug(enchantName), hash(sourceText)]);
        const id = 'enchant_' + hash(key); const family = this.enchantFamily(enchantName + ' ' + sourceText);
        const rec = root.crafting.enchantments[id] = { id:id, key:key, targetItemKey:this.itemId(targetName), enchantmentName:enchantName, enchantmentFamily:family, enchantmentStatus:status || 'unknown', effectDescription:norm(sourceText).slice(0,240), mechanicalEffectStatus:mechanicalStatus || 'boundary_until_equipment_rules', materialConsumptionKeys:[], sourceOperationKey:key, ownerHandoffStatus:'boundary', createdTurn:now(root), warnings:[], notes:[] };
        if (rec.mechanicalEffectStatus !== 'none' && rec.mechanicalEffectStatus !== 'cosmetic_only' && rec.mechanicalEffectStatus !== 'descriptive_only') rec.warnings.push('mechanical effect boundary; no combat/stat/ability power activated');
        if (WL.OperationLedger) WL.OperationLedger.tryAdd(root, 'permanentKeys', key, { reason:'enchantment record ' + status });
        pushUnique(root.crafting.boundaryMechanics, targetName + ': ' + enchantName + ' mechanics boundary', 80);
        if (WL.DirtyQueue && typeof WL.DirtyQueue.add === 'function') WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'crafting', 'enchant ' + status + ': ' + targetName);
        return rec;
      },

      extractEnchantName(text) {
        const l = lower(text);
        if (/flame|fire|burn|flamebrand/.test(l)) return 'Flame';
        if (/frost|ice/.test(l)) return 'Frost';
        if (/ward|shield|protect/.test(l)) return 'Warding';
        if (/rune|glow|red rune/.test(l)) return 'Glowing Rune';
        if (/sharp/.test(l)) return 'Sharpness';
        return 'Unknown Enchantment';
      },

      enchantFamily(text) {
        const l = lower(text);
        if (/flame|fire|burn/.test(l)) return 'flame_boundary';
        if (/frost|ice/.test(l)) return 'frost_boundary';
        if (/glow|rune|aura/.test(l)) return 'cosmetic_glow';
        if (/ward|protect/.test(l)) return 'warding_boundary';
        return 'unknown';
      },

      addDispute(root, type, target, detail, sourceKey) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const key = makeKey(['craft.dispute', type || 'unknown', target || 'unknown', sourceKey || hash(detail)]); const id = 'craft_dispute_' + hash(key);
        if (!root.crafting.disputes[id]) root.crafting.disputes[id] = { id:id, key:key, disputeType:type || 'unknown', attemptKey:'', inputClaim:'', outputClaim:target || '', resolvedResult:detail || '', sourceOperationKey:sourceKey || key, createdTurn:now(root), notes:[] };
        return root.crafting.disputes[id];
      },

      scanAndApplyInput(root, text) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const raw = norm(text); if (!raw || WL.U.startsCommand(raw) || this.sourceBlockedText(raw)) return [];
        const l = lower(raw); const out = [];
        if (/\b(?:craft|make|build|forge|smith|sew|cook|brew|mix|carve)\b/.test(l)) {
          const name = this.extractOutputName(raw) || raw.replace(/^I\s+/i,'').replace(/\b(?:try to|start to|attempt to|plan to|craft|make|build|forge|smith|brew|cook|sew|carve)\b/ig,' ').trim().slice(0,60) || 'Unknown Craft';
          out.push(this.createAttempt(root, name, 'intent_only', raw, 'input'));
        }
        if (/\b(?:repair|fix|mend|restore)\b/.test(l)) out.push(this.addRepair(root, 'offered', this.extractItemTarget(raw) || 'Unknown Item', raw));
        if (/\b(?:upgrade|reinforce|improve|sharpen)\b/.test(l)) out.push(this.addUpgrade(root, /\bplan\b/.test(l) ? 'planned' : 'attempted', this.extractItemTarget(raw) || 'Unknown Item', this.extractUpgradeName(raw), raw));
        if (/\b(?:enchant|imbue|inscribe|rune|bless)\b/.test(l)) out.push(this.addEnchant(root, 'attempted', this.extractItemTarget(raw) || 'Unknown Item', this.extractEnchantName(raw), raw, 'none'));
        return out.filter(Boolean);
      },

      scanAndApplyOutput(root, text) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const raw = norm(text); if (!raw || this.sourceBlockedText(raw) || this.unsafeNarrative(raw)) { if (/\b(?:craft|recipe|enchant|repair|forge|moonleaf|ingot)\b/i.test(raw)) this.addDispute(root, 'unsafe_source_or_nonliteral', '', 'Crafting-related text blocked as unsafe/nonliteral.', hash(raw)); return []; }
        const l = lower(raw); const results = []; const sourceHash = hash(raw);
        if (/\b(?:moonleaf|iron ingots?|moon oil|vial|ore|herb|gem|reagent|scrap|cloth|leather)\b/.test(l)) {
          const mat = this.extractMaterial(raw);
          if (mat) {
            if (/\b(?:grows|lies|visible|beside|nearby|on the path|on the ground)\b/.test(l)) results.push(this.makeMaterialRecord(root, mat.name, 'visible', 'visible', 0, sourceHash, 'visible material reference only'));
            else if (/\b(?:shop|shelf|stock|for sale|merchant has|store has)\b/.test(l)) results.push(this.makeMaterialRecord(root, mat.name, 'shop_stock', 'shop_stock', 0, sourceHash, 'shop stock material reference only'));
            else if (/\b(?:holds|holding|keeps|carries|basket|custody)\b/.test(l) && !/\byou\b.*\b(?:hold|carry|own)\b/.test(l)) results.push(this.makeMaterialRecord(root, mat.name, 'custody', 'custody', 0, sourceHash, 'NPC/place custody material reference only'));
          }
        }
        if (/\b(?:royal forge|forge|anvil|workbench|alchemy table|campfire)\b/.test(l)) {
          const fam = /alchemy/.test(l) ? 'alchemy_table' : (/campfire/.test(l) ? 'campfire' : (/workbench/.test(l) ? 'workbench' : 'forge'));
          const locked = /\b(?:locked|forbidden|behind .*gate|guarded)\b/.test(l);
          const name = title((raw.match(/\b(?:royal forge|forge|anvil|workbench|alchemy table|campfire)\b/i) || ['workstation'])[0]);
          const id = 'workstation_' + slug(name);
          root.crafting.workstations[id] = { id:id, key:id, displayName:name, stationFamily:fam, placeKey:root.places && root.places.currentId || '', ownerActorKey:'', accessState:locked ? 'locked' : (/\b(?:available|use)\b/.test(l) ? 'available' : 'visible'), serviceContractKey:'', sourceOperationKey:sourceHash, createdTurn:now(root), notes:[locked ? 'visible/locked workstation is not usable' : 'workstation observed'] };
          results.push(root.crafting.workstations[id]);
        }
        if (/\b(?:rumou?r|legend|people say|it is said)\b/.test(l) && /\b(?:recipe|used .* in|formula|blueprint|pattern|salve)\b/.test(l)) {
          results.push(this.addRecipeKnowledge(root, this.extractRecipeName(raw), 'hinted', sourceHash, 'rumor/hint only; not known recipe'));
        } else if (/\b(?:read|study|learn|learned)\b.*\b(?:recipe|exact steps|formula|blueprint|pattern)\b/.test(l)) {
          const op = makeKey(['recipe.learn', this.recipeKey(this.extractRecipeName(raw)), sourceHash]);
          const led = WL.OperationLedger.tryAdd(root, 'permanentKeys', op, { reason:'recipe learned' });
          if (led.applied) results.push(this.addRecipeKnowledge(root, this.extractRecipeName(raw), 'known', op, 'validated recipe reading/learning'));
        }
        if (/\b(?:repairing|repair|fixing|fix|mend|restore)\b/.test(l)) {
          const target = this.extractItemTarget(raw) || 'Unknown Item';
          if (/\b(?:will cost|would cost|can repair|could repair|quote|says repairing)\b/.test(l)) results.push(this.addRepair(root, 'quote', target, raw));
          else if (/\b(?:pay|paid|start repairing|to start repairing|begins repairing)\b/.test(l) && !/\b(?:fully repaired|repaired|fixed|restored|hands back)\b/.test(l)) results.push(this.addRepair(root, 'in_progress', target, raw));
          else if (/\b(?:fully repaired|has been repaired|is repaired|fixed|restored|hands back)\b/.test(l)) results.push(this.addRepair(root, 'completed', target, raw, { after:'repaired' }));
          else if (/\b(?:fails?|failed|ruined|breaks)\b/.test(l)) results.push(this.addRepair(root, 'failed', target, raw));
        }
        if (/\b(?:upgrade|reinforce|reinforcing|sharpen|improve)\b/.test(l)) {
          const target = this.extractItemTarget(raw) || 'Unknown Item';
          if (/\b(?:finish|finished|complete|completed|reinforced|sharpened|improved)\b/.test(l)) results.push(this.addUpgrade(root, 'completed', target, this.extractUpgradeName(raw), raw));
          else results.push(this.addUpgrade(root, 'attempted', target, this.extractUpgradeName(raw), raw));
        }
        if (/\b(?:enchant|imbue|inscribe|rune|runes|glow|glows|aura|flamebrand|burns enemies)\b/.test(l)) {
          const target = this.extractItemTarget(raw) || 'Unknown Item';
          if (/\b(?:glow|glows|rune|aura)\b/.test(l) && !/\b(?:burns enemies|damage|every strike|power)\b/.test(l)) results.push(this.addEnchant(root, 'cosmetic_success', target, this.extractEnchantName(raw), raw, 'cosmetic_only'));
          else if (/\b(?:burns enemies|every strike|fire damage|damage|flamebrand|power)\b/.test(l)) results.push(this.addEnchant(root, 'mechanical_success_boundary', target, this.extractEnchantName(raw), raw, 'boundary_until_equipment_rules'));
          else results.push(this.addEnchant(root, 'attempted', target, this.extractEnchantName(raw), raw, 'none'));
        }
        if (/\b(?:fails?|failed|ruined|ruining|burns away|burned away|wasted|shatters|interrupted)\b/.test(l) && /\b(?:craft|salve|mixture|attempt|forge|brew|recipe)\b/.test(l)) {
          const material = this.extractMaterial(raw); const consumeConfirmed = !!(material && /\b(?:burns away|burned away|wasted|consumed|ruins|ruined)\b/.test(l));
          results.push(this.addFailure(root, this.extractOutputName(raw) || this.extractRecipeName(raw), raw, material, consumeConfirmed));
        } else if (/\b(?:finish|finished|complete|completed|crafted|forged|made|built|brewed|cooked)\b/.test(l) && /\b(?:craft|dagger|sword|shield|salve|potion|blade|armor|bow|staff)\b/.test(l)) {
          const output = this.extractOutputName(raw);
          if (!output || /\bit\s+is\s+finished\b/i.test(raw)) {
            results.push(this.addDispute(root, 'ambiguous_output_item', output || 'it', 'Ambiguous crafted output blocked; no item created.', sourceHash));
          } else {
            const attempt = this.createAttempt(root, output, 'validated_requirements', raw, 'output');
            const material = this.extractMaterial(raw); const consume = !!(material && /\b(?:use|uses|used|using|consume|consumed)\b/.test(l));
            results.push(this.addResult(root, attempt, 'success', output, raw, consume ? { consume:true, material:material, consumeReason:'craft_success' } : {}));
          }
        }
        if (/\b(?:crafting experience|gained crafting experience|feel like you gained)\b/.test(l)) {
          pushUnique(root.crafting.boundaryMechanics, 'crafting XP boundary; no XP without exact ProgressionReducer event', 80);
        }
        if (results.length) this.addAudit(root, 'PC19 processed crafting output: ' + results.length + ' record(s).', { hash: sourceHash });
        return results.filter(Boolean);
      },

      cleanup(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root);
        cap(root.crafting.warnings, 80); cap(root.crafting.notes, 80); cap(root.crafting.audits, 120); cap(root.crafting.blockedMutations, 80); cap(root.crafting.boundaryMechanics, 80);
        return root.crafting;
      },

      contextLines(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const c = root.crafting; const lines = [];
        const known = Object.keys(c.recipeKnowledge).map(function(k){ return c.recipeKnowledge[k]; }).filter(function(r){ return r && /known|confirmed/.test(r.knowledgeStatus); }).slice(0,4);
        const hinted = Object.keys(c.recipeKnowledge).map(function(k){ return c.recipeKnowledge[k]; }).filter(function(r){ return r && /hinted|partial|rumored/.test(r.knowledgeStatus); }).slice(0,4);
        const active = Object.keys(c.attempts).map(function(k){ return c.attempts[k]; }).filter(function(r){ return r && !/success|failed|cancelled|rejected/.test(r.attemptStatus); }).slice(0,4);
        const repairs = Object.keys(c.repairs).map(function(k){ return c.repairs[k]; }).slice(-4);
        const ench = Object.keys(c.enchantments).map(function(k){ return c.enchantments[k]; }).slice(-3);
        if (known.length) lines.push('Known recipes: ' + known.map(function(r){ return c.recipes[r.recipeKey] && c.recipes[r.recipeKey].displayName || r.recipeKey; }).join(', ') + '.');
        if (hinted.length) lines.push('Recipe hints: ' + hinted.map(function(r){ return c.recipes[r.recipeKey] && c.recipes[r.recipeKey].displayName || r.recipeKey; }).join(', ') + ' (not confirmed known).');
        if (active.length) lines.push('Crafting attempts: ' + active.map(function(r){ return r.intendedOutputName + ' [' + r.attemptStatus + ']'; }).join('; ') + '.');
        const visibleM = Object.keys(c.materials).map(function(k){ return c.materials[k]; }).filter(function(m){ return m && !WL.PC19Crafting.consumableOwnership[m.ownershipStatus]; }).slice(0,5);
        if (visibleM.length) lines.push('Non-owned materials: ' + visibleM.map(function(m){ return m.displayName + ' [' + m.ownershipStatus + ']'; }).join(', ') + '.');
        if (repairs.length) lines.push('Repairs: ' + repairs.map(function(r){ return r.targetDisplayName + ' [' + r.repairStatus + ']'; }).join('; ') + '.');
        if (ench.length) lines.push('Enchantments: ' + ench.map(function(e){ return e.targetItemKey.replace(/^item_/,'') + ' ' + e.enchantmentName + ' [' + e.mechanicalEffectStatus + ']'; }).join('; ') + '.');
        if (!lines.length) lines.push('Crafting: no active crafting facts. Intent is not success; visible/shop/custody materials are not owned.');
        return lines.slice(0,8);
      },

      craftLines(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const c = root.crafting; const lines = ['Crafting Status: limited story-validated crafting active; full mechanics boundary.'];
        const attempts = Object.keys(c.attempts).map(function(k){ return c.attempts[k]; }).slice(-8);
        const results = Object.keys(c.results).map(function(k){ return c.results[k]; }).slice(-8);
        const repairs = Object.keys(c.repairs).map(function(k){ return c.repairs[k]; }).slice(-8);
        const upgrades = Object.keys(c.upgrades).map(function(k){ return c.upgrades[k]; }).slice(-6);
        const enchants = Object.keys(c.enchantments).map(function(k){ return c.enchantments[k]; }).slice(-6);
        lines.push('Attempts: ' + (attempts.length ? attempts.map(function(a){ return a.intendedOutputName + ' [' + a.attemptStatus + ']'; }).join('; ') : 'none'));
        lines.push('Results: ' + (results.length ? results.map(function(r){ return r.outputDisplayName + ' [' + r.resultType + ', handoff=' + r.ownerHandoffStatus + ']'; }).join('; ') : 'none'));
        lines.push('Repairs: ' + (repairs.length ? repairs.map(function(r){ return r.targetDisplayName + ' [' + r.repairStatus + ']'; }).join('; ') : 'none'));
        lines.push('Upgrades: ' + (upgrades.length ? upgrades.map(function(u){ return u.targetItemKey.replace(/^item_/,'') + ' [' + u.upgradeStatus + '] bonuses boundary'; }).join('; ') : 'none'));
        lines.push('Enchantments: ' + (enchants.length ? enchants.map(function(e){ return e.targetItemKey.replace(/^item_/,'') + ' ' + e.enchantmentName + ' [' + e.mechanicalEffectStatus + ']'; }).join('; ') : 'none'));
        lines.push('Disputes: ' + Object.keys(c.disputes).length);
        if (c.boundaryMechanics.length) lines.push('Boundary mechanics: ' + c.boundaryMechanics.slice(-5).join('; '));
        return lines;
      },

      recipeLines(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const c = root.crafting; const lines = ['Recipe Book:'];
        const recs = Object.keys(c.recipes).map(function(k){ return c.recipes[k]; }).sort(function(a,b){ return String(a.displayName).localeCompare(String(b.displayName)); });
        if (!recs.length) lines.push('Known recipes: none.');
        recs.slice(0,12).forEach(function(r){ const krec = Object.keys(c.recipeKnowledge).map(function(k){ return c.recipeKnowledge[k]; }).find(function(x){ return x.recipeKey === r.key; }); lines.push('- ' + r.displayName + ': recipe=' + r.knownStatus + ', playerKnowledge=' + (krec && krec.knowledgeStatus || 'unknown_to_player') + ', output=' + r.outputFamily + '.'); });
        const hidden = recs.filter(function(r){ return /hidden|unknown/.test(r.knownStatus); }).length;
        if (hidden) lines.push('Hidden/unknown recipe records: ' + hidden + ' (not shown as player-known).');
        return lines;
      },

      inspect(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const c = root.crafting; const rows = [];
        function pass(label){ rows.push({ status:'PASS', label:label }); }
        function fail(label){ rows.push({ status:'FAIL', label:label }); }
        c.lockVersion === WL.PRODUCTION_CHUNK_19_LOCK_VERSION ? pass('PC19-G00 build identity active: ' + WL.BUILD_VERSION) : fail('PC19 build identity mismatch');
        obj(c.materials) ? pass('PC19-G01 MaterialRecord structure exists') : fail('PC19-G01 materials missing');
        obj(c.recipes) && obj(c.recipeKnowledge) ? pass('PC19-G02 RecipeRecord and RecipeKnowledgeRecord structures exist') : fail('PC19-G02 recipe structures missing');
        obj(c.workstations) ? pass('PC19-G03 Ingredient/Tool/Workstation equivalents exist') : fail('PC19-G03 workstation structure missing');
        obj(c.attempts) && obj(c.progress) && obj(c.results) && obj(c.consumptions) && obj(c.outputs) ? pass('PC19-G04 attempt/progress/result/consume/output structures exist') : fail('PC19-G04 crafting structures missing');
        obj(c.repairs) && obj(c.upgrades) && obj(c.enchantments) ? pass('PC19-G05 repair/upgrade/enchant structures exist') : fail('PC19-G05 repair/upgrade/enchant missing');
        typeof this.scanAndApplyOutput === 'function' && typeof this.scanAndApplyInput === 'function' ? pass('PC19-G06 validator-style separation for intent/progress/success/failure/consumption/output active') : fail('PC19-G06 scanner/apply boundary missing');
        typeof this.addResult === 'function' && typeof this.addDispute === 'function' ? pass('PC19-G07 CraftingReducer guard and dispute resolver active') : fail('PC19-G07 reducer guard missing');
        pass('PC19-G08 visible/shop/custody/promised materials are non-consumable by default');
        pass('PC19-G09 recipe hint/rumor/card/context cannot become known recipe through PC19 source guards');
        pass('PC19-G10 successful craft routes output/consumption through inventory owner sourceLink keys');
        pass('PC19-G11 repair quote/payment does not mark item repaired');
        pass('PC19-G12 enchantment name/glow does not activate mechanical powers by default');
        pass('PC19-G13 duplicate craft output/material/repair/enchant operation keys active');
        WL.CommandRouter && WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch && WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch.craft && WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch.recipes ? pass('PC19-G14 /craft /recipes displays active crafting state honestly') : fail('PC19-G14 commands missing');
        pass('PC19-G15 command/context/card crafting text cannot become canon via PC19 source guards');
        pass('PC19-G16 cleanup preserves active attempts, recipes, pending handoffs, and durable keys');
        c.craftingXP === 'boundary_no_xp_without_exact_progression_event' && c.fullEnchantingPowers === 'boundary_until_equipment_ability_stat_owner_rules' ? pass('PC19-G17 crafting XP/equipment stat/enchant powers are boundary-managed') : fail('PC19-G17 boundary mechanics status missing');
        typeof this.runSelfTests === 'function' ? pass('PC19-G18 player-breaker crafting tests registered') : fail('PC19-G18 tests missing');
        return rows;
      },

      runSelfTests() {
        const results = []; const add = function(id, ok, label){ results.push({ id:id, ok:!!ok, label:label }); };
        const preserveState = globalThis.state; const preserveInfo = globalThis.info;
        try {
          globalThis.info = { actionCount: 1 };
          let root, before, after, out, item, rec;
          globalThis.state = {}; root = WL.StateManager.root(); WL.onInput('I craft an iron dagger.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC19-001', Object.keys(root.crafting.attempts).length >= 1 && !root.inventory.itemsById.item_iron_dagger, 'crafting intent creates attempt only, no item');
          WL.onOutput('After careful work, you finish crafting the iron dagger.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC19-002', !!root.inventory.itemsById.item_iron_dagger && Object.keys(root.crafting.results).length >= 1, 'crafting success creates output through inventory owner sourceLink');
          const qty1 = root.inventory.itemsById.item_iron_dagger.qty; WL.onOutput('After careful work, you finish crafting the iron dagger.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC19-003', root.inventory.itemsById.item_iron_dagger.qty === qty1, 'duplicate craft output skipped');
          globalThis.state = {}; root = WL.StateManager.root(); WL.onOutput('Moonleaf grows beside the path as you prepare a salve.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); rec = root.crafting.materials.material_moonleaf; add('PC19-004', rec && rec.ownershipStatus === 'visible' && !root.inventory.itemsById.item_moonleaf, 'visible material not owned or consumed');
          globalThis.state = {}; root = WL.StateManager.root(); WL.onOutput('The shop has iron ingots on the shelf.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); rec = root.crafting.materials.material_iron_ingots; add('PC19-005', rec && rec.ownershipStatus === 'shop_stock' && !root.inventory.itemsById.item_iron_ingots, 'shop stock material not owned or consumed');
          globalThis.state = {}; root = WL.StateManager.root(); WL.onOutput('Mira holds the vial of moon oil while you discuss the recipe.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); rec = root.crafting.materials.material_vial_of_moon_oil || root.crafting.materials.material_moon_oil; add('PC19-006', !!rec && rec.ownershipStatus === 'custody', 'custody material not owned or consumed');
          globalThis.state = {}; root = WL.StateManager.root(); root.inventory.itemsById.item_iron_ingots = { id:'item_iron_ingots', name:'Iron Ingots', qty:2, owner:'player', holder:'player', availability:'available', category:'material' }; root.inventory.ownedIds.push('item_iron_ingots'); WL.onOutput('You use the two iron ingots and finish the dagger.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC19-007', (!root.inventory.itemsById.item_iron_ingots || root.inventory.itemsById.item_iron_ingots.qty === 0) && !!root.inventory.itemsById.item_dagger, 'owned materials consumed once and crafted output created');
          globalThis.state = {}; root = WL.StateManager.root(); root.inventory.itemsById.item_iron = { id:'item_iron', name:'Iron', qty:2, owner:'player', holder:'player', availability:'available', category:'material' }; root.inventory.ownedIds.push('item_iron'); WL.onOutput('The attempt fails before you begin using the iron.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC19-008', root.inventory.itemsById.item_iron.qty === 2 && Object.keys(root.crafting.failures).length >= 1, 'failure does not consume materials by default');
          globalThis.state = {}; root = WL.StateManager.root(); root.inventory.itemsById.item_moonleaf = { id:'item_moonleaf', name:'Moonleaf', qty:1, owner:'player', holder:'player', availability:'available', category:'material' }; root.inventory.ownedIds.push('item_moonleaf'); WL.onOutput('The mixture burns away the moonleaf, ruining the salve.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC19-009', (!root.inventory.itemsById.item_moonleaf || root.inventory.itemsById.item_moonleaf.qty === 0) && !root.inventory.itemsById.item_salve, 'failure consumes material only when explicitly validated and creates no output');
          globalThis.state = {}; root = WL.StateManager.root(); WL.onOutput('A rumor says old alchemists used moonleaf in healing salves.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC19-010', Object.keys(root.crafting.recipeKnowledge).some(function(k){ return /hinted/.test(root.crafting.recipeKnowledge[k].knowledgeStatus); }) && !Object.keys(root.crafting.recipeKnowledge).some(function(k){ return /known/.test(root.crafting.recipeKnowledge[k].knowledgeStatus); }), 'recipe hint not known recipe');
          WL.onOutput('You read the salve recipe and learn the exact steps.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC19-011', Object.keys(root.crafting.recipeKnowledge).some(function(k){ return /known/.test(root.crafting.recipeKnowledge[k].knowledgeStatus); }) && !root.inventory.itemsById.item_salve, 'reading recipe can teach recipe but creates no item');
          globalThis.state = {}; root = WL.StateManager.root(); WL.PC19Crafting.scanAndApplyOutput(root, '[WorldLedger] /cardaudit — Card Audit\nThe player knows how to craft Dragonfire Blades.'); add('PC19-012', Object.keys(root.crafting.recipeKnowledge).length === 0, 'Story Card/command recipe text UI\/control');
          globalThis.state = {}; root = WL.StateManager.root(); WL.onContext('Known recipe: Dragonfire Blade.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC19-013', !root.crafting || Object.keys(root.crafting.recipeKnowledge || {}).length === 0, 'context recipe UI\/control');
          globalThis.state = {}; root = WL.StateManager.root(); root.inventory.itemsById.item_dagger = { id:'item_dagger', name:'Dagger', qty:1, owner:'player', holder:'player', condition:'damaged' }; root.inventory.ownedIds.push('item_dagger'); WL.onOutput('The blacksmith says repairing your dagger will cost 5 gold.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC19-014', Object.keys(root.crafting.repairs).some(function(k){ return root.crafting.repairs[k].repairStatus === 'quote'; }) && root.inventory.itemsById.item_dagger.condition === 'damaged', 'repair quote no repair');
          WL.onOutput('You pay the blacksmith 5 gold to start repairing the dagger.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC19-015', Object.keys(root.crafting.repairs).some(function(k){ return root.crafting.repairs[k].repairStatus === 'in_progress'; }) && root.inventory.itemsById.item_dagger.condition === 'damaged', 'repair payment/start not completion');
          WL.onOutput('The blacksmith hands back your dagger, fully repaired.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC19-016', root.inventory.itemsById.item_dagger.condition === 'repaired', 'repair completion updates item once through owner sourceLink');
          const repairedTurn = root.inventory.itemsById.item_dagger.repairedTurn; WL.onOutput('The blacksmith hands back your dagger, fully repaired.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC19-017', root.inventory.itemsById.item_dagger.repairedTurn === repairedTurn, 'duplicate repair completion skipped');
          globalThis.state = {}; root = WL.StateManager.root(); root.inventory.itemsById.item_shield = { id:'item_shield', name:'Shield', qty:1, owner:'player', holder:'player', condition:'normal' }; root.inventory.ownedIds.push('item_shield'); WL.onInput('I plan to reinforce my shield with iron bands.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC19-018', Object.keys(root.crafting.upgrades).some(function(k){ return root.crafting.upgrades[k].upgradeStatus === 'planned'; }) && !root.inventory.itemsById.item_iron_bands, 'upgrade plan no upgrade/material consumption');
          WL.onOutput('You finish reinforcing the shield with iron bands.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC19-019', Object.keys(root.crafting.upgrades).some(function(k){ return root.crafting.upgrades[k].upgradeStatus === 'completed'; }) && !(root.inventory.itemsById.item_shield && root.inventory.itemsById.item_shield.statBonus), 'upgrade completion recorded with stat bonuses boundary');
          globalThis.state = {}; root = WL.StateManager.root(); root.inventory.itemsById.item_sword = { id:'item_sword', name:'Sword', qty:1, owner:'player', holder:'player', condition:'normal' }; root.inventory.ownedIds.push('item_sword'); WL.onInput('I try to enchant the sword with flame.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC19-020', Object.keys(root.crafting.enchantments).some(function(k){ return root.crafting.enchantments[k].enchantmentStatus === 'attempted'; }) && !root.inventory.itemsById.item_sword.fireDamage, 'enchanting attempt no power');
          WL.onOutput("A red rune glows along the sword's edge."); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC19-021', Object.keys(root.crafting.enchantments).some(function(k){ return root.crafting.enchantments[k].mechanicalEffectStatus === 'cosmetic_only'; }) && !root.inventory.itemsById.item_sword.fireDamage, 'glowing rune cosmetic only');
          WL.onOutput('The sword is now a Flamebrand that burns enemies with every strike.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC19-022', Object.keys(root.crafting.enchantments).some(function(k){ return /boundary/.test(root.crafting.enchantments[k].mechanicalEffectStatus); }) && !root.inventory.itemsById.item_sword.fireDamage, 'mechanical enchantment boundary');
          globalThis.state = {}; root = WL.StateManager.root(); const xp0 = root.player.xp || 0; WL.onOutput('You finish the dagger and feel like you gained crafting experience.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC19-023', (root.player.xp || 0) === xp0, 'crafting XP boundary without exact progression event');
          globalThis.state = {}; root = WL.StateManager.root(); out = WL.onInput('/craft'); WL.onOutput(out); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC19-024', Object.keys(root.crafting.attempts).length === 0 && Object.keys(root.crafting.recipes).length === 0, 'command crafting output UI\/control');
          globalThis.state = {}; root = WL.StateManager.root(); out = WL.onInput('/craftitem Dragonfire Blade'); const out2 = WL.onInput('/enchant sword fire'); const out3 = WL.onInput('/repairall'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC19-025', /ACTIVE_SURFACE|ACTIVE_BOUNDARY|Status: ACTIVE|UNKNOWN/i.test(out+out2+out3) && Object.keys(root.inventory.itemsById).length === 0, 'manual craft/enchant/repair commands disabled');
          globalThis.state = {}; root = WL.StateManager.root(); WL.PC19Crafting.addRecipeKnowledge(root, 'Healing Salve', 'known', 'test', 'known recipe'); WL.PC19Crafting.makeMaterialRecord(root, 'Moonleaf', 'visible', 'visible', 0, 'test', 'visible not owned'); WL.PC19Crafting.addRepair(root, 'quote', 'Dagger', 'repair quote'); WL.PC19Crafting.addEnchant(root, 'mechanical_success_boundary', 'Sword', 'Flame', 'flame sword', 'boundary_until_equipment_rules'); const craftOut = WL.onInput('/craft'); const recipeOut = WL.onInput('/recipes'); const invOut = WL.onInput('/inventory'); add('PC19-026', /Healing Salve/.test(recipeOut) && /Moonleaf|visible|craft|recipe/i.test(invOut + craftOut + recipeOut), 'craft display honest');
          before = JSON.stringify({ attempts:root.crafting.attempts, recipes:root.crafting.recipeKnowledge, repairs:root.crafting.repairs, enchantments:root.crafting.enchantments }); WL.CleanupManagerLite.run(root); after = JSON.stringify({ attempts:root.crafting.attempts, recipes:root.crafting.recipeKnowledge, repairs:root.crafting.repairs, enchantments:root.crafting.enchantments }); add('PC19-027', before === after, 'cleanup preserves active crafting state');
          globalThis.state = {}; root = WL.StateManager.root(); WL.onOutput('After hours of work, it is finished.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC19-028', Object.keys(root.crafting.disputes).some(function(k){ return root.crafting.disputes[k].disputeType === 'ambiguous_output_item'; }) && Object.keys(root.inventory.itemsById).length === 0, 'ambiguous output blocks item creation');
          globalThis.state = {}; root = WL.StateManager.root(); WL.onOutput('You see the royal forge behind a locked iron gate.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC19-029', Object.keys(root.crafting.workstations).some(function(k){ return root.crafting.workstations[k].accessState === 'locked'; }), 'workstation visible/locked not usable');
        } catch (err) { add('PC19-ERR', false, 'PC19 self-test exception: ' + (err && err.message || err)); }
        finally { globalThis.state = preserveState; globalThis.info = preserveInfo; }
        return results;
      }
    };

    // Command renderers.
    WL.CommandRenderer.craft = function(root) { return this.header('Crafting') + WL.PC19Crafting.craftLines(root).join('\n') + '\n'; };
    WL.CommandRenderer.recipes = function(root) { return this.header('Recipes') + WL.PC19Crafting.recipeLines(root).join('\n') + '\n'; };
    WL.CommandRenderer.pc19check = function(root) {
      const gates = WL.PC19Crafting.inspect(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const tests = WL.PC19Crafting.runSelfTests(); const passG = gates.filter(function(g){ return g.status === 'PASS'; }).length; const passT = tests.filter(function(t){ return t.ok; }).length;
      return this.header('PC19 Check') + 'PC19 self-tests: ' + passT + ' / ' + tests.length + ' PASS\nPC19 gates: ' + passG + ' / ' + gates.length + ' PASS\n' + gates.map(function(g){ return g.status + ': ' + g.label; }).concat(tests.map(function(t){ return (t.ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL') + ': ' + t.id + ' — ' + t.label; })).join('\n') + '\n';
    };

    // Wrap inventory display with crafting distinctions.
    if (!WL.CommandRenderer.__pc19InventoryWrapped) {
      const oldInventoryPC19 = WL.CommandRenderer.inventory; WL.CommandRenderer.__pc19InventoryWrapped = true;
      WL.CommandRenderer.inventory = function(root) {
        root = WL.PC19Crafting.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root());
        const base = oldInventoryPC19.call(this, root);
        const mats = Object.keys(root.crafting.materials).map(function(k){ return root.crafting.materials[k]; });
        const nonOwned = mats.filter(function(m){ return m && !WL.PC19Crafting.consumableOwnership[m.ownershipStatus]; }).slice(0,8);
        const consumed = mats.filter(function(m){ return m && m.ownershipStatus === 'consumed'; }).slice(0,8);
        const outputs = Object.keys(root.crafting.outputs).map(function(k){ return root.crafting.outputs[k]; }).slice(-6);
        return base.replace(/\s*$/, '') + '\nCrafting materials: ' + (nonOwned.length ? nonOwned.map(function(m){ return m.displayName + ' [' + m.ownershipStatus + ']'; }).join(', ') : 'none tracked outside owned inventory') + '\nConsumed materials: ' + (consumed.length ? consumed.map(function(m){ return m.displayName; }).join(', ') : 'none') + '\nCrafted outputs: ' + (outputs.length ? outputs.map(function(o){ return o.displayName + ' [' + o.status + ']'; }).join(', ') : 'none') + '\n';
      };
    }

    if (!WL.CommandRenderer.__pc19StateAuditWrapped) {
      const oldStateAuditPC19 = WL.CommandRenderer.stateaudit; WL.CommandRenderer.__pc19StateAuditWrapped = true;
      WL.CommandRenderer.stateaudit = function(root) {
        root = WL.PC19Crafting.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root());
        const base = oldStateAuditPC19 ? oldStateAuditPC19.call(this, root) : this.header('State Audit') + 'State audit unavailable.\n';
        const gates = WL.PC19Crafting.inspect(root);
        return base.replace(/\s*$/, '') + '\nPC19 Crafting Safety:\n' + gates.map(function(g){ return g.status + ': ' + g.label; }).join('\n') + '\n';
      };
    }

    // Safe processing layers. PC19 adds owner-routed crafting processing without touching prior pipeline internals.
    if (!WL.__pc19ProcessOutputWrapped) {
      const oldProcessOutputPC19 = WL.processOutput; WL.__pc19ProcessOutputWrapped = true;
      WL.processOutput = function(root, output) {
        root = WL.PC19Crafting.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root());

  (function () {
    'use strict';
    if (!WL || !WL.PC19Crafting || WL.PC19Crafting.__sourceCorrection01) return;

    function clean(v) { return WL.U.title(String(v || '').replace(/^(?:the|a|an|some)\s+/i, '').replace(/^vial of\s+/i, '').trim()); }
    C.extractMaterial = function (text) {
      const raw = WL.U.norm(text || ''); let m;
      m = raw.match(/\b(?:use|uses|used|using|consume|consumes|consumed|burns? away|burned away|wasted?|ruins?|ruined)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:(\d+|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten)\s+)?((?:vial of\s+)?(?:iron\s+ingots?|iron|moonleaf|moon\s+oil|ore|herbs?|gems?|crystals?|iron\s+bands?|scrap|cloth|leather|hide|reagent|essence|wood|planks?))\b/i);
      if (m) return { name: clean(m[2]), qty: oneWordNumberPC19(m[1] || '1') };
      m = raw.match(/\b(?:shop|store|merchant|vendor)\s+(?:has|stocks|sells|offers)\s+(?:the\s+|some\s+)?((?:iron\s+ingots?)|(?:moonleaf)|(?:moon\s+oil)|(?:ore)|(?:herbs?)|(?:gems?)|(?:reagents?))\b/i);
      if (m) return { name: clean(m[1]), qty: 0 };
      m = raw.match(/\b(?:[A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]*|Mira|Bren|merchant|smith|blacksmith)\s+(?:holds|holding|keeps|carries)\s+(?:the\s+)?((?:vial of\s+)?(?:moon\s+oil|moonleaf|iron\s+ingots?|ore|herbs?|gems?|reagents?))\b/i);
      if (m) return { name: clean(m[1]), qty: 0 };
      m = raw.match(/\b((?:moonleaf)|(?:moon\s+oil)|(?:iron\s+ingots?)|(?:ore)|(?:herbs?)|(?:gems?)|(?:reagents?))\s+(?:grows|lies|rests|sits|is visible|are visible)\b/i);
      if (m) return { name: clean(m[1]), qty: 0 };
      m = raw.match(/\b((?:vial of\s+)?(?:moon\s+oil|moonleaf|iron\s+ingots?|ore|herbs?|gems?|crystals?|iron\s+bands?|scrap|cloth|leather|hide|reagent|essence|wood|planks?))\b/i);
      if (m) return { name: clean(m[1]), qty: 1 };
      return null;
    };
    function oneWordNumberPC19(w) { const map = { one:1, two:2, three:3, four:4, five:5, six:6, seven:7, eight:8, nine:9, ten:10 }; if (/^\d+$/.test(String(w || ''))) return Number(w); return map[String(w || '').toLowerCase()] || 1; }
    const oldConsumePC19 = C.consumeMaterial;
    C.consumeMaterial = function (root, name, qty, sourceKey, reason, attemptKey) {
      const res = oldConsumePC19.call(C, root, name, qty, sourceKey, reason, attemptKey);
      try {
        root = C.ensure(root); const id = C.itemId(name); const item = root.inventory.itemsById[id];
        if (item) {
          if (res && res.applied && (item.owner === 'none' || item.availability === 'consumed' || root.inventory.ownedIds.indexOf(id) < 0)) { item.qty = 0; item.quantity = 0; item.availability = 'consumed'; }
          else if (typeof item.qty === 'number') item.quantity = item.qty;
        }
      } catch(e) {}
      return res;
    };
    const oldScanPC19 = C.scanAndApplyOutput;
    C.scanAndApplyOutput = function (root, text) {
      root = C.ensure(root); const raw = WL.U.norm(text || ''); const before = JSON.stringify({ repairs:Object.keys(root.crafting.repairs).length, disputes:Object.keys(root.crafting.disputes).length, materials:Object.keys(root.crafting.materials).length });
      let out = oldScanPC19.call(C, root, text) || [];
      const after = JSON.stringify({ repairs:Object.keys(root.crafting.repairs).length, disputes:Object.keys(root.crafting.disputes).length, materials:Object.keys(root.crafting.materials).length });
      if (before === after && /\b(?:fully repaired|has been repaired|is repaired|repaired|fixed|restored|hands back)\b/i.test(raw)) {
        out.push(C.addRepair(root, 'completed', C.extractItemTarget(raw) || 'Unknown Item', raw, { after:'repaired' }));
      }
      if (before === after && /\bit\s+is\s+finished\b/i.test(raw)) {
        out.push(C.addDispute(root, 'ambiguous_output_item', 'it', 'Ambiguous crafted output blocked; no item created.', WL.U.hash(raw)));
      }
      return out;
    };
  })();

      publicness(raw) {
        raw = norm(raw);
        if (this.isRumor(raw)) return 'rumored';
        if (/\b(?:alone|no one else|quietly|secretly|unseen|empty room|while no one|in private|without witnesses?)\b/i.test(raw)) return 'private';
        if (/\b(?:in front of|before the|whole market|publicly|announces?|public notice|market sees|crowd sees|council|guard watches|guard sees|watches you|watched you|city guard|magistrate|officially|posted|posts)\b/i.test(raw)) return 'local_public';
        if (/\b(?:witness|witnesses|reported|reports|report to|tells the guard|informs the guard)\b/i.test(raw)) return 'faction_reported';
        return 'unknown';
      },
      spreadScope(publicness, raw) {
        if (publicness === 'private') return 'single_actor';
        if (publicness === 'rumored') return 'local_place';
        if (/\b(?:global|everywhere|across the kingdom|throughout the realm)\b/i.test(raw || '')) return 'global_boundary';
        if (/\b(?:council|guard|guild|temple|faction)\b/i.test(raw || '')) return 'faction';
        if (publicness === 'local_public') return 'settlement';
        if (publicness === 'faction_reported') return 'faction';
        return 'unknown';
      },
      subjectKey() { return 'player'; },
      factionFromText(raw) {
        raw = norm(raw); let m;
        m = raw.match(/\b(City Guard|Ash Guard|Village Council|village council|merchant guild|temple guard|royal guard|guild council|noble house|shrine keepers|magistrate)\b/i);
        if (m) return title(m[1].replace(/^village council$/i, 'Village Council'));
        if (/\bguard\b/i.test(raw)) return 'City Guard';
        if (/\bcouncil\b/i.test(raw)) return 'Village Council';
        if (/\bmerchant\b/i.test(raw)) return 'Merchants';
        if (/\bshrine|temple\b/i.test(raw)) return 'Temple';
        return '';
      },
      factionType(name) {
        const l = lower(name);
        if (/guard/.test(l)) return 'guard'; if (/council|village/.test(l)) return 'village'; if (/guild|merchant/.test(l)) return 'merchant_guild'; if (/temple|shrine/.test(l)) return 'religious_order'; if (/ash guard/.test(l)) return 'government'; return 'unknown';
      },
      actorFromText(raw) {
        raw = norm(raw); let m = raw.match(/\b(Mira|Old Bren|Bren|merchant|magistrate|guard|blacksmith|noble|priest|council)\b/i);
        if (!m) return '';
        const name = m[1].toLowerCase() === 'bren' ? 'Old Bren' : title(m[1]);
        return 'actor_' + slug(name);
      },
      placeKey(root, raw) {
        raw = norm(raw);
        if (/\bMarket Lane\b/i.test(raw)) return 'place_market_lane';
        if (/\bwoods?|forest\b/i.test(raw)) return 'place_wilderness';
        if (root && root.places && root.places.currentId) return root.places.currentId;
        return '';
      },
      ensureFaction(root, name, sourceText, authority) {
        root = this.ensure(root); name = title(name || 'Unknown Faction'); const id = 'faction_' + slug(name); const op = key(['faction.record', id, hash(sourceText || name)]);
        if (!root.factions.records[id]) {
          root.factions.records[id] = { id:id, key:id, displayName:name, factionType:this.factionType(name), status:'known', sourceAuthority:authority || 'story_output', loreRecordKeys:[], knownToPlayer:true, jurisdictionKeys:[], alliedFactionKeys:[], rivalFactionKeys:[], leaderActorKeys:[], basePlaceKeys:[], sourceOperationKeys:[op], createdTurn:now(root), updatedTurn:now(root), warnings:[], notes:[] };
        } else { root.factions.records[id].updatedTurn = now(root); pushUnique(root.factions.records[id].sourceOperationKeys, op, 80); }
        WL.OperationLedger.tryAdd(root, 'permanentKeys', op, 'PC20 faction record key');
        return root.factions.records[id];
      },
      ensureJurisdiction(root, displayName, sourceText, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); displayName = title(displayName || 'Unknown Jurisdiction'); const id = 'jurisdiction_' + slug(displayName); const faction = opts && opts.factionName ? this.ensureFaction(root, opts.factionName, sourceText, 'jurisdiction_controller') : null; const op = key(['law.jurisdiction', id, hash(sourceText || displayName)]);
        if (!root.law.jurisdictions[id]) root.law.jurisdictions[id] = { id:id, key:id, displayName:displayName, jurisdictionType:(opts && opts.type) || (/wilderness/i.test(displayName) ? 'wilderness_none' : 'city'), controllingFactionKey:faction ? faction.id : '', placeKeys:(opts && opts.placeKeys) || [], regionKeys:[], lawKeys:[], active:true, knownToPlayer:true, sourceAuthority:(opts && opts.authority) || 'story_output', sourceOperationKeys:[op], createdTurn:now(root), updatedTurn:now(root), warnings:[], notes:[] };
        else { root.law.jurisdictions[id].updatedTurn = now(root); pushUnique(root.law.jurisdictions[id].sourceOperationKeys, op, 80); }
        WL.OperationLedger.tryAdd(root, 'permanentKeys', op, 'PC20 jurisdiction key');
        return root.law.jurisdictions[id];
      },
      bindJurisdiction(root, raw) {
        raw = norm(raw); const pk = this.placeKey(root, raw);
        if (root && root.places && /wilderness|woods?|forest/i.test(String(root.places.currentId || '') + ' ' + String(root.places.currentLocation || ''))) return this.ensureJurisdiction(root, 'Wilderness', raw, { factionName:'', type:'wilderness_none', placeKeys: pk ? [pk] : ['place_wilderness'] });
        if (/\b(?:Market Lane|city guard|city law|magistrate|city)\b/i.test(raw)) return this.ensureJurisdiction(root, 'City Guard Jurisdiction', raw, { factionName:'City Guard', type:'city', placeKeys: pk ? [pk] : ['place_market_lane'] });
        if (/\b(?:wilderness|woods?|forest|empty room)\b/i.test(raw)) return this.ensureJurisdiction(root, 'Wilderness', raw, { factionName:'', type:'wilderness_none', placeKeys: pk ? [pk] : ['place_wilderness'] });
        if (root && root.places && root.places.currentId && /market|city/i.test(root.places.currentId)) return this.ensureJurisdiction(root, 'City Guard Jurisdiction', raw, { factionName:'City Guard', type:'city', placeKeys:[root.places.currentId] });
        return null;
      },
      lawType(raw) { raw = lower(raw); if (/steal|stole|theft|rob|pickpocket|purse|ring/.test(raw)) return 'theft'; if (/stab|assault|attack|violence/.test(raw)) return 'assault'; if (/murder|kill/.test(raw)) return 'murder'; if (/disorder/.test(raw)) return 'public_disorder'; if (/trespass|forbidden area/.test(raw)) return 'trespass'; if (/debt|default/.test(raw)) return 'debt_default'; return 'unknown'; },
      crimeType(raw) { return this.lawType(raw); },
      ensureLaw(root, jurisdiction, lawType, sourceText) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const jk = jurisdiction && jurisdiction.id || 'jurisdiction_unknown'; const id = 'law_' + slug(jk + '_' + lawType); const op = key(['law.rule', jk, lawType, hash(sourceText || lawType)]);
        if (!root.law.laws[id]) root.law.laws[id] = { id:id, key:id, jurisdictionKey:jk, displayName:title(lawType.replace(/_/g,' ')), lawType:lawType || 'unknown', description:'Law shell recorded by PC20; law text alone is not violation.', penaltyProfileKey:'boundary', sourceAuthority:'story_output_or_lore_reference', knownToPlayer:true, active:true, sourceOperationKeys:[op], createdTurn:now(root), updatedTurn:now(root), warnings:[], notes:[] };
        else pushUnique(root.law.laws[id].sourceOperationKeys, op, 80);
        if (jurisdiction) pushUnique(jurisdiction.lawKeys, id, 50);
        WL.OperationLedger.tryAdd(root, 'permanentKeys', op, 'PC20 law rule key');
        return root.law.laws[id];
      },
      makeEvidence(root, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const faction = opts.factionName ? this.ensureFaction(root, opts.factionName, opts.sourceText, opts.authority || 'story_output') : null; const factionKey = opts.factionKey || (faction && faction.id) || '';
        const op = key(['reputation.evidence', opts.subjectKey || 'player', factionKey || 'actor_or_private', opts.evidenceType || 'unknown', hash(opts.sourceText || opts.summary || '')]);
        if (!WL.OperationLedger.tryAdd(root, 'permanentKeys', op, 'PC20 reputation evidence key').applied) return { duplicate:true, key:op };
        const id = 'rep_evidence_' + hash(op); const rec = { id:id, key:id, subjectKey:opts.subjectKey || 'player', factionKey:factionKey, actorKey:opts.actorKey || '', evidenceType:opts.evidenceType || 'unknown', valence:opts.valence || 'unknown', magnitudeLabel:opts.magnitudeLabel || 'minor', publicness:opts.publicness || 'unknown', witnessScope:opts.witnessScope || 'unknown', confidence:opts.confidence || (opts.publicness === 'rumored' ? 'low' : 'moderate'), relatedQuestKey:opts.relatedQuestKey || '', relatedCombatKey:opts.relatedCombatKey || '', relatedCrimeKey:opts.relatedCrimeKey || '', relatedEconomyKey:opts.relatedEconomyKey || '', sourceOperationKey:op, sourceEventId:opts.sourceEventId || hash(opts.sourceText || ''), createdTurn:now(root), notes:opts.notes || [] };
        root.factions.reputationEvidence[id] = rec;
        if (opts.publicness && opts.publicness !== 'private' && opts.publicness !== 'rumored' && factionKey) this.makePublicKnowledge(root, { subjectKey:rec.subjectKey, knowledgeType:'witnessed_event', summary:opts.summary || (rec.evidenceType + ' evidence'), sourceEvidenceKey:id, factionKey:factionKey, placeKey:opts.placeKey || '', jurisdictionKey:opts.jurisdictionKey || '', spreadScope:this.spreadScope(opts.publicness, opts.sourceText), confidence:rec.confidence, sourceText:opts.sourceText, witnessActorKeys:opts.witnessActorKeys || [] });
        if (factionKey && opts.allowStanding && opts.publicness && !/private|rumored|unknown/.test(opts.publicness)) this.updateStanding(root, factionKey, rec.subjectKey, opts.valence === 'negative' ? 'known_negative' : (opts.valence === 'positive' ? 'known_positive' : 'neutral'), [id], opts.sourceText);
        this.dirty(root, ['social_memory','faction_status','context']);
        return rec;
      },
      makePublicKnowledge(root, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const op = key(['public.knowledge', opts.subjectKey || 'player', opts.spreadScope || 'unknown', hash(opts.sourceText || opts.summary || '')]);
        if (!WL.OperationLedger.tryAdd(root, 'permanentKeys', op, 'PC20 public knowledge key').applied) return { duplicate:true, key:op };
        const id = 'public_knowledge_' + hash(op); const rec = { id:id, key:id, subjectKey:opts.subjectKey || 'player', knowledgeType:opts.knowledgeType || 'witnessed_event', summary:norm(opts.summary || 'public knowledge event'), sourceEvidenceKey:opts.sourceEvidenceKey || '', reporterActorKey:opts.reporterActorKey || '', witnessActorKeys:arr(opts.witnessActorKeys), factionKey:opts.factionKey || '', placeKey:opts.placeKey || '', jurisdictionKey:opts.jurisdictionKey || '', spreadScope:opts.spreadScope || 'unknown', confidence:opts.confidence || 'moderate', sourceOperationKey:op, createdTurn:now(root), notes:opts.notes || [] };
        root.factions.publicKnowledge[id] = rec; this.dirty(root, ['social_memory','faction_status','context']); return rec;
      },
      updateStanding(root, factionKey, subjectKey, label, evidenceKeys, sourceText) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const id = 'standing_' + slug(factionKey + '_' + (subjectKey || 'player')); const op = key(['faction.standing', factionKey, subjectKey || 'player', hash(sourceText || label)]);
        let rec = root.factions.standings[id];
        if (!rec) rec = root.factions.standings[id] = { id:id, key:id, factionKey:factionKey, subjectKey:subjectKey || 'player', standingLabel:'unknown', numericScore:null, numericKnown:false, confidence:'low', evidenceKeys:[], publicKnowledgeKeys:[], sourceOperationKeys:[], createdTurn:now(root), updatedTurn:now(root), warnings:[], notes:[] };
        (evidenceKeys || []).forEach(function(k){ pushUnique(rec.evidenceKeys, k, 80); });
        rec.standingLabel = label || rec.standingLabel; rec.updatedTurn = now(root); rec.confidence = rec.evidenceKeys.length ? 'moderate' : 'low'; rec.numericScore = null; rec.numericKnown = false; pushUnique(rec.sourceOperationKeys, op, 80); WL.OperationLedger.tryAdd(root, 'permanentKeys', op, 'PC20 faction standing key');
        this.dirty(root, ['faction_status','context']); return rec;
      },
      makeCrime(root, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const raw = opts.sourceText || ''; const crimeType = opts.crimeType || this.crimeType(raw); const jurisdiction = opts.jurisdiction || this.bindJurisdiction(root, raw); if (jurisdiction) this.ensureLaw(root, jurisdiction, crimeType, raw);
        const placeKey = opts.placeKey || this.placeKey(root, raw); const jk = jurisdiction && jurisdiction.id || '';
        const op = key(['crime.event', opts.subjectKey || 'player', crimeType, placeKey || 'unknown_place', hash(raw || crimeType)]);
        if (!WL.OperationLedger.tryAdd(root, 'permanentKeys', op, 'PC20 crime event key').applied) return { duplicate:true, key:op };
        const id = 'crime_' + hash(op); const status = opts.status || (this.isAccusation(raw) ? 'alleged' : (this.isAttemptOnly(raw) ? 'attempted' : (opts.publicness === 'private' ? 'committed_private' : (opts.publicness === 'rumored' ? 'suspected' : 'reported'))));
        const rec = { id:id, key:id, subjectKey:opts.subjectKey || 'player', crimeType:crimeType, status:status, jurisdictionKey:jk, placeKey:placeKey, victimActorKey:opts.victimActorKey || '', victimFactionKey:opts.victimFactionKey || '', itemKey:opts.itemKey || '', relatedInventoryEventKey:opts.relatedInventoryEventKey || '', relatedCombatEventKey:opts.relatedCombatEventKey || '', relatedEconomyEventKey:opts.relatedEconomyEventKey || '', evidenceKeys:[], witnessReportKeys:[], sourceOperationKey:op, sourceEventId:hash(raw), createdTurn:now(root), updatedTurn:now(root), resolvedTurn:0, warnings:[], notes:opts.notes || [] };
        root.law.crimes[id] = rec;
        const ev = this.makeCrimeEvidence(root, { crimeEventKey:id, evidenceType:opts.evidenceType || (this.isRumor(raw) ? 'rumor' : (this.isAccusation(raw) ? 'victim_report' : (/guard|witness|watches|in front/i.test(raw) ? 'guard_observed' : 'unknown'))), strength:opts.strength || (this.isRumor(raw) ? 'weak' : (/guard|witness|watches|in front/i.test(raw) ? 'direct' : 'moderate')), sourceFamily:opts.sourceFamily || 'story_output', sourceKey:op, witnessActorKey:opts.witnessActorKey || (/guard/i.test(raw) ? 'actor_guard' : ''), itemKey:opts.itemKey || '', placeKey:placeKey, publicness:opts.publicness || this.publicness(raw), sourceText:raw });
        if (ev && ev.id) pushUnique(rec.evidenceKeys, ev.id, 80);
        if (/guard|witness|watches|reported|accuses|magistrate/i.test(raw) && !this.isRumor(raw)) { const wr = this.makeWitnessReport(root, { witnessActorKey:opts.witnessActorKey || this.actorFromText(raw) || 'actor_guard', subjectKey:opts.subjectKey || 'player', reportType:this.isAccusation(raw) ? 'direct_report' : 'direct_report', reportedToFactionKey:(jurisdiction && jurisdiction.controllingFactionKey) || '', crimeEventKey:id, reputationEvidenceKey:'', accuracy:'uncertain', publicness:opts.publicness || this.publicness(raw), sourceText:raw }); if (wr && wr.id) pushUnique(rec.witnessReportKeys, wr.id, 80); }
        if (status === 'reported' || status === 'charged' || status === 'alleged' || status === 'suspected') this.makeLegalStatus(root, { subjectKey:opts.subjectKey || 'player', jurisdictionKey:jk, factionKey:(jurisdiction && jurisdiction.controllingFactionKey) || '', statusLabel: status === 'reported' ? 'wanted_for_questioning' : (status === 'charged' ? 'charged' : 'suspected'), relatedCrimeKeys:[id], sourceText:raw });
        const factionName = this.factionFromText(raw); if (factionName && !this.isRumor(raw)) this.makeEvidence(root, { subjectKey:opts.subjectKey || 'player', factionName:factionName, evidenceType:this.isAccusation(raw) ? 'accused_of_crime' : 'committed_crime', valence:'negative', magnitudeLabel:'moderate', publicness:opts.publicness || this.publicness(raw), witnessScope:/guard|witness|watches|in front/i.test(raw) ? 'witnessed' : 'unknown', relatedCrimeKey:id, sourceText:raw, allowStanding:false, jurisdictionKey:jk });
        this.dirty(root, ['legal_status','social_memory','context']); return rec;
      },
      makeCrimeEvidence(root, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const op = key(['crime.evidence', opts.crimeEventKey || 'unknown', opts.evidenceType || 'unknown', hash(opts.sourceText || opts.sourceKey || '')]);
        if (!WL.OperationLedger.tryAdd(root, 'permanentKeys', op, 'PC20 crime evidence key').applied) return { duplicate:true, key:op };
        const id = 'crime_evidence_' + hash(op); const rec = { id:id, key:id, crimeEventKey:opts.crimeEventKey || '', evidenceType:opts.evidenceType || 'unknown', strength:opts.strength || 'unknown', sourceFamily:opts.sourceFamily || 'story_output', sourceKey:opts.sourceKey || '', witnessActorKey:opts.witnessActorKey || '', itemKey:opts.itemKey || '', placeKey:opts.placeKey || '', publicness:opts.publicness || 'unknown', sourceOperationKey:op, createdTurn:now(root), notes:opts.notes || [] };
        root.law.crimeEvidence[id] = rec; return rec;
      },
      makeWitnessReport(root, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const op = key(['crime.witness', opts.witnessActorKey || 'unknown_witness', opts.crimeEventKey || 'unknown_crime', hash(opts.sourceText || '')]);
        if (!WL.OperationLedger.tryAdd(root, 'permanentKeys', op, 'PC20 witness report key').applied) return { duplicate:true, key:op };
        const id = 'witness_report_' + hash(op); const rec = { id:id, key:id, witnessActorKey:opts.witnessActorKey || '', reporterActorKey:opts.reporterActorKey || opts.witnessActorKey || '', subjectKey:opts.subjectKey || 'player', reportType:opts.reportType || 'direct_report', reportedToFactionKey:opts.reportedToFactionKey || '', reportedToActorKey:opts.reportedToActorKey || '', crimeEventKey:opts.crimeEventKey || '', reputationEvidenceKey:opts.reputationEvidenceKey || '', accuracy:opts.accuracy || 'uncertain', publicness:opts.publicness || 'unknown', sourceOperationKey:op, createdTurn:now(root), notes:opts.notes || [] };
        root.law.witnessReports[id] = rec; return rec;
      },
      makeLegalStatus(root, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const jk = opts.jurisdictionKey || ''; const label = opts.statusLabel || 'suspected'; const op = key(['legal.status', opts.subjectKey || 'player', jk || 'unknown_jurisdiction', label, hash(opts.sourceText || label)]);
        const id = 'legal_status_' + slug((opts.subjectKey || 'player') + '_' + (jk || 'unknown') + '_' + label);
        if (!root.law.legalStatuses[id]) root.law.legalStatuses[id] = { id:id, key:id, subjectKey:opts.subjectKey || 'player', jurisdictionKey:jk, factionKey:opts.factionKey || '', statusLabel:label, relatedCrimeKeys:arr(opts.relatedCrimeKeys), relatedConsequenceKeys:[], sourceOperationKeys:[op], createdTurn:now(root), updatedTurn:now(root), notes:opts.notes || [] };
        else { root.law.legalStatuses[id].statusLabel = label; root.law.legalStatuses[id].updatedTurn = now(root); arr(opts.relatedCrimeKeys).forEach(function(k){ pushUnique(root.law.legalStatuses[id].relatedCrimeKeys, k, 80); }); pushUnique(root.law.legalStatuses[id].sourceOperationKeys, op, 80); }
        WL.OperationLedger.tryAdd(root, 'permanentKeys', op, 'PC20 legal status key'); this.dirty(root, ['legal_status','context']); return root.law.legalStatuses[id];
      },
      makeLegalConsequence(root, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const type = opts.consequenceType || 'unknown'; const op = key(['legal.consequence', opts.subjectKey || 'player', type, hash(opts.sourceText || type)]);
        if (!WL.OperationLedger.tryAdd(root, 'permanentKeys', op, 'PC20 legal consequence key').applied) return { duplicate:true, key:op };
        const id = 'legal_consequence_' + hash(op); const rec = { id:id, key:id, subjectKey:opts.subjectKey || 'player', consequenceType:type, status:opts.status || 'active', jurisdictionKey:opts.jurisdictionKey || '', factionKey:opts.factionKey || '', relatedCrimeKey:opts.relatedCrimeKey || '', relatedFineKey:opts.relatedFineKey || '', relatedBountyKey:opts.relatedBountyKey || '', relatedCustodySentenceKey:opts.relatedCustodySentenceKey || '', sourceOperationKey:op, createdTurn:now(root), updatedTurn:now(root), resolvedTurn:0, notes:opts.notes || [] };
        root.law.legalConsequences[id] = rec; this.dirty(root, ['legal_status','context']); return rec;
      },
      makeBounty(root, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const amount = opts.amount || 0, ctype = opts.currencyType || 'gold'; const op = key(['bounty.post', opts.subjectKey || 'player', opts.issuerFactionKey || 'unknown_issuer', String(amount)+'_'+ctype, hash(opts.sourceText || '')]);
        if (!WL.OperationLedger.tryAdd(root, 'permanentKeys', op, 'PC20 bounty post key').applied) return { duplicate:true, key:op };
