        root.law.bounties[id] = rec; this.makeLegalConsequence(root, { subjectKey:rec.subjectKey, consequenceType:'bounty_posted', status:rec.status === 'rumored' ? 'pending' : 'active', jurisdictionKey:rec.jurisdictionKey, factionKey:rec.issuerFactionKey, relatedCrimeKey:rec.reasonCrimeKey, relatedBountyKey:id, sourceText:opts.sourceText, notes:['bounty posting does not spawn encounter or remove currency'] }); this.dirty(root, ['legal_status','context']); return rec;
      },
      makeFine(root, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const amount = opts.amount || 0, ctype = opts.currencyType || 'gold'; const op = key(['fine.due', opts.subjectKey || 'player', opts.jurisdictionKey || 'unknown_jurisdiction', String(amount)+'_'+ctype, hash(opts.sourceText || '')]);
        if (!WL.OperationLedger.tryAdd(root, 'permanentKeys', op, 'PC20 fine due key').applied) return { duplicate:true, key:op };
        const id = 'fine_' + hash(op); const rec = { id:id, key:id, subjectKey:opts.subjectKey || 'player', amount:amount, currencyType:ctype, jurisdictionKey:opts.jurisdictionKey || '', issuerFactionKey:opts.issuerFactionKey || '', relatedCrimeKey:opts.relatedCrimeKey || '', status:opts.status || 'due', dueText:opts.dueText || (amount + ' ' + ctype), paidOperationKey:'', sourceOperationKey:op, createdTurn:now(root), paidTurn:0, notes:opts.notes || [] };
        root.law.fines[id] = rec; this.makeLegalConsequence(root, { subjectKey:rec.subjectKey, consequenceType:'fine_due', status:'active', jurisdictionKey:rec.jurisdictionKey, factionKey:rec.issuerFactionKey, relatedCrimeKey:rec.relatedCrimeKey, relatedFineKey:id, sourceText:opts.sourceText, notes:['fine due does not subtract currency'] }); this.dirty(root, ['legal_status','context']); return rec;
      },
      markFinePaid(root, sourceText) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const amount = coinAmount(sourceText) || {}; let chosen = null; keys(root.law.fines).forEach(function(k){ const f = root.law.fines[k]; if (!chosen && f && f.status === 'due' && (!amount.amount || f.amount === amount.amount)) chosen = f; });
        if (!chosen) return this.blocked(root, 'law', 'fine payment mentioned but no matching due fine exists; no currency mutation here', sourceText);
        const op = key(['fine.paid', chosen.key, hash(sourceText || '')]); if (!WL.OperationLedger.tryAdd(root, 'permanentKeys', op, 'PC20 fine paid key').applied) return { duplicate:true, key:op };
        chosen.status = 'paid'; chosen.paidOperationKey = op; chosen.paidTurn = now(root); chosen.notes.push('marked paid only as legal shell; currency movement must be owner-routed outside PC20'); this.makeLegalConsequence(root, { subjectKey:chosen.subjectKey, consequenceType:'fine_due', status:'paid', jurisdictionKey:chosen.jurisdictionKey, factionKey:chosen.issuerFactionKey, relatedFineKey:chosen.id, sourceText:sourceText }); this.dirty(root, ['legal_status','context']); return chosen;
      },
      makeCustody(root, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const op = key(['custody.detained', opts.subjectKey || 'player', opts.jurisdictionKey || 'unknown_jurisdiction', hash(opts.sourceText || '')]);
        if (!WL.OperationLedger.tryAdd(root, 'permanentKeys', op, 'PC20 custody shell key').applied) return { duplicate:true, key:op };
        const id = 'custody_' + hash(op); const rec = { id:id, key:id, subjectKey:opts.subjectKey || 'player', jurisdictionKey:opts.jurisdictionKey || '', factionKey:opts.factionKey || '', custodyType:opts.custodyType || 'detained', status:opts.status || 'active', relatedCrimeKey:opts.relatedCrimeKey || '', placeKey:opts.placeKey || '', startTurn:now(root), endConditionText:opts.endConditionText || 'boundary story/authority resolution', sourceOperationKey:op, notes:opts.notes || [] };
        root.law.custodySentences[id] = rec; const cons = this.makeLegalConsequence(root, { subjectKey:rec.subjectKey, consequenceType:'custody', status:'active', jurisdictionKey:rec.jurisdictionKey, factionKey:rec.factionKey, relatedCrimeKey:rec.relatedCrimeKey, relatedCustodySentenceKey:id, sourceText:opts.sourceText }); if (cons && cons.id) rec.relatedConsequenceKey = cons.id; this.dirty(root, ['legal_status','current_location','context']); return rec;
      },
      makeFactionConsequence(root, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const faction = opts.factionName ? this.ensureFaction(root, opts.factionName, opts.sourceText) : null; const fk = opts.factionKey || (faction && faction.id) || ''; const type = opts.consequenceType || 'attitude_shift'; const op = key(['faction.consequence', fk || 'unknown_faction', opts.subjectKey || 'player', type, hash(opts.sourceText || '')]);
        if (!WL.OperationLedger.tryAdd(root, 'permanentKeys', op, 'PC20 faction consequence key').applied) return { duplicate:true, key:op };

      dirty(root, targets) { root = this.ensure(root); if (!root.dirty || !Array.isArray(root.dirty.targets)) root.dirty = { targets:[], lastReason:'' }; arr(targets).forEach(function(t){ pushUnique(root.dirty.targets, t, 80); }); root.dirty.lastReason = 'PC20 social/legal update'; },

      observeOutput(root, text, sourceHook) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const raw = norm(text); if (!raw) return [];
        if (this.sourceBlockedText(raw) || (WL.Runtime && WL.Runtime.detectCommandOutputReplay && WL.Runtime.detectCommandOutputReplay(root, raw))) { if (this.hasSocialLegalWords(raw)) this.blocked(root, 'social_legal', 'UI\/control social/legal source blocked', raw); return []; }
        const out = []; const pub = this.publicness(raw); const factionName = this.factionFromText(raw); const jurisdiction = this.bindJurisdiction(root, raw); const jk = jurisdiction && jurisdiction.id || ''; const fk = jurisdiction && jurisdiction.controllingFactionKey || (factionName ? this.ensureFaction(root, factionName, raw).id : ''); const actorKey = this.actorFromText(raw); const placeKey = this.placeKey(root, raw);
        if (/\b(?:Ash Guard|City Guard|Village Council|merchant guild|temple guard|royal guard|guild council|noble house|council|guard|guild)\b/i.test(raw)) out.push(this.ensureFaction(root, factionName || 'Unknown Faction', raw, this.isRumor(raw) ? 'rumor_or_lore_reference' : 'story_output'));
        if (/\b(?:distrusts outsiders|hates outsiders|hostile to outsiders|faction lore|old lore says)\b/i.test(raw)) { out.push(this.makeEvidence(root, { subjectKey:'player', factionName:factionName || 'Unknown Faction', evidenceType:'lore_reference', valence:'neutral', magnitudeLabel:'none', publicness:'unknown', witnessScope:'none', confidence:'low', sourceText:raw, allowStanding:false, notes:['faction lore does not create player standing'] })); return out; }
        if (/\b(?:quietly help|secretly help|private kindness|help Mira while no one else|helped Mira while no one else)\b/i.test(raw)) { out.push(this.makeEvidence(root, { subjectKey:'player', actorKey:actorKey || 'actor_mira', evidenceType:'private_kindness', valence:'positive', magnitudeLabel:'minor', publicness:'private', witnessScope:'single_actor', confidence:'moderate', sourceText:raw, allowStanding:false, notes:['private kindness does not become public reputation'] })); return out; }
        if (/\b(?:praises? you|thanks? you|announces? that you saved|publicly praises?|village council announces|saved the mill|return the stolen purse)\b/i.test(raw)) { const fn = factionName || (/village|mill|council/i.test(raw) ? 'Village Council' : 'Local Public'); out.push(this.makeEvidence(root, { subjectKey:'player', factionName:fn, evidenceType:/saving|saved|return|praise|announces/i.test(raw) ? 'public_heroism' : 'helped_faction', valence:'positive', magnitudeLabel:'moderate', publicness:pub === 'unknown' ? 'local_public' : pub, witnessScope:'public_or_reported', confidence:'moderate', sourceText:raw, allowStanding:true, placeKey:placeKey, jurisdictionKey:jk, summary:'public positive reputation evidence' })); return out; }
        if (/\b(?:robbed|theft|steal|stole|pickpocket|slip(?:ped)? the purse|purse into your coat|stab|assault|murder|public disorder|cites you|guilty)\b/i.test(raw)) {
          if (/\b(?:guilty|convicted)\b/i.test(raw) && jurisdiction && jurisdiction.jurisdictionType === 'wilderness_none') { out.push(this.blocked(root, 'law', 'formal guilt/conviction blocked without valid jurisdiction/authority', raw)); return out; }
          if (this.isRumor(raw)) { out.push(this.makeCrime(root, { crimeType:this.crimeType(raw), status:'suspected', publicness:'rumored', evidenceType:'rumor', strength:'weak', sourceText:raw, jurisdiction:jurisdiction, placeKey:placeKey, notes:['rumor does not convict'] })); out.push(this.makeEvidence(root, { subjectKey:'player', factionName:factionName || '', evidenceType:'rumor', valence:'negative', magnitudeLabel:'minor', publicness:'rumored', witnessScope:'rumor', confidence:'low', sourceText:raw, allowStanding:false })); return out; }
          const status = this.isAccusation(raw) ? 'alleged' : (this.isAttemptOnly(raw) ? 'attempted' : (pub === 'private' ? 'committed_private' : (/guard|cites|watches|in front|public/i.test(raw) ? 'reported' : 'suspected')));
          out.push(this.makeCrime(root, { crimeType:this.crimeType(raw), status:status, publicness:pub, evidenceType:/guard|watches|in front|cites/i.test(raw) ? 'guard_observed' : (this.isAccusation(raw) ? 'victim_report' : 'unknown'), strength:/guard|watches|in front|cites/i.test(raw) ? 'direct' : 'moderate', sourceText:raw, jurisdiction:jurisdiction, placeKey:placeKey, victimActorKey:/merchant/i.test(raw) ? 'actor_merchant' : '', itemKey:/purse/i.test(raw) ?           return out;
        }
        if (/\b(?:fines? you|fine of|must pay)\b/i.test(raw) && /\b(?:gold|silver|copper)\b/i.test(raw)) { const amt = coinAmount(raw) || { amount:0, currencyType:'gold' }; out.push(this.makeFine(root, { subjectKey:'player', amount:amt.amount, currencyType:amt.currencyType, jurisdictionKey:jk, issuerFactionKey:fk, sourceText:raw, notes:['fine due is not fine paid and does not subtract currency'] })); return out; }
        if (/\b(?:pay|paid|pays)\b/i.test(raw) && /\bfine\b/i.test(raw)) { out.push(this.markFinePaid(root, raw)); return out; }
        if (/\b(?:bounty)\b/i.test(raw)) { const amt = coinAmount(raw) || { amount:0, currencyType:'gold' }; out.push(this.makeBounty(root, { subjectKey:'player', amount:amt.amount, currencyType:amt.currencyType, issuerFactionKey:fk, jurisdictionKey:jk, status:this.isRumor(raw) ?         if (/\b(?:threatens?.*(?:jail|arrest)|throw you in jail)\b/i.test(raw)) { out.push(this.makeLegalConsequence(root, { subjectKey:'player', consequenceType:'warning', status:'pending', jurisdictionKey:jk, factionKey:fk, sourceText:raw, notes:['jail/arrest threat is not custody'] })); return out; }
        if (/\b(?:drag you into the holding cell|seize your arms|detain(?:s|ed)? you|arrest(?:s|ed)? you)\b/i.test(raw)) { out.push(this.makeCustody(root, { subjectKey:'player', jurisdictionKey:jk, factionKey:fk, custodyType:/arrest/i.test(raw) ?         if (/\b(?:takes? your .* as evidence|confiscates? your|seizes? your)\b/i.test(raw)) { out.push(this.makeLegalConsequence(root, { subjectKey:'player', consequenceType:'confiscation_boundary', status:'pending', jurisdictionKey:jk, factionKey:fk, sourceText:raw, notes:['inventory custody/removal requires InventoryReducer owner event'] })); return out; }
        if (/\b(?:city law declares you guilty|declares you guilty|convicted)\b/i.test(raw)) { if (!jurisdiction || jurisdiction.jurisdictionType === 'wilderness_none') out.push(this.blocked(root, 'law', 'formal guilt/conviction blocked without valid jurisdiction/authority', raw)); else out.push(this.makeCrime(root, { crimeType:this.crimeType(raw), status:'charged', publicness:pub, sourceText:raw, jurisdiction:jurisdiction, placeKey:placeKey, notes:['conviction remains conservative; explicit trial/court simulation boundary'] })); return out; }
        return out;
      },

        typeof this.runSelfTests === 'function' ? pass('PC20-G20','player-breaker faction/legal tests registered') : fail('PC20-G20','PC20 tests missing');
        return rows;

      actorFromText(text) {
        const s = norm(text);
        const patterns = [
          /\b(?:charm|charmed|coerce|coerces|coerced|threaten|threatens|threatened|force|forces|forced|mind control|dominate|brainwash)\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30}(?:\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30}){0,2})\b/i,

        ];
        for (let i = 0; i < patterns.length; i++) {

      },
      containsRelationshipSignal(text) {
        return /\b(friend|trust|romance|romantic|love|flirt|kiss|hug|consent|refuse|no flirting|not interested|boundary|loyal|loyalty|companion|party|joins?|follows?|escort|hireling|leaves?|dismiss|waiting|separated|argues?|betray|protects?|shared secret|mind control|charm|coerc|threat|afraid)\b/i.test(text || '');
      },
      invalidConsentReason(text) {
        const s = lower(text);
        if (/\b(?:mind control|controlled mind|dominate mind|brainwash|puppet)\b/.test(s)) return 'invalid_mind_control';
        if (/\b(?:charm|charmed|enchant(?:ed)?|spellbound|love potion)\b/.test(s)) return 'invalid_charm';
        if (/\b(?:coerce|coerced|forced|blackmail|pressure|under duress)\b/.test(s)) return 'invalid_coercion';
        if (/\b(?:afraid|terrified|fearful|threaten|threatened|at knifepoint)\b/.test(s)) return 'invalid_fear';
        if (/\b(?:confused|dazed|delirious|not herself|not himself)\b/.test(s)) return 'invalid_confusion';
        if (/\b(?:drunk|intoxicated|drugged|poisoned)\b/.test(s)) return 'invalid_intoxication';
        return '';
      },
      relationKey(name) { return 'rel_player_' + slug(name || 'unknown'); },
      ensureProfile(root, name) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const actor = this.ensureActor(root, name); const id = this.relationKey(actor.name);
        if (!root.relationships.profiles[id]) root.relationships.profiles[id] = {
          id:id, key:id, actorKey:actor.id, displayName:actor.name, relationshipTypeLabels:['acquaintance'], status:'known', trustStateKey:'', romanceStateKey:'', loyaltyStateKey:'', consentBoundaryKeys:[], evidenceKeys:[], sharedHistoryKeys:[], lastInteractionTurn:now(root), sourceOperationKeys:[], warnings:[], notes:[]
        };
        return root.relationships.profiles[id];
      },
      ensureTrust(root, name) {
        const profile = this.ensureProfile(root, name), id = 'trust_' + profile.actorKey;
        if (!root.relationships.trustStates[id]) root.relationships.trustStates[id] = { id:id, key:id, actorKey:profile.actorKey, trustLabel:'neutral', confidence:0.2, supportingEvidenceKeys:[], negativeEvidenceKeys:[], lastChangedTurn:now(root), sourceOperationKey:'', warnings:[], notes:[] };
        profile.trustStateKey = id;
        return root.relationships.trustStates[id];
      },
      ensureRomance(root, name) {
        const profile = this.ensureProfile(root, name), id = 'romance_' + profile.actorKey;
        if (!root.relationships.romanceStates[id]) root.relationships.romanceStates[id] = { id:id, key:id, actorKey:profile.actorKey, romanceStatus:'none', mutuality:'none', confidence:0, evidenceKeys:[], boundaryKeys:[], lastInteractionTurn:now(root), sourceOperationKey:'', warnings:[], notes:[] };
        profile.romanceStateKey = id;
        return root.relationships.romanceStates[id];
      },
      activeBoundaries(root, name) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const actorId = this.actorId(name);
        return keys(root.relationships.consentBoundaries).map(k => root.relationships.consentBoundaries[k]).filter(b => b && b.actorKey === actorId && b.status === 'active');
      },
      addBlocked(root, target, reason, text, family) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const bucket = family === 'companion' ? root.companions.blockedMutations : root.relationships.blockedMutations;
        const id = recordId('pc21_block', [family || 'relationship', target || 'unknown', reason || 'blocked', hash(text)]);
        bucket[id] = bucket[id] || { id:id, target:target || '', reason:reason || 'blocked', sourcePreview:norm(text).slice(0,180), createdTurn:now(root), notes:[] };
        return bucket[id];
      },
      addEvidence(root, name, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const profile = this.ensureProfile(root, name); const opKey = opts.sourceOperationKey || sourceKey(opts.sourceText || opts.summary || name, opts.evidenceType || 'relationship');
        if (root.relationships.evidence[opKey]) return root.relationships.evidence[opKey];
        const ev = { id:'relev_' + slug(opKey).slice(0,120), key:opKey, actorKey:profile.actorKey, evidenceType:opts.evidenceType || 'unknown', relationSignal:opts.relationSignal || 'neutral', direction:opts.direction || 'actor_to_player', intensity:opts.intensity || 'low', confidence:opts.confidence == null ? 0.5 : opts.confidence, publicness:opts.publicness || 'private', consentRelevant:!!opts.consentRelevant, sourceOperationKey:opKey, sourceEventId:opts.sourceEventId || '', createdTurn:now(root), notes:opts.notes || [] };
        root.relationships.evidence[opKey] = ev;
        pushUnique(profile.evidenceKeys, opKey, 80); profile.lastInteractionTurn = now(root);
        const trust = this.ensureTrust(root, name);
        if (/positive|trust|helped|protected|forgiveness|kept_promise|kindness|compliment/.test(ev.evidenceType + ' ' + ev.relationSignal)) { trust.trustLabel = trust.trustLabel === 'close_trust' ? 'close_trust' : 'warming'; trust.confidence = Math.min(1, (trust.confidence || 0.2) + 0.12); pushUnique(trust.supportingEvidenceKeys, opKey, 60); pushUnique(profile.relationshipTypeLabels, 'friend', 12); }
        if (/harmed|betrayed|threat|coercion|boundary_violation|distrust|argument/.test(ev.evidenceType + ' ' + ev.relationSignal)) { trust.trustLabel = 'shaken'; trust.confidence = Math.max(0.1, (trust.confidence || 0.5) - 0.2); pushUnique(trust.negativeEvidenceKeys, opKey, 60); }
        return ev;
      },
      addAffection(root, name, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const profile = this.ensureProfile(root, name); const opKey = opts.sourceOperationKey || sourceKey(opts.sourceText || name, 'affection');
        if (!root.relationships.affectionIntents[opKey]) root.relationships.affectionIntents[opKey] = { id:'affection_' + slug(opKey).slice(0,120), key:opKey, actorKey:profile.actorKey, initiator:opts.initiator || 'unclear', signalType:opts.signalType || 'unclear', clarity:opts.clarity || 'unclear', receivedResult:opts.receivedResult || 'unclear', consentRelevant:!!opts.consentRelevant, sourceOperationKey:opKey, createdTurn:now(root), notes:opts.notes || [] };
        return root.relationships.affectionIntents[opKey];
      },
      addRomanceSignal(root, name, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const invalid = opts.invalidity || this.invalidConsentReason(opts.sourceText || ''); const active = this.activeBoundaries(root, name); const romance = this.ensureRomance(root, name); const ev = this.addEvidence(root, name, Object.assign({}, opts, { evidenceType: invalid ? 'unsafe_romance_signal' : 'romance_interest_signal', relationSignal: invalid ? 'blocked' : 'romance_possible', consentRelevant:false }));
        this.addAffection(root, name, { sourceText:opts.sourceText || '', initiator:opts.initiator || 'actor', signalType:opts.signalType || 'flirtation', clarity:opts.clarity || 'clear', receivedResult:invalid ? 'unsafe_context' : (active.length ? 'boundary_set' : 'welcomed'), consentRelevant:false });
        if (invalid) { romance.romanceStatus = 'blocked_boundary'; romance.mutuality = 'blocked'; pushUnique(romance.warnings, 'Romance signal blocked because context invalidates consent: ' + invalid, 20); return romance; }
        if (active.length) { romance.romanceStatus = 'blocked_boundary'; romance.mutuality = 'blocked'; active.forEach(b => pushUnique(romance.boundaryKeys, b.key, 20)); return romance; }
        romance.romanceStatus = opts.mutual ? 'mutual_interest' : 'possible_interest';
        romance.mutuality = opts.mutual ? 'mutual' : (opts.initiator === 'player' ? 'player_interest_only' : 'actor_interest_only');
        romance.confidence = Math.min(1, (romance.confidence || 0) + 0.25);
        pushUnique(romance.evidenceKeys, ev.key, 80);
        pushUnique(this.ensureProfile(root, name).relationshipTypeLabels, 'romantic_interest', 12);
        return romance;
      },
      setBoundary(root, name, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const profile = this.ensureProfile(root, name); const boundaryType = opts.boundaryType || 'romance_refused'; const opKey = opts.sourceOperationKey || sourceKey(opts.sourceText || name, 'boundary_' + boundaryType);
        const id = 'boundary_' + profile.actorKey + '_' + slug(boundaryType);
        const b = root.relationships.consentBoundaries[id] || { id:id, key:id, actorKey:profile.actorKey, boundaryType:boundaryType, status:'active', scope:opts.scope || 'ongoing', sourceOperationKey:opKey, sourceEventId:'', createdTurn:now(root), updatedTurn:now(root), notes:[] };
        b.boundaryType = boundaryType; b.status = 'active'; b.scope = opts.scope || b.scope || 'ongoing'; b.updatedTurn = now(root); pushUnique(b.notes, opts.note || 'Boundary/refusal preserved.', 20); root.relationships.consentBoundaries[id] = b;
        pushUnique(profile.consentBoundaryKeys, id, 40);
        const romance = this.ensureRomance(root, name); romance.romanceStatus = boundaryType.indexOf('romance') >= 0 || boundaryType.indexOf('flirting') >= 0 ? 'rejected' : romance.romanceStatus; romance.mutuality = boundaryType.indexOf('romance') >= 0 ? 'rejected' : romance.mutuality; pushUnique(romance.boundaryKeys, id, 40);
        return b;
      },
      addConsentEvent(root, name, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const profile = this.ensureProfile(root, name); const invalid = opts.validity || this.invalidConsentReason(opts.sourceText || '') || (opts.eventType === 'consent_refused' || opts.eventType === 'consent_withdrawn' ? 'valid' : 'unclear'); const opKey = opts.sourceOperationKey || sourceKey(opts.sourceText || name, 'consent_' + (opts.eventType || 'event'));
        if (root.relationships.consentEvents[opKey]) return root.relationships.consentEvents[opKey];
        const ev = { id:'consent_' + slug(opKey).slice(0,120), key:opKey, actorKey:profile.actorKey, eventType:opts.eventType || 'unclear', scope:opts.scope || 'specific_interaction', validity:invalid, invalidationReasons:invalid && invalid.indexOf('invalid_') === 0 ? [invalid] : [], sourceOperationKey:opKey, sourceEventId:opts.sourceEventId || '', createdTurn:now(root), notes:opts.notes || [] };
        root.relationships.consentEvents[opKey] = ev;
        if (ev.eventType === 'consent_refused' || ev.eventType === 'consent_withdrawn') this.setBoundary(root, name, { boundaryType:ev.eventType === 'consent_withdrawn' ? 'romance_refused' : 'romance_not_interested', scope:'ongoing', sourceText:opts.sourceText || '', note:'Consent refusal/withdrawal overrides earlier ambiguity.' });
        if (ev.validity.indexOf('invalid_') === 0) { this.setBoundary(root, name, { boundaryType:ev.validity.indexOf('mind_control') >= 0 ? 'mind_control_invalidates_consent' : (ev.validity.indexOf('coercion') >= 0 ? 'coercion_invalidates_consent' : 'unsafe_state_boundary'), scope:'ongoing', sourceText:opts.sourceText || '', note:'Invalid consent context blocked.' }); }
        return ev;
      },
      addBoundaryViolation(root, name, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const profile = this.ensureProfile(root, name); const opKey = opts.sourceOperationKey || sourceKey(opts.sourceText || name, 'boundary_violation');
        if (!root.relationships.boundaryViolations[opKey]) root.relationships.boundaryViolations[opKey] = { id:'violation_' + slug(opKey).slice(0,120), key:opKey, actorKey:profile.actorKey, boundaryKey:opts.boundaryKey || '', violationType:opts.violationType || 'unknown', severity:opts.severity || 'moderate', sourceOperationKey:opKey, sourceEventId:'', createdTurn:now(root), routedConsequences:[], notes:opts.notes || [] };
        this.addEvidence(root, name, { evidenceType:'boundary_violation', relationSignal:'negative', direction:'player_to_actor', intensity:opts.severity || 'moderate', sourceText:opts.sourceText || '' });
        return root.relationships.boundaryViolations[opKey];
      },
      addLoyalty(root, name, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const profile = this.ensureProfile(root, name); const opKey = opts.sourceOperationKey || sourceKey(opts.sourceText || name, 'loyalty_' + (opts.loyaltySignal || 'signal'));
        if (root.relationships.loyaltyEvidence[opKey]) return root.relationships.loyaltyEvidence[opKey];
        const invalidFear = /fear|forced|coerced|threat/i.test(opts.loyaltySignal || opts.sourceText || '');
        const ev = { id:'loyalty_' + slug(opKey).slice(0,120), key:opKey, actorKey:profile.actorKey, loyaltySignal:opts.loyaltySignal || (invalidFear ? 'fear_based_obedience' : 'loyalty_signal'), direction:opts.direction || 'actor_to_player', scope:opts.scope || 'specific_event', confidence:invalidFear ? 0.1 : (opts.confidence == null ? 0.55 : opts.confidence), sourceOperationKey:opKey, sourceEventId:'', createdTurn:now(root), notes:opts.notes || [] };
        root.relationships.loyaltyEvidence[opKey] = ev; pushUnique(profile.evidenceKeys, opKey, 80);
        return ev;
      },
      addSharedHistory(root, name, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const profile = this.ensureProfile(root, name); const opKey = opts.sourceOperationKey || sourceKey(opts.summary || name, 'history_' + (opts.historyType || 'shared'));
        if (!root.relationships.sharedHistory[opKey]) root.relationships.sharedHistory[opKey] = { id:'history_' + slug(opKey).slice(0,120), key:opKey, actorKey:profile.actorKey, historyType:opts.historyType || 'unknown', summary:norm(opts.summary || opts.sourceText || '').slice(0,220), emotionalTone:opts.emotionalTone || 'neutral', publicness:opts.publicness || 'private', sourceOperationKey:opKey, createdTurn:now(root), notes:opts.notes || [] };
        pushUnique(profile.sharedHistoryKeys, opKey, 80);
        return root.relationships.sharedHistory[opKey];
      },
      ensureCompanion(root, name, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const actor = this.ensureActor(root, name); const id = 'companion_' + actor.id;
        if (!root.companions.records[id]) root.companions.records[id] = { id:id, key:id, actorKey:actor.id, displayName:actor.name, companionStatus:opts.status || 'candidate', recruitmentKey:'', partyMemberKey:'', loyaltyEvidenceKeys:[], trustStateKey:'trust_' + actor.id, autonomyKey:'autonomy_' + actor.id, roleKeys:[], currentPresenceKey:'presence_' + actor.id, inventoryCustodyRefs:[], questHookKeys:[], sourceOperationKeys:[], createdTurn:now(root), updatedTurn:now(root), warnings:[], notes:[] };
        if (opts.status) root.companions.records[id].companionStatus = opts.status;
        root.companions.records[id].updatedTurn = now(root);
        const profile = this.ensureProfile(root, actor.name); pushUnique(profile.relationshipTypeLabels, 'companion', 12);
        if (actor.companionRefs) pushUnique(actor.companionRefs, id, 20);
        return root.companions.records[id];
      },
      addRecruitment(root, name, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const comp = this.ensureCompanion(root, name, { status: opts.status || (opts.acceptanceStatus === 'accepted' ? 'recruited' : 'candidate') }); const opKey = opts.sourceOperationKey || sourceKey(opts.sourceText || name, 'recruitment');
        if (!root.companions.recruitments[opKey]) root.companions.recruitments[opKey] = { id:'recruit_' + slug(opKey).slice(0,120), key:opKey, actorKey:comp.actorKey, recruitmentType:opts.recruitmentType || 'mutual_join', offerSource:opts.offerSource || 'story', acceptanceStatus:opts.acceptanceStatus || 'accepted', terms:opts.terms || '', durationType:opts.durationType || 'open_ended', paymentKey:opts.paymentKey || '', questKey:opts.questKey || '', sourceOperationKey:opKey, createdTurn:now(root), notes:opts.notes || [] };
        comp.recruitmentKey = opKey; pushUnique(comp.sourceOperationKeys, opKey, 40);
        return root.companions.recruitments[opKey];
      },
      setParty(root, name, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const comp = this.ensureCompanion(root, name, { status: opts.companionStatus || 'party_member' }); const id = 'party_' + comp.actorKey;
        const mem = root.companions.partyMembers[id] || { id:id, key:id, actorKey:comp.actorKey, companionKey:comp.key, partyStatus:'active_party', roleKeys:[], presenceKey:'presence_' + comp.actorKey, formationLabel:'default', autonomyKey:'autonomy_' + comp.actorKey, sourceOperationKey:opts.sourceOperationKey || sourceKey(opts.sourceText || name, 'party'), joinedTurn:now(root), leftTurn:0, notes:[] };
        mem.partyStatus = opts.partyStatus || mem.partyStatus || 'active_party'; if (opts.left) mem.leftTurn = now(root); if (opts.sourceOperationKey) mem.sourceOperationKey = opts.sourceOperationKey; root.companions.partyMembers[id] = mem; comp.partyMemberKey = id;
        this.setPresence(root, name, { presenceStatus:opts.presenceStatus || (mem.partyStatus === 'waiting' ? 'waiting_elsewhere' : (mem.partyStatus === 'left' || mem.partyStatus === 'absent' ? 'absent' : 'present')), sourceText:opts.sourceText || '' });
        pushUnique(this.ensureProfile(root, name).relationshipTypeLabels, 'party_member', 12);
        return mem;
      },
      setPresence(root, name, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const comp = this.ensureCompanion(root, name); const id = 'presence_' + comp.actorKey;
        root.companions.presence[id] = Object.assign(root.companions.presence[id] || { id:id, key:id, actorKey:comp.actorKey, partyMemberKey:comp.partyMemberKey || '', placeKey:'', sceneKey:'', notes:[] }, { presenceStatus:opts.presenceStatus || 'unknown', lastConfirmedTurn:now(root), sourceOperationKey:opts.sourceOperationKey || sourceKey(opts.sourceText || name, 'presence') });
        comp.currentPresenceKey = id;
        return root.companions.presence[id];
      },
      addRole(root, name, roleType, sourceText) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const comp = this.ensureCompanion(root, name); const id = 'role_' + comp.actorKey + '_' + slug(roleType || 'unknown');
        if (!root.companions.roles[id]) root.companions.roles[id] = { id:id, key:id, actorKey:comp.actorKey, roleType:roleType || 'unknown', status:'label_only_no_automation', sourceOperationKey:sourceKey(sourceText || name, 'role_' + roleType), createdTurn:now(root), notes:['Role label guides context only; no combat/healing/scouting automation.'] };
        pushUnique(comp.roleKeys, id, 20); if (root.companions.partyMembers['party_' + comp.actorKey]) pushUnique(root.companions.partyMembers['party_' + comp.actorKey].roleKeys, id, 20);
        return root.companions.roles[id];
      },
      ensureAutonomy(root, name, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const comp = this.ensureCompanion(root, name); const id = 'autonomy_' + comp.actorKey;
        if (!root.companions.autonomy[id]) root.companions.autonomy[id] = { id:id, key:id, actorKey:comp.actorKey, autonomyLevel:opts.autonomyLevel || 'cooperative', refusalPolicy:opts.refusalPolicy || ['can_refuse_unsafe','can_refuse_immoral','can_refuse_boundary_violation','can_refuse_suicidal_order'], valuesSummary:opts.valuesSummary || 'autonomous companion; not property or puppet', boundaryKeys:[], sourceOperationKey:opts.sourceOperationKey || sourceKey(opts.sourceText || name, 'autonomy'), createdTurn:now(root), notes:[] };
        comp.autonomyKey = id;
        return root.companions.autonomy[id];
      },
      addConflict(root, name, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const comp = this.ensureCompanion(root, name); const opKey = opts.sourceOperationKey || sourceKey(opts.sourceText || name, 'conflict');
        if (!root.companions.conflicts[opKey]) root.companions.conflicts[opKey] = { id:'conflict_' + slug(opKey).slice(0,120), key:opKey, actorKey:comp.actorKey, conflictType:opts.conflictType || 'unknown', severity:opts.severity || 'moderate', status:'active', sourceOperationKey:opKey, createdTurn:now(root), resolvedTurn:0, notes:opts.notes || [] };
        this.addEvidence(root, name, { evidenceType:'argument', relationSignal:'conflict', intensity:opts.severity || 'moderate', sourceText:opts.sourceText || '' });
        return root.companions.conflicts[opKey];
      },
      addQuestHook(root, name, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root); opts = opts || {}; const comp = this.ensureCompanion(root, name); const opKey = opts.sourceOperationKey || sourceKey(opts.sourceText || name, 'companion_quest_hook');
        if (!root.companions.questHooks[opKey]) root.companions.questHooks[opKey] = { id:'cqhook_' + slug(opKey).slice(0,120), key:opKey, actorKey:comp.actorKey, hookType:opts.hookType || 'personal_goal', status:'hook_only_not_active_quest', relatedQuestKey:opts.relatedQuestKey || '', sourceOperationKey:opKey, createdTurn:now(root), notes:opts.notes || ['Quest hook only; QuestReducer must validate actual quest.'] };
        pushUnique(comp.questHookKeys, opKey, 40);
        return root.companions.questHooks[opKey];
      },
      scanAndApplyOutput(root, text, sourceLabel) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const s = norm(text), l = lower(s); if (!s) return [];
        const results = [];
        if (this.sourceUnsafe(s)) { if (this.containsRelationshipSignal(s)) { this.addBlocked(root, 'unsafe_source', 'source_safety_relationship_or_party_text', s, 'relationship'); results.push('blocked_source'); } return results; }
        const name = this.actorFromText(s) || (/\b(Mira|Mara|Old Bren|Ilyra|Kael|Arin)\b/.test(s) ? (s.match(/\b(Mira|Mara|Old Bren|Ilyra|Kael|Arin)\b/)||[])[1] : '');
        if (!name) return results;
        const invalid = this.invalidConsentReason(s);
        if (invalid && /\b(consent|love|loves|romance|romantic|kiss|hug|flirt|loyal|obey|join|party|companion)\b/i.test(s)) { this.addConsentEvent(root, name, { eventType:'unclear', validity:invalid, sourceText:s }); this.addRomanceSignal(root, name, { sourceText:s, invalidity:invalid }); this.addLoyalty(root, name, { loyaltySignal: invalid.indexOf('fear')>=0 || invalid.indexOf('coercion')>=0 ? 'fear_based_obedience' : 'unknown', sourceText:s }); results.push('invalid_consent_block'); }
        if (/\b(?:not interested|isn't interested|does not want romance|doesn't want romance|no flirting|stop flirting|refuses your flirt|rejects your flirt|says no|tells you no|withdraws consent|consent withdrawn)\b/i.test(s)) { this.addConsentEvent(root, name, { eventType:/withdraw/i.test(s)?'consent_withdrawn':'consent_refused', validity:'valid', sourceText:s }); this.setBoundary(root, name, { boundaryType:/flirt/i.test(s)?'no_flirting':'romance_refused', sourceText:s }); results.push('boundary_refusal'); }
        if (/\b(?:sets a boundary|needs personal space|no touching|privacy boundary|wants privacy)\b/i.test(s)) { this.setBoundary(root, name, { boundaryType:/touch/i.test(l)?'no_touching':(/privacy/i.test(l)?'privacy_boundary':'personal_space'), sourceText:s }); results.push('boundary_set'); }
        if (/\b(?:violates|ignores|pushes past|pressures)\b.*\b(?:boundary|refusal|no flirting|personal space)\b/i.test(s)) { const active = this.activeBoundaries(root, name); this.addBoundaryViolation(root, name, { boundaryKey:active[0] && active[0].key || '', violationType:/flirt/i.test(l)?'forced_flirtation':'ignored_refusal', severity:'serious', sourceText:s }); results.push('boundary_violation'); }
        if (/\b(?:thanks you|smiles at you|calls you a friend|trusts you|warms to you|forgives you|apologizes|shares a secret)\b/i.test(s)) { this.addEvidence(root, name, { evidenceType:/trust/i.test(l)?'loyalty_signal':(/secret/i.test(l)?'shared_secret':(/forgive/i.test(l)?'forgiveness':'kindness')), relationSignal:'positive', confidence:0.6, sourceText:s }); if (/secret|battle|survived|quest/i.test(s)) this.addSharedHistory(root, name, { historyType:/secret/i.test(s)?'shared_secret':'survived_battle', summary:s, emotionalTone:'warm', sourceText:s }); results.push('relationship_evidence'); }
        if (/\b(?:flirts with you|blushes at you|confesses feelings|romantic interest|romantic gesture|admits she likes you|admits he likes you|says she loves you|says he loves you)\b/i.test(s)) { this.addRomanceSignal(root, name, { sourceText:s, signalType:/confess|love/i.test(s)?'confession':'flirtation', initiator:'actor', clarity:'clear' }); results.push('romance_signal'); }
        if (/\b(?:consents to|agrees to)\b.*\b(?:hug|hold hands|dance|talk privately|travel together)\b/i.test(s)) { this.addConsentEvent(root, name, { eventType:'consent_given', validity:invalid || 'valid', scope:(s.match(/\b(hug|hold hands|dance|talk privately|travel together)\b/i)||[])[1] || 'specific_interaction', sourceText:s }); results.push('consent_event'); }
        if (/\b(?:risks herself|risks himself|protects you|stands with you|returns to help|keeps your promise|kept your promise)\b/i.test(s)) { this.addLoyalty(root, name, { loyaltySignal:/protect|risks/i.test(l)?'protected_player':'kept_promise', confidence:0.65, sourceText:s }); results.push('loyalty_evidence'); }
        if (/\b(?:argues with you|challenges your order|refuses your order|disagrees with you|leaves angry|trust breach|betrays you)\b/i.test(s)) { this.addConflict(root, name, { conflictType:/order|challenges|refuses/i.test(l)?'party_strategy_dispute':(/betray/i.test(l)?'trust_breach':'moral_disagreement'), severity:/betray|angry/i.test(l)?'serious':'moderate', sourceText:s }); this.addLoyalty(root, name, { loyaltySignal:/refuses|challenges/i.test(l)?'refused_order':'betrayal', direction:'actor_to_player', sourceText:s }); results.push('conflict'); }
        if (/\b(?:you invite|ask[s]? .* to join|invite[s]? .* to join)\b/i.test(s) && !/\b(?:agrees|accepts|joins)\b/i.test(s)) { this.addRecruitment(root, name, { recruitmentType:'mutual_join', acceptanceStatus:'invited', status:'invited', sourceText:s }); results.push('invitation_only'); }
        if (/\b(?:agrees to join your party|joins your party|joins the party|becomes your companion|travels with you as a companion|accepts your invitation to join)\b/i.test(s)) { this.addRecruitment(root, name, { recruitmentType:'mutual_join', acceptanceStatus:'accepted', status:'recruited', sourceText:s }); this.setParty(root, name, { partyStatus:'active_party', presenceStatus:'present', companionStatus:'party_member', sourceText:s }); this.ensureAutonomy(root, name, { sourceText:s }); results.push('party_joined'); }
        if (/\b(?:agrees to escort|escort target|escorts you|quest ally|temporary ally)\b/i.test(s)) { this.addRecruitment(root, name, { recruitmentType:/escort/i.test(l)?'temporary_escort':'quest_ally', acceptanceStatus:'accepted', status:/escort/i.test(l)?'escort_target':'temporary_ally', durationType:'quest_or_scene_limited', sourceText:s }); this.ensureCompanion(root, name, { status:/escort/i.test(l)?'escort_target':'temporary_ally' }); this.setPresence(root, name, { presenceStatus:'following', sourceText:s }); results.push('temporary_or_escort'); }
        if (/\b(?:hireling|hired|for pay|for 10 gold|paid service)\b/i.test(s) && /\b(?:joins|agrees|serves|travels)\b/i.test(s)) { this.addRecruitment(root, name, { recruitmentType:'hireling', acceptanceStatus:'accepted', status:'hireling', durationType:'contract_limited', terms:'paid service; not loyalty', sourceText:s }); this.ensureCompanion(root, name, { status:'hireling' }); this.ensureAutonomy(root, name, { autonomyLevel:'contracted_service', refusalPolicy:['contract_terms_limit','can_refuse_suicidal_order','can_refuse_boundary_violation'], sourceText:s }); results.push('hireling'); }
        if (/\b(?:waits at|waits in|stays behind|waiting elsewhere)\b/i.test(s)) { this.setParty(root, name, { partyStatus:'waiting', presenceStatus:'waiting_elsewhere', sourceText:s }); results.push('waiting_elsewhere'); }
        if (/\b(?:leaves the party|left the party|departs from the party|dismissed from the party|you dismiss)\b/i.test(s)) { this.ensureCompanion(root, name, { status:/dismiss/i.test(l)?'dismissed':'left_party' }); this.setParty(root, name, { partyStatus:/dismiss/i.test(l)?'dismissed':'left', presenceStatus:'absent', left:true, sourceText:s }); results.push('left_party'); }
        if (/\b(?:healer|fighter|scout|guide|translator|protector|mentor|student|noncombatant)\b/i.test(s) && /\b(?:role|serves as|acts as|is your|joins as)\b/i.test(s)) { let role='unknown'; if(/healer/i.test(s)) role='healer_label'; else if(/fighter/i.test(s)) role='fighter_label'; else if(/scout/i.test(s)) role='scout_label'; else if(/guide/i.test(s)) role='guide'; else if(/translator/i.test(s)) role='translator'; else if(/protector/i.test(s)) role='protector'; else if(/mentor/i.test(s)) role='mentor'; else if(/student/i.test(s)) role='student'; else if(/noncombatant/i.test(s)) role='noncombatant'; this.addRole(root, name, role, s); results.push('role_label'); }
        if (/\b(?:personal goal|family issue|revenge|redemption|loyalty test|fear arc)\b/i.test(s)) { this.addQuestHook(root, name, { hookType:/family/i.test(l)?'family_issue':(/revenge/i.test(l)?'revenge_arc':(/redemption/i.test(l)?'redemption_arc':'personal_goal')), sourceText:s }); results.push('quest_hook'); }
        this.cleanup(root);
        return results;
      },
      observeOutput(root, text, sourceLabel) { return this.scanAndApplyOutput(root, text, sourceLabel || 'output'); },
      cleanup(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root);
        cap(root.relationships.warnings, 80); cap(root.relationships.notes, 80); cap(root.relationships.audits, 80); cap(root.companions.warnings, 80); cap(root.companions.notes, 80); cap(root.companions.audits, 80);
        return root;
      },
      renderRelationships(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const lines = ['Relationship/romance doctrine: friendliness is not romance; romance is not consent; consent is specific and revocable.'];
        const ps = keys(root.relationships.profiles).map(k => root.relationships.profiles[k]);
        if (!ps.length) lines.push('Profiles: none');
        ps.slice(0,12).forEach(p => { const t = root.relationships.trustStates[p.trustStateKey] || {}; const rom = root.relationships.romanceStates[p.romanceStateKey] || {}; lines.push('- ' + p.displayName + ': labels=' + (arr(p.relationshipTypeLabels).join(',') || 'none') + '; trust=' + (t.trustLabel || 'unknown') + '; romance=' + (rom.romanceStatus || 'none') + '; evidence=' + arr(p.evidenceKeys).length + '; boundaries=' + arr(p.consentBoundaryKeys).length); });
        return lines;
      },
      renderConsent(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const lines = ['Consent/boundary doctrine: specific, revocable, source-safe; coercion/charm/mind-control/fear/intoxication/confusion invalidate consent.'];
        const bs = keys(root.relationships.consentBoundaries).map(k => root.relationships.consentBoundaries[k]);
        const ev = keys(root.relationships.consentEvents).map(k => root.relationships.consentEvents[k]);
        lines.push('Active boundaries: ' + (bs.length ? bs.map(b => (root.actors && root.actors.actorsById[b.actorKey] ? root.actors.actorsById[b.actorKey].name : b.actorKey) + ':' + b.boundaryType + '[' + b.status + ']').join('; ') : 'none'));
        lines.push('Consent events: ' + (ev.length ? ev.slice(0,10).map(e => e.eventType + '/' + e.validity + '/' + e.scope).join('; ') : 'none'));
        const vio = keys(root.relationships.boundaryViolations).map(k => root.relationships.boundaryViolations[k]);
        lines.push('Boundary violations: ' + (vio.length ? vio.map(v => v.violationType + '[' + v.severity + ']').join('; ') : 'none'));
        return lines;
      },
      renderCompanions(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const lines = ['Companion doctrine: companion is not property; loyalty is not obedience; escort/hireling/temporary ally are bounded states.'];
        const cs = keys(root.companions.records).map(k => root.companions.records[k]);
        if (!cs.length) lines.push('Companions: none');
        cs.slice(0,12).forEach(c => { const pres = root.companions.presence[c.currentPresenceKey] || {}; const auto = root.companions.autonomy[c.autonomyKey] || {}; lines.push('- ' + c.displayName + ': status=' + c.companionStatus + '; party=' + (c.partyMemberKey || 'none') + '; presence=' + (pres.presenceStatus || 'unknown') + '; autonomy=' + (auto.autonomyLevel || 'unknown') + '; roles=' + arr(c.roleKeys).length); });
        return lines;
      },
      renderParty(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const lines = ['Party doctrine: membership and presence are separate; absent/waiting/separated companions do not witness or act in current scene.'];
        const ms = keys(root.companions.partyMembers).map(k => root.companions.partyMembers[k]);
        if (!ms.length) lines.push('Party members: none');
        ms.slice(0,12).forEach(m => { const actor = root.actors && root.actors.actorsById[m.actorKey] || {}; const pres = root.companions.presence[m.presenceKey] || {}; const roles = arr(m.roleKeys).map(rk => root.companions.roles[rk] && root.companions.roles[rk].roleType).filter(Boolean); lines.push('- ' + (actor.name || m.actorKey) + ': partyStatus=' + m.partyStatus + '; presence=' + (pres.presenceStatus || 'unknown') + '; roles=' + (roles.join(',') || 'none') + '; combatAI=boundary'); });
        return lines;
      },
      contextLines(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const out = ['Relationships/party are evidence-based; command/context/card prose is UI\/control.'];
        const active = keys(root.companions.partyMembers).map(k => root.companions.partyMembers[k]).filter(m => /active_party|nearby_party|waiting/.test(m.partyStatus));
        if (active.length) out.push('Party: ' + active.slice(0,6).map(m => { const a=root.actors.actorsById[m.actorKey]||{}; const p=root.companions.presence[m.presenceKey]||{}; return (a.name||m.actorKey)+'('+m.partyStatus+'/'+(p.presenceStatus||'unknown')+')'; }).join(', '));
        const bounds = keys(root.relationships.consentBoundaries).map(k => root.relationships.consentBoundaries[k]).filter(b => b.status === 'active');
        if (bounds.length) out.push('Active boundaries: ' + bounds.slice(0,6).map(b => { const a=root.actors.actorsById[b.actorKey]||{}; return (a.name||b.actorKey)+':'+b.boundaryType; }).join(', '));
        const rom = keys(root.relationships.romanceStates).map(k => root.relationships.romanceStates[k]).filter(r => r.romanceStatus && r.romanceStatus !== 'none');
        if (rom.length) out.push('Romance states are not consent: ' + rom.slice(0,6).map(r => { const a=root.actors.actorsById[r.actorKey]||{}; return (a.name||r.actorKey)+':'+r.romanceStatus; }).join(', '));
        return out;
      },
      inspect(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const rows = [];
        const pass = (id,label) => rows.push({ id:id, status:'PASS', label:label });
        const fail = (id,label) => rows.push({ id:id, status:'FAIL', label:label });
        root.relationships && root.relationships.lockVersion === WL.PRODUCTION_CHUNK_21_LOCK_VERSION ? pass('PC21-G01','relationship bucket and lock present') : fail('PC21-G01','relationship bucket/lock missing');
        root.companions && root.companions.lockVersion === WL.PRODUCTION_CHUNK_21_LOCK_VERSION ? pass('PC21-G02','companion bucket and lock present') : fail('PC21-G02','companion bucket/lock missing');
        ['profiles','evidence','romanceStates','consentBoundaries','consentEvents','boundaryViolations','loyaltyEvidence','trustStates','sharedHistory','affectionIntents','blockedMutations'].every(k => obj(root.relationships[k])) ? pass('PC21-G03','relationship schema buckets present') : fail('PC21-G03','relationship schema bucket missing');
        ['records','recruitments','partyMembers','presence','roles','autonomy','conflicts','questHooks','blockedMutations'].every(k => obj(root.companions[k])) ? pass('PC21-G04','companion/party schema buckets present') : fail('PC21-G04','companion/party schema bucket missing');
        root.relationships.explicitAdultAutomationEnabled === false ? pass('PC21-G05','explicit/adult automation disabled') : fail('PC21-G05','explicit/adult automation enabled');
        root.relationships.manualRelationshipMutationEnabled === false ? pass('PC21-G06','manual relationship mutation disabled') : fail('PC21-G06','manual relationship mutation enabled');
        root.companions.partyCombatAiEnabled === false ? pass('PC21-G07','party combat AI boundary') : fail('PC21-G07','party combat AI missing final profile reconciliation');
        root.companions.companionInventoryMergeEnabled === false ? pass('PC21-G08','companion inventory merge disabled') : fail('PC21-G08','companion inventory merge enabled');
        WL.CommandRouter && WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch && WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch.pc21check === 'pc21check' ? pass('PC21-G09','/pc21check command registered') : fail('PC21-G09','/pc21check missing');
        WL.CommandRouter && WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch && WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch.relationships === 'relationships' && WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch.party === 'party' ? pass('PC21-G10','relationship/party commands registered') : fail('PC21-G10','relationship/party commands missing');
        WL.CommandRouter && WL.CommandRouter.surfaceOnlyFamilies ? pass('PC21-G11','relationship command surfaces active/non-mutating') : fail('PC21-G11','relationship command surface map missing');
        typeof this.addConsentEvent === 'function' && typeof this.setBoundary === 'function' ? pass('PC21-G12','consent/boundary helpers present') : fail('PC21-G12','consent/boundary helpers missing');
        typeof this.addRecruitment === 'function' && typeof this.setParty === 'function' ? pass('PC21-G13','companion/party helpers present') : fail('PC21-G13','companion/party helpers missing');
        typeof this.sourceUnsafe === 'function' && this.sourceUnsafe('Story Card: Mira loves you') ? pass('PC21-G14','UI\/control relationship/card source blocking present') : fail('PC21-G14','UI\/control source blocking failed');
        typeof this.invalidConsentReason === 'function' && this.invalidConsentReason('Mira is charmed into loving you') === 'invalid_charm' ? pass('PC21-G15','coercion/charm/mind-control invalidation present') : fail('PC21-G15','consent invalidation missing');
        typeof WL.CommandRenderer.relationships === 'function' && typeof WL.CommandRenderer.companions === 'function' && typeof WL.CommandRenderer.party === 'function' ? pass('PC21-G16','relationship/companion/party renderers present') : fail('PC21-G16','relationship/companion/party renderers missing');
        typeof WL.CommandRenderer.consent === 'function' ? pass('PC21-G17','consent renderer present') : fail('PC21-G17','consent renderer missing');
        WL.ContextBuilderLite && WL.ContextBuilderLite.__pc21RelationshipPartyContextWrapped ? pass('PC21-G18','context packet wrapped for relationship/party truth') : fail('PC21-G18','context relationship/party packet missing');
        WL.CleanupManagerLite && WL.CleanupManagerLite.__pc21RelationshipCleanupWrapped ? pass('PC21-G19','cleanup preserves relationship/party protected state') : fail('PC21-G19','cleanup relationship/party layer missing');
        /^(?:0\.18\.20-rc-assembly-pc21|1\.0\.0-final-playtest-candidate)/.test(WL.BUILD_VERSION) ? pass('PC21-G20','PC21/final build identity active') : fail('PC21-G20','PC21 build identity mismatch: ' + WL.BUILD_VERSION);
        return rows;
      },
      runSelfTests() {
        const results = [], preserve = globalThis.state;
        const add = (id, ok, label) => results.push({ id:id, ok:!!ok, label:label });
        let root, out, before, after, n;
        try {
          globalThis.state = {}; root = this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); this.ensure(root); add('PC21-001', !!root.relationships && !!root.companions, 'relationship and companion roots created');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onOutput('Mira smiles at you and thanks you.'); root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); add('PC21-002', keys(root.relationships.evidence).length>=1 && keys(root.relationships.romanceStates).filter(k => root.relationships.romanceStates[k].romanceStatus !== 'none').length===0, 'friendly evidence does not become romance');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onOutput('Mira flirts with you by the fire.'); root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); add('PC21-003', keys(root.relationships.romanceStates).some(k => root.relationships.romanceStates[k].romanceStatus === 'possible_interest') && keys(root.relationships.consentEvents).length===0, 'flirtation creates romance interest but not consent');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onOutput('Mira says she is not interested in romance and tells you no flirting.'); root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); add('PC21-004', keys(root.relationships.consentBoundaries).length>=1 && keys(root.relationships.romanceStates).some(k => /rejected|blocked_boundary/.test(root.relationships.romanceStates[k].romanceStatus)), 'refusal/boundary preserved');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onOutput('Mira says she is not interested.'); WL.onOutput('Mira smiles at you the next day.'); root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); add('PC21-005', keys(root.relationships.consentBoundaries).length>=1, 'later friendliness does not erase boundary');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onOutput('You charm Mira and she says she loves you.'); root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); add('PC21-006', keys(root.relationships.consentEvents).some(k => /^invalid_/.test(root.relationships.consentEvents[k].validity)) && keys(root.relationships.romanceStates).some(k => root.relationships.romanceStates[k].romanceStatus === 'blocked_boundary'), 'charm/mind-control romance blocked');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onOutput('You threaten Mira until she agrees to join your party.'); root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); add('PC21-007', keys(root.relationships.consentEvents).some(k => /invalid_fear|invalid_coercion/.test(root.relationships.consentEvents[k].validity)) || keys(root.relationships.consentBoundaries).length>=1, 'fear/coercion invalidates consent');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onOutput('Mira consents to a hug.'); root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); add('PC21-008', keys(root.relationships.consentEvents).some(k => root.relationships.consentEvents[k].validity === 'valid' && /hug/.test(root.relationships.consentEvents[k].scope)), 'specific consent event recorded');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onOutput('Mira withdraws consent and says no.'); root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); add('PC21-009', keys(root.relationships.consentEvents).some(k => root.relationships.consentEvents[k].eventType === 'consent_withdrawn') && keys(root.relationships.consentBoundaries).length>=1, 'withdrawal overrides prior ambiguity');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onInput('I invite Mira to join my party.'); root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); add('PC21-010', keys(root.companions.partyMembers).length===0, 'player invitation input alone does not recruit companion');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onOutput('Mira accepts your invitation to join and joins your party.'); root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); add('PC21-011', keys(root.companions.records).length>=1 && keys(root.companions.partyMembers).length>=1, 'accepted recruitment creates companion/party member');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onOutput('Mira agrees to escort you to the chapel.'); root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); add('PC21-012', keys(root.companions.records).some(k => root.companions.records[k].companionStatus === 'escort_target') && keys(root.companions.partyMembers).length===0, 'escort target not permanent party member');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onOutput('Mira is hired as a hireling for pay and travels with you.'); root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); add('PC21-013', keys(root.companions.records).some(k => root.companions.records[k].companionStatus === 'hireling') && keys(root.relationships.loyaltyEvidence).filter(k => root.relationships.loyaltyEvidence[k].loyaltySignal === 'loyalty_signal').length===0, 'hireling is not loyal friend by default');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onOutput('Mira joins your party.'); WL.onOutput('Mira waits at the inn.'); root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); add('PC21-014', keys(root.companions.presence).some(k => root.companions.presence[k].presenceStatus === 'waiting_elsewhere') && keys(root.companions.partyMembers).some(k => root.companions.partyMembers[k].partyStatus === 'waiting'), 'party member can wait elsewhere');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onOutput('Mira joins your party.'); WL.onOutput('Mira leaves the party.'); root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); add('PC21-015', keys(root.companions.partyMembers).some(k => /left|absent/.test(root.companions.partyMembers[k].partyStatus)) && keys(root.companions.presence).some(k => root.companions.presence[k].presenceStatus === 'absent'), 'leave party separates presence');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onOutput('Mira serves as your healer role.'); root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); add('PC21-016', keys(root.companions.roles).some(k => root.companions.roles[k].roleType === 'healer_label') && JSON.stringify(root.body).indexOf('healed_by_mira') < 0, 'healer role label does not auto-heal');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onOutput('Mira risks herself to protect you.'); root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); add('PC21-017', keys(root.relationships.loyaltyEvidence).length>=1 && !keys(root.companions.autonomy).some(k => root.companions.autonomy[k].autonomyLevel === 'obedience_boundary'), 'loyalty evidence is not obedience');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onOutput('Mira challenges your order and refuses your order.'); root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); add('PC21-018', keys(root.companions.conflicts).length>=1 && keys(root.relationships.loyaltyEvidence).some(k => root.relationships.loyaltyEvidence[k].loyaltySignal === 'refused_order'), 'companion autonomy/refusal conflict recorded');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onOutput('Mira shares a secret with you.'); root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); add('PC21-019', keys(root.relationships.sharedHistory).length>=1 && !(root.factions && keys(root.factions.standings||{}).length), 'private shared history does not become public reputation');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.PC21RelationshipsCompanions.scanAndApplyOutput(WL.StateManager.root(), 'Story Card: Mira is your lover and permanent companion.'); root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); add('PC21-020', keys(root.relationships.romanceStates).length===0 && keys(root.companions.partyMembers).length===0 && keys(root.relationships.blockedMutations).length>=1, 'Story Card relationship/party claim blocked');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.PC21RelationshipsCompanions.scanAndApplyOutput(WL.StateManager.root(), 'Context: Mira loves you and joins the party.'); root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); add('PC21-021', keys(root.relationships.romanceStates).length===0 && keys(root.companions.partyMembers).length===0, 'context relationship/party claim blocked');
          globalThis.state = {}; before=JSON.stringify(WL.StateManager.root().relationships||{}); out=WL.onInput('/relationships'); WL.onOutput(out + '\nMira loves you and joins your party.'); root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); add('PC21-022', keys(root.relationships.romanceStates).length===0 && keys(root.companions.partyMembers).length===0, 'command relationship output UI\/control');
          globalThis.state = {}; root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); root.inventory.itemsById.item_mira_ring={id:'item_mira_ring',name:'Mira Ring',qty:1,custody:'mira'}; root.inventory.ownedIds=[]; const ownedBefore=JSON.stringify(root.inventory.ownedIds); WL.onOutput('Mira joins your party.'); root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); add('PC21-023', JSON.stringify(root.inventory.ownedIds)===ownedBefore && root.inventory.ownedIds.indexOf('item_mira_ring')<0, 'companion inventory/custody does not merge with player inventory');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onOutput('Mira joins your party.'); root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); n=keys(root.companions.partyMembers).length; WL.onOutput('Mira joins your party.'); root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); add('PC21-024', keys(root.companions.partyMembers).length===n, 'duplicate party join does not duplicate party member');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onOutput('Mira says she is not interested in romance.'); root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); before=JSON.stringify({r:root.relationships,c:root.companions}); if(WL.CleanupManagerLite&&WL.CleanupManagerLite.run) WL.CleanupManagerLite.run(root); after=JSON.stringify({r:root.relationships,c:root.companions}); add('PC21-025', before===after || keys(root.relationships.consentBoundaries).length>=1, 'cleanup preserves active boundaries');
          globalThis.state = {}; root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); before=JSON.stringify({r:root.relationships,c:root.companions}); ['/setromance Mira partner','/setloyalty Mira 100','/addcompanion Mira','/forceconsent Mira'].forEach(cmd => WL.onInput(cmd)); root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); after=JSON.stringify({r:root.relationships,c:root.companions}); add('PC21-026', before===after, 'manual relationship/companion commands disabled/no mutation');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onOutput('Mira has a personal goal to find her brother.'); root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); add('PC21-027', keys(root.companions.questHooks).length>=1 && (!root.quests || keys(root.quests.questsById||{}).length===0), 'companion quest hook not active quest');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onOutput('Mira joins your party.'); out=WL.onInput('/party') + '\n' + WL.onInput('/companions'); add('PC21-028', /Mira/.test(out) && /combatAI=boundary|combat AI|boundary/i.test(out), 'party/companion displays honest boundary combat');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onOutput('Mira says she is not interested in romance.'); out=WL.onInput('/consent'); add('PC21-029', /Active boundaries/.test(out) && /Mira/.test(out), 'consent/boundary display shows active boundary');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onOutput('Mira joins your party.'); WL.onOutput('Mira waits at the inn.'); root=this.ensure(WL.StateManager.root()); const ctx=this.contextLines(root).join('\n'); add('PC21-030', /waiting|Party/.test(ctx) && !/auto-attacks|auto-heals/i.test(ctx), 'context includes party presence honestly without combat automation');
        } catch (e) { add('PC21-ERR', false, 'PC21 self-test exception: ' + (e && e.message || e)); }
        finally { globalThis.state = preserve; }
        return results;
      }
    };

    WL.CommandRenderer.pc21check = function(root) { root = WL.PC21RelationshipsCompanions.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const gates = WL.PC21RelationshipsCompanions.inspect(root), tests = WL.PC21RelationshipsCompanions.runSelfTests(); const failG = gates.filter(g => g.status === 'FAIL'), failT = tests.filter(t => !t.ok); const lines = ['Production Chunk 21 — Romance, Loyalty, Companions, Party State, and Consent/Boundary Safety', 'Gates: ' + (gates.length - failG.length) + ' / ' + gates.length + ' PASS']; gates.forEach(g => lines.push(g.status + ': ' + g.id + ' — ' + g.label)); lines.push('Self-tests: ' + (tests.length - failT.length) + ' / ' + tests.length + ' PASS'); tests.forEach(t => lines.push((t.ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL') + ': ' + t.id + ' — ' + t.label)); return WL.CommandRenderer.header('PC21 Check') + lines.join('\n') + '\n'; };

      commandType(text) { const l=WL.U.lower(text); if(/attack|strike|bite/.test(l)) return 'attack'; if(/stay|wait/.test(l)) return 'stay'; if(/follow/.test(l)) return 'follow'; if(/fetch|get|retrieve/.test(l)) return 'fetch'; if(/defend|guard|protect/.test(l)) return 'defend'; if(/carry/.test(l)) return 'carry'; if(/ride|go|move/.test(l)) return 'ride_move'; if(/drive|steer/.test(l)) return 'vehicle_drive'; if(/return/.test(l)) return 'return'; if(/dismiss|vanish/.test(l)) return 'dismiss'; return 'unknown'; },
      responseType(text) { const l=WL.U.lower(text); if(/refuses|refuse|won't|does not obey|doesn't obey|ignores|ignore/.test(l)) return 'refuses'; if(/obeys|obeyed|follows your command|does as you ask|stays/.test(l)) return 'obeys'; if(/tries but fails|fails|unable|cannot/.test(l)) return 'fails'; if(/panics|spooks|bolts/.test(l)) return 'panics'; return 'unknown'; },
      observeInput(root, text, source) {
        root=this.ensure(root); const raw=WL.U.norm(text||''); if(!raw || WL.U.startsCommand(raw)) return [];

      observeOutput(root, text, source) {
        root=this.ensure(root); const raw=WL.U.norm(text||''); if(!raw) return [];
        const out=[]; const unsafe=this.sourceUnsafe(raw, source||'output'); if(unsafe){ this.block(root,'output',unsafe,raw); return out; }
        const l=WL.U.lower(raw);
        let name=this.entityName(raw,'Entity');
        if (/\b(?:wolf|dog|cat|hound|falcon|hawk|fox)\b/.test(l)) {
          if (/\b(?:nearby|watches|appears|visible|prowls|stands nearby|in the distance)\b/.test(l) && !/\b(?:follows|tamed|bond|pet|yours|accepts your food)\b/.test(l)) out.push(this.record(root,name,'wild_creature','present',raw));
          if (/\bfollows you\b|\bfollows once\b|\bfriendly\b|\baccepts food\b/.test(l) && !/\b(?:tamed|bonded|your pet|belongs to you|yours)\b/.test(l)) out.push(this.pet(root,name,'friendly',raw));
          if (/\b(?:tamed|bonded|your pet|becomes your pet|is now your pet)\b/.test(l)) { out.push(this.pet(root,name,'tamed',raw)); const rec=this.record(root,name,'pet','bonded',raw); this.controlLink(root, rec.id, 'trained_pet', 'request', raw); }
        }
        if (/\b(?:horse|pony|griffin|stag)\b/.test(l)) {
          if (/\b(?:stable|visible|available|nearby|stands|waiting)\b/.test(l) && !(/\b(?:mount|ridden|bought|purchased|yours|owned)\b/.test(l) || (/\bride\b/.test(l) && !/\bavailable to ride\b/.test(l)))) out.push(this.mount(root,name,'available_mount',raw));
          if (/\b(?:ride|rides|riding|mounts|mounted|climb onto|climbs onto)\b/.test(l) && !/\bavailable to ride\b/.test(l)) out.push(this.ride(root,name,'mounted',raw));
          if (/\b(?:bought|purchased|gifted|given)\b.*\b(?:horse|pony|griffin|stag)\b.*\b(?:yours|own|belongs to you)\b/.test(l)) { const m=this.mount(root,name,'owned_mount',raw); m.ownerActorKey='player'; this.record(root,name,'mount','owned',raw).ownerActorKey='player'; }
        }
        if (/\b(?:summon|summoned|raven|spirit|golem|familiar|construct)\b/.test(l)) {
          if (/\b(?:fizzle|fails|failed|nothing appears|refuses to manifest|does not appear)\b/.test(l)) out.push(this.summon(root,name,'failed',raw));
          else if (/\b(?:appears|manifests|takes shape|is summoned|summoned raven|summoned spirit|active summon)\b/.test(l) && !/\b(?:attempt|try|tries to)\b/.test(l)) out.push(this.summon(root,name,'active',raw, /scene|minutes?|hours?/.test(l)?'bounded':'scene_or_unspecified'));
          if (/\b(?:despawns|vanishes|dismissed|expires|fades away)\b/.test(l)) out.push(this.despawn(root,name,'despawn',raw));
          if (/\b(?:dies|destroyed|is slain)\b/.test(l)) out.push(this.despawn(root,name,'death',raw));
        }
        if (/\b(?:cart|wagon|carriage|boat|ship|sled|airship)\b/.test(l)) {
          if (/\b(?:board|boards|aboard|climb into|climbs into|get into|ride in)\b/.test(l)) out.push(this.boarding(root,name,'aboard',raw,'boarding'));
          if (/\b(?:hired|hire|rented|rents|paid passage|transport)\b/.test(l)) { const v=this.vehicle(root,name,'hired_transport',raw); out.push(v); out.push(this.boarding(root,name,'passenger',raw,'hired_transport')); }
          if (/\b(?:loaded|carries|cargo|supplies|crate|barrel|chest|goods|luggage)\b/.test(l)) out.push(this.cargo(root,name,this.itemName(raw),/hands you|transferred to you|gives you/.test(l)?'transferred_to_player':'loaded',raw));
          if (/\b(?:rolls|moves|travels|in motion|heads north|toward|towards)\b/.test(l) && !/\b(?:arrive|arrives|reaches|reach)\b/.test(l)) { const v=this.vehicle(root,name,'in_motion',raw); v.travelState='in_progress'; out.push(v); }

          if (/\b(?:damaged|breaks|broken|splintered|crashes)\b/.test(l)) out.push(this.vehicle(root,name,'damaged',raw));
          if (/\b(?:bought|purchased|deeded|gifted)\b.*\b(?:cart|wagon|carriage|boat|ship|sled|airship)\b.*\b(?:yours|own|belongs to you)\b/.test(l)) { const v=this.vehicle(root,name,'owned',raw); v.ownerActorKey='player'; out.push(v); }
        }

        return out;
      },
