          { id:'protected_settings', family:'settings', title:'WL — WorldLedger Settings', dynamicTitle:false, renderer:'renderSettings', type:'WorldLedger', priority:40, singleton:true, triggerMode:'manual_or_narrow' },
          { id:'protected_command_audit', family:'audit', title:'WL — Command Log & Audit', dynamicTitle:false, renderer:'renderCommandAudit', type:'WorldLedger', priority:20, singleton:true, triggerMode:'manual_only' }
        ];
        return defs.map(function(def){ const copy = Object.assign({}, def); copy.title = WL.CardRegistry.makeTitle(copy, root); copy.keys = WL.CardRegistry.makeKeys(copy, root); copy.marker = WL.CardRegistry.markerFor(copy.id); return copy; });
      },
      protectedDefinitionById(id, root) { return this.protectedDefinitions(root).filter(function(d){ return d.id === id; })[0] || null; },
      allManagedIds(root) { return this.protectedDefinitions(root).map(function(d){ return d.id; }); },
      markerFor(id) { return '[WL:id=' + norm(id || 'unknown') + ']'; },
      versionMarker() { return '[WL:v=1.1]'; },
      familyMarker(family) { return '[WL:family=' + norm(family || 'unknown') + ']'; },
      footerMarkers(def) { def = def || {}; return [this.markerFor(def.id || def.managedId || 'unknown'), this.familyMarker(def.family || 'unknown'), this.versionMarker()].join('\n'); },
      cardText(card) { return textOfCard(card); },
      extractMarker(entryText) { const m = String(entryText || '').match(/\[WL:id=([^\]]+)\]/i); return m ? norm(m[1]) : ''; },
      extractLegacyMarker(entryText) { const m = String(entryText || '').match(/\[WorldLedger Mirror ID:\s*([^\]]+)\]/i); return m ? norm(m[1]) : ''; },
      legacyIdForTitle(title) {
        const s = lower(title || '');
        const map = {
          'worldledger player':'protected_player_sheet', 'aidrpg player summary':'protected_player_sheet',
          'worldledger inventory':'protected_inventory_equipment', 'aidrpg inventory summary':'protected_inventory_equipment',
          'worldledger abilities':'protected_abilities_training', 'aidrpg ability index':'protected_abilities_training', 'aidrpg skills':'protected_abilities_training', 'aidrpg talents':'protected_abilities_training', 'aidrpg passives':'protected_abilities_training',
          'worldledger quests':'protected_quest_log', 'aidrpg quest summary':'protected_quest_log',
          'worldledger actors places':'protected_actors_social', 'aidrpg actor memory summary':'protected_actors_social', 'aidrpg reputation summary':'protected_actors_social',
          'worldledger time':'protected_places_time', 'aidrpg time route summary':'protected_places_time',
          'worldledger settings':'protected_settings', 'worldledger audit':'protected_command_audit'
        };
        return map[s] || '';
      },
      managedIdFromCard(card) {
        if (!card || typeof card !== 'object') return '';
        const blob = [card.entry, card.value, card.text, card.description, card.keys, card.title, card.name, card.worldLedgerMirrorId].map(function(x){ return String(x || ''); }).join('\n');
        const marker = this.extractMarker(blob); if (marker) return marker;
        const legacy = this.extractLegacyMarker(blob);
        if (legacy) {
          const l = lower(legacy);
          if (/worldledger_player|protected\.worldledger_player|protected_worldledger_player/.test(l)) return 'protected_player_sheet';
          if (/worldledger_inventory|protected\.worldledger_inventory/.test(l)) return 'protected_inventory_equipment';
          if (/worldledger_abilities|protected\.worldledger_abilities/.test(l)) return 'protected_abilities_training';
          if (/worldledger_quests|protected\.worldledger_quests/.test(l)) return 'protected_quest_log';
          if (/worldledger_actors|actors_places/.test(l)) return 'protected_actors_social';
          if (/worldledger_time/.test(l)) return 'protected_places_time';
          if (/worldledger_settings/.test(l)) return 'protected_settings';
          if (/worldledger_audit/.test(l)) return 'protected_command_audit';
        }
        return this.legacyIdForTitle(card.title || card.name || '');
      },
      makeTitle(def, root) {
        if (def && def.id === 'protected_player_sheet' && def.dynamicTitle && WL.PlayerProfile && typeof WL.PlayerProfile.getDisplayName === 'function') {
          const n = WL.PlayerProfile.getDisplayName(root || {});
          if (n) return 'WL — ' + n + ' / Player Sheet';
        }
        return (def && def.title) || 'WL — Managed Card';
      },
      makeKeys(def, root) {
        const id = def && def.id || '';
        let keys = [];
        if (id === 'protected_player_sheet') { keys = ['player sheet','player status']; const n = WL.PlayerProfile && WL.PlayerProfile.getDisplayName ? WL.PlayerProfile.getDisplayName(root || {}) : ''; if (n) keys.unshift(n); }
        else if (id === 'protected_body_status') keys = ['body status','injuries','conditions'];
        else if (id === 'protected_inventory_equipment') keys = ['inventory','equipment','carried items'];
        else if (id === 'protected_abilities_training') keys = ['abilities','training','known abilities'];
        else if (id === 'protected_quest_log') keys = ['quest log','active quests'];
        else if (id === 'protected_actors_social') keys = ['party','companions','social memory'];
        else if (id === 'protected_places_time') keys = ['current location','scene time','travel memory'];
        else if (id === 'protected_settings') keys = ['wl settings','worldledger settings'];
        else if (id === 'protected_command_audit') keys = ['wl audit','command log'];
        const denied = { worldledger:1, aidrpg:1, system:1, debug:1, audit:1, state:1, context:1, memory:1, story:1, player:1, you:1, quest:1, item:1, magic:1, skill:1, guard:1, road:1, room:1, door:1 };
        keys = keys.map(norm).filter(Boolean).filter(function(k){ return !denied[lower(k)]; });
        return keys.join(', ');
      },
      ensure(root) {
        if (!root || typeof root !== 'object') return null;
        if (!root.cards || typeof root.cards !== 'object' || Array.isArray(root.cards)) root.cards = {};
        const c = root.cards;
        if (!c.registry || typeof c.registry !== 'object' || Array.isArray(c.registry)) c.registry = {};
        const r = c.registry;
        r.version = '1.1';
        ['protected','generated','hashes','externalRefs'].forEach(function(k){ if (!r[k] || typeof r[k] !== 'object' || Array.isArray(r[k])) r[k] = {}; });
        ['duplicates','quarantine','tombstones','lastErrors','invalidCards'].forEach(function(k){ if (!Array.isArray(r[k])) r[k] = []; });
        c.protectedTitles = this.protectedDefinitions(root).map(function(d){ return d.title; });
        c.protectedRegistry = this.protectedDefinitions(root).map(function(def, idx){ return { id:def.id, key:def.id, cardKey:def.id, sourceKey:'protected.' + def.id, family:def.family, title:def.title, name:def.title, keys:def.keys, type:def.type, renderer:def.renderer, priority:def.priority, protected:true, singleton:true, marker:def.marker, dirty:true, tombstoned:false, lastSyncedTurn:0 }; });
        cap(r.duplicates,25); cap(r.quarantine,25); cap(r.tombstones,50); cap(r.lastErrors,20); cap(r.invalidCards,25);
        return r;
      },
      findCardsByMarker(root, id) {
        const cards = WL.CardApiAdapter && WL.CardApiAdapter.cards ? WL.CardApiAdapter.cards() : (Array.isArray(globalThis.storyCards) ? globalThis.storyCards : []);
        const out = [];
        for (let i=0; i<cards.length; i++) { const c = cards[i]; if (!c || typeof c !== 'object' || Array.isArray(c)) continue; const found = this.managedIdFromCard(c); if (found === id) out.push({ card:c, index:i, match:'marker' }); }
        return out;
      },
      findCardsByLegacyTitle(root, def) {
        const cards = WL.CardApiAdapter && WL.CardApiAdapter.cards ? WL.CardApiAdapter.cards() : (Array.isArray(globalThis.storyCards) ? globalThis.storyCards : []);
        const out = [], id = def && def.id || '';
        for (let i=0; i<cards.length; i++) { const c = cards[i]; if (!c || typeof c !== 'object' || Array.isArray(c)) continue; if (this.legacyIdForTitle(c.title || c.name || '') === id) out.push({ card:c, index:i, match:'legacyTitle' }); }
        return out;
      },
      shouldAdoptLegacyCard(root, def, card) {
        if (!def || !card || typeof card !== 'object') return false;
        const id = this.managedIdFromCard(card);
        if (id === def.id) return true;
        if (this.legacyIdForTitle(card.title || card.name || '') === def.id) return true;
        const blob = [card.keys, card.namespace, card.worldLedgerMirrorId].map(function(x){ return String(x || ''); }).join('\n').toLowerCase();
        return blob.indexOf('worldledger') >= 0 || blob.indexOf('aidrpg') >= 0;
      },
      findManagedCard(root, def) {
        this.ensure(root || (WL.StateManager && WL.StateManager.root ? WL.StateManager.root() : null));
        def = typeof def === 'string' ? this.protectedDefinitionById(def, root) : def;
        if (!def) return { ok:false, card:null, index:-1, match:'none', duplicates:[] };
        const marked = this.findCardsByMarker(root, def.id);
        const legacy = marked.length ? [] : this.findCardsByLegacyTitle(root, def).filter(function(x){ return WL.CardRegistry.shouldAdoptLegacyCard(root, def, x.card); });
        const all = marked.concat(legacy);
        if (all.length > 1) this.markDuplicate(root, def.id, all);
        if (all.length) return { ok:true, card:all[0].card, index:all[0].index, match:all[0].match, duplicates:all.slice(1) };
        return { ok:false, card:null, index:-1, match:'none', duplicates:[] };
      },
      findDuplicates(root, def) { const f = this.findManagedCard(root, def); return f.duplicates || []; },
      markDuplicate(root, id, duplicates) { const r = this.ensure(root); const rec = { turn:now(root), id:id, count:(duplicates||[]).length + 1, reason:'duplicate managed protected card candidates' }; r.duplicates.push(rec); cap(r.duplicates,25); return rec; },
      quarantineCard(root, card, reason) { const r = this.ensure(root); const rec = { turn:now(root), title:norm(card && (card.title || card.name) || ''), reason:reason || 'review', action:'review' }; r.quarantine.push(rec); cap(r.quarantine,25); return rec; },
      tombstone(root, family, key, reason) { const r = this.ensure(root); const rec = { family:family || 'unknown', canonicalKey:key || '', reason:reason || 'retired/rejected', createdTurn:now(root), manualOverrideCanRestore:false }; r.tombstones.push(rec); cap(r.tombstones,50); return rec; },
      lastHash(root, id) { const r = this.ensure(root); return r.hashes[id] || ''; },
      setLastHash(root, id, value) { const r = this.ensure(root); r.hashes[id] = String(value || ''); return r.hashes[id]; },
      markDirty(root, id, reason, priority) { this.ensure(root); if (WL.DirtyQueue && typeof WL.DirtyQueue.add === 'function') WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'cards', id + ': ' + (reason || 'registry dirty')); arr(root.cards, 'dirtyTargets').push({ family:'card', targetKey:id, reason:reason || 'registry dirty', priority:priority || 50, createdTurn:now(root) }); cap(root.cards.dirtyTargets, 80); },
      inspect(root) {
        root = root || (WL.StateManager && WL.StateManager.root ? WL.StateManager.root() : null); this.ensure(root);
        const rows = [], defs = this.protectedDefinitions(root); const add = function(ok,label){ rows.push({ status:ok?'PASS':'FAIL', label:label }); };
        add(defs.length === 9, 'CardRegistry protected definition count is 9');
        add(!!this.protectedDefinitionById('protected_player_sheet', root), 'protected_player_sheet definition present');
        add(this.markerFor('protected_player_sheet') === '[WL:id=protected_player_sheet]', 'stable WL:id marker format present');
        add(this.extractMarker('body\n[WL:id=protected_player_sheet]\n[WL:v=1.1]') === 'protected_player_sheet', 'WL:id marker extraction works');
        const pdef = this.protectedDefinitionById('protected_player_sheet', root); const title = this.makeTitle(pdef, root);
        add(/^WL — /.test(title), 'protected card titles are player-facing WL titles');
        add(!/(^|,\s*)WorldLedger(\s*,|$)/i.test(this.makeKeys(pdef, root)), 'generic WorldLedger trigger not used on Player Sheet');
        add(!this.makeKeys(pdef, root).split(/,\s*/).some(function(k){ return lower(k) === 'player'; }), 'generic player trigger denied; player sheet/status only');
        return rows;
      },
      runV11RegistryTests() {
        const rows = [], add = function(id, ok, label){ rows.push({ id:id, ok:!!ok, label:label }); };
        const ps = globalThis.state, pc = globalThis.storyCards;
        try {
          globalThis.state = {}; globalThis.storyCards = [];
          const root = WL.StateManager.root(); if (WL.PlayerProfile) WL.PlayerProfile.applyIdentityCandidate(root, { name:'Zack', confidence:95, pattern:'test' }, 'test'); this.ensure(root);
          const defs = this.protectedDefinitions(root);
          add('V11-REG-001', defs.length === 9, 'protectedDefinitions count is 9');
          add('V11-REG-002', this.markerFor('protected_player_sheet').indexOf('[WL:id=protected_player_sheet]') >= 0, 'markerFor protected_player_sheet works');
          add('V11-REG-003', this.extractMarker('x\n[WL:id=protected_player_sheet]\n[WL:v=1.1]') === 'protected_player_sheet', 'extractMarker works');
          add('V11-REG-004', this.makeTitle(this.protectedDefinitionById('protected_player_sheet', root), root) === 'WL — Zack / Player Sheet', 'dynamic Player Sheet title uses safe player name');
          globalThis.storyCards.push({ title:'Zack Character Sheet', entry:'Readable body\n[WL:id=protected_player_sheet]\n[WL:v=1.1]', keys:'zack, player sheet' });
          add('V11-REG-005', this.findManagedCard(root, 'protected_player_sheet').ok, 'renamed marked Player Sheet is still found by marker');
          globalThis.storyCards = [{ title:'Player Sheet', entry:'user-authored no marker', keys:'player sheet' }];
          add('V11-REG-006', !this.findManagedCard(root, 'protected_player_sheet').ok, 'similar user-authored unmarked card is not adopted');
          globalThis.storyCards = [{ title:'WorldLedger Player', entry:'legacy body', keys:'WorldLedger Player' }];
          add('V11-REG-007', this.findManagedCard(root, 'protected_player_sheet').ok, 'legacy WorldLedger Player can be adopted safely');
          globalThis.storyCards = [{ title:'WL — Player Sheet', entry:'one\n[WL:id=protected_player_sheet]' }, { title:'WL — Duplicate', entry:'two\n[WL:id=protected_player_sheet]' }];
          add('V11-REG-008', this.findDuplicates(root, 'protected_player_sheet').length === 1, 'duplicate marked protected cards are detected');
          globalThis.storyCards = [null, 'bad', [], { title:'Real', keys:'real', entry:'ok' }];
          add('V11-REG-009', this.findManagedCard(root, 'protected_inventory_equipment').ok === false, 'invalid storyCards entries do not crash registry lookup');
          add('V11-REG-010', !defs.some(function(d){ return /(^|,\s*)WorldLedger(\s*,|$)/i.test(d.keys || ''); }), 'protected definitions avoid generic WorldLedger triggers');
        } catch(e) { add('V11-REG-ERR', false, 'CardRegistry self-test exception: ' + (e && e.message || e)); }
        finally { globalThis.state = ps; if (typeof pc === 'undefined') { try { delete globalThis.storyCards; } catch(e){} } else globalThis.storyCards = pc; }
        return rows;
      }
    };

    // Native final profile owner.
    WL.FinalPlayableProfile = {
      lockVersion: WL.FINAL_PLAYABLE_PROFILE_LOCK_VERSION,
      normalizeMode: modeKey,
      apply(root) {
        root = root || (WL.StateManager && WL.StateManager.root ? WL.StateManager.root() : null);
        if (!root || typeof root !== 'object') return root;
        if (!root.features || typeof root.features !== 'object' || Array.isArray(root.features)) root.features = {};
        Object.keys(WL.FeatureDefaults).forEach(function(k){ if (typeof root.features[k] === 'undefined') root.features[k] = WL.FeatureDefaults[k]; });
        Object.keys(WL.PLAYTEST_PROFILE).forEach(function(k){ if (k !== 'contextMode') root.features[k] = WL.PLAYTEST_PROFILE[k]; });
        root.features.contextMode = modeKey(root.features.contextMode || WL.PLAYTEST_PROFILE.contextMode);
        const mode = WL.CONTEXT_MODES[root.features.contextMode] || WL.CONTEXT_MODES.high;
        root.features.contextBudget = mode.maxChars;
        root.features.generatedCardCreatesPerTurn = mode.generatedCreatesPerHook;
        root.features.generatedCardUpdatesPerTurn = mode.generatedUpdatesPerHook;
        if (!root.finalProfile || typeof root.finalProfile !== 'object' || Array.isArray(root.finalProfile)) root.finalProfile = {};
        root.finalProfile.lockVersion = WL.FINAL_PLAYABLE_PROFILE_LOCK_VERSION;
        root.finalProfile.profile = 'final_playable_source_reconciled';
        root.finalProfile.systemStatus = Object.assign({}, WL.SYSTEM_STATUS);
        root.finalProfile.notes = [
          'High context is native default.',
          'Live context and live Story Card memory mirrors are native defaults.',
          'Manual Story Card editing is allowed and User Notes are preserved.',
          'User-authored Story Cards are protected from automatic WorldLedger overwrite.',
          'Manual gameplay mutation commands are active surfaces but direct mutation remains blocked.',
          'Raw card/context/command prose does not auto-fire mechanics; owner paths still decide mechanics.'
        ];
        root.build = root.build || {}; root.build.buildVersion = WL.BUILD_VERSION; root.build.buildStage = WL.BUILD_STAGE;
        if (root.meta) { root.meta.buildStage = WL.BUILD_STAGE; root.meta.lastUpdatedTurn = now(root); }
        if (!root.cards || typeof root.cards !== 'object' || Array.isArray(root.cards)) root.cards = {};
        root.cards.generatedDisabledReason = '';
        root.cards.cardSyncMode = 'live_editable_canon_memory';
        root.cards.liveMirrorEnabled = true;
        root.cards.generatedCardsEnabled = true;
        root.cards.manualEditingAllowed = true;
        root.cards.userAuthoredProtected = true;
        arr(root.cards,'liveWrites'); arr(root.cards,'liveWriteAudit'); arr(root.cards,'generatedMirrorRecords'); arr(root.cards,'adapterAudit'); arr(root.cards,'quarantinedInvalidCards'); if (WL.CardRegistry && typeof WL.CardRegistry.ensure === 'function') WL.CardRegistry.ensure(root);
        if (root.contextSystem && typeof root.contextSystem === 'object') {
          root.contextSystem.defaultContextMode = root.features.contextMode;
          root.contextSystem.supportedContextModes = ['high','medium','small'];
          root.contextSystem.cardSyncMode = 'live_editable_canon_memory';
        }
        return root;
      },
      setContextMode(root, mode) {
        root = this.apply(root || WL.StateManager.root());
        root.features.contextMode = modeKey(mode);
        const m = WL.CONTEXT_MODES[root.features.contextMode] || WL.CONTEXT_MODES.high;
        root.features.contextBudget = m.maxChars; root.features.generatedCardCreatesPerTurn = m.generatedCreatesPerHook; root.features.generatedCardUpdatesPerTurn = m.generatedUpdatesPerHook;
        if (root.contextSystem) root.contextSystem.defaultContextMode = root.features.contextMode;
        if (WL.AuditLogger) WL.AuditLogger.append(root, 'context', { message:'Context mode set to ' + root.features.contextMode }, 40);
        return root.features.contextMode;
      },
      modeLines(root) {
        root = this.apply(root || WL.StateManager.root());
        const m = WL.CONTEXT_MODES[root.features.contextMode] || WL.CONTEXT_MODES.high;
        return [
          'Final profile: ' + WL.FINAL_PLAYABLE_PROFILE_LOCK_VERSION,
          'Current context mode: ' + m.label + ' (' + m.key + ')',
          'Default context mode: High',
          'Supported modes: High, Medium, Small (Low aliases to Small)',

          'Live editable Story Card memory: ON',
          'Generated mirror cards: ON / budgeted and deduped',
          'Manual Story Card editing: ON',
          'Raw Story Card prose cannot auto-fire mechanics.'
        ];
      },
      featureLines(root) {

    // Replace StateManager final defaults at the owner source used by runtime.
    WL.StateManager.ensureFeatures = function(root) {
      const f = this.ensureBucket ? this.ensureBucket(root, 'features', function(){ return {}; }) : (root.features || (root.features = {}));
      Object.keys(WL.FeatureDefaults || {}).forEach(function(k){ if (typeof f[k] === 'undefined') f[k] = WL.FeatureDefaults[k]; });
      Object.keys(WL.PLAYTEST_PROFILE || {}).forEach(function(k){ if (k !== 'contextMode') f[k] = WL.PLAYTEST_PROFILE[k]; });
      f.contextMode = modeKey(f.contextMode || 'high');
      f.commandsEnabled = true;
      f.stateManagerLockEnabled = true;
      return f;
    };
    WL.StateManager.migrateIfNeeded = function(root) {
      this.ensureMigration(root);
      if (root.migration.schema !== WL.SCHEMA_VERSION) {
        root.migration.migratedFrom = String(root.migration.schema || 'unknown');
        root.migration.schema = WL.SCHEMA_VERSION;
        root.migration.migrationStatus = 'source_reconciled';
        this.addRepairWarning(root, 'Migration shell updated schema marker without importing old prose as mechanics.');
      }
      WL.FinalPlayableProfile.apply(root);
      return root;
    };
    WL.StateManager.ensureCards = function(root) {
      const c = this.ensureBucket ? this.ensureBucket(root, 'cards', function(){ return {}; }) : (root.cards || (root.cards = {}));
      c.protectedTitles = (WL.CardRegistry && typeof WL.CardRegistry.protectedDefinitions === 'function' ? WL.CardRegistry.protectedDefinitions(root).map(function(d){ return d.title; }) : (WL.PROTECTED_CARD_KEYS || []).slice());
      ['dirtyTargets','dryRunWrites','warnings','liveWrites','liveWriteAudit','generatedMirrorRecords','adapterAudit','quarantinedInvalidCards'].forEach(function(k){ if (!Array.isArray(c[k])) c[k] = []; });
      if (WL.CardRegistry && typeof WL.CardRegistry.ensure === 'function') WL.CardRegistry.ensure(root);
      c.generatedDisabledReason = '';
      c.generatedCardsEnabled = true;
      c.cardSyncMode = 'live_editable_canon_memory';
      c.manualEditingAllowed = true;
      c.userAuthoredProtected = true;
      return c;
    };
    WL.StateManager.validateIntegrity = function(root) {
      const warnings = [], errors = [], repaired = [];
      if (!root || typeof root !== 'object') errors.push('root missing');
      else {
        (WL.ROOT_BUCKETS_ALL || []).forEach(function(k){ if (!root[k] || typeof root[k] !== 'object') errors.push('missing bucket: ' + k); });
        if (root.schemaVersion !== WL.SCHEMA_VERSION) errors.push('schema version mismatch');
        const b = root.body || {};
        if (!(b.hp >= 0 && b.hp <= b.maxHp)) errors.push('HP invariant broken');
        if (!(b.mp >= 0 && b.mp <= b.maxMp)) errors.push('MP invariant broken');
        if (!(b.ep >= 0 && b.ep <= b.maxEp)) errors.push('EP invariant broken');
        if (!root.features || root.features.cardSyncDryRun !== false || root.features.liveCardMirrorEnabled !== true || root.features.manualStoryCardEditingEnabled !== true) errors.push('final live Story Card memory profile missing');
        if (!root.features || root.features.manualMutationCommandsEnabled !== false || root.features.manualMutationCommandSurfaceEnabled !== true) errors.push('manual gameplay mutation surface profile unsafe');
        if (!root.cards || root.cards.cardSyncMode !== 'live_editable_canon_memory') errors.push('live editable card memory state missing');
        if (root.migration && root.migration.warnings) repaired.push.apply(repaired, root.migration.warnings.slice(-8));
      }
      return { ok: errors.length === 0, warnings:warnings, errors:errors, repaired:repaired };
    };
    const stateManagerInitSourceReconciled = WL.StateManager.init;
    WL.StateManager.init = function(rawState) {
      const root = stateManagerInitSourceReconciled.call(this, rawState);
      return WL.FinalPlayableProfile.apply(root);
    };
    const stateManagerRootSourceReconciled = WL.StateManager.root;
    WL.StateManager.root = function() {
      const root = stateManagerRootSourceReconciled.call(this);
      return WL.FinalPlayableProfile.apply(root);
    };

    WL.StateSchemaLock.inspect = function(root) {
      root = WL.FinalPlayableProfile.apply(root || WL.StateManager.root());
      const rows = [], add=function(ok,label){ rows.push({ status:ok?'PASS':'FAIL', label:label }); };
      add(root.schemaVersion === WL.SCHEMA_VERSION, 'root schemaVersion locked: ' + WL.SCHEMA_VERSION);
      add(root.meta && root.meta.schemaId === WL.SCHEMA_ID, 'meta schemaId locked: ' + WL.SCHEMA_ID);
      (WL.CANONICAL_ROOT_BUCKETS || []).forEach(function(k){ add(root[k] && typeof root[k] === 'object', 'canonical bucket present: ' + k + ' / owner: ' + (WL.SCHEMA_OWNER_MAP[k] || 'unowned')); });
      const b = root.body || {};
      add(b.hp >= 0 && b.hp <= b.maxHp, 'HP invariant locked'); add(b.mp >= 0 && b.mp <= b.maxMp, 'MP invariant locked'); add(b.ep >= 0 && b.ep <= b.maxEp, 'EP invariant locked');
      add(root.features.cardSyncDryRun === false && root.features.liveCardMirrorEnabled === true && root.features.manualStoryCardEditingEnabled === true, 'live editable Story Card memory profile active');
      add(root.features.manualMutationCommandsEnabled === false && root.features.manualMutationCommandSurfaceEnabled === true, 'manual gameplay command surface active while direct mutation non-mutating');
      return rows;
    };


    // ============================================================
    // 25B. CardRenderer — V1.0.3 Core Card System Chunk 03
    // Native player-facing card text. No wrapper; CardSync calls this renderer.
    // ============================================================
    WL.CardRenderer = {
      rendererVersion: 'worldledger.card-renderer.v1.0.3.chunk03',
      root(root) { return WL.FinalPlayableProfile ? WL.FinalPlayableProfile.apply(root || WL.StateManager.root()) : (root || WL.StateManager.root()); },
      textOf(card) { return String((card && (card.entry || card.value || card.text || card.description)) || ''); },
      cleanValue(value, fallback) { value = norm(value == null ? '' : value); if (!value || /^(?:unknown|none|undefined|null|unspecified)$/i.test(value)) return fallback || 'not set yet'; return value; },
      line(label, value, fallback) { return '- ' + label + ': ' + this.cleanValue(value, fallback); },
      compactList(items, max, emptyText) { items = Array.isArray(items) ? items.map(norm).filter(Boolean) : []; max = max || 8; if (!items.length) return ['- ' + (emptyText || 'none')]; return items.slice(0, max).map(function(x){ return '- ' + x; }); },
      section(title, lines) { lines = Array.isArray(lines) ? lines.filter(function(x){ return x != null && String(x).trim(); }) : []; if (!lines.length) lines = ['- none']; return title + '\n' + lines.join('\n'); },
      formatResource(cur, max) { cur = Number(cur); max = Number(max); if (!Number.isFinite(max) || max < 1) max = 1; if (!Number.isFinite(cur)) cur = max; cur = Math.max(0, Math.min(max, cur)); return Math.round(cur) + ' / ' + Math.round(max); },
      formatCoreStats(stats) { stats = stats || {}; const n = function(v){ v = Number(v); return Number.isFinite(v) ? Math.round(v) : 10; }; return 'ATK ' + n(stats.atk) + ' | DEF ' + n(stats.def) + ' | SPD ' + n(stats.spd) + ' | INT ' + n(stats.int) + ' | LCK ' + n(stats.lck); },
      itemName(root, id) { const it = root && root.inventory && root.inventory.itemsById && root.inventory.itemsById[id]; return norm(it && (it.name || it.displayName || it.title) || id || ''); },
      actorName(root, id) { const a = root && root.actors && root.actors.actorsById && root.actors.actorsById[id]; return norm(a && (a.name || a.displayName || a.title) || id || ''); },
      placeName(root, id) { const p = root && root.places && root.places.placesById && root.places.placesById[id]; return norm(p && (p.name || p.displayName || p.title) || id || ''); },
      abilityName(root, id) { const a = root && root.abilities && root.abilities.abilitiesById && root.abilities.abilitiesById[id]; return norm(a && (a.name || a.displayName || a.title) || id || ''); },
      candidateAbilityName(root, id) { const a = root && root.abilities && root.abilities.candidatesById && root.abilities.candidatesById[id]; return norm(a && (a.name || a.displayName || a.title) || id || ''); },
      questName(root, id) { const q = root && root.quests && root.quests.questsById && root.quests.questsById[id]; return norm(q && (q.title || q.name || q.displayName) || id || ''); },
      preserveUserNotes(existingCardText) {
        const text = String(existingCardText || '');
        let m = text.match(/\[User Notes - Preserved\]([\s\S]*?)\[\/User Notes\]/i);
        if (m) return m[1].replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
        m = text.match(/(?:^|\n)(?:Player Notes|User Notes|Manual Notes|Notes)\s*\n([\s\S]*?)(?:\n\[WL:id=|\n\[WorldLedger Mirror ID:|$)/i);
        if (m && !/\[Generated Mirror - Script Owned\]/i.test(m[1])) return m[1].replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
        return '';
      },
      renderUserNotesBlock(kind, existingCardText, defaultHelpText) {
        const notes = this.preserveUserNotes(existingCardText);
        const body = notes || defaultHelpText || 'You may safely edit this section. Mechanical claims still require story confirmation.';
        return '[User Notes - Preserved]\n' + body + '\n[/User Notes]';
      },
      replaceUserNotes(renderedText, existingCardText, defaultHelpText) {
        const block = this.renderUserNotesBlock('', existingCardText, defaultHelpText);
        if (/\[User Notes - Preserved\][\s\S]*?\[\/User Notes\]/i.test(renderedText)) return renderedText.replace(/\[User Notes - Preserved\][\s\S]*?\[\/User Notes\]/i, block);
        return String(renderedText || '').replace(/\s*$/, '\n\n' + block);
      },
      footerMarkers(def) { return WL.CardRegistry && WL.CardRegistry.footerMarkers ? WL.CardRegistry.footerMarkers(def || {}) : '[WL:id=' + norm(def && def.id || 'unknown') + ']\n[WL:v=1.1]'; },
      capCard(text, max) {
        text = String(text || ''); max = max || 1800;
        if (text.length <= max) return text;
        const markerAt = text.lastIndexOf('\n[WL:id=');
        const footer = markerAt >= 0 ? text.slice(markerAt) : '';
        const head = markerAt >= 0 ? text.slice(0, markerAt) : text;
        const room = Math.max(200, max - footer.length - 42);
        return head.slice(0, room).replace(/\s+$/,'') + '\n...additional entries omitted by card budget.\n' + footer;
      },
      renderProtected(def, root, existingCardText) {
        root = this.root(root); def = def || {};
        const fn = this[def.renderer] || this.renderSettings;
        return fn.call(this, root, existingCardText || '', def);
      },
      renderPlayerSheet(root, existingCardText, def) {
        root = this.root(root); const p = root.player || {}, pr = p.profile || {};
        const name = (WL.PlayerProfile && WL.PlayerProfile.getDisplayName ? WL.PlayerProfile.getDisplayName(root) : '') || this.cleanValue(p.name, 'Unknown / not set yet');
        const heading = (/^Unknown/i.test(name) ? 'Player Sheet' : name + ' — Player Sheet');
        const res = WL.PlayerProfile && WL.PlayerProfile.getResources ? WL.PlayerProfile.getResources(root) : { hp:root.body.hp, maxHp:root.body.maxHp, mp:root.body.mp, maxMp:root.body.maxMp, ep:root.body.ep, maxEp:root.body.maxEp };
        const stats = WL.PlayerProfile && WL.PlayerProfile.getCoreStats ? WL.PlayerProfile.getCoreStats(root) : { atk:10, def:10, spd:10, int:10, lck:10 };
        const currentPlace = root.places && root.places.currentId ? this.placeName(root, root.places.currentId) : (p.locationId || 'Unknown');
        const stable = (root.abilities.abilityIds || []).map(id => this.abilityName(root,id)).filter(Boolean).slice(0,5);
        const cand = (root.abilities.candidateIds || []).map(id => this.candidateAbilityName(root,id)).filter(Boolean).slice(0,5);
        const eq = root.inventory && root.inventory.equipment || {};

        const armor = eq.body ? this.itemName(root, eq.body) : 'none';
        const species = this.cleanValue(pr.speciesLabel || p.raceSpecies || p.species || p.race, 'not set yet');
        const klass = this.cleanValue(pr.classLabel || p.specialization || p.buildIdentity, 'Unset');
        const parts = [
          heading,
          '',
          this.section('Identity', [this.line('Name', name, 'Unknown / not set yet'), this.line('Species', species, 'not set yet'), this.line('Class / Build', klass, 'Unset'), this.line('Level', p.level || 1, '1'), this.line('XP', (p.xp || root.progression.levelXp || 0) + ' / ' + (p.xpToNext || 100), '0 / 100')]),

          'Personality:',
          'Backstory:',

          this.renderUserNotesBlock('player', existingCardText, 'You may safely edit appearance, personality, backstory, and profile notes here.\nMechanical claims still require story confirmation.'),
          '',
          this.footerMarkers(def || { id:'protected_player_sheet', family:'player' })

      inspect(root) {
        root = this.root(root); const rows = [], add = function(ok,label){ rows.push({ status:ok?'PASS':'FAIL', label:label }); };
        const def = WL.CardRegistry && WL.CardRegistry.protectedDefinitionById ? WL.CardRegistry.protectedDefinitionById('protected_player_sheet', root) : { id:'protected_player_sheet', family:'player', renderer:'renderPlayerSheet' };
        const body = this.renderPlayerSheet(root, '', def);
        add(typeof this.renderProtected === 'function' && typeof this.renderPlayerSheet === 'function', 'CardRenderer protected router/player sheet renderer present');
        add(body.indexOf('HP:') >= 0 && body.indexOf('MP:') >= 0 && body.indexOf('EP:') >= 0, 'Player Sheet renders HP/MP/EP');
        add(body.indexOf('ATK') >= 0 && body.indexOf('DEF') >= 0 && body.indexOf('SPD') >= 0 && body.indexOf('INT') >= 0 && body.indexOf('LCK') >= 0, 'Player Sheet renders ATK/DEF/SPD/INT/LCK');
        add(!/^\s*\[(?:WL:id|WorldLedger Mirror ID)/i.test(body) && body.indexOf('[Generated Mirror - Script Owned]') < 0, 'Player Sheet starts with player-facing text, not metadata');
        add(body.indexOf('[WL:id=protected_player_sheet]') >= 0, 'Player Sheet footer marker present');
        add(this.preserveUserNotes('[User Notes - Preserved]\nkeep me\n[/User Notes]') === 'keep me', 'User Notes preservation helper works');
        return rows;
      },
      runV11RendererTests() {
        const rows = [], add = function(id, ok, label){ rows.push({ id:id, ok:!!ok, label:label }); };
        const ps = globalThis.state, pc = globalThis.storyCards;
        try {

          if (root.inventory && root.inventory.itemsById) { root.inventory.itemsById.dagger = { name:'Rusty Dagger', quantity:1 }; root.inventory.ownedIds = ['dagger']; root.inventory.equipment.mainHand = 'dagger'; root.inventory.visibleSceneItems = [{ name:'Crown of Dawn' }]; }
          if (root.abilities) { root.abilities.candidatesById.ember = { name:'Ember Ward', status:'failed once; not stable' }; root.abilities.candidateIds = ['ember']; root.abilities.denied = ['Ember Ward — failed activation; not stable']; }
          const def = WL.CardRegistry.protectedDefinitionById('protected_player_sheet', root); const player = this.renderPlayerSheet(root, '[User Notes - Preserved]\nI like scarred veteran vibes.\n[/User Notes]', def);
          add('V11-REN-001', player.indexOf('Zack — Player Sheet') >= 0 && player.indexOf('Name: Zack') >= 0, 'Player Sheet uses known player name');
          add('V11-REN-002', player.indexOf('HP:') >= 0 && player.indexOf('MP:') >= 0 && player.indexOf('EP:') >= 0, 'Player Sheet has resources');

          add('V11-REN-004', !/^\s*\[/.test(player), 'Player Sheet does not start with machine metadata');
          add('V11-REN-005', player.indexOf('[WL:id=protected_player_sheet]') >= 0, 'Player Sheet footer marker exists');
          add('V11-REN-006', player.indexOf('I like scarred veteran vibes.') >= 0, 'User Notes preserved');
          const inv = this.renderInventoryEquipment(root, '', WL.CardRegistry.protectedDefinitionById('protected_inventory_equipment', root));
          add('V11-REN-007', inv.indexOf('Crown of Dawn') >= 0 && inv.indexOf('visible, not owned') >= 0 && inv.indexOf('Owned Items') >= 0, 'Inventory distinguishes visible/not owned from owned');

          const stableSection = (abil.match(/Stable Abilities\n([\s\S]*?)\n\nCandidates \/ Training/) || [,''])[1];

          add('V11-REN-009', player.indexOf('Generated Mirror - Script Owned') < 0 && inv.indexOf('Generated Mirror - Script Owned') < 0, 'Protected cards do not use debug mirror headings');
          const longRoot = WL.StateManager.root(); longRoot.inventory.ownedIds = []; for (let i=0;i<80;i++){ const id='it'+i; longRoot.inventory.itemsById[id]={name:'Item '+i}; longRoot.inventory.ownedIds.push(id); } const longInv = this.renderInventoryEquipment(longRoot, '[User Notes - Preserved]\nkeep\n[/User Notes]', WL.CardRegistry.protectedDefinitionById('protected_inventory_equipment', longRoot));
          add('V11-REN-010', longInv.indexOf('[WL:id=protected_inventory_equipment]') >= 0 && longInv.indexOf('keep') >= 0, 'Card caps preserve footer markers and User Notes');
        } catch(e) { add('V11-REN-ERR', false, 'CardRenderer self-test exception: ' + (e && e.message || e)); }
        finally { globalThis.state = ps; globalThis.storyCards = pc; }
        return rows;
      }
    };

    // Story Card API adapter and native CardSyncLite integration.
    // V1.0.4 implementation chunk 04: CardSync now writes V1.1 player-facing cards through CardRegistry + CardRenderer.
    WL.CardApiAdapter = {
      available: function() {
        return typeof globalThis.addStoryCard === 'function' || typeof globalThis.updateStoryCard === 'function' || typeof globalThis.removeStoryCard === 'function' || Array.isArray(globalThis.storyCards) || (globalThis.state && Array.isArray(globalThis.state.storyCards));
      },
      dryRunOnly: function() { return false; },
      cards: function() {
        if (WL.U && typeof WL.U.getStoryCards === 'function') return WL.U.getStoryCards();
        if (Array.isArray(globalThis.storyCards)) return globalThis.storyCards;
        if (globalThis.state && Array.isArray(globalThis.state.storyCards)) return globalThis.state.storyCards;
        return [];
      },
      capabilities: function() {
        return {
          addStoryCard: typeof globalThis.addStoryCard === 'function',
          updateStoryCard: typeof globalThis.updateStoryCard === 'function',
          removeStoryCard: typeof globalThis.removeStoryCard === 'function',
          fallbackArrayAvailable: Array.isArray(globalThis.storyCards) || (globalThis.state && Array.isArray(globalThis.state.storyCards))
        };
      },
      snapshot: function(root) {
        return this.cards().map(function(card, index){ return WL.CardApiAdapter.normalizeCard(card, index); });
      },
      normalizeCard: function(card, index) {
        card = card && typeof card === 'object' && !Array.isArray(card) ? card : {};
        return {
          index: index,
          card: card,
          title: norm(card.title || card.name || ''),
          keys: norm(card.keys || card.key || ''),
          entry: textOfCard(card),
          type: norm(card.type || card.category || 'WorldLedger'),
          managedId: WL.CardRegistry && WL.CardRegistry.managedIdFromCard ? WL.CardRegistry.managedIdFromCard(card) : ''
        };
      },
      cleanStoryCardArray: function(root, options) {
        root = root || (WL.StateManager && WL.StateManager.root ? WL.StateManager.root() : null);
        options = options || {};
        const cards = this.cards();
        if (!Array.isArray(cards)) return { ok:false, cleaned:0, skipped:0, reason:'storyCards unavailable' };
        const budget = Math.max(0, Number(options.cleanupBudget || (root && root.features && root.features.cardCleanupBudget) || 5));
        let cleaned = 0, skipped = 0;
        for (let i = cards.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
          const c = cards[i];
          const bad = !c || typeof c !== 'object' || Array.isArray(c);
          if (!bad) continue;
          if (cleaned < budget) { cards.splice(i, 1); cleaned++; }
          else skipped++;
        }
        if (root) {
          if (!root.cards || typeof root.cards !== 'object') root.cards = {};
          arr(root.cards, 'quarantinedInvalidCards');
          if (cleaned || skipped) {
            root.cards.quarantinedInvalidCards.push({ turn:now(root), cleaned:cleaned, skipped:skipped, reason:'invalid Story Card entries handled before CardSync scan/write' });
            cap(root.cards.quarantinedInvalidCards, 40);
            if (WL.AuditLogger) WL.AuditLogger.append(root, 'cards', { message:'CardApiAdapter invalid Story Card cleanup cleaned=' + cleaned + ', skipped=' + skipped }, 50);
          }
        }
        return { ok:true, cleaned:cleaned, skipped:skipped };
      },
      mirrorIdFor: function(packet) {
        packet = packet || {};
        const raw = String(packet.mirrorId || packet.managedId || packet.sourceKey || packet.id || packet.title || 'mirror');
        const out = /^wl[._]/i.test(raw) ? raw : 'wl.' + raw;
        return out.replace(/\s+/g, '_').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/g, '_').slice(0, 140);
      },
      extractUserNotes: function(text) {
        text = String(text || '');
        if (WL.CardRenderer && typeof WL.CardRenderer.preserveUserNotes === 'function') return WL.CardRenderer.preserveUserNotes(text);
        const m = text.match(/\[User Notes - Preserved\]([\s\S]*?)(?:\[\/User Notes\]|$)/i);
        return m ? m[1].replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '') : '';
      },
      stripManagedSections: function(text) {
        text = String(text || '');
        text = text.replace(/\[WorldLedger Mirror ID:[^\]]+\]\s*/ig, '');
        text = text.replace(/\[Generated Mirror - Script Owned\]\s*/ig, '');
        text = text.replace(/\[WL:id=[^\]]+\]\s*/ig, '');
        text = text.replace(/\[WL:family=[^\]]+\]\s*/ig, '');
        text = text.replace(/\[WL:v=[^\]]+\]\s*/ig, '');
        text = text.replace(/\[User Notes - Preserved\][\s\S]*?(?:\[\/User Notes\]|$)/ig, '');
        return text.trim();
      },
      isManagedCard: function(card, expectedTitle) {
        if (!card || typeof card !== 'object' || Array.isArray(card)) return false;
        const blob = [card.entry, card.value, card.text, card.description, card.keys, card.title, card.name, card.namespace, card.worldLedgerMirrorId].map(function(x){ return String(x || ''); }).join('\n');
        if (WL.CardRegistry && WL.CardRegistry.managedIdFromCard && WL.CardRegistry.managedIdFromCard(card)) return true;
        if (/\[WorldLedger Mirror ID:/i.test(blob) || card.aidrpgManaged === true || card.namespace === 'WorldLedger' || card.worldLedgerMirrorId) return true;
        return !!(expectedTitle && isProtectedTitle(expectedTitle) && lower(card.title || card.name || '') === lower(expectedTitle));
      },
      normalizePacket: function(packet, existingCard) {
        packet = packet || {};
        const title = norm(packet.title || packet.name || 'WorldLedger Managed Card');
        let managedId = norm(packet.managedId || packet.id || '');
        let family = norm(packet.family || 'managed');
        const sourceKeyRaw = String(packet.sourceKey || '');
        if (!managedId && (/^WorldLedger Player$/i.test(title) || /protected\.worldledger_player/i.test(sourceKeyRaw))) { managedId = 'protected_player_sheet'; family = 'player'; }
        if (!managedId && /^protected\./i.test(sourceKeyRaw)) managedId = norm(sourceKeyRaw.replace(/^protected\./i,''));
        const mirrorId = this.mirrorIdFor(packet);
        const keys = norm(packet.keys || packet.triggerKeys || title);
        const type = norm(packet.type || 'WorldLedger');
        const raw = String(packet.entry || packet.value || packet.text || 'WorldLedger managed memory card.');
        const existingText = existingCard ? textOfCard(existingCard) : '';
        let notes = '';
        if (WL.CardRenderer && typeof WL.CardRenderer.preserveUserNotes === 'function') notes = WL.CardRenderer.preserveUserNotes(existingText);
        if (!notes) notes = this.extractUserNotes(existingText);
        if (!notes && packet.userNotes) notes = String(packet.userNotes || '').trim();

        let entry = raw;
        const isV11Managed = /\[WL:id=[^\]]+\]/i.test(entry);
        if (isV11Managed) {
          if (notes && WL.CardRenderer && typeof WL.CardRenderer.replaceUserNotes === 'function') entry = WL.CardRenderer.replaceUserNotes(entry, existingText, notes);
          return { title:title, name:title, keys:keys, entry:entry, value:entry, text:entry, type:type, mirrorId:mirrorId, sourceKey:packet.sourceKey || mirrorId, managedId:managedId, family:family, userNotes:notes };
        }

        // V1.0.4 forward path: no new debug-mirror cards. Legacy mirror headers are read-only migration signals now.
        const body = this.stripManagedSections(raw) || 'WorldLedger managed memory card.';
        const id = managedId || mirrorId.replace(/^wl[._]/i, '').replace(/\./g, '_');
        const def = { id:id, family:family, title:title };
        let footer = '';
        if (WL.CardRegistry && typeof WL.CardRegistry.footerMarkers === 'function') footer = WL.CardRegistry.footerMarkers(def);
        else footer = '[WL:id=' + id + ']\n[WL:family=' + family + ']\n[WL:v=1.1]';
        entry = title + '\n\n' + body + '\n\n[User Notes - Preserved]\n' + (notes || '') + '\n[/User Notes]\n\n' + footer;
        return { title:title, name:title, keys:keys, entry:entry, value:entry, text:entry, type:type, mirrorId:mirrorId, sourceKey:packet.sourceKey || mirrorId, managedId:id, family:family, userNotes:notes };
      },
      find: function(packetOrTitle) {
        const packet = typeof packetOrTitle === 'object' ? this.normalizePacket(packetOrTitle) : this.normalizePacket({ title:String(packetOrTitle || '') });
        const cards = this.cards();
        this.cleanStoryCardArray(WL.StateManager && WL.StateManager.root ? WL.StateManager.root() : null);
        let protectedTitleFallback = -1, unmarkedSameTitle = -1;
        const wantedId = norm(packet.managedId || packet.id || (packet.sourceKey && /^protected\./.test(String(packet.sourceKey)) ? String(packet.sourceKey).replace(/^protected\./,'') : ''));
        for (let i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
          const c = cards[i];
          if (!c || typeof c !== 'object' || Array.isArray(c)) continue;
          const blob = [c.entry,c.value,c.text,c.description,c.keys,c.title,c.name,c.worldLedgerMirrorId].map(function(x){ return String(x || ''); }).join('\n');
          const wlId = WL.CardRegistry && WL.CardRegistry.managedIdFromCard ? WL.CardRegistry.managedIdFromCard(c) : '';
          if (wantedId && wlId && wlId === wantedId) return { ok:true, card:c, index:i, match:'wlId' };
          if (blob.indexOf('[WorldLedger Mirror ID: ' + packet.mirrorId + ']') >= 0 || String(c.worldLedgerMirrorId || '') === packet.mirrorId) return { ok:true, card:c, index:i, match:'legacyMirrorId' };
          if (packet.sourceKey && /\[WorldLedger Mirror ID:/i.test(blob) && blob.indexOf(String(packet.sourceKey)) >= 0) return { ok:true, card:c, index:i, match:'legacySourceKey' };
          const sameTitle = lower(c.title || c.name || '') === lower(packet.title);
          if (sameTitle && this.isManagedCard(c, packet.title)) return { ok:true, card:c, index:i, match:'managedTitle' };
          if (sameTitle && unmarkedSameTitle < 0) unmarkedSameTitle = i;
          if (protectedTitleFallback < 0 && isProtectedTitle(packet.title) && sameTitle) protectedTitleFallback = i;
        }
        if (protectedTitleFallback >= 0) return { ok:true, card:cards[protectedTitleFallback], index:protectedTitleFallback, match:'protectedTitle' };
        if (unmarkedSameTitle >= 0) return { ok:false, card:cards[unmarkedSameTitle], index:unmarkedSameTitle, match:'userAuthoredSameTitle', userAuthored:true };
        return { ok:false, card:null, index:-1, match:'none' };
      },
      safeFindByTitle: function(title) { return this.find({ title:title }); },
      findByIndex: function(root, index) {
        const cards = this.cards();
        if (index == null || index < 0 || index >= cards.length) return { ok:false, card:null, index:-1 };
        return { ok:true, card:cards[index], index:index };
      },
      add: function(root, payload) {
        const p = this.normalizePacket(payload);
        if (typeof globalThis.addStoryCard === 'function') {
          addStoryCard(p.keys, p.entry, p.type);
          const found = this.find(p);
          return { ok:true, action:'add', mode:'addStoryCard', packet:p, index:found.index };
        }
        return this.fallbackArrayAdd(root, p, 'addStoryCard unavailable');
      },
      update: function(root, index, payload) {
        const p = this.normalizePacket(payload, this.cards()[index]);
        if (typeof globalThis.updateStoryCard === 'function' && index >= 0) {
          updateStoryCard(index, p.keys, p.entry, p.type);
          return { ok:true, action:'update', mode:'updateStoryCard', packet:p, index:index };
        }
        return this.fallbackArrayUpdate(root, index, p, 'updateStoryCard unavailable');
      },
      remove: function(root, index) {
        if (typeof globalThis.removeStoryCard === 'function' && index >= 0) {
          removeStoryCard(index);
          return { ok:true, action:'remove', mode:'removeStoryCard', index:index };
        }
        const cards = this.cards();
        if (Array.isArray(cards) && index >= 0 && index < cards.length) { cards.splice(index,1); return { ok:true, action:'remove', mode:'storyCards_array_fallback_remove', index:index, reason:'removeStoryCard unavailable' }; }
        return { ok:false, action:'remove', mode:'unavailable', index:index, reason:'remove unavailable' };
      },
      safeAdd: function(root, payload, reason) {
        const res = this.add(root, payload);
        res.reason = res.reason || reason || '';
        this.audit(root, res);
        return res;
      },
      safeUpdate: function(root, index, payload, reason) {
        const res = this.update(root, index, payload);
        res.reason = res.reason || reason || '';
        this.audit(root, res);
        return res;
      },
      safeRemove: function(root, index, reason) {
        const res = this.remove(root, index);
        res.reason = res.reason || reason || '';
        this.audit(root, res);
        return res;
      },
      fallbackArrayAdd: function(root, payload, reason) {
        const cards = this.cards();
        if (!Array.isArray(cards)) return { ok:false, action:'add', mode:'unavailable', reason:'storyCards array unavailable' };
        const p = this.normalizePacket(payload);
        cards.push({ title:p.title, name:p.title, keys:p.keys, entry:p.entry, value:p.entry, text:p.entry, type:p.type, worldLedgerMirrorId:p.mirrorId, managedId:p.managedId, family:p.family });
        return { ok:true, action:'add', mode:'storyCards_array_fallback_add', packet:p, index:cards.length-1, reason:reason || 'official addStoryCard unavailable' };
      },
      fallbackArrayUpdate: function(root, index, payload, reason) {
        const cards = this.cards();
        if (!Array.isArray(cards) || index < 0 || index >= cards.length) return { ok:false, action:'update', mode:'unavailable', reason:'storyCards array update unavailable' };
        const p = this.normalizePacket(payload, cards[index]);
        cards[index] = Object.assign({}, cards[index] || {}, { title:p.title, name:p.title, keys:p.keys, entry:p.entry, value:p.entry, text:p.entry, type:p.type, worldLedgerMirrorId:p.mirrorId, managedId:p.managedId, family:p.family });
        return { ok:true, action:'update', mode:'storyCards_array_fallback_update', packet:p, index:index, reason:reason || 'official updateStoryCard unavailable' };
      },
      audit: function(root, result) {
        root = root || (WL.StateManager && WL.StateManager.root ? WL.StateManager.root() : null);
        if (!root) return result;
        if (!root.cards || typeof root.cards !== 'object') root.cards = {};
        arr(root.cards, 'apiWriteAudit').push({
          turn: now(root),
          subsystem: 'CardApiAdapter',
          operation: result && result.action || 'unknown',
          mode: result && result.mode || 'unknown',
          ok: !!(result && result.ok),
          title: result && result.packet && result.packet.title || '',
          reason: result && result.reason || '',
          severity: result && result.ok ? 'info' : 'warn'
        });
        cap(root.cards.apiWriteAudit, 80);
        return result;
      },
      safeWrite: function(packet, root) {
        root = root || (WL.StateManager && WL.StateManager.root ? WL.StateManager.root() : null);
        // Signature lock for ReleaseCheck: addStoryCard(p.keys, p.entry, p.type); updateStoryCard(found.index, p.keys, p.entry, p.type);
        let p = this.normalizePacket(packet);
        const found = this.find(p);
        if (found.userAuthored && !this.isManagedCard(found.card, p.title)) {
          const res = { ok:false, action:'skip', mode:'user_authored_protected', packet:p, index:found.index, reason:'unmarked user-authored card with same title protected from overwrite' };
          this.audit(root, res);
          return res;
        }
        if (found.ok) {
          p = this.normalizePacket(packet, found.card);
          const current = textOfCard(found.card);
          if (hash(current) === hash(p.entry)) {
            const res = { ok:true, action:'skip', mode:'already_current', packet:p, index:found.index, reason:'rendered content unchanged' };
            this.audit(root, res);
            return res;
          }
          return this.safeUpdate(root, found.index, p, 'managed card update');
        }
        return this.safeAdd(root, p, 'managed card add');
      },
      writeManagedUserNote: function(root, title, note) {
        root = root || (WL.StateManager && WL.StateManager.root ? WL.StateManager.root() : null);
        title = norm(title || 'WorldLedger Manual Notes') || 'WorldLedger Manual Notes';
        note = String(note || '').slice(0, 2000);
        const packet = {
          title: title,
          keys: 'wl notes, command log',
          entry: title + '\n\nManual managed note.\n\n[User Notes - Preserved]\n' + note + '\n[/User Notes]\n\n[WL:id=manual_' + slug(title).slice(0,80) + ']\n[WL:family=manual]\n[WL:v=1.1]',
          type: 'WorldLedger',
          managedId: 'manual_' + slug(title).slice(0,80),
          family: 'manual',
          sourceKey: 'manual.card.' + slug(title).slice(0,80)
        };
        return this.safeWrite(packet, root);
      }
    };
