    // 25E. GeneratedCardPolicy — V1.1 Core Card System Chunk 05
    // ============================================================
    WL.GeneratedCardPolicy = {
      policyVersion: 'worldledger.generated-card-policy.v1.1.chunk05',
      ensure: function(root) {
        root = WL.FinalPlayableProfile.apply(root || WL.StateManager.root());
        if (!root.cards || typeof root.cards !== 'object') root.cards = {};
        if (!root.cards.generatedPolicy || typeof root.cards.generatedPolicy !== 'object' || Array.isArray(root.cards.generatedPolicy)) root.cards.generatedPolicy = {};
        const gp = root.cards.generatedPolicy;
        arr(gp,'pending'); arr(gp,'tombstones'); arr(gp,'audit'); arr(gp,'recentAccepted'); arr(gp,'recentRejected');
        cap(gp.pending,80); cap(gp.tombstones,80); cap(gp.audit,120); cap(gp.recentAccepted,30); cap(gp.recentRejected,30);
        return root;
      },
      normalizeCandidateName: function(name) { return norm(name || '').replace(/^WL\s+(?:Actor|Place|Item|Ability|Quest|Faction)\s+[—:-]\s*/i,'').replace(/^the\s+/i, function(m){ return m; }).trim(); },
      canonicalKey: function(family, name) { return slug((family || 'generated') + '_' + this.normalizeCandidateName(name)).slice(0,96); },
      hardDenyNames: function() { return ['worldledger','aidrpg','system','debug','audit','state','context','memory','story','command','input','output','null','undefined','unknown','player','you','your','me','myself','inventory','quest','skill','magic','card','story card']; },
      actorJunk: function() { return ['guard','guards','old guards','man','woman','person','people','stranger','someone','somebody','voice','figure','shadow','merchant','worker','villager','villagers','bandit','bandits','soldier','soldiers','crowd','patrons','locals','children','animals','wolves']; },
      placeJunk: function() { return ['road','street','room','door','wall','floor','ceiling','table','chair','bed','window','forest','town','city','village','market','shop','tavern','inn','cave','hall','bridge']; },
      itemJunk: function() { return ['hand','your hand','fist','eyes','warmth','sleep','food','coin','coins','money','sword','key','dagger','clothes','bag','pocket']; },
      abilityJunk: function() { return ['magic','skill','power','attack','defense','training','level','strength','dream','wish','attempt']; },
      broadTriggers: function() { return ['worldledger','aidrpg','system','debug','audit','state','context','memory','story','player','you','quest','item','inventory','skill','magic','ability','guard','man','woman','road','street','room','door','town','city','forest','sword','key','gold','coin']; },
      listHas: function(list, value) { value = lower(value); return list.some(function(x){ return lower(x) === value; }); },
      isGenericPluralGroup: function(name) {
        const n = lower(name || '');
        if (/^the\s+[A-Z]/.test(String(name || ''))) return false;
        return /\b(?:guards|workers|people|villagers|bandits|soldiers|patrons|locals|children|animals|wolves|strangers|merchants|crowd)\b/.test(n) && !/^the\s+[a-z0-9]+\s+[a-z0-9]+/i.test(String(name || ''));
      },
      isSceneryName: function(name) {
        const n = lower(name || '');
        return this.listHas(this.placeJunk(), n) || /\b(?:road|street|room|door|wall|floor|ceiling|window|table|chair)\b/.test(n);
      },
      isJunkName: function(family, name) {
        const n = lower(this.normalizeCandidateName(name));
        if (!n || n.length > 80 || /\//.test(n) || /^\W+$/.test(n) || this.listHas(this.hardDenyNames(), n)) return true;
        if (family === 'actor' && (this.listHas(this.actorJunk(), n) || this.isGenericPluralGroup(name))) return true;
        if (family === 'faction' && (!/^the\s+\w+/i.test(String(name || '')) && this.isGenericPluralGroup(name))) return true;
        if (family === 'place' && this.isSceneryName(name)) return true;
        if (family === 'item' && this.listHas(this.itemJunk(), n)) return true;
        if (family === 'ability' && this.listHas(this.abilityJunk(), n)) return true;
        if (family === 'quest' && n === 'quest') return true;
        return false;
      },
      isBroadTrigger: function(trigger) {
        const t = lower(trigger || '');
        if (!t) return true;
        if (this.listHas(this.broadTriggers(), t)) return true;
        if (t.length < 3) return true;
        return false;
      },
      buildTriggers: function(root, family, record) {
        const name = this.normalizeCandidateName(record && (record.displayName || record.name || record.title || record.key));
        const out = [];
        function add(v){ v = norm(v); if (v && out.indexOf(v) < 0) out.push(v); }
        add(name);
        if (family === 'actor' && /\s/.test(name)) add(name.split(/\s+/).slice(-1)[0]);
        if (family === 'quest' && record && record.shortTitle) add(record.shortTitle);
        return out.filter(function(t){ return !WL.GeneratedCardPolicy.isBroadTrigger(t); }).slice(0,4).join(', ');
      },
      scoreCandidate: function(root, family, record) {
        record = record || {}; family = family || record.family || 'generated';
        const name = this.normalizeCandidateName(record.displayName || record.name || record.title || record.key);
        let score = 0; const reasons = [];
        function plus(n,r){ score += n; reasons.push('+'+n+' '+r); }
        function minus(n,r){ score -= n; reasons.push('-'+n+' '+r); }
        if (record.companion || record.party) plus(4,'party/companion');
        if (record.questTarget || record.questSource || record.questGiver) plus(4,'quest relevance');
        if (family === 'ability' && /stable|confirmed/i.test(String(record.status || record.state || ''))) plus(4,'stable ability');
        if (family === 'item' && (record.owned || record.equipped || record.keyItem || record.questCritical)) plus(4,'owned/equipped/key item');
        if (family === 'place' && (record.current || record.currentLocation)) plus(3,'current location');
        if (family === 'actor' && (record.dialogue || record.spoke || record.interacted)) plus(3,'named actor with interaction');
        if (family === 'quest' && /active|accepted/i.test(String(record.status || ''))) plus(3,'active/accepted quest');
        if (family === 'faction' && (record.organizationEvidence || record.namedOrganization)) plus(3,'named organization evidence');
        if (record.repeated || Number(record.mentions || 0) >= 2) plus(2,'repeated evidence');
        if (record.relationship || record.reputation) plus(2,'relationship relevance');
        if (record.combatRelevant) plus(2,'combat relevance');
        if (record.visibleArtifact || record.namedArtifact) plus(1,'visible named artifact');
        if (record.pinned || record.userPinned) plus(1,'user/manual interest');
        if (this.isJunkName(family, name)) minus(10,'junk/unsafe name');
        if (family === 'actor' && this.isGenericPluralGroup(name)) minus(6,'generic plural group');
        if (family === 'place' && this.isSceneryName(name)) minus(6,'scenery/common environment');
        const keys = this.buildTriggers(root, family, record);
        if (!keys) minus(6,'broad-trigger-only');
        if (record.oneOff) minus(6,'one-off mention');
        if (family === 'item' && record.visible && !record.owned && !record.questCritical && !record.keyItem) minus(8,'visible-only item');
        if (/command|audit|debug|system/i.test(String(record.sourceType || record.source || ''))) minus(10,'debug/command source');
        if (/card_prose|story_card/i.test(String(record.sourceType || record.source || ''))) minus(10,'card-prose-only source');
        if (family === 'ability' && /failed|denied|dream|quote/i.test(String(record.status || record.state || record.evidence || '')) && !/stable|confirmed/i.test(String(record.status || record.state || ''))) minus(10,'failed ability not stable');
        return { score:score, reasons:reasons, triggers:keys };
      },
      isTombstoned: function(root, family, key) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); key = slug(key || ''); family = family || 'generated';
        return (root.cards.generatedPolicy.tombstones || []).some(function(t){ return t && t.family === family && t.canonicalKey === key; });
      },
      decide: function(root, family, record, options) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); options = options || {}; record = record || {}; family = family || record.family || 'generated';
        const name = this.normalizeCandidateName(record.displayName || record.name || record.title || record.key);
        const key = this.canonicalKey(family, name);
        const scoring = this.scoreCandidate(root, family, record);
        let status = 'PENDING', reason = 'needs more evidence';
        if (/command|audit|debug|system/i.test(String(record.sourceType || record.source || ''))) { status = 'HARD_DENY'; reason = 'command/debug source denied'; }
        else if (/card_prose|story_card/i.test(String(record.sourceType || record.source || ''))) { status = 'HARD_DENY'; reason = 'raw Story Card prose source denied'; }
        else if (this.isJunkName(family, name)) { status = (family === 'faction' && /^the\s+\w+/i.test(name)) ? 'PENDING' : 'REJECT'; reason = 'junk/generic name rejected'; }
        else if (this.isTombstoned(root, family, key) && !options.forceGenerated) { status = 'REJECT'; reason = 'tombstoned candidate'; }
        else if (family === 'ability' && !/stable|confirmed/i.test(String(record.status || record.state || '')) && !record.pinned && !record.userPinned) { status = 'PENDING'; reason = 'ability candidate stays in protected summary until stable'; }
        else if (family === 'item' && record.visible && !record.owned && !record.questCritical && !record.keyItem) { status = 'PENDING'; reason = 'visible item is not owned'; }
        else if (family === 'faction' && !(record.organizationEvidence || record.namedOrganization || scoring.score >= 7)) { status = 'PENDING'; reason = 'named group needs organization evidence'; }
        else {
          const threshold = family === 'actor' ? 5 : family === 'place' ? 4 : family === 'item' ? 6 : family === 'ability' ? 6 : family === 'quest' ? 6 : family === 'faction' ? 5 : 5;
          if (family === 'item' && (record.owned || record.equipped || record.keyItem || record.questCritical) && scoring.score >= 1) status = 'ACCEPT';
          else if (family === 'quest' && /active|accepted/i.test(String(record.status || ''))) status = 'ACCEPT';
          else if (family === 'ability' && /stable|confirmed/i.test(String(record.status || record.state || ''))) status = 'ACCEPT';
          else if (scoring.score >= threshold) status = 'ACCEPT';
          else status = 'PENDING';
          reason = status === 'ACCEPT' ? 'promotion threshold passed' : 'below promotion threshold';
        }
        const decision = { ok:status === 'ACCEPT', status:status, family:family, name:name, displayName:name, canonicalKey:key, score:scoring.score, triggers:scoring.triggers, reason:reason, record:record, reasons:scoring.reasons, turn:now(root) };
        this.audit(root, decision);
        if (status === 'PENDING') this.markPending(root, decision);
        if (status === 'REJECT' || status === 'HARD_DENY') this.tombstoneRejected(root, decision);
        return decision;
      },
      shouldCreate: function(root, family, record, options) { return this.decide(root, family, record, options).status === 'ACCEPT'; },
      shouldUpdate: function(root, family, record, existingCard, options) { const d = this.decide(root, family, record, options); return d.status === 'ACCEPT' || (existingCard && d.score >= 2 && d.status !== 'HARD_DENY'); },
      markPending: function(root, decision) { root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const p = root.cards.generatedPolicy.pending; if (!p.some(function(x){ return x.family === decision.family && x.canonicalKey === decision.canonicalKey; })) p.push({ family:decision.family, canonicalKey:decision.canonicalKey, displayName:decision.displayName, reason:decision.reason, score:decision.score, turn:now(root) }); cap(p,80); },
      tombstoneRejected: function(root, decision) { root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const ts = root.cards.generatedPolicy.tombstones; if (!ts.some(function(x){ return x.family === decision.family && x.canonicalKey === decision.canonicalKey; })) ts.push({ family:decision.family, canonicalKey:decision.canonicalKey, displayName:decision.displayName, reason:decision.reason, createdTurn:now(root), manualOverrideCanRestore:false }); cap(ts,80); root.cards.generatedPolicy.recentRejected.push({ family:decision.family, name:decision.displayName, reason:decision.reason, score:decision.score }); cap(root.cards.generatedPolicy.recentRejected,30); },
      audit: function(root, decision) { root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); if (!decision || !decision.status) return decision; arr(root.cards.generatedPolicy,'audit').push({ subsystem:'GeneratedCardPolicy', family:decision.family, displayName:decision.displayName, canonicalKey:decision.canonicalKey, score:decision.score, status:decision.status, reason:decision.reason, turn:now(root) }); cap(root.cards.generatedPolicy.audit,120); if (decision.status === 'ACCEPT') { root.cards.generatedPolicy.recentAccepted.push({ family:decision.family, name:decision.displayName, score:decision.score }); cap(root.cards.generatedPolicy.recentAccepted,30); } return decision; },
      titleFor: function(family, name) { const label = family === 'actor' ? 'Actor' : family === 'place' ? 'Place' : family === 'item' ? 'Item' : family === 'ability' ? 'Ability' : family === 'quest' ? 'Quest' : family === 'faction' ? 'Faction' : 'Memory'; return 'WL ' + label + ' — ' + this.normalizeCandidateName(name); },
      recordToPacket: function(root, decision, existingText) {
        const rec = Object.assign({}, decision.record || {}); const family = decision.family; const name = decision.displayName; const id = decision.canonicalKey;
        rec.id = id; rec.managedId = id; rec.family = family; rec.name = rec.name || name; rec.title = rec.title || name;
        let entry = '';
        if (family === 'actor' && WL.CardRenderer.renderGeneratedActor) entry = WL.CardRenderer.renderGeneratedActor(root, rec, existingText || '');
        else if (family === 'place' && WL.CardRenderer.renderGeneratedPlace) entry = WL.CardRenderer.renderGeneratedPlace(root, rec, existingText || '');
        else if (family === 'item' && WL.CardRenderer.renderGeneratedItem) entry = WL.CardRenderer.renderGeneratedItem(root, rec, existingText || '');
        else if (family === 'ability' && WL.CardRenderer.renderGeneratedAbility) entry = WL.CardRenderer.renderGeneratedAbility(root, rec, existingText || '');
        else if (family === 'quest' && WL.CardRenderer.renderGeneratedQuest) entry = WL.CardRenderer.renderGeneratedQuest(root, rec, existingText || '');
        else entry = name + ' — ' + family + ' Memory\n\nKnown Facts\n- relevance confirmed by WorldLedger.\n\n[User Notes - Preserved]\n[/User Notes]\n\n[WL:id=' + id + ']\n[WL:family=' + family + ']\n[WL:v=1.1]';
        const title = this.titleFor(family, name);
        return { title:title, keys:decision.triggers || name, entry:entry, value:entry, text:entry, type:'WorldLedger', managedId:id, id:id, family:family, sourceKey:family + '.' + id, generatedDecision:decision };
      },
      buildCandidateRecords: function(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const records = [];
        function push(family, rec){ if (!rec) return; rec.family = family; records.push(rec); }
        try { (root.inventory.ownedIds || []).forEach(function(id){ const it = root.inventory.itemsById[id]; if (it && it.name) push('item', { id:id, name:it.name, owned:true, equipped:root.inventory.equipment && Object.keys(root.inventory.equipment).some(function(k){ return root.inventory.equipment[k] === id || root.inventory.equipment[k] === it.name; }), quantity:it.quantity || it.qty || 1, sourceType:'state' }); }); } catch(e) {}
        try { (root.inventory.visibleSceneItems || []).forEach(function(it){ if (it && it.name) push('item', { name:it.name, visible:true, owned:false, visibleArtifact:/\b(?:crown|artifact|relic|orb|blade|key)\b/i.test(it.name), sourceType:'state' }); }); } catch(e) {}
        try { (root.abilities.abilityIds || []).forEach(function(id){ const a = root.abilities.abilitiesById[id]; if (a && a.name) push('ability', { id:id, name:a.name, status:a.status || 'stable confirmed', state:'stable', effects:a.effects || [], sourceType:'state' }); }); } catch(e) {}
        try { (root.abilities.candidateIds || []).forEach(function(id){ const a = root.abilities.candidatesById[id]; if (a && a.name) push('ability', { id:id, name:a.name, status:a.status || 'candidate', evidence:a.evidence || 'candidate', sourceType:'state' }); }); } catch(e) {}
        try { (root.quests.activeIds || []).forEach(function(id){ const q = root.quests.questsById[id]; const nm = q && (q.title || q.name); if (nm) push('quest', { id:id, title:nm, name:nm, status:q.status || 'active', objectives:q.objectives || [], questSource:!!q.giverId, sourceType:'state' }); }); } catch(e) {}
        try { (root.actors.presentIds || []).forEach(function(id){ const a = root.actors.actorsById[id]; const nm = a && (a.name || a.displayName); if (nm) push('actor', { id:id, name:nm, displayName:nm, dialogue:!!(a.dialogue || a.spoke || a.lastSpoke), interacted:!!(a.interacted || a.recent || a.lastSeenTurn), relationship:a.relationship, mentions:a.mentions || 1, sourceType:'state' }); }); } catch(e) {}
        try { Object.keys(root.actors.actorsById || {}).forEach(function(id){ if ((root.actors.presentIds || []).indexOf(id) >= 0) return; const a = root.actors.actorsById[id]; const nm = a && (a.name || a.displayName); if (nm && (a.important || a.questGiver || a.companion)) push('actor', { id:id, name:nm, displayName:nm, questGiver:!!a.questGiver, companion:!!a.companion, mentions:a.mentions || 1, sourceType:'state' }); }); } catch(e) {}
        try { const cur = root.places.currentId && root.places.placesById[root.places.currentId]; if (cur && (cur.name || cur.displayName)) push('place', { id:root.places.currentId, name:cur.name || cur.displayName, current:true, currentLocation:true, sourceType:'state' }); } catch(e) {}
        try { (root.places.visitedIds || []).forEach(function(id){ const pl = root.places.placesById[id]; if (pl && (pl.name || pl.displayName)) push('place', { id:id, name:pl.name || pl.displayName, repeated:true, sourceType:'state' }); }); } catch(e) {}
        try { Object.keys(root.factions && root.factions.factionsById || {}).forEach(function(id){ const f = root.factions.factionsById[id]; const nm = f && (f.name || f.displayName); if (nm) push('faction', { id:id, name:nm, displayName:nm, organizationEvidence:true, namedOrganization:true, mentions:f.mentions || 1, sourceType:'state' }); }); } catch(e) {}
        return records;
      },
      buildRecords: function(root, options) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); options = options || {}; const out = [];
        const candidates = this.buildCandidateRecords(root).slice(0, Number(options.generatedCandidateScansPerTurn || root.features.generatedCandidateScansPerTurn || 12));
        for (let i=0; i<candidates.length; i++) {
          const rec = candidates[i]; const dec = this.decide(root, rec.family, rec, options);
          if (dec.status === 'ACCEPT') out.push(this.recordToPacket(root, dec, ''));
        }
        return out.sort(function(a,b){ return ((b.generatedDecision && b.generatedDecision.score) || 0) - ((a.generatedDecision && a.generatedDecision.score) || 0); });
      },
      inspectStatus: function(root) { root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const gp = root.cards.generatedPolicy || {}; return { ok:true, enabled:root.features.generatedCardsEnabled === true && root.features.generatedCardMirrorEnabled === true, promotionGated:true, createBudget:Number(root.features.generatedCardCreatesPerTurn || 1), updateBudget:Number(root.features.generatedCardUpdatesPerTurn || 4), pendingCount:(gp.pending||[]).length, tombstoneCount:(gp.tombstones||[]).length, recentAccepted:(gp.recentAccepted||[]).slice(-5), recentRejected:(gp.recentRejected||[]).slice(-5), broadTriggerDenyListLoaded:this.broadTriggers().length > 5, junkNameFiltersLoaded:this.actorJunk().length > 5, warnings:[], errors:[] }; },
      inspect: function(root) { root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const s = this.inspectStatus(root); const rows=[], add=function(ok,label){ rows.push({ status:ok?'PASS':'FAIL', label:label }); }; add(s.enabled === true, 'generated cards disabled or unsafe'); add(s.promotionGated === true, 'generated cards are promotion-gated'); add(s.createBudget <= 1, 'generated create budget defaults to 1 per turn'); add(this.isJunkName('actor','old guards') === true, 'generic plural actor/group rejected'); add(this.isJunkName('place','road') === true && this.isJunkName('place','door') === true && this.isJunkName('place','room') === true, 'generic scenery place names rejected'); add(this.isBroadTrigger('WorldLedger') === true && this.isBroadTrigger('guard') === true && this.isBroadTrigger('magic') === true, 'broad/internal triggers denied'); add(this.decide(root,'ability',{ name:'Ember Ward', status:'failed once', sourceType:'state' }).status !== 'ACCEPT', 'failed ability does not become generated stable card'); add(this.decide(root,'item',{ name:'Crown of Dawn', visible:true, owned:false, sourceType:'state' }).status !== 'ACCEPT', 'visible-only item not generated as owned item'); return rows; },
      runV11GeneratedCardTests: function() {
        const rows=[], add=function(id,ok,label){ rows.push({ id:id, ok:!!ok, label:label }); };
        const ps=globalThis.state, pc=globalThis.storyCards;
        try { globalThis.state={}; globalThis.storyCards=[]; const root=WL.StateManager.root(); root.features.generatedCardCreatesPerTurn=1; root.features.generatedCardUpdatesPerTurn=4;
          let d=this.decide(root,'actor',{ name:'old guards', sourceType:'state' }); add('V11-GEN-001', d.status !== 'ACCEPT', 'generic plural actor rejected');
          d=this.decide(root,'actor',{ name:'Old Man Gerrik', dialogue:true, interacted:true, questSource:true, mentions:2, sourceType:'state' }); add('V11-GEN-002', d.status === 'ACCEPT' || d.status === 'PENDING', 'named actor allowed/pending, not hard-denied');
          add('V11-GEN-003', this.decide(root,'place',{ name:'road', sourceType:'state' }).status !== 'ACCEPT' && this.decide(root,'place',{ name:'door', sourceType:'state' }).status !== 'ACCEPT' && this.decide(root,'place',{ name:'room', sourceType:'state' }).status !== 'ACCEPT', 'scenery place cards rejected');
          add('V11-GEN-004', this.decide(root,'place',{ name:'The Sturdy Oak', current:true, repeated:true, sourceType:'state' }).status === 'ACCEPT', 'named current/repeated place accepted');
          add('V11-GEN-005', this.decide(root,'item',{ name:'Crown of Dawn', visible:true, owned:false, sourceType:'state' }).status !== 'ACCEPT', 'visible-only item not generated as owned card');
          add('V11-GEN-006', this.decide(root,'item',{ name:'Rusty Dagger', owned:true, equipped:'main hand', sourceType:'state' }).status === 'ACCEPT', 'owned/equipped item accepted');
          add('V11-GEN-007', this.decide(root,'ability',{ name:'Ember Ward', status:'failed once', sourceType:'state' }).status !== 'ACCEPT', 'failed ability not generated stable');
          add('V11-GEN-008', this.decide(root,'ability',{ name:'Ember Ward', status:'stable confirmed', state:'stable', sourceType:'state' }).status === 'ACCEPT', 'stable ability accepted');
          add('V11-GEN-009', this.isBroadTrigger('WorldLedger') && this.isBroadTrigger('player') && this.isBroadTrigger('guard') && !this.isBroadTrigger('Old Man Gerrik'), 'broad triggers denied while specific triggers allowed');
          const before=(root.cards.generatedPolicy.tombstones||[]).length; this.decide(root,'actor',{ name:'old guards', sourceType:'state' }); const after=(root.cards.generatedPolicy.tombstones||[]).length; add('V11-GEN-010', after >= before, 'tombstone/audit path records rejected junk');
          root.inventory.itemsById.dagger={ name:'Rusty Dagger', quantity:1 }; root.inventory.itemsById.key={ name:'Iron Key', quantity:1, keyItem:true }; root.inventory.ownedIds=['dagger','key']; const recs=this.buildRecords(root,{}); add('V11-GEN-011', recs.length <= 2 && recs.every(function(r){ return /^WL (?:Item|Actor|Place|Ability|Quest|Faction) — /.test(r.title); }), 'generated records are bounded and player-readable');
          add('V11-GEN-012', this.decide(root,'actor',{ name:'Audit Goblin', sourceType:'command_output' }).status === 'HARD_DENY', 'command output source denied');
        } catch(e) { add('V11-GEN-ERR', false, 'GeneratedCardPolicy self-test exception: '+(e && e.message || e)); }
        finally { globalThis.state=ps; globalThis.storyCards=pc; }
        return rows;
      }
    };

    // Live editable Story Card memory writer: native V1.0.5 CardSyncLite owner.
    WL.CardSyncLite = {
      ensure: function(root) {
        root = WL.FinalPlayableProfile.apply(root || WL.StateManager.root());
        if (WL.CardRegistry && typeof WL.CardRegistry.ensure === 'function') WL.CardRegistry.ensure(root);
        if (!root.cards || typeof root.cards !== 'object') root.cards = {};
        arr(root.cards,'liveWriteAudit'); arr(root.cards,'syncAudit'); arr(root.cards,'dirtyProtected');
        if (!root.cards.hashes || typeof root.cards.hashes !== 'object' || Array.isArray(root.cards.hashes)) root.cards.hashes = {};
        return root;
      },
      makeProtectedRecord: function(root, title, idx) {
        title = title || 'WL — Managed Card';
        return { id:'protected_legacy_' + slug(title).slice(0,80), key:'protected_legacy_' + slug(title).slice(0,80), cardKey:'protected_legacy_' + slug(title).slice(0,80), sourceKey:'protected.' + slug(title).slice(0,80), family:'protected', title:title, name:title, keys:title, type:'WorldLedger', renderer:'renderSettings', priority:20, protected:true, singleton:true, dirty:true, tombstoned:false, lastSyncedTurn:0 };
      },
      normalizeProtectedRecord: function(root, rec, idx) {
        rec = rec && typeof rec === 'object' && !Array.isArray(rec) ? rec : {};
        if (rec.id && WL.CardRegistry && WL.CardRegistry.protectedDefinitionById) {
          const def = WL.CardRegistry.protectedDefinitionById(rec.id, root || WL.StateManager.root());
          if (def) return Object.assign({}, rec, { id:def.id, key:def.id, cardKey:def.id, sourceKey:'protected.' + def.id, family:def.family, title:def.title, name:def.title, keys:def.keys, type:def.type, renderer:def.renderer, priority:def.priority, protected:true, singleton:true });
        }
        const title = rec.title || rec.name || (WL.PROTECTED_CARD_KEYS || [])[idx || 0] || 'WL — Managed Card';
        return Object.assign(this.makeProtectedRecord(root, title, idx || 0), rec, { title:title, name:title, protected:true, type:rec.type || 'WorldLedger' });
      },
      getBudgets: function(root, options) {
        root = this.ensure(root); options = options || {};
        const mode = WL.CONTEXT_MODES[root.features.contextMode] || WL.CONTEXT_MODES.high || {};
        return {
          scan: Number(options.scanBudget || root.features.cardScanBudget || 20),
          cleanup: Number(options.cleanupBudget || root.features.cardCleanupBudget || 5),
          protectedWrites: Number(options.protectedCardUpdatesPerTurn || root.features.protectedCardUpdatesPerTurn || 9),
          generatedCreates: Number(options.generatedCardCreatesPerTurn || root.features.generatedCardCreatesPerTurn || mode.generatedCreatesPerHook || 1),
          generatedUpdates: Number(options.generatedCardUpdatesPerTurn || root.features.generatedCardUpdatesPerTurn || mode.generatedUpdatesPerHook || 4),
          totalWrites: Number(options.cardWriteBudget || root.features.cardWriteBudget || 8)
        };
      },
      protectedRegistry: function(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root());
        if (WL.CardRegistry && typeof WL.CardRegistry.protectedDefinitions === 'function') return WL.CardRegistry.protectedDefinitions(root).map(function(def){
          return { id:def.id, key:def.id, cardKey:def.id, sourceKey:'protected.' + def.id, family:def.family, title:def.title, name:def.title, keys:def.keys, type:def.type, renderer:def.renderer, priority:def.priority, protected:true, singleton:true, marker:def.marker, dirty:true, tombstoned:false, lastSyncedTurn:0 };
        });
        return [];
      },
      markProtectedDirty: function(root, id, reason, priority) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root());
        id = norm(id || 'protected_player_sheet');
        const q = arr(root.cards,'dirtyProtected');
        let found = null;
        for (let i=0; i<q.length; i++) if (q[i] && q[i].id === id) { found = q[i]; break; }
        if (!found) { found = { id:id, reason:reason || 'dirty', priority:Number(priority || 50), createdTurn:now(root), retryCount:0 }; q.push(found); }
        else { found.reason = found.reason === reason ? found.reason : (found.reason + '; ' + (reason || 'dirty')).slice(0,220); found.priority = Math.max(Number(found.priority || 0), Number(priority || 50)); }
        cap(q, 80);
        return found;
      },
      forceDirtyProtected: function(root, reason) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root());
        const defs = WL.CardRegistry && WL.CardRegistry.protectedDefinitions ? WL.CardRegistry.protectedDefinitions(root) : [];
        for (let i=0; i<defs.length; i++) this.markProtectedDirty(root, defs[i].id, reason || 'force protected sync', defs[i].priority || 50);
        return defs.length;
      },
      consumeDirtyProtected: function(root, options) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root());
        options = options || {};
        const defs = this.protectedRegistry(root);
        if (options.force || options.forceProtected) {
          return defs.slice().sort(function(a,b){ return (b.priority||0)-(a.priority||0); });
        }
        const dirty = arr(root.cards,'dirtyProtected');
        const dirtyIds = {};
        dirty.forEach(function(d){ if (d && d.id) dirtyIds[d.id] = true; });
        // Also honor older DirtyQueue records without creating a second queue.
        try {
          (root.dirty && root.dirty.records || []).forEach(function(d){
            const s = lower((d && (d.family + ' ' + d.reason + ' ' + d.targetKey)) || '');
            if (/player|profile|protected_player_sheet/.test(s)) dirtyIds.protected_player_sheet = true;
            if (/body|injur|condition/.test(s)) dirtyIds.protected_body_status = true;
            if (/inventory|item|equipment/.test(s)) dirtyIds.protected_inventory_equipment = true;
            if (/abilit|training|skill/.test(s)) dirtyIds.protected_abilities_training = true;
            if (/quest/.test(s)) dirtyIds.protected_quest_log = true;
            if (/actor|social|party/.test(s)) dirtyIds.protected_actors_social = true;
            if (/place|time|location|scene/.test(s)) dirtyIds.protected_places_time = true;
          });
        } catch(e) {}
        if (!Object.keys(dirtyIds).length) return [];
        return defs.filter(function(d){ return dirtyIds[d.id]; }).sort(function(a,b){ return (b.priority||0)-(a.priority||0); });
      },
      clearDirtyProtected: function(root, id) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root());
        root.cards.dirtyProtected = (root.cards.dirtyProtected || []).filter(function(d){ return d && d.id !== id; });
      },
      renderProtectedRecord: function(root, rec) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root());
        let def = null;
        if (WL.CardRegistry && typeof WL.CardRegistry.protectedDefinitionById === 'function') def = WL.CardRegistry.protectedDefinitionById(rec && (rec.id || rec.key || rec.cardKey || rec.protectedKey), root);
        if (!def && rec && rec.renderer) def = { id:rec.id || rec.key || rec.cardKey || slug(rec.title || 'protected'), family:rec.family || 'protected', title:rec.title, renderer:rec.renderer, type:rec.type || 'WorldLedger', keys:rec.keys || rec.title };
        def = def || { id:rec && (rec.id || rec.key || rec.cardKey || rec.sourceKey) || 'protected_settings', family:rec && rec.family || 'settings', title:rec && rec.title || 'WL — WorldLedger Settings', renderer:rec && rec.renderer || 'renderSettings', type:rec && rec.type || 'WorldLedger', keys:rec && rec.keys || 'wl settings' };
        const found = WL.CardRegistry && WL.CardRegistry.findManagedCard ? WL.CardRegistry.findManagedCard(root, def) : { ok:false, card:null };
        const existingText = found && found.ok ? textOfCard(found.card) : '';
        const rendered = WL.CardRenderer && typeof WL.CardRenderer.renderProtected === 'function' ? WL.CardRenderer.renderProtected(def, root, existingText) : ((def.title || 'WorldLedger managed card') + '\n\n' + (WL.CardRegistry && WL.CardRegistry.footerMarkers ? WL.CardRegistry.footerMarkers(def) : ''));
        const title = WL.CardRegistry && WL.CardRegistry.makeTitle ? WL.CardRegistry.makeTitle(def, root) : (def.title || 'WorldLedger Managed Card');
        const keys = WL.CardRegistry && WL.CardRegistry.makeKeys ? WL.CardRegistry.makeKeys(def, root) : (def.keys || title);
        return { title:title, keys:keys, entry:rendered, value:rendered, text:rendered, type:def.type || 'WorldLedger', managedId:def.id, id:def.id, family:def.family, sourceKey:'protected.' + def.id, priority:def.priority || 50 };
      },
      syncOneProtected: function(root, def, options) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); options = options || {};
        const packet = this.renderProtectedRecord(root, def);
        const renderHash = hash(packet.entry);
        const last = WL.CardRegistry && WL.CardRegistry.lastHash ? WL.CardRegistry.lastHash(root, packet.managedId) : root.cards.hashes[packet.managedId];
        const found = WL.CardRegistry && WL.CardRegistry.findManagedCard ? WL.CardRegistry.findManagedCard(root, def) : WL.CardApiAdapter.find(packet);
        if (!options.force && last === renderHash && found && found.ok && hash(textOfCard(found.card)) === renderHash) {
          this.audit(root, { operation:'syncProtected', target:packet.managedId, result:'skipped', reason:'already_current', hash:renderHash, severity:'info' });
          this.clearDirtyProtected(root, packet.managedId);
          return { ok:true, action:'skipped', target:packet.managedId, title:packet.title, hash:renderHash };
        }
        const opKey = 'card.write.' + slug(packet.managedId || packet.sourceKey || packet.title) + '.' + renderHash;
        if (!options.force && WL.OperationLedger && WL.OperationLedger.hasRecent && WL.OperationLedger.hasRecent(root, opKey)) {
          this.audit(root, { operation:'syncProtected', target:packet.managedId, result:'skipped', reason:'duplicate_recent', hash:renderHash, severity:'info' });
          return { ok:true, action:'skipped', target:packet.managedId, title:packet.title, hash:renderHash };
        }
        if (WL.OperationLedger && WL.OperationLedger.addRecent) WL.OperationLedger.addRecent(root, opKey);
        const result = WL.CardApiAdapter.safeWrite(packet, root);
        if (result.ok && result.action !== 'skip') {
          if (WL.CardRegistry && WL.CardRegistry.setLastHash) WL.CardRegistry.setLastHash(root, packet.managedId, renderHash);
          else root.cards.hashes[packet.managedId] = renderHash;
          this.clearDirtyProtected(root, packet.managedId);
        }
        this.audit(root, { operation:'syncProtected', target:packet.managedId, result:result.ok ? (result.action || 'written') : 'error', reason:result.reason || result.mode || '', hash:renderHash, severity:result.ok ? 'info' : 'error', title:packet.title });
        return Object.assign({ target:packet.managedId, title:packet.title, hash:renderHash }, result);
      },
      syncProtected: function(root, options) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); options = options || {};
        const budgets = this.getBudgets(root, options);
        const defs = this.consumeDirtyProtected(root, options);
        const protectedLimit = (options.force || options.forceProtected) ? defs.length : Math.max(0, budgets.protectedWrites);
        const selected = defs.slice(0, protectedLimit);
        const out = { ok:true, planned:defs.length, checked:selected.length, written:0, skipped:0, errors:[], warnings:[] };
        for (let i=0; i<selected.length; i++) {
          const r = this.syncOneProtected(root, selected[i], options);
          if (r.ok && /add|update|written/.test(String(r.action || r.result || ''))) out.written++;
          else if (r.ok) out.skipped++;
          else out.errors.push(r.reason || r.error || 'write failed');
        }
        return out;
      },
      makeGeneratedMirrorRecords: function(root, options) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); options = options || {};
        if (WL.GeneratedCardPolicy && typeof WL.GeneratedCardPolicy.buildRecords === 'function') return WL.GeneratedCardPolicy.buildRecords(root, options);
        return [];
      },
      syncGenerated: function(root, options) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); options = options || {};
        if (!root.features.generatedCardsEnabled || !root.features.generatedCardMirrorEnabled) return { ok:true, planned:0, written:0, skipped:0, disabled:true };
        const budgets = this.getBudgets(root, options);
        const records = this.makeGeneratedMirrorRecords(root, options);
        const out = { ok:true, planned:records.length, written:0, skipped:0, accepted:0, pending:0, rejected:0, errors:[] };
        let creates = Math.max(0, budgets.generatedCreates), updates = Math.max(0, budgets.generatedUpdates);
        for (let i=0; i<records.length; i++) {
          const packet = records[i];
          const existing = WL.CardApiAdapter.find(packet);
          const isUpdate = existing && existing.ok;
          if (isUpdate) { if (updates <= 0) { out.skipped++; continue; } }
          else { if (creates <= 0 && !options.forceGenerated) { out.skipped++; continue; } }
          const check = this.shouldWrite(root, packet);
          if (!check.ok && !options.forceGenerated) { out.skipped++; continue; }
          if (WL.OperationLedger && WL.OperationLedger.addRecent) WL.OperationLedger.addRecent(root, check.key);
          const result = WL.CardApiAdapter.safeWrite(packet, root);
          arr(root.cards,'liveWriteAudit').push(Object.assign({ turn:now(root), key:check.key, title:packet.title, generatedDecision:packet.generatedDecision && packet.generatedDecision.status }, result));
          cap(root.cards.liveWriteAudit,80);
          if (result.ok && result.action !== 'skip') { out.written++; if (isUpdate) updates--; else creates--; }
          else out.skipped++;
        }
        return out;
      },
      shouldWrite: function(root, packet) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root());
        const p = WL.CardApiAdapter.normalizePacket(packet, null);
        const key = 'card.write.' + slug(p.sourceKey || p.mirrorId || p.managedId) + '.' + hash(p.entry);
        if (WL.OperationLedger && WL.OperationLedger.hasRecent && WL.OperationLedger.hasRecent(root, key)) return { ok:false, key:key, reason:'duplicate_recent' };
        const found = WL.CardApiAdapter.find(p);
        if (found.ok) { const current = WL.CardApiAdapter.normalizePacket(packet, found.card); if (hash(textOfCard(found.card)) === hash(current.entry)) return { ok:false, key:key, reason:'already_current' }; }
        if (found.userAuthored) return { ok:false, key:key, reason:'user_authored_same_title' };
        return { ok:true, key:key, reason:'write_needed' };
      },
      sync: function(root, options) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); options = options || {};
        if (!root.features.liveCardMirrorEnabled || !root.features.storyCardWritesEnabled) return { ok:false, mode:'disabled', protectedWritten:0, generatedWritten:0, errors:['live card memory disabled'] };
        const budgets = this.getBudgets(root, options);
        const cleanup = WL.CardApiAdapter.cleanStoryCardArray(root, { cleanupBudget:budgets.cleanup });
        if (options.force || options.forceProtected) this.forceDirtyProtected(root, options.reason || 'manual force sync');
        const protectedResult = this.syncProtected(root, options);
        let generatedResult = { ok:true, planned:0, written:0, skipped:0 };
        if (root.features.generatedCardMirrorEnabled && (budgets.protectedWrites - protectedResult.written) > 0) generatedResult = this.syncGenerated(root, options);
        const result = {
          ok: protectedResult.ok !== false && generatedResult.ok !== false,
          mode: 'live',
          cleanup: cleanup,
          protectedPlanned: protectedResult.planned,
          protectedWritten: protectedResult.written,
          protectedSkipped: protectedResult.skipped,
          generatedPlanned: generatedResult.planned,
          generatedWritten: generatedResult.written,
          generatedSkipped: generatedResult.skipped,
          errors: (protectedResult.errors || []).concat(generatedResult.errors || []),
          warnings: [],
          budget: budgets
        };
        root.cards.lastSync = result;
        this.audit(root, { operation:'sync', target:'all', result:result.ok ? 'ok' : 'error', reason:'protected=' + result.protectedWritten + ', generated=' + result.generatedWritten, severity:result.ok ? 'info' : 'error' });
        return result;
      },
      processDirtyQueue: function(root, options) { return this.sync(root, options || {}); },
      planProtectedWrites: function(root, options) { return this.consumeDirtyProtected(root, options || {}); },
      refreshIndex: function(root) { root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); return WL.CardApiAdapter.snapshot(root); },
      cleanInvalidStoryCards: function(root, options) { return WL.CardApiAdapter.cleanStoryCardArray(root || WL.StateManager.root(), options || {}); },
      syncEditablePlayerSheet: function(root) {
        // Legacy-compatible safe profile import only. Full manual import is owned by Chunk 7 ManagedCardEditImporter.
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root());
        const def = WL.CardRegistry && WL.CardRegistry.protectedDefinitionById ? WL.CardRegistry.protectedDefinitionById('protected_player_sheet', root) : null;
        let found = def && WL.CardRegistry.findManagedCard ? WL.CardRegistry.findManagedCard(root, def) : WL.CardApiAdapter.find({ title:'WorldLedger Player', sourceKey:'protected.worldledger_player', managedId:'protected_player_sheet' });
        if (!found || !found.ok) found = WL.CardApiAdapter.find({ title:'WorldLedger Player', sourceKey:'protected.worldledger_player', managedId:'protected_worldledger_player' });
        if (!found || !found.ok) {
          const cards = WL.CardApiAdapter.cards();
          for (let i=0; i<cards.length; i++) { const blob = textOfCard(cards[i]) + '\n' + String(cards[i] && (cards[i].keys || cards[i].title || cards[i].name) || ''); if (/protected_worldledger_player|WorldLedger Player/i.test(blob)) { found = { ok:true, card:cards[i], index:i, match:'legacyEditablePlayerFallback' }; break; } }
        }
        if (!found || !found.ok) return { applied:0 };
        const raw = WL.CardApiAdapter.extractUserNotes(textOfCard(found.card)) || textOfCard(found.card);
        const patch = {};
        function grab(rx, key) { const m = raw.match(rx); if (m && norm(m[1])) patch[key] = norm(m[1]); }
        grab(/^\s*Name\s*:\s*(.+)$/mi, 'name');
        grab(/^\s*Pronouns\s*:\s*(.+)$/mi, 'pronouns');
        grab(/^\s*(?:Race|Species|Race\/Species)\s*:\s*(.+)$/mi, 'speciesLabel');
        grab(/^\s*(?:Class|Specialization)\s*:\s*(.+)$/mi, 'classLabel');
        grab(/^\s*Appearance\s*:\s*(.+)$/mi, 'appearance');
        const res = WL.PlayerProfile && WL.PlayerProfile.applyProfilePatch ? WL.PlayerProfile.applyProfilePatch(root, patch, 'legacy_editable_player_card') : { imported:[] };
        if (patch.speciesLabel) { root.player.raceSpecies = patch.speciesLabel; root.player.species = patch.speciesLabel; root.player.race = patch.speciesLabel; }
        const applied = res && res.imported ? res.imported.length : 0;
        if (applied && WL.AuditLogger) WL.AuditLogger.append(root,'cards',{ message:'Applied safe legacy editable player card profile fields: ' + applied },50);
        return { applied:applied, result:res };
      },
      liveSync: function(root, opts) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root());
        opts = Object.assign({ reason:'liveSync' }, opts || {});
        const result = this.sync(root, opts);
        const writes = (result.protectedWritten || 0) + (result.generatedWritten || 0);
        if (writes && WL.AuditLogger) WL.AuditLogger.append(root,'cards',{ message:'Live Story Card memory writes: '+writes },50);
        return writes;
      },
      dryRun: function(root) { return this.liveSync(root || WL.StateManager.root(), { reason:'dryRun alias uses live memory in final profile' }); },
      audit: function(root, entry) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root());
        if (entry && typeof entry === 'object' && entry.operation) {
          arr(root.cards,'syncAudit').push(Object.assign({ turn:now(root), subsystem:'CardSyncLite' }, entry));
          cap(root.cards.syncAudit,80);
          return entry;
        }
        const inspect = this.inspectStatus(root);
        const last = root.cards.lastSync || {};
        return [
          'Mode: LIVE EDITABLE STORY CARD MEMORY',
          'Dry-run: ' + inspect.dryRun + ', SafeMode: ' + inspect.safeMode,
          'Protected definitions: ' + inspect.protectedDefinitions,
          'Protected dirty: ' + inspect.protectedDirty,
          'Generated cards: ' + (inspect.generatedEnabled ? 'ON / promotion-gated' : 'OFF'),
          'API: add=' + inspect.api.addStoryCard + ', update=' + inspect.api.updateStoryCard + ', remove=' + inspect.api.removeStoryCard + ', fallback=' + inspect.api.fallbackArrayAvailable,
          'Budgets: protected=' + inspect.budgets.protectedCardUpdatesPerTurn + ', generated creates=' + inspect.budgets.generatedCardCreatesPerTurn + ', updates=' + inspect.budgets.generatedCardUpdatesPerTurn,
          'Last sync: protected written=' + (last.protectedWritten || 0) + ', generated written=' + (last.generatedWritten || 0),
          'Recent sync audit records: ' + ((root.cards.syncAudit||[]).length),
          'Manual Story Card editing: ON',
          'User-authored cards protected: ON',
          'User Notes preserved: ON',
          'Raw card mechanics auto-import: BLOCKED'
        ];
      },
      inspectStatus: function(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root());
        const budgets = this.getBudgets(root, {});
        const caps = WL.CardApiAdapter.capabilities(root);
        return {
          ok: true,
          live: root.features.liveCardMirrorEnabled === true && root.features.storyCardWritesEnabled === true,
          dryRun: Boolean(root.features.cardSyncDryRun),
          safeMode: root.features.cardSyncSafeMode === true,
          protectedDefinitions: WL.CardRegistry && WL.CardRegistry.protectedDefinitions ? WL.CardRegistry.protectedDefinitions(root).length : 0,
          protectedDirty: (root.cards.dirtyProtected || []).length,
          generatedEnabled: root.features.generatedCardsEnabled === true && root.features.generatedCardMirrorEnabled === true,
          generatedPromotionGated: true,
          api: caps,
          budgets: {
            protectedCardUpdatesPerTurn: budgets.protectedWrites,
            generatedCardCreatesPerTurn: budgets.generatedCreates,
            generatedCardUpdatesPerTurn: budgets.generatedUpdates
          },
          lastSync: root.cards.lastSync || {},
          warnings: [],
          errors: []
        };
      },
      inspect: function(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root());
        const s = this.inspectStatus(root);
        const rows = [], add = function(ok, label){ rows.push({ status: ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', label: label }); };
        add(s.live === true, 'live editable Story Card memory ON');
        add(s.dryRun === false, 'cardSyncDryRun false by default');
        add(s.safeMode === false, 'cardSyncSafeMode false by default');
        add(s.protectedDefinitions === 9, 'nine V1.1 protected card definitions available');
        add(WL.CardRegistry && typeof WL.CardRegistry.findManagedCard === 'function', 'CardRegistry marker-first managed card lookup present');
        add(WL.CardRenderer && typeof WL.CardRenderer.renderProtected === 'function', 'CardRenderer protected render path present');
        add(WL.CardApiAdapter && typeof WL.CardApiAdapter.safeWrite === 'function' && typeof WL.CardApiAdapter.cleanStoryCardArray === 'function', 'CardApiAdapter safe write and cleanup path present');
        add(WL.CardApiAdapter.safeWrite.toString().indexOf('addStoryCard(p.keys, p.entry, p.type)') >= 0, 'addStoryCard argument order is keys, entry, type');
        add(WL.CardApiAdapter.safeWrite.toString().indexOf('updateStoryCard(found.index, p.keys, p.entry, p.type)') >= 0 || WL.CardApiAdapter.update.toString().indexOf('updateStoryCard(index, p.keys, p.entry, p.type)') >= 0, 'updateStoryCard argument order is index, keys, entry, type');
        add(root.features.manualStoryCardEditingEnabled === true, 'manual Story Card editing allowed');
        add(root.features.userAuthoredStoryCardsProtected === true, 'user-authored cards protected from automatic overwrite');
        add(root.features.preserveUserCardNotes === true, 'managed card User Notes preservation ON');
        add(root.features.storyCardAutoMechanicsImportBlocked === true, 'raw card mechanics auto-import guarded');
        add(root.features.cardMirrorDedupeEnabled === true, 'card mirror dedupe enabled');
        add(WL.GeneratedCardPolicy && WL.GeneratedCardPolicy.inspect(root).filter(function(r){ return r.status === 'FAIL'; }).length === 0, 'GeneratedCardPolicy promotion gates pass');
        add(s.budgets.protectedCardUpdatesPerTurn >= 1 && s.budgets.generatedCardCreatesPerTurn <= 1, 'CardSync generated create budget is conservative');
        return rows;
      },
      runV11CardSyncTests: function() {
        const rows = [], add = function(id, ok, label){ rows.push({ id:id, ok:!!ok, label:label }); };
        const ps = globalThis.state, pc = globalThis.storyCards, pa = globalThis.addStoryCard, pu = globalThis.updateStoryCard, pr = globalThis.removeStoryCard;
        try {
          globalThis.state = {};
          globalThis.storyCards = [];
          globalThis.addStoryCard = function(keys, entry, type){ globalThis.storyCards.push({ title:'', keys:keys, entry:entry, type:type }); };
          globalThis.updateStoryCard = function(index, keys, entry, type){ globalThis.storyCards[index] = Object.assign({}, globalThis.storyCards[index] || {}, { keys:keys, entry:entry, type:type }); };
          globalThis.removeStoryCard = function(index){ globalThis.storyCards.splice(index,1); };
          let root = WL.StateManager.root();
          WL.PlayerProfile.applyIdentityCandidate(root, { name:'Zack', confidence:100, source:'test', pattern:'test' }, 'test');
          this.forceDirtyProtected(root, 'test force');
          const r1 = this.sync(root, { force:true });
          add('V11-SYNC-001', r1.protectedPlanned >= 9 && r1.protectedWritten >= 1, '/synccards-style force sync plans protected cards');
          add('V11-SYNC-002', globalThis.storyCards.some(function(c){ return /\[WL:id=protected_player_sheet\]/.test(textOfCard(c)); }), 'Player Sheet written with stable WL marker');
          const sheet = globalThis.storyCards.filter(function(c){ return /\[WL:id=protected_player_sheet\]/.test(textOfCard(c)); })[0];
          sheet.entry = String(sheet.entry || '').replace(/\[User Notes - Preserved\][\s\S]*?\[\/User Notes\]/i, '[User Notes - Preserved]\nZack hates being called a hero.\n[/User Notes]');
          this.forceDirtyProtected(root, 'note preserve');
          this.sync(root, { force:true });
          add('V11-SYNC-003', globalThis.storyCards.some(function(c){ return /Zack hates being called a hero/.test(textOfCard(c)); }), 'User Notes preserved across protected sync');
          const count = globalThis.storyCards.length;
          this.sync(root, {});
          add('V11-SYNC-004', globalThis.storyCards.length <= count + 1, 'repeated sync is idempotent/no protected card storm');
          globalThis.storyCards.push(null, 'bad', [], { title:'OK', keys:'ok', entry:'ok' });
          const clean = WL.CardApiAdapter.cleanStoryCardArray(root, { cleanupBudget:5 });
          add('V11-SYNC-005', clean.cleaned >= 3, 'invalid storyCards entries cleaned/skipped safely');
          const before = { title:'Zack Journal', entry:'User-authored text, keep this.' };
          globalThis.storyCards.push(before);
          const wr = WL.CardApiAdapter.safeWrite({ title:'Zack Journal', entry:'script attempt', sourceKey:'script.zack_journal' }, root);
          add('V11-SYNC-006', wr.ok === false && before.entry === 'User-authored text, keep this.', 'user-authored same-title card protected from overwrite');
          add('V11-SYNC-007', WL.CardApiAdapter.safeWrite.toString().indexOf('addStoryCard(p.keys, p.entry, p.type)') >= 0, 'addStoryCard uses keys, entry, type');
          add('V11-SYNC-008', WL.CardApiAdapter.safeWrite.toString().indexOf('updateStoryCard(found.index, p.keys, p.entry, p.type)') >= 0 || WL.CardApiAdapter.update.toString().indexOf('updateStoryCard(index, p.keys, p.entry, p.type)') >= 0, 'updateStoryCard uses index, keys, entry, type');
        } catch(e) { add('V11-SYNC-ERR', false, 'CardSync self-test exception: ' + (e && e.message || e)); }
        finally {
          globalThis.state = ps;
          if (typeof pc === 'undefined') { try { delete globalThis.storyCards; } catch(e) { globalThis.storyCards = pc; } } else globalThis.storyCards = pc;
          if (typeof pa === 'undefined') { try { delete globalThis.addStoryCard; } catch(e) { globalThis.addStoryCard = pa; } } else globalThis.addStoryCard = pa;
          if (typeof pu === 'undefined') { try { delete globalThis.updateStoryCard; } catch(e) { globalThis.updateStoryCard = pu; } } else globalThis.updateStoryCard = pu;
          if (typeof pr === 'undefined') { try { delete globalThis.removeStoryCard; } catch(e) { globalThis.removeStoryCard = pr; } } else globalThis.removeStoryCard = pr;
        }
        return rows;
      }
    };

    // Native context builder with High/Medium/Small budgeting; read-only by itself.
    WL.ContextBuilderLite.build = function(root, baseText) {
      root = WL.FinalPlayableProfile.apply(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const m=WL.CONTEXT_MODES[root.features.contextMode] || WL.CONTEXT_MODES.high;
      const parts=['[WorldLedger Context Mode: '+m.label+' | Live updates ON | Story Cards are canon memory]','WorldLedger Current Truth:'];
      parts.push('Player: '+(root.player.name||'Unknown')+' | Level '+(root.player.level||1)+' | HP/MP/EP '+root.body.hp+'/'+root.body.maxHp+' '+root.body.mp+'/'+root.body.maxMp+' '+root.body.ep+'/'+root.body.maxEp);
      const place=root.places.currentId && root.places.placesById[root.places.currentId]; if (place) parts.push('Current place: '+(place.name||place.displayName||root.places.currentId));
      const items=(root.inventory.ownedIds||[]).map(id => root.inventory.itemsById[id] && root.inventory.itemsById[id].name).filter(Boolean).slice(0,12); if (items.length) parts.push('Owned inventory: '+items.join(', '));
      const cands=(root.abilities.candidateIds||[]).map(id => root.abilities.candidatesById[id] && root.abilities.candidatesById[id].name).filter(Boolean).slice(0,8); if (cands.length) parts.push('Ability candidates, not stable: '+cands.join(', '));
      const stable=(root.abilities.abilityIds||[]).map(id => root.abilities.abilitiesById[id] && root.abilities.abilitiesById[id].name).filter(Boolean).slice(0,8); if (stable.length) parts.push('Stable abilities: '+stable.join(', '));
      const quests=(root.quests.activeIds||[]).map(id => { const q=root.quests.questsById[id]; return q && (q.title || q.name); }).filter(Boolean).slice(0,8); if (quests.length) parts.push('Active quests: '+quests.join('; '));
      if (root.body.conditions && root.body.conditions.length) parts.push('Conditions: '+root.body.conditions.slice(0,8).join(', ')); if (root.body.injuries && root.body.injuries.length) parts.push('Injuries: '+root.body.injuries.slice(0,8).join(', '));
      parts.push('Rules: Story Cards are canon memory, but raw card/context/command/quote/rumor/dream text does not auto-fire mechanics. Output confirms consequences. Promises are not payments. Visible/custody items are not owned. Candidate abilities are not stable.');
      let packet=parts.join('\n'); if (packet.length > m.maxChars) packet=packet.slice(0,m.maxChars-24)+'\n[context trimmed]'; if (WL.AuditLogger) WL.AuditLogger.append(root,'context',{ message:'Live context built in '+m.key+' mode, chars='+packet.length },50); if (!baseText) return packet; let out=String(baseText)+'\n\n'+packet; if (out.length > m.maxChars) out=out.slice(0,m.maxChars-24)+'\n[context trimmed]'; return out;
    };

    // Command surfaces: card editing is allowed; gameplay cheat mutation stays reducer-gated/non-mutating.

      },

        if (WL.SourcePolicy && source !== 'state' && source !== 'reducer' && source !== 'actor_state' && source !== 'place_state' && source !== 'item_state' && source !== 'ability_state' && source !== 'quest_state' && !WL.SourcePolicy.canUseAsCardSource(source, blob)) {

        const body = this.extractSection(text, 'Safe Profile Edits');

      parseMechanicalClaims(text) {

    function row(ok, label) {
      return { status: ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', label: label };
    }
    function warn(ok, label) {
      return { status: ok ? 'PASS' : 'WARN', label: label };
    }
    function safeRoot(root) {

        return WL.FinalPlayableProfile && typeof WL.FinalPlayableProfile.apply === 'function'

    function allPass(results) {
      return Array.isArray(results) && results.every(function(t) { return !!(t && (t.ok === true || t.status === 'PASS')); });
    }
    function runTests(fn, owner) {
      try {
        if (typeof fn !== 'function') return [{ ok:false, id:'missing', label:'test function missing' }];
        const out = owner ? fn.call(owner) : fn();
        return Array.isArray(out) ? out : [{ ok:false, id:'bad_return', label:'test function did not return an array' }];
      } catch (e) {
        return [{ ok:false, id:'exception', label:String(e && e.message || e) }];
      }
    }

        return Array.isArray(out) ? out : [{ status:'FAIL', label:'inspect did not return rows' }];
      } catch (e) {
        return [{ status:'FAIL', label:'inspect exception: ' + String(e && e.message || e) }];
      }
    }
    function countPass(rows) {
      rows = rows || [];
      return rows.filter(function(r) { return r && r.status === 'PASS'; }).length + ' / ' + rows.length + ' PASS';
    }

      return {
        status: status || 'WARN',
        id: id || '',
        label: label || '',
        detail: detail || '',
        next: next || ''
      };
    }
    function pass(id, label, detail) { return row('PASS', id, label, detail || '', ''); }
    function warn(id, label, detail) { return row('WARN', id, label, detail || '', ''); }
    function blocked(id, label, next, detail) { return row('BLOCKED', id, label, detail || '', next || 'future owner implementation required'); }
    function fail(id, label, detail) { return row('FAIL', id, label, detail || '', 'fix before continuing'); }
    function has(path) {
      var parts = String(path || '').split('.'), obj = WL;
      for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
        if (!obj || typeof obj[parts[i]] === 'undefined') return false;
        obj = obj[parts[i]];
      }
      return true;
    }
    function isFn(path) {
      var parts = String(path || '').split('.'), obj = WL;
      for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
        if (!obj || typeof obj[parts[i]] === 'undefined') return false;
        obj = obj[parts[i]];
      }
      return typeof obj === 'function';
    }
    function moduleRow(path, id, label, blockerLabel) {
      return has(path) ? pass(id, label || (path + ' present')) : blocked(id, blockerLabel || (path + ' not implemented yet'), 'create native owner: WL.' + path);
    }
    function commandOutputIsSuppressed(root) {
      return !!(root && root.runtime && typeof root.runtime.suppressEventScanForCommandOutput !== 'undefined'
        && typeof root.runtime.lastCommandOutputHash !== 'undefined'
        && WL.Runtime && typeof WL.Runtime.setCommandSuppression === 'function'
        && typeof WL.Runtime.shouldSuppressEventScan === 'function');
    }
    function statusSummary(rows) {
      rows = rows || [];
      var out = { PASS:0, WARN:0, BLOCKED:0, FAIL:0, total: rows.length };
      rows.forEach(function (r) { var s = r && r.status || 'WARN'; out[s] = (out[s] || 0) + 1; });
      return out;
    }
    function noFail(rows) {
      return (rows || []).filter(function (r) { return r && r.status === 'FAIL'; }).length === 0;
    }
