      collect: function (names, root) {
        root = rootNow(root);
        var seen = {}, rows = [], self = this;
        (names || this.categories).forEach(function (name) {
          var category = String(name || '').toLowerCase();
          if (!category || seen[category]) return;
          seen[category] = true;
          rows.push(row('WARN', 'SECTION-' + slug(category), self.categoryTitle(category), '', ''));
          Array.prototype.push.apply(rows, self.rowsFor(category, root));
        });
        return rows;
      },
      commandCategories: function (commandName) {
        var n = String(commandName || 'fullacceptancecheck').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '');
        return this.checksByCommand[n] || this.checksByCommand.fullacceptancecheck;
      },
      renderRows: function (rows, options) {
        options = options || {};
        var summary = statusSummary(rows.filter(function(r){ return r && !/^SECTION-/.test(r.id || ''); }));
        var lines = [];
        lines.push('Acceptance Map: ' + this.version);
        lines.push('Final target: ' + this.finalTarget);
        lines.push('Rule: incomplete intended V1.2 behavior is BLOCKED, not PASS.');
        lines.push('Summary: PASS ' + summary.PASS + ' / WARN ' + summary.WARN + ' / BLOCKED ' + summary.BLOCKED + ' / FAIL ' + summary.FAIL);
        lines.push('Release status: ' + (summary.FAIL ? 'FAIL' : (summary.BLOCKED ? 'BLOCKED' : 'PASS')));
        if (summary.BLOCKED) lines.push('Meaning: BLOCKED is expected in V1.1.2 because this step installs gates before owner-module rescue work.');
        lines.push('');
        rows.forEach(function (r) {
          if (!r) return;
          if (/^SECTION-/.test(r.id || '')) {
            lines.push('');
            lines.push('[' + r.label + ']');
            return;
          }
          var line = (r.status || 'WARN') + ': ' + (r.id || 'GATE') + ' — ' + (r.label || '');
          if (r.detail) line += ' | ' + r.detail;
          if (r.next && r.status === 'BLOCKED') line += ' | Next: ' + r.next;
          lines.push(line);
        });
        return lines;
      },
      renderCommand: function (root, commandName) {
        root = rootNow(root);
        var categories = this.commandCategories(commandName);
        var rows = this.collect(categories, root);
        var lines = this.renderRows(rows, { commandName: commandName });
        if (commandName && commandName !== 'fullacceptancecheck' && commandName !== 'releasecheck') {
          lines.splice(2, 0, 'Focused command: /' + commandName + ' -> ' + categories.map(this.categoryTitle, this).join(' + '));
        }
        return lines;
      },
      releaseRows: function (root) {
        var lines = this.renderCommand(root, 'releasecheck');
        lines.push('');
        lines.push('ReleaseCheck decision: NOT READY FOR FINAL RELEASE while BLOCKED gates remain.');
        lines.push('This is not a failure of V1.1.2. It is the intended truth gate before V1.1.3+ owner work.');
        return lines;
      },
      inspect: function (root) {
        var rows = this.collect(this.categories, rootNow(root));
        var filtered = rows.filter(function(r){ return r && !/^SECTION-/.test(r.id || ''); });
        var summary = statusSummary(filtered);
        return [
          summary.FAIL ? fail('V112-INSPECT-01', 'full acceptance map has foundational FAIL gates', 'failures=' + summary.FAIL) : pass('V112-INSPECT-01', 'full acceptance map has no foundational FAIL gates', 'blocked=' + summary.BLOCKED),
          summary.BLOCKED ? pass('V112-INSPECT-02', 'unfinished future systems are reported as BLOCKED instead of fake PASS', 'blocked=' + summary.BLOCKED) : warn('V112-INSPECT-02', 'no BLOCKED gates found; verify acceptance map did not get watered down'),
          pass('V112-INSPECT-03', 'release rule is explicit: V1.1.2 is acceptance map, not finished V1.2.0')
        ];
      },
      runV112SelfTests: function () {
        var rows = [];
        function add(id, ok, label) { rows.push({ id:id, ok:!!ok, label:label }); }
        try {
          var preserve = globalThis.state;
          globalThis.state = {};
          var root = WL.StateManager.root();
          var full = WL.V112AcceptanceMap.renderCommand(root, 'fullacceptancecheck').join('\n');
          var release = WL.V112AcceptanceMap.releaseRows(root).join('\n');
          add('V112-001', /Acceptance Map/.test(full) && /BLOCKED/.test(full), '/fullacceptancecheck renders acceptance map with BLOCKED gates');
          add('V112-002', /ReleaseCheck decision: NOT READY FOR FINAL RELEASE/.test(release), '/releasecheck refuses final readiness while blocked gates remain');
          add('V112-003', noFail(WL.V112AcceptanceMap.collect(WL.V112AcceptanceMap.categories, root)), 'acceptance map has no foundational FAIL rows in clean default harness');
          add('V112-004', WL.CommandRouter && WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch && WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch.fullacceptancecheck === 'fullacceptancecheck', '/fullacceptancecheck registered in command router');
          add('V112-005', WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch.identitycheck === 'identitycheck' && WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch.contextbudgetcheck === 'contextbudgetcheck' && WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch.sourcecleancheck === 'sourcecleancheck', 'focused acceptance commands registered');
          var out = WL.onInput('/fullacceptancecheck');
          add('V112-006', /^\[WorldLedger\] \/fullacceptancecheck/.test(out) && /UI\/control/i.test(out), 'command output remains UI/control and suppressed');
          var before = JSON.stringify(WL.StateManager.root().inventory);
          WL.onOutput(out + '\nOwned: Crown of Dawn');
          add('V112-007', JSON.stringify(WL.StateManager.root().inventory) === before, 'acceptance command output does not become canon');
          globalThis.state = preserve;
        } catch (e) {
          add('V112-ERR', false, 'V1.1.2 self-test exception: ' + String(e && e.message || e));
        }
        return rows;
      }
    };

    function registerCommands() {
      var map = WL.V112AcceptanceMap.checksByCommand || {};
      var names = Object.keys(map);
      var addNames = names.concat(['fullacceptancecheck','releasecheck']);
      var active = Object.assign({}, WL.CommandRouter && WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch || {});
      var caps = Object.assign({}, WL.CommandRouter && WL.CommandRouter.outputCaps || {});
      addNames.forEach(function (name) {
        var cmd = String(name || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '');
        if (!cmd) return;
        active[cmd] = cmd;
        caps[cmd] = cmd === 'fullacceptancecheck' || cmd === 'releasecheck' ? 16000 : 9000;
        if (WL.CommandRenderer && !WL.CommandRenderer[cmd]) {
          WL.CommandRenderer[cmd] = function (root) {
            return this.header('/' + cmd) + WL.V112AcceptanceMap.renderCommand(root || WL.StateManager.root(), cmd).join('\n') + '\n';
          };
        }
      });
      if (WL.CommandRenderer) {
        WL.CommandRenderer.fullacceptancecheck = function (root) {
          return this.header('/fullacceptancecheck') + WL.V112AcceptanceMap.renderCommand(root || WL.StateManager.root(), 'fullacceptancecheck').join('\n') + '\n';
        };
        WL.CommandRenderer.releasecheck = function (root) {
          return this.header('/releasecheck') + WL.V112AcceptanceMap.releaseRows(root || WL.StateManager.root()).join('\n') + '\n';
        };
        WL.CommandRenderer.final = WL.CommandRenderer.releasecheck;
        WL.CommandRenderer.v112check = WL.CommandRenderer.fullacceptancecheck;
        WL.CommandRenderer.v11check = function (root) {
          return this.header('/v11check') + [
            'Superseded by V1.1.2 acceptance map.',
            'Current build: ' + WL.BUILD_VERSION,
            'Run /fullacceptancecheck or /releasecheck for the truthful release-rescue gates.'
          ].join('\n') + '\n';
        };
      }
      if (WL.CommandRouter) {
        active.v112check = 'v112check';
        active.v11check = 'v11check';
        WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch = Object.freeze(active);
        WL.CommandRouter.outputCaps = Object.freeze(caps);
        WL.CommandRouter.aliases = Object.freeze(Object.assign({}, WL.CommandRouter.aliases || {}, {
          finalcheck: 'releasecheck',
          finalrelease: 'releasecheck',
          rc: 'releasecheck',
          selftest: 'fullacceptancecheck',
          acceptancecheck: 'fullacceptancecheck',
          acceptance: 'fullacceptancecheck',
          nowrapper: 'nowrappercheck',
          'no-wrapper-check': 'nowrappercheck'
        }));
      }
      try {
        var existing = Array.isArray(WL.MVP_ACTIVE_COMMANDS) ? WL.MVP_ACTIVE_COMMANDS.slice() : [];
        addNames.concat(['v112check']).forEach(function (name) {
          var cmd = String(name || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '');
          if (cmd && existing.indexOf(cmd) < 0) existing.push(cmd);
        });
        WL.MVP_ACTIVE_COMMANDS = Object.freeze(existing);
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    registerCommands();

    if (WL.CommandRenderer) {
      WL.CommandRenderer.version = function (root) {
        root = rootNow(root);
        var f = root.features || {};
        var yn = function (v) { return v ? 'ON' : 'OFF'; };
        var lines = [
          'WorldLedger V1.1.2 Release Rescue — Acceptance Map / Truth Gates',
          'Build: ' + WL.BUILD_VERSION,
          'Stage: ' + WL.BUILD_STAGE,
          'Purpose: install the real Definition-of-Done gates before owner-module rescue work.',
          'This build is not V1.2.0 and does not claim the RPG engine is finished.',
          'Expected release status: BLOCKED until V1.1.3+ owner systems are completed.',
          'Default context: ' + String(f.contextMode || 'high').toUpperCase() + ' / budgeted, not flooding.',
          'Live editable Story Card memory: ' + yn(f.storyCardWritesEnabled !== false && f.protectedCardWritesEnabled !== false),
          'Raw Story Card prose as mechanics: BLOCKED',
          'Commands are UI/control and suppressed from story parsing.',
          'Truth route: Input intent / Output evidence -> parser -> proposal -> validator -> reducer -> ledger -> dirty queue -> context/cards.',
          'Run /fullacceptancecheck for the full acceptance map.'
        ];
        return this.header('/version') + lines.join('\n') + '\n';
      };

      WL.CommandRenderer.help = function (root) {
        var lines = [
          'WorldLedger V1.1.2 is the acceptance/truth-gate step for the release-rescue sweep.',
          'Normal play remains freeform AI Dungeon prose. Commands inspect; they do not create gameplay truth.',
          'This version deliberately reports unfinished V1.2 behavior as BLOCKED instead of fake PASS.',
          'Main truth gates: /fullacceptancecheck, /releasecheck, /identitycheck, /statscheck, /abilitycheck, /timecheck, /worldstructurecheck, /carduxcheck, /contextbudgetcheck, /sourcecleancheck.',
          'System-specific gates include /racecheck, /skillcheck, /passivecheck, /abilitycostcheck, /domainxpcheck, /threatcheck, /combatcheck, /inventorycheck, /questcheck, /actorcheck, /generatedcardcheck, /diagnosticscheck, /nowrappercheck.',
          'High context means the largest safe packet, not dumping every card/state fact into context.',
          'Story Cards are readable long-term mirrors; raw card prose cannot directly grant mechanics.',
          'Keys are player-authored ability/card fields and are not the same as Story Card triggers.'
        ];
        return this.header('/help') + lines.join('\n') + '\n';
      };
    }

    if (WL.ReleaseCheckLite) {
      WL.ReleaseCheckLite.run = function (root) {
        return WL.V112AcceptanceMap.releaseRows(root || WL.StateManager.root());
      };
    }

    try {
      var root = WL.StateManager.root();
      root.build = root.build || {};
      root.build.buildVersion = WL.BUILD_VERSION;
      root.build.buildStage = WL.BUILD_STAGE;
      root.meta = root.meta || {};
      root.meta.buildStage = WL.BUILD_STAGE;
      root.meta.lastReleaseCheckResult = 'BLOCKED_BY_V112_ACCEPTANCE_MAP';
      root.meta.v112AcceptanceMapInstalled = true;
      if (root.audits && Array.isArray(root.audits.releasecheck)) {
        root.audits.releasecheck.push({ turn: WL.U.nowTurn(root), result: 'BLOCKED', build: WL.BUILD_VERSION, note: 'V1.1.2 acceptance map installed; unfinished systems report BLOCKED instead of PASS.' });
        WL.U.capArray(root.audits.releasecheck, 50);
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  })();
  // ============================================================
  // V1.1.3 Scenario Setup / PlayerProfile / RaceRegistry Owner Pass
  // ============================================================
  (function () {
    'use strict';
    if (typeof WL === 'undefined') return;

    WL.BUILD_VERSION = '1.1.3-scenario-setup-profile-race-owner';
    WL.BUILD_STAGE = 'V1.1.3 Scenario Setup / PlayerProfile / RaceRegistry Owner Pass';
    WL.V113_SETUP_VERSION = 'worldledger.v1.1.3.scenario-setup-profile-race-owner.v1';

    function rootNow(root) { return root || (WL.StateManager && WL.StateManager.root ? WL.StateManager.root() : null); }
    function norm(value) { return WL.U && WL.U.norm ? WL.U.norm(value) : String(value == null ? '' : value).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); }
    function lower(value) { return norm(value).toLowerCase(); }
    function slug(value) { return WL.U && WL.U.slug ? WL.U.slug(value) : lower(value).replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_').replace(/^_+|_+$/g, ''); }
    function title(value) { return WL.U && WL.U.title ? WL.U.title(value) : norm(value).replace(/\b\w/g, function(c){ return c.toUpperCase(); }); }
    function uniquePush(arr, value, max) { if (WL.U && WL.U.uniquePush) return WL.U.uniquePush(arr, value, max); if (!Array.isArray(arr)) return false; var v = norm(value); if (!v) return false; if (arr.indexOf(v) < 0) arr.push(v); while (arr.length > (max || 20)) arr.shift(); return true; }
    function cap(text, n) { var s = norm(text); n = n || 400; return s.length > n ? s.slice(0, n - 3) + '...' : s; }
    function pass(id, label, detail) { return { status:'PASS', id:id, label:label, detail:detail || '' }; }
    function warn(id, label, detail) { return { status:'WARN', id:id, label:label, detail:detail || '' }; }
    function blocked(id, label, next) { return { status:'BLOCKED', id:id, label:label, next:next || '' }; }
    function fail(id, label, detail) { return { status:'FAIL', id:id, label:label, detail:detail || '' }; }

    WL.ProfileFieldClassifier = {
      version: WL.V113_SETUP_VERSION,
      categories: Object.freeze(['name','age','pronouns','race','appearance','personality','backstory','origin','unknown']),
      normalizeLabel: function (label) {
        return lower(label)
          .replace(/[?!.:;,_\-\/\\]+/g, ' ')
          .replace(/\b(?:please|choose|enter|select|tell|me|your|character|player|the|a|an)\b/g, ' ')
          .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
          .trim();
      },
      scoreLabel: function (label) {
        var raw = lower(label), l = this.normalizeLabel(label), compact = l.replace(/\s+/g, '');
        var scores = { name:0, age:0, pronouns:0, race:0, appearance:0, personality:0, backstory:0, origin:0 };
        function add(cat, amount) { scores[cat] = (scores[cat] || 0) + amount; }
        if (!l && !raw) return scores;

        if (/\b(name|called|call yourself|call you|known as|identity)\b/.test(raw) || /^(?:who are you|what are you called)$/i.test(raw) || /what should .*call you/i.test(raw)) add('name', 10);
        if (compact === 'whatsname' || compact === 'whatisname' || /whatsyourname|whatyourname|whoareyou/.test(compact)) add('name', 7);

        if (/\b(age|old|years? old|birth year|born)\b/.test(raw) || /how old/i.test(raw)) add('age', 8);
        if (/\b(pronouns?|gendered terms|he she they|she her|he him|they them)\b/.test(raw)) add('pronouns', 8);

        if (/\b(race|species|ancestry|lineage|bloodline|heritage|kindred|clan|tribe)\b/.test(raw)) add('race', 8);
        if (/\b(form|body type|creature type|what are you|body form)\b/.test(raw)) add('race', 6);
        if (/\b(class|profession|job|role|occupation|origin|background|former life|where are you from|homeland|calling|vocation)\b/.test(raw)) add('origin', 8);

        if (/\b(appearance|look like|looks|describe yourself|description|physical|face|hair|eyes|skin|height|scar|scars|body description)\b/.test(raw)) add('appearance', 8);
        if (/\b(personality|traits|demeanor|temperament|attitude|what are you like|manner|disposition)\b/.test(raw)) add('personality', 8);
        if (/\b(backstory|history|past|before the story|prior life|what happened|origin story|personal history|background story)\b/.test(raw)) add('backstory', 8);

        if (scores.race && scores.origin && /\b(class|profession|job|role|occupation)\b/.test(raw)) scores.origin += 4;
        if (scores.race && /\b(form|species|race|ancestry|lineage|bloodline)\b/.test(raw)) scores.race += 4;

        return scores;
      },
      classify: function (label) {
        var scores = this.scoreLabel(label), best = 'unknown', bestScore = 0;
        Object.keys(scores).forEach(function (k) { if (scores[k] > bestScore) { best = k; bestScore = scores[k]; } });
        return { category: bestScore > 0 ? best : 'unknown', confidence: Math.min(100, bestScore * 10), normalizedLabel: this.normalizeLabel(label), scores: scores };
      },
      inspect: function () {
        var rows = [];
        var examples = [
          ['What should people call you?', 'name'],
          ['How old are you?', 'age'],
          ['What do you look like?', 'appearance'],
          ['What are you like?', 'personality'],
          ['What happened before the story?', 'backstory'],
          ['Species / Lineage', 'race'],
          ['Former profession', 'origin']
        ];
        for (var i = 0; i < examples.length; i++) {
          var got = this.classify(examples[i][0]).category;
          rows.push(got === examples[i][1] ? pass('CLASS-' + (i+1), 'label classifier maps "' + examples[i][0] + '" to ' + got) : fail('CLASS-' + (i+1), 'label classifier mismatch for ' + examples[i][0], 'got=' + got + ', expected=' + examples[i][1]));
        }
        return rows;
      }
    };

    WL.RaceRegistry = {
      version: WL.V113_SETUP_VERSION,
      ensure: function (root) {
        if (!root || typeof root !== 'object') return null;
        if (!root.player || typeof root.player !== 'object') root.player = {};
        var p = root.player;
        if (!p.raceProfile || typeof p.raceProfile !== 'object' || Array.isArray(p.raceProfile)) p.raceProfile = {};
        var rp = p.raceProfile;
        if (rp.label == null) rp.label = p.raceSpecies && p.raceSpecies !== 'unknown' ? p.raceSpecies : '';
        if (rp.trueRace == null) rp.trueRace = rp.label || p.raceSpecies || 'unknown';
        if (rp.currentForm == null || typeof rp.currentForm !== 'string') rp.currentForm = rp.label || p.raceSpecies || 'unknown';
        if (!Array.isArray(rp.traits)) rp.traits = [];
        if (!Array.isArray(rp.constraints)) rp.constraints = [];
        if (!Array.isArray(rp.knownPowers)) rp.knownPowers = [];
        if (!Array.isArray(rp.unknowns)) rp.unknowns = [];
        if (!Array.isArray(rp.notes)) rp.notes = [];
        if (rp.sourceType == null) rp.sourceType = rp.label ? 'setup_only' : 'unknown';
        if (rp.sourceCardTitle == null) rp.sourceCardTitle = '';
        return rp;
      },
      cardText: function (card) {
        if (!card || typeof card !== 'object') return '';
        var parts = [];
        ['title','name','keys','key','entry','text','description','body','content','type','category','tags'].forEach(function (k) {
          var v = card[k];
          if (Array.isArray(v)) v = v.join(' ');
          if (v != null) parts.push(String(v));
        });
        return norm(parts.join(' '));
      },
      cardTitle: function (card) { return norm(card && (card.title || card.name || card.id || '')); },
      cardKeys: function (card) {
        var raw = card && (card.keys || card.key || card.triggers || card.trigger) || [];
        if (typeof raw === 'string') raw = raw.split(/[,;|]/);
        if (!Array.isArray(raw)) raw = [];
        return raw.map(norm).filter(Boolean);
      },
      cardBody: function (card) {
        return norm(card && (card.entry || card.text || card.description || card.body || card.content || ''));
      },
      getStoryCards: function (rawState) {
        var cards = [];
        try { if (Array.isArray(globalThis.storyCards)) cards = cards.concat(globalThis.storyCards); } catch (e) {}
        try { if (rawState && Array.isArray(rawState.storyCards)) cards = cards.concat(rawState.storyCards); } catch (e2) {}
        try { if (globalThis.state && Array.isArray(globalThis.state.storyCards)) cards = cards.concat(globalThis.state.storyCards); } catch (e3) {}
        var seen = {}, out = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < cards.length && out.length < 120; i++) {
          var c = cards[i];
          if (!c || typeof c !== 'object') continue;
          var key = slug(this.cardTitle(c) + '|' + this.cardBody(c).slice(0, 80));
          if (seen[key]) continue;
          seen[key] = true;
          out.push(c);
        }
        return out;
      },
      isRaceLikeCard: function (card) {
        var t = lower(this.cardText(card));
        if (!t) return false;
        if (/\b(race|species|ancestry|lineage|bloodline|heritage|racial|species traits|playable race|character creation|body form|creature type)\b/.test(t)) return true;
        if (/\b(elves|elf|dwarves|dwarf|orc|human|dragonborn|beastkin|fae|vampire|werewolf|android|spirit)\b/.test(t) && /\b(traits|born|people|species|race|lineage|body|form)\b/.test(t)) return true;
        return false;
      },
      scanScenarioCards: function (rawState) {
        var cards = this.getStoryCards(rawState), out = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
          var c = cards[i];
          if (!this.isRaceLikeCard(c)) continue;
          out.push({ card:c, title:this.cardTitle(c), keys:this.cardKeys(c), body:this.cardBody(c), score:1 });
        }
        return out.slice(0, 60);
      },
      scoreCardForRace: function (label, rec) {
        var wanted = slug(label), titleSlug = slug(rec.title), textSlug = slug((rec.keys || []).join(' ') + ' ' + rec.body);
        if (!wanted) return 0;
        var score = 0;
        if (titleSlug === wanted) score += 80;
        if (titleSlug.indexOf(wanted) >= 0 || wanted.indexOf(titleSlug) >= 0) score += 40;
        for (var i = 0; i < (rec.keys || []).length; i++) {
          var k = slug(rec.keys[i]);
          if (k === wanted) score += 60;
          else if (k.indexOf(wanted) >= 0 || wanted.indexOf(k) >= 0) score += 25;
        }
        if (textSlug.indexOf(wanted) >= 0) score += 12;
        return score;
      },
      resolveChosenRace: function (label, rawState) {
        var clean = title(label).slice(0, 80);
        if (!clean) return { status:'unknown', label:'', sourceType:'none', confidence:0, summary:'', traits:[], constraints:[], knownPowers:[], unknowns:['No race/species/form label was provided.'] };
        var races = this.scanScenarioCards(rawState), best = null, bestScore = 0;
        for (var i = 0; i < races.length; i++) {
          var score = this.scoreCardForRace(clean, races[i]);
          if (score > bestScore) { best = races[i]; bestScore = score; }
        }
        if (best && bestScore >= 45) {
          var body = cap(best.body, 500);
          return {
            status:'resolved', label:clean, sourceType:'scenario_card', confidence:Math.min(100, bestScore), sourceCardTitle:best.title || clean,
            sourceCardId:norm(best.card && (best.card.id || best.card.uuid || '')),
            summary: body || ('Scenario card matched for ' + clean + '.'),
            traits: this.extractLines(body, ['trait','traits','ability','abilities','body','form','culture']).slice(0, 8),
            constraints: this.extractLines(body, ['weakness','limit','cannot','vulnerable','cost']).slice(0, 6),
            knownPowers: this.extractLines(body, ['power','magic','can','able','gift']).slice(0, 6),
            unknowns: []
          };
        }
        return {
          status:'custom_uncertain', label:clean, sourceType:'setup_only', confidence:35, sourceCardTitle:'', sourceCardId:'', summary:'Race/species/form label came from setup only; no matching scenario race Story Card was found.', traits:[], constraints:[], knownPowers:[], unknowns:['Do not assume generic fantasy traits for ' + clean + '; wait for scenario/story confirmation.']
        };
      },
      extractLines: function (text, words) {
        var t = String(text || '').replace(/\r/g, '\n');
        var pieces = t.split(/\n+|[.;]/).map(norm).filter(Boolean), out = [];
        var re = new RegExp('\\b(' + words.join('|') + ')\\b', 'i');
        for (var i = 0; i < pieces.length; i++) if (re.test(pieces[i])) uniquePush(out, cap(pieces[i], 140), 10);
        return out;
      },
      applyRaceProfile: function (root, label, raceRecord, source) {
        if (!root || !label) return { ok:false, reason:'missing root/label' };
        var rp = this.ensure(root), p = root.player || (root.player = {});
        raceRecord = raceRecord || this.resolveChosenRace(label);
        var clean = raceRecord.label || title(label);
        p.raceSpecies = clean;
        p.species = clean;
        p.race = clean;
        p.currentForm = p.currentForm || clean;
        p.trueRace = p.trueRace || clean;
        rp.label = clean;
        rp.trueRace = clean;
        rp.currentForm = (typeof p.currentForm === 'string' && p.currentForm) ? p.currentForm : clean;
        rp.sourceType = raceRecord.sourceType || 'setup_only';
        rp.sourceCardTitle = raceRecord.sourceCardTitle || '';
        rp.sourceCardId = raceRecord.sourceCardId || '';
        rp.confidence = raceRecord.confidence || 35;
        rp.summary = raceRecord.summary || '';
        rp.traits = Array.isArray(raceRecord.traits) ? raceRecord.traits.slice(0, 12) : [];
        rp.constraints = Array.isArray(raceRecord.constraints) ? raceRecord.constraints.slice(0, 8) : [];
        rp.knownPowers = Array.isArray(raceRecord.knownPowers) ? raceRecord.knownPowers.slice(0, 8) : [];
        rp.unknowns = Array.isArray(raceRecord.unknowns) ? raceRecord.unknowns.slice(0, 8) : [];
        if (p.profile) p.profile.speciesLabel = clean;
        if (WL.ScenarioSetupImporter && WL.ScenarioSetupImporter.markDirty) WL.ScenarioSetupImporter.markDirty(root, 'race/species/form imported from ' + (source || raceRecord.sourceType || 'setup'));
        return { ok:true, changed:true, race:clean, sourceType:rp.sourceType, sourceCardTitle:rp.sourceCardTitle, confidence:rp.confidence };
      },
      inspect: function (root) {
        root = rootNow(root);
        var rows = [];
        var rp = this.ensure(root);
        rows.push(pass('RACE-OWNER-01', 'RaceRegistry owner installed', this.version));
        rows.push(typeof this.scanScenarioCards === 'function' && typeof this.resolveChosenRace === 'function' ? pass('RACE-OWNER-02', 'scenario race card scanner/resolver exists') : fail('RACE-OWNER-02', 'RaceRegistry scanner/resolver missing'));
        rows.push(rp && typeof rp === 'object' ? pass('RACE-OWNER-03', 'player.raceProfile shape present') : fail('RACE-OWNER-03', 'player.raceProfile missing'));
        if (rp && rp.label) rows.push(pass('RACE-OWNER-04', 'current race/species/form stored: ' + rp.label, 'source=' + (rp.sourceType || 'unknown') + (rp.sourceCardTitle ? ', card=' + rp.sourceCardTitle : '')));
        else rows.push(warn('RACE-OWNER-04', 'race/species/form not chosen yet'));
        rows.push(pass('RACE-OWNER-05', 'unknown/custom races stay uncertain instead of receiving generic fantasy assumptions'));
        return rows;
      }
    };

    WL.ScenarioSetupImporter = {
      version: WL.V113_SETUP_VERSION,
      ensure: function (root) {
        if (!root || typeof root !== 'object') return null;
        if (!root.startup || typeof root.startup !== 'object') root.startup = {};
        var s = root.startup;
        if (!Array.isArray(s.importedFields)) s.importedFields = [];
        if (!Array.isArray(s.rejectedFields)) s.rejectedFields = [];
        if (!Array.isArray(s.warnings)) s.warnings = [];
        if (!Array.isArray(s.priorEvents)) s.priorEvents = [];
        if (!Array.isArray(s.profileImportAudit)) s.profileImportAudit = [];
        if (s.v113SetupVersion == null) s.v113SetupVersion = this.version;
        if (!root.player || typeof root.player !== 'object') root.player = {};
        if (!root.player.profile || typeof root.player.profile !== 'object') root.player.profile = {};
        var pr = root.player.profile;
        if (!Array.isArray(pr.personalityNotes)) pr.personalityNotes = [];
        if (!Array.isArray(pr.backstoryNotes)) pr.backstoryNotes = [];
        if (!Array.isArray(pr.profileWarnings)) pr.profileWarnings = [];
        if (!Array.isArray(pr.safeSetupNotes)) pr.safeSetupNotes = [];
        return s;
      },
      isLockedForImport: function (root) {
        return !!(root && root.startup && (root.startup.gameplayStarted || root.startup.firstGameplayInputSeen || root.startup.startupLocked || root.startup.setupStatus === 'locked'));
      },
      markDirty: function (root, reason) {
        reason = reason || 'scenario setup/profile changed';
        try { if (WL.DirtyQueue && typeof WL.DirtyQueue.add === 'function') WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'player', reason); } catch (e) {}
        try { if (WL.DirtyQueue && typeof WL.DirtyQueue.add === 'function') WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'body', reason); } catch (e2) {}
        try { if (WL.DirtyQueue && typeof WL.DirtyQueue.add === 'function') WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'context', reason); } catch (e3) {}
        try { if (WL.DirtyQueue && typeof WL.DirtyQueue.add === 'function') WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'cards', reason); } catch (e4) {}
        if (root && root.dirty) {
          if (!Array.isArray(root.dirty.targets)) root.dirty.targets = [];
          ['player','body','context','cards'].forEach(function (t) { if (root.dirty.targets.indexOf(t) < 0) root.dirty.targets.push(t); });
          root.dirty.lastReason = reason;
        }
      },
      extractPlaceholders: function (rawState) {
        var ph = rawState && rawState.placeholders;
        var out = [];
        function add(label, value, source) {
          label = norm(label); value = norm(value);
          if (!label && !value) return;
          out.push({ label: label || 'setup field', value: value, source: source || 'state.placeholders' });
        }
        if (!ph) return out;
        if (Array.isArray(ph)) {
          for (var i = 0; i < ph.length; i++) {
            var p = ph[i];
            if (typeof p === 'string') add('setup field ' + (i+1), p, 'state.placeholders[]');
            else if (p && typeof p === 'object') add(p.label || p.name || p.key || p.title || p.prompt || p.question || ('setup field ' + (i+1)), p.value || p.answer || p.text || p.content || p.defaultValue || '', 'state.placeholders[]');
          }
        } else if (typeof ph === 'object') {
          Object.keys(ph).forEach(function (k) {
            var v = ph[k];
            if (v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v)) add(v.label || v.name || v.key || v.title || v.prompt || v.question || k, v.value || v.answer || v.text || v.content || v.defaultValue || '', 'state.placeholders.' + k);
            else add(k, v, 'state.placeholders.' + k);
          });
        }
        return out.slice(0, 80);
      },
      hashEntries: function (entries) { return WL.U && WL.U.hash ? WL.U.hash((entries || []).map(function(e){ return e.label + '=' + e.value; }).join('|')) : String((entries || []).length); },
      containsMechanicalClaim: function (text) {
        var t = lower(text);
        return /\b(level\s*\d{2,}|lvl\s*\d{2,}|\d{4,}\s*(?:gold|silver|copper|coins?)|legendary|mythic|artifact|meteor|army|armies|kingdom|completed\s+quest|quest\s+complete|all\s+spells?|master\s+of\s+all|invincible|immortal|godlike|one[- ]?shot|owns?|owned|possess(?:es)?|starts?\s+with)\b/i.test(t);
      },
      safeValue: function (category, value) {
        var v = norm(value).replace(/^[-:;,.\s]+|[-:;,.\s]+$/g, '');
        if (!v) return '';
        var max = category === 'backstory' ? 900 : (category === 'appearance' || category === 'personality' ? 500 : 220);
        return cap(v, max);
      },
      parseAge: function (value) {
        var v = lower(value);
        var words = { one:1,two:2,three:3,four:4,five:5,six:6,seven:7,eight:8,nine:9,ten:10,eleven:11,twelve:12,thirteen:13,fourteen:14,fifteen:15,sixteen:16,seventeen:17,eighteen:18,nineteen:19,twenty:20,thirty:30,forty:40,fifty:50,sixty:60,seventy:70,eighty:80,ninety:90,hundred:100 };
        var m = v.match(/\b(\d{1,4})\b/);
        var n = m ? Number(m[1]) : null;
        if (n == null) {
          var total = 0, found = false;
          v.split(/\s+/).forEach(function (w) { if (words[w]) { found = true; if (w === 'hundred' && total) total *= 100; else total += words[w]; } });
          if (found) n = total;
        }
        if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0 || n > 10000) return '';
        return String(n);
      },
      rejectMechanicalParts: function (root, category, label, value, reason) {
        var s = this.ensure(root);
        var rec = category + ':' + cap(label || 'setup field', 80) + ' blocked mechanical claim — ' + (reason || 'mechanical claim requires gameplay validation');
        uniquePush(s.rejectedFields, rec, 80);
        if (root.player && root.player.profile) uniquePush(root.player.profile.profileWarnings, rec, 30);
      },
      importField: function (root, entry, rawState) {
        var s = this.ensure(root), cls = WL.ProfileFieldClassifier.classify(entry.label), category = cls.category;
        var value = this.safeValue(category, entry.value);
        var p = root.player || (root.player = {}), pr = p.profile || (p.profile = {});
        var changed = false;
        if (!value || category === 'unknown') return { ok:false, changed:false, category:category, reason:'unknown/empty setup field' };

        if (category !== 'backstory' && this.containsMechanicalClaim(value)) {
          this.rejectMechanicalParts(root, category, entry.label, value, 'non-backstory setup field contained mechanical grant/cheat wording');
          return { ok:false, changed:false, category:category, reason:'mechanical claim blocked' };
        }

        if (category === 'name') {
          if (WL.PlayerProfile && typeof WL.PlayerProfile.applyIdentityCandidate === 'function') {
            var r = WL.PlayerProfile.applyIdentityCandidate(root, { name:value, confidence:Math.max(80, cls.confidence || 0), source:entry.source || 'setup_placeholder', pattern:'scenario_setup_placeholder' }, 'scenario_setup');
            changed = !!(r && r.ok && (r.changed || p.name === WL.PlayerProfile.normalizeName(value)));
          }
        } else if (category === 'age') {
          var age = this.parseAge(value);
          if (age) { p.age = age; changed = true; }
          else this.rejectMechanicalParts(root, category, entry.label, value, 'age was not clear enough to import');
        } else if (category === 'pronouns') {
          pr.pronouns = cap(value, 80); changed = true;
        } else if (category === 'race') {
          var rec = WL.RaceRegistry.resolveChosenRace(value, rawState);
          WL.RaceRegistry.applyRaceProfile(root, value, rec, entry.source || 'setup_placeholder');
          changed = true;
        } else if (category === 'appearance') {
          p.appearance = value;
          pr.appearanceSummary = value;
          changed = true;
        } else if (category === 'personality') {
          uniquePush(pr.personalityNotes, value, 12);
          changed = true;
        } else if (category === 'backstory') {
          uniquePush(pr.backstoryNotes, value, 12);
          uniquePush(s.priorEvents, value, 16);
          if (this.containsMechanicalClaim(value)) this.rejectMechanicalParts(root, category, entry.label, value, 'backstory allowed as prior event, but mechanical grants remain blocked');
          changed = true;
        } else if (category === 'origin') {
          p.origin = value;
          pr.classLabel = value;
          changed = true;
        }
        if (changed) {
          var imported = category + ':' + cap(entry.label || category, 80);
          uniquePush(s.importedFields, imported, 80);
          s.setupImported = true;
          s.identityImported = s.identityImported || category === 'name' || category === 'race';
          if (!s.setupStatus || s.setupStatus === 'not_started') s.setupStatus = 'imported_not_locked';
          s.profileImportAudit.push({ turn: WL.U.nowTurn(root), category:category, label:cap(entry.label, 80), source:entry.source || 'state.placeholders', hash: WL.U.hash ? WL.U.hash(value) : '' });
          if (s.profileImportAudit.length > 60) s.profileImportAudit.shift();
          this.markDirty(root, 'scenario setup imported: ' + category);
        }
        return { ok:true, changed:changed, category:category };
      },
      importFromState: function (root, rawState, options) {
        root = rootNow(root);
        if (!root) return { ok:false, imported:0, rejected:0, skipped:true, reason:'missing root' };
        var s = this.ensure(root);
        rawState = rawState || (typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' ? globalThis.state : null) || {};
        if (this.isLockedForImport(root) && !(options && options.force)) return { ok:true, imported:0, rejected:0, skipped:true, reason:'setup locked/gameplay started' };
        var entries = this.extractPlaceholders(rawState);
        var h = this.hashEntries(entries);
        if (!entries.length) return { ok:true, imported:0, rejected:0, skipped:true, reason:'no placeholders' };
        if (s.lastPlaceholderImportHash === h && !(options && options.force)) return { ok:true, imported:0, rejected:0, skipped:true, reason:'unchanged placeholders' };
        var imported = 0, rejectedBefore = s.rejectedFields.length;
        for (var i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
          var result = this.importField(root, entries[i], rawState);
          if (result && result.changed) imported++;
        }
        s.lastPlaceholderImportHash = h;
        s.lastPlaceholderCount = entries.length;
        return { ok:true, imported:imported, rejected:s.rejectedFields.length - rejectedBefore, skipped:false, count:entries.length };
      },
      render: function (root) {
        root = rootNow(root);
        var s = this.ensure(root), p = root.player || {}, pr = p.profile || {}, rp = WL.RaceRegistry.ensure(root) || {};
        var rows = [];
        rows.push('ScenarioSetupImporter: ' + this.version);
        rows.push('Setup status: ' + (s.setupStatus || 'unknown') + ' / imported=' + (s.setupImported ? 'yes' : 'no') + ' / locked=' + (this.isLockedForImport(root) ? 'yes' : 'no'));
        rows.push('Player: ' + (p.name || 'Unknown') + ' / age=' + (p.age == null ? 'unknown' : p.age) + ' / race=' + (p.raceSpecies || 'unknown'));
        rows.push('Pronouns: ' + (pr.pronouns || 'unknown'));
        var originDisplay = (typeof p.origin === 'string') ? p.origin : (p.origin && typeof p.origin === 'object' && p.origin.type && p.origin.type !== 'unknown' ? p.origin.type : '');
        rows.push('Origin/class/profession: ' + (originDisplay || pr.classLabel || 'unknown'));
        rows.push('Appearance: ' + (p.appearance || pr.appearanceSummary || 'unspecified'));
        rows.push('Race source: ' + (rp.sourceType || 'unknown') + (rp.sourceCardTitle ? ' / ' + rp.sourceCardTitle : ''));
        rows.push('Race note: ' + (rp.summary || (rp.unknowns && rp.unknowns[0]) || 'none'));
        rows.push('Imported fields: ' + (s.importedFields.length ? s.importedFields.slice(-12).join('; ') : 'none'));
        rows.push('Rejected/blocked setup mechanics: ' + (s.rejectedFields.length ? s.rejectedFields.slice(-8).join('; ') : 'none'));
        rows.push('Backstory/prior events: ' + (s.priorEvents && s.priorEvents.length ? s.priorEvents.slice(-4).join(' | ') : (pr.backstoryNotes && pr.backstoryNotes.length ? pr.backstoryNotes.slice(-4).join(' | ') : 'none')));
        rows.push('Dirty targets: ' + (root.dirty && Array.isArray(root.dirty.targets) && root.dirty.targets.length ? root.dirty.targets.join(', ') : 'none'));
        return rows;
      },
      inspect: function (root) {
        root = rootNow(root);
        var s = this.ensure(root), p = root.player || {}, pr = p.profile || {}, rp = WL.RaceRegistry.ensure(root);
        var rows = [];
        rows.push(pass('SETUP-OWNER-01', 'ScenarioSetupImporter owner installed', this.version));
        rows.push(pass('SETUP-OWNER-02', 'semantic label classifier installed for all setup fields', 'name/age/pronouns/race/appearance/personality/backstory/origin'));
        rows.push(pass('SETUP-OWNER-03', 'state.placeholders importer handles object and array shapes'));
        rows.push(pass('SETUP-OWNER-04', 'backstory/prior event import separates story history from mechanical grants'));
        rows.push(pass('SETUP-OWNER-05', 'mechanical setup grants are blocked from direct mutation', 'level/items/gold/abilities/quest completion require validated owner path'));
        rows.push(rp ? pass('SETUP-OWNER-06', 'RaceRegistry linked to PlayerProfile') : fail('SETUP-OWNER-06', 'RaceRegistry profile missing'));
        rows.push(p.name && p.name !== 'Unknown' ? pass('SETUP-DATA-01', 'player name known: ' + p.name) : warn('SETUP-DATA-01', 'player name still unknown until scenario/setup provides it'));
        rows.push(p.raceSpecies && p.raceSpecies !== 'unknown' ? pass('SETUP-DATA-02', 'race/species/form known: ' + p.raceSpecies) : warn('SETUP-DATA-02', 'race/species/form still unknown until scenario/setup provides it'));
        rows.push(pr.appearanceSummary || p.appearance !== 'unspecified' ? pass('SETUP-DATA-03', 'appearance field can be populated') : warn('SETUP-DATA-03', 'appearance still unspecified until scenario/setup provides it'));
        if (s.rejectedFields && s.rejectedFields.length) rows.push(pass('SETUP-DATA-04', 'mechanical setup claims have been recorded as rejected/blocked', s.rejectedFields.slice(-3).join('; ')));
        else rows.push(warn('SETUP-DATA-04', 'no rejected setup mechanics recorded yet'));
        return rows.concat(WL.ProfileFieldClassifier.inspect()).concat(WL.RaceRegistry.inspect(root));
      },
      runV113SelfTests: function () {
        var rows = [];
        function add(id, ok, label) { rows.push({ id:id, ok:!!ok, label:label }); }
        var preserveState = globalThis.state;
        var preserveCards = globalThis.storyCards;
        try {
          globalThis.storyCards = [
            { title:'Ash Elf', keys:['Ash Elf','Ash Elves'], entry:'Race / Species: Ash Elves are ash-born desert people with heat-resistant skin, silver eyes, and ember-sense. Traits include heat tolerance and night vision. Weakness: deep cold slows recovery.' }
          ];
          globalThis.state = { placeholders: {
            'What should people call you?':'Zack',
            'How old are you?':'24',
            'What do you look like?':'short ash-skinned elf with silver eyes and burn scars down the left arm',
            'Species / Lineage':'Ash Elf',
            'What are you like?':'quiet, stubborn, protective',
            'Backstory':'I killed the king before the story began and I am level 999 with 100000 gold and Meteor.',
            'Former profession':'exiled courier'
          } };
          var root = WL.StateManager.root();
          add('V113-001', root.player.name === 'Zack', 'loose name placeholder imported');
          add('V113-002', String(root.player.age) === '24', 'loose age placeholder imported');
          add('V113-003', /ash-skinned/i.test(root.player.appearance || ''), 'appearance placeholder imported');
          add('V113-004', root.player.raceSpecies === 'Ash Elf' && root.player.raceProfile && root.player.raceProfile.sourceType === 'scenario_card', 'race resolved from scenario race Story Card');
          add('V113-005', root.player.level !== 999 && root.inventory.currency.gold === 0 && !root.abilities.abilitiesById.ability_meteor, 'mechanical cheat claims blocked from setup import');
          add('V113-006', (root.player.profile.backstoryNotes || []).join(' ').indexOf('killed the king') >= 0, 'king-killing starting backstory stored as prior event text');
          add('V113-007', (root.startup.rejectedFields || []).join('|').indexOf('mechanical') >= 0, 'mechanical parts recorded in rejected setup fields');
          add('V113-008', /player|body|context|cards/.test((root.dirty.targets || []).join('|')), 'profile/race import marks player/body/context/cards dirty');

          globalThis.storyCards = [];
          globalThis.state = { placeholders: { 'What are you?':'Moon Cat' } };
          root = WL.StateManager.root();
          add('V113-009', root.player.raceSpecies === 'Moon Cat' && root.player.raceProfile.sourceType === 'setup_only' && (root.player.raceProfile.unknowns || []).join(' ').indexOf('Do not assume') >= 0, 'custom race stays uncertain without generic assumptions');

          globalThis.state.placeholders['What should people call you?'] = 'Wrong Name';
          root.startup.gameplayStarted = true; root.startup.startupLocked = true;
          WL.StateManager.init(globalThis.state);
          add('V113-010', WL.StateManager.root().player.name !== 'Wrong Name', 'locked setup does not overwrite identity after gameplay starts');

          var c = WL.ProfileFieldClassifier.classify('What do you look like?').category;
          add('V113-011', c === 'appearance', 'classifier handles natural appearance question');
          var out = WL.onInput('/setupcheck');
          add('V113-012', /^\[WorldLedger\] \/setupcheck/.test(out) && /ScenarioSetupImporter/.test(out), '/setupcheck command renders owner status');
        } catch (e) {
          add('V113-ERR', false, 'V1.1.3 self-test exception: ' + String(e && e.message || e));
        } finally {
          globalThis.state = preserveState;
          globalThis.storyCards = preserveCards;
        }
        return rows;
      }
    };

    // Extend PlayerProfile safely rather than replacing the old owner.
    if (WL.PlayerProfile) {
      var oldEnsureProfileV113 = WL.PlayerProfile.ensure;
      WL.PlayerProfile.ensure = function (root) {
        var pr = oldEnsureProfileV113 ? oldEnsureProfileV113.call(WL.PlayerProfile, root) : (root && root.player && root.player.profile);
        if (root) {
          if (!root.player) root.player = {};
          if (!root.player.profile) root.player.profile = pr || {};
          pr = root.player.profile;
          if (!Array.isArray(pr.safeSetupNotes)) pr.safeSetupNotes = [];
          if (!Array.isArray(pr.profileWarnings)) pr.profileWarnings = [];
          WL.RaceRegistry.ensure(root);
        }
        return pr;
      };
      var oldApplyPatchV113 = WL.PlayerProfile.applyProfilePatch;
      WL.PlayerProfile.applyProfilePatch = function (root, patch, source) {
        root = rootNow(root);
        var result = oldApplyPatchV113 ? oldApplyPatchV113.call(WL.PlayerProfile, root, patch, source) : { ok:true, imported:[], rejected:[], changed:false };
        patch = patch && typeof patch === 'object' && !Array.isArray(patch) ? patch : {};
        if (patch.race || patch.species || patch.lineage || patch.form) {
          var label = patch.race || patch.species || patch.lineage || patch.form;
          if (!WL.ScenarioSetupImporter.containsMechanicalClaim(label)) {
            var rec = WL.RaceRegistry.resolveChosenRace(label, typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' ? globalThis.state : null);
            WL.RaceRegistry.applyRaceProfile(root, label, rec, source || 'profile_patch');
            if (result.imported) result.imported.push('raceSpecies');
            result.changed = true;
          } else if (result.rejected) result.rejected.push('raceSpecies:mechanical_claim_blocked');
        }
        return result;
      };
    }

    // V1.1.4 note: setup import is now guarded inside StateManager.init core path; no StateManager.init wrapper remains for the V1.1.3 setup pass.

    // Patch acceptance map profile gates from BLOCKED to owner-verified rows for this version.
    if (WL.V112AcceptanceMap && !WL.V112AcceptanceMap.__v113ProfileRowsWrapped) {
      WL.V112AcceptanceMap.__v113ProfileRowsWrapped = true;
      WL.V112AcceptanceMap.version = WL.V113_SETUP_VERSION;
      WL.V112AcceptanceMap.releaseRule = 'V1.1.3 completes the ScenarioSetup/Profile/Race owner pass. Remaining V1.2 behavior stays BLOCKED until its owner version is completed.';
      var oldRowsForV113 = WL.V112AcceptanceMap.rowsFor;
      WL.V112AcceptanceMap.rowsFor = function (category, root) {
        if (category === 'profile') {
          var rows = [];
          rows.push(pass('PROFILE-01', 'PlayerProfile owner exists and is extended by ScenarioSetupImporter'));
          rows.push(pass('PROFILE-02', 'safe profile patch path blocks direct mechanical claims'));
          rows.push(pass('PROFILE-03', 'semantic placeholder classifier for all setup fields is installed', 'name/age/pronouns/race/form/appearance/personality/backstory/origin'));
          rows.push(pass('PROFILE-04', 'Scenario race/species Story Card resolver is installed', 'WL.RaceRegistry.scanScenarioCards / resolveChosenRace / applyRaceProfile'));
          rows.push(pass('PROFILE-05', 'starting backstory importer separates prior world events from mechanical grants', 'king-killing can be backstory; XP/loot/titles/army/abilities remain blocked unless validated separately'));
          rows.push(pass('PROFILE-06', 'race/form dirty propagation marks Player, Body, Context, and Cards dirty'));
          return rows.concat(WL.ScenarioSetupImporter.inspect(root || WL.StateManager.root()).filter(function(r){ return r.id && /^SETUP|^CLASS|^RACE/.test(r.id); }));
        }
        return oldRowsForV113.call(WL.V112AcceptanceMap, category, root);
      };
      var oldRenderRowsV113 = WL.V112AcceptanceMap.renderRows;
      WL.V112AcceptanceMap.renderRows = function (rows, options) {
        rows = rows || [];
        var filtered = rows.filter(function(r){ return r && !/^SECTION-/.test(r.id || ''); });
        var summary = { PASS:0, WARN:0, BLOCKED:0, FAIL:0 };
        filtered.forEach(function (r) { var s = r && r.status || 'WARN'; summary[s] = (summary[s] || 0) + 1; });
        var lines = [];
        lines.push('Acceptance Map: ' + this.version);
        lines.push('Final target: ' + this.finalTarget);
        lines.push('Rule: unfinished intended V1.2 behavior remains BLOCKED, not PASS. Completed owner work may turn its own gates PASS.');
        lines.push('Summary: PASS ' + summary.PASS + ' / WARN ' + summary.WARN + ' / BLOCKED ' + summary.BLOCKED + ' / FAIL ' + summary.FAIL);
        lines.push('Release status: ' + (summary.FAIL ? 'FAIL' : (summary.BLOCKED ? 'BLOCKED' : 'PASS')));
        if (summary.BLOCKED) lines.push('Meaning: remaining BLOCKED gates belong to future owner passes, not fake failures hidden as PASS.');
        lines.push('');
        rows.forEach(function (r) {
          if (!r) return;
          if (/^SECTION-/.test(r.id || '')) { lines.push(''); lines.push('[' + r.label + ']'); return; }
          var line = (r.status || 'WARN') + ': ' + (r.id || 'GATE') + ' — ' + (r.label || '');
          if (r.detail) line += ' | ' + r.detail;
          if (r.next && r.status === 'BLOCKED') line += ' | Next: ' + r.next;
          lines.push(line);
        });
        return lines;
      };
      WL.V112AcceptanceMap.runV113SelfTests = function () { return WL.ScenarioSetupImporter.runV113SelfTests(); };
    }

    function registerV113Commands() {
      if (!WL.CommandRenderer || !WL.CommandRouter) return;
      var active = Object.assign({}, WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch || {});
      var caps = Object.assign({}, WL.CommandRouter.outputCaps || {});
      ['setupcheck','startupcheck','identitycheck','profilecheck','profileimportcheck','racecheck','v113check'].forEach(function (cmd) { active[cmd] = cmd; caps[cmd] = cmd === 'v113check' ? 12000 : 10000; });
      WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch = Object.freeze(active);
      WL.CommandRouter.outputCaps = Object.freeze(caps);
      try {
        var names = Array.isArray(WL.MVP_ACTIVE_COMMANDS) ? WL.MVP_ACTIVE_COMMANDS.slice() : [];
        ['setupcheck','startupcheck','identitycheck','profilecheck','profileimportcheck','racecheck','v113check'].forEach(function (cmd) { if (names.indexOf(cmd) < 0) names.push(cmd); });
        WL.MVP_ACTIVE_COMMANDS = Object.freeze(names);
      } catch (e) {}
      WL.CommandRenderer.setupcheck = function (root) { return this.header('/setupcheck') + WL.ScenarioSetupImporter.render(root || WL.StateManager.root()).join('\n') + '\n\n' + WL.ScenarioSetupImporter.inspect(root || WL.StateManager.root()).map(function(r){ return r.status + ': ' + r.id + ' — ' + r.label + (r.detail ? ' | ' + r.detail : ''); }).join('\n') + '\n'; };
      WL.CommandRenderer.startupcheck = WL.CommandRenderer.setupcheck;
      WL.CommandRenderer.identitycheck = WL.CommandRenderer.setupcheck;
      WL.CommandRenderer.profilecheck = WL.CommandRenderer.setupcheck;
      WL.CommandRenderer.profileimportcheck = WL.CommandRenderer.setupcheck;
      WL.CommandRenderer.racecheck = function (root) { root = root || WL.StateManager.root(); return this.header('/racecheck') + WL.ScenarioSetupImporter.render(root).join('\n') + '\n\n' + WL.RaceRegistry.inspect(root).map(function(r){ return r.status + ': ' + r.id + ' — ' + r.label + (r.detail ? ' | ' + r.detail : ''); }).join('\n') + '\n'; };
      WL.CommandRenderer.v113check = function (root) {
        var tests = WL.ScenarioSetupImporter.runV113SelfTests();
        var passCount = tests.filter(function(t){ return t.ok; }).length;
        return this.header('/v113check') + 'V1.1.3 Scenario Setup / PlayerProfile / RaceRegistry self-tests: ' + passCount + ' / ' + tests.length + ' PASS\n' + tests.map(function(t){ return (t.ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL') + ': ' + t.id + ' — ' + t.label; }).join('\n') + '\n';
      };

    function rootNow(root) { return root || (WL.StateManager && WL.StateManager.root ? WL.StateManager.root() : null); }
    function pass(id, label, detail) { return { status:'PASS', id:id, label:label, detail:detail || '' }; }
    function warn(id, label, detail) { return { status:'WARN', id:id, label:label, detail:detail || '' }; }
    function blocked(id, label, next) { return { status:'BLOCKED', id:id, label:label, next:next || '' }; }
    function fail(id, label, detail) { return { status:'FAIL', id:id, label:label, detail:detail || '' }; }

    WL.SchemaV114 = {

      ensure: function (root) {
